text_en: And the Lord spoke to Moses in the desert of Sinai in the tabernacle of the covenant , the first day of the second month, the second year of their going out of Egypt , saying:
text_la: Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen in deserto Sinai in tabernaculo fœderis, prima die mensis secundi, anno altero egressionis eorum ex Ægypto, dicens:
text_pt: Falou mais o SENHOR a Moisés no deserto de Sinai, na tenda da congregação, no primeiro dia do segundo mês, no segundo ano da sua saída da terra do Egito, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ τῇ Σινα ἐν τῇ σκηνῇ τοῦ μαρτυρίου ἐν μιᾷ τοῦ μηνὸς τοῦ δευτέρου ἔτους δευτέρου ἐξελθόντων αὐτῶν ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου λέγων

text_en: Take the sum of all the congregation of the children of Israel by their families , and houses, and the names of every one, as many as are of the male sex,
text_la: Tollite summam universæ congregationis filiorum Israël per cognationes et domos suas, et nomina singulorum, quidquid sexus est masculini
text_pt: Tomai a soma de toda a congregação dos filhos de Israel, segundo as suas famílias, segundo a casa de seus pais, conforme o número dos nomes de todo o homem, cabeça por cabeça;
text_el: λάβετε ἀρχὴν πάσης συναγωγῆς υἱῶν Ισραηλ κατὰ συγγενείας αὐτῶν κατ' οἴκους πατριῶν αὐτῶν κατὰ ἀριθμὸν ἐξ ὀνόματος αὐτῶν κατὰ κεφαλὴν αὐτῶν πᾶς ἄρσην

text_en: from twenty years old and upwards, of all the men of Israel fit for war , and you shall number them by their troops, you and Aaron .
text_la: a vigesimo anno et supra, omnium virorum fortium ex Israël, et numerabitis eos per turmas suas, tu et Aaron.
text_pt: Da idade de vinte anos para cima, todos os que em Israel podem sair à guerra, a estes contareis segundo os seus exércitos, tu e Arão.
text_el: ἀπὸ εἰκοσαετοῦς καὶ ἐπάνω πᾶς ὁ ἐκπορευόμενος ἐν δυνάμει Ισραηλ ἐπισκέψασθε αὐτοὺς σὺν δυνάμει αὐτῶν σὺ καὶ Ααρων ἐπισκέψασθε αὐτούς

text_en: And there shall be with you the princes of the tribes , and of the houses in their kindreds,
text_la: Eruntque vobiscum principes tribuum ac domorum in cognationibus suis,
text_pt: Estará convosco, de cada tribo, um homem que seja cabeça da casa de seus pais.
text_el: καὶ μεθ' ὑμῶν ἔσονται ἕκαστος κατὰ φυλὴν ἑκάστου ἀρχόντων κατ' οἴκους πατριῶν ἔσονται

text_en: whose names are these: Of Ruben , Elisur the son of Sedeur.
text_la: quorum ista sunt nomina : de Ruben, Elisur, filius Sedeur;
text_pt: Estes, pois, são os nomes dos homens que estarão convosco: De Rúben, Elizur, filho de Sedeur;
text_el: καὶ ταῦτα τὰ ὀνόματα τῶν ἀνδρῶν οἵτινες παραστήσονται μεθ' ὑμῶν τῶν Ρουβην Ελισουρ υἱὸς Σεδιουρ

text_en: Of Simeon , Salamiel the son of Surisaddai.
text_la: de Simeon, Salamiel filius Surisaddai;
text_pt: De Simeão, Selumiel, filho de Zurisadai;
text_el: τῶν Συμεων Σαλαμιηλ υἱὸς Σουρισαδαι

text_en: Of Juda , Nahasson the son of Aminadab.
text_la: de Juda, Nahasson filius Aminadab;
text_pt: De Judá, Naasson, filho de Aminadabe;
text_el: τῶν Ιουδα Ναασσων υἱὸς Αμιναδαβ

text_en: Of Issachar , Nathanael the son of Suar.
text_la: de Issachar, Nathanaël filius Suar;
text_pt: De Issacar, Natanael, filho de Zuar;
text_el: τῶν Ισσαχαρ Ναθαναηλ υἱὸς Σωγαρ

text_en: Of Zabulon , Eliab the son of Helon.
text_la: de Zabulon, Eliab filius Helon;
text_pt: De Zebulom, Eliabe, filho de Helom;
text_el: τῶν Ζαβουλων Ελιαβ υἱὸς Χαιλων

text_en: And of the sons of Joseph : of Ephraim, Elisama the son of Ammiud: of Manasses , Gamaliel the son of Phadassur.
text_la: filiorum autem Joseph, de Ephraim, Elisama filius Ammiud; de Manasse, Gamaliel filius Phadassur;
text_pt: Dos filhos de José: De Efraim, Elisama, filho de Amiúde; de Manassés, Gamaliel, filho de Pedazur;
text_el: τῶν υἱῶν Ιωσηφ τῶν Εφραιμ Ελισαμα υἱὸς Εμιουδ τῶν Μανασση Γαμαλιηλ υἱὸς Φαδασσουρ

text_en: Of Benjamin , Abidan the son of Gedeon.
text_la: de Benjamin, Abidan filius Gedeonis;
text_pt: De Benjamim, Abidã, filho de Gideoni;
text_el: τῶν Βενιαμιν Αβιδαν υἱὸς Γαδεωνι

text_en: Of Dan , Ahiezer the son of Ammisaddai.
text_la: de Dan, Ahiezer filius Ammisaddai;
text_pt: De Dã, Aieser, filho de Amisadai;
text_el: τῶν Δαν Αχιεζερ υἱὸς Αμισαδαι

text_en: Of Aser , Phegiel the son of Ochran.
text_la: de Aser, Phegiel filius Ochran;
text_pt: De Aser, Pagiel, filho de Ocrã;
text_el: τῶν Ασηρ Φαγαιηλ υἱὸς Εχραν

text_en: Of Gad , Eliasaph the son of Duel.
text_la: de Gad, Eliasaph filius Duel;
text_pt: De Gade, Eliasafe, filho de Deuel;
text_el: τῶν Γαδ Ελισαφ υἱὸς Ραγουηλ

text_en: Of Nephtali , Ahira the son of Enan.
text_la: de Nephthali, Ahira filius Enan.
text_pt: De Naftali, Aira, filho de Enã.
text_el: τῶν Νεφθαλι Αχιρε υἱὸς Αιναν

text_en: These are the most noble princes of the multitude by their tribes and kindreds, and the chiefs of the army of Israel :
text_la: Hi nobilissimi principes multitudinis per tribus et cognationes suas, et capita exercitus Israël,
text_pt: Estes foram os chamados da congregação, os príncipes das tribos de seus pais, os cabeças dos milhares de Israel.
text_el: οὗτοι ἐπίκλητοι τῆς συναγωγῆς ἄρχοντες τῶν φυλῶν κατὰ πατριάς χιλίαρχοι Ισραηλ εἰσίν

text_en: Whom Moses and Aaron took with all the multitude of the common people:
text_la: quos tulerunt Moyses et Aaron cum omni vulgi multitudine:
text_pt: Então tomaram Moisés e Arão a estes homens, que foram declarados pelos seus nomes,
text_el: καὶ ἔλαβεν Μωυσῆς καὶ Ααρων τοὺς ἄνδρας τούτους τοὺς ἀνακληθέντας ἐξ ὀνόματος

text_en: And assembled them on the first day of the second month, reckoning them up by the kindreds, and houses, and families , and heads, and names of every one from twenty years old and upward,
text_la: et congregaverunt primo die mensis secundi, recensentes eos per cognationes, et domos, ac familias, et capita, et nomina singulorum a vigesimo anno et supra,
text_pt: E reuniram toda a congregação no primeiro dia do mês segundo, e declararam a sua descendência segundo as suas famílias, segundo a casa de seus pais, pelo número dos nomes dos de vinte anos para cima, cabeça por cabeça;
text_el: καὶ πᾶσαν τὴν συναγωγὴν συνήγαγον ἐν μιᾷ τοῦ μηνὸς τοῦ δευτέρου ἔτους καὶ ἐπηξονοῦσαν κατὰ γενέσεις αὐτῶν κατὰ πατριὰς αὐτῶν κατὰ ἀριθμὸν ὀνομάτων αὐτῶν ἀπὸ εἰκοσαετοῦς καὶ ἐπάνω πᾶν ἀρσενικὸν κατὰ κεφαλὴν αὐτῶν

text_en: as the Lord had commanded Moses . And they were numbered in the desert of Sinai .
text_la: sicut præceperat Dominus Moysi. Numeratique sunt in deserto Sinai.
text_pt: Como o Senhor ordenara a Moisés, assim os contou no deserto de Sinai.
text_el: ὃν τρόπον συνέταξεν κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ καὶ ἐπεσκέπησαν ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ τῇ Σινα

text_en: Of Ruben the eldest son of Israel , by their generations and families and houses and names of every head, all that were of the male sex, from twenty years old and upward, that were able to go forth to war ,
text_la: De Ruben primogenito Israëlis per generationes et familias ac domos suas, et nomina capitum singulorum, omne quod sexus est masculini a vigesimo anno et supra, procedentium ad bellum,
text_pt: Foram, pois, os filhos de Rúben, o primogênito de Israel, as suas gerações, pelas suas famílias, segundo a casa de seus pais, pelo número dos nomes, cabeça por cabeça, todo o homem de vinte anos para cima, todos os que podiam sair à guerra,
text_el: καὶ ἐγένοντο οἱ υἱοὶ Ρουβην πρωτοτόκου Ισραηλ κατὰ συγγενείας αὐτῶν κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν κατ' οἴκους πατριῶν αὐτῶν κατὰ ἀριθμὸν ὀνομάτων αὐτῶν κατὰ κεφαλὴν αὐτῶν πάντα ἀρσενικὰ ἀπὸ εἰκοσαετοῦς καὶ ἐπάνω πᾶς ὁ ἐκπορευόμενος ἐν τῇ δυνάμει

text_en: were forty-six thousand five hundred.
text_la: quadraginta sex millia quingenti.
text_pt: Foram contados deles, da tribo de Rúben, quarenta e seis mil e quinhentos.
text_el: ἡ ἐπίσκεψις αὐτῶν ἐκ τῆς φυλῆς Ρουβην ἓξ καὶ τεσσαράκοντα χιλιάδες καὶ πεντακόσιοι

text_en: Of the sons of Simeon by their generations and families , and houses of their kindreds, were reckoned up by the names and heads of every one, all that were of the male sex, from twenty years old and upward, that were able to go forth to war ,
text_la: De filiis Simeon per generationes et familias ac domos cognationum suarum recensiti sunt per nomina et capita singulorum, omne quod sexus est masculini a vigesimo anno et supra, procedentium ad bellum,
text_pt: Dos filhos de Simeão, as suas gerações pelas suas famílias, segundo a casa dos seus pais; os seus contados, pelo número dos nomes, cabeça por cabeça, todo o homem de vinte anos para cima, todos os que podiam sair à guerra,
text_el: τοῖς υἱοῖς Συμεων κατὰ συγγενείας αὐτῶν κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν κατ' οἴκους πατριῶν αὐτῶν κατὰ ἀριθμὸν ὀνομάτων αὐτῶν κατὰ κεφαλὴν αὐτῶν πάντα ἀρσενικὰ ἀπὸ εἰκοσαετοῦς καὶ ἐπάνω πᾶς ὁ ἐκπορευόμενος ἐν τῇ δυνάμει

text_en: fifty-nine thousand three hundred.
text_la: quinquaginta novem millia trecenti.
text_pt: Foram contados deles, da tribo de Simeão, cinqüenta e nove mil e trezentos.
text_el: ἡ ἐπίσκεψις αὐτῶν ἐκ τῆς φυλῆς Συμεων ἐννέα καὶ πεντήκοντα χιλιάδες καὶ τριακόσιοι

text_en: Of the sons of Gad , by their generations and families and houses of their kindreds were reckoned up by the names of every one from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war ,
text_la: De filiis Gad per generationes et familias ac domos cognationum suarum recensiti sunt per nomina singulorum a viginti annis et supra, omnes qui ad bella procederent,
text_pt: Dos filhos de Gade, as suas gerações, pelas suas famílias, segundo a casa de seus pais, pelo número dos nomes dos de vinte anos para cima, todos os que podiam sair à guerra,
text_el: τοῖς υἱοῖς Ιουδα κατὰ συγγενείας αὐτῶν κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν κατ' οἴκους πατριῶν αὐτῶν κατὰ ἀριθμὸν ὀνομάτων αὐτῶν κατὰ κεφαλὴν αὐτῶν πάντα ἀρσενικὰ ἀπὸ εἰκοσαετοῦς καὶ ἐπάνω πᾶς ὁ ἐκπορευόμενος ἐν τῇ δυνάμει

text_en: forty-five thousand six hundred and fifty.
text_la: quadraginta quinque millia sexcenti quinquaginta.
text_pt: Foram contados deles, da tribo de Gade, quarenta e cinco mil e seiscentos e cinqüenta.
text_el: ἡ ἐπίσκεψις αὐτῶν ἐκ τῆς φυλῆς Ιουδα τέσσαρες καὶ ἑβδομήκοντα χιλιάδες καὶ ἑξακόσιοι

text_en: Of the sons of Juda , by their generations and families and houses of their kindreds, by the names of every one from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war ,
text_la: De filiis Juda per generationes et familias ac domos cognationum suarum, per nomina singulorum a vigesimo anno et supra, omnes qui poterant ad bella procedere,
text_pt: Dos filhos de Judá, as suas gerações, pelas suas famílias, segundo a casa de seus pais; pelo número dos nomes dos de vinte anos para cima, todos os que podiam sair à guerra,
text_el: τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισσαχαρ κατὰ συγγενείας αὐτῶν κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν κατ' οἴκους πατριῶν αὐτῶν κατὰ ἀριθμὸν ὀνομάτων αὐτῶν κατὰ κεφαλὴν αὐτῶν πάντα ἀρσενικὰ ἀπὸ εἰκοσαετοῦς καὶ ἐπάνω πᾶς ὁ ἐκπορευόμενος ἐν τῇ δυνάμει

text_en: were reckoned up seventy-four thousand six hundred.
text_la: recensiti sunt septuaginta quatuor millia sexcenti.
text_pt: Foram contados deles, da tribo de Judá, setenta e quatro mil e seiscentos.
text_el: ἡ ἐπίσκεψις αὐτῶν ἐκ τῆς φυλῆς Ισσαχαρ τέσσαρες καὶ πεντήκοντα χιλιάδες καὶ τετρακόσιοι

text_en: Of the sons of Issachar , by their generations and families and houses of their kindreds, by the names of every one from twenty years old and upward, all that could go forth to war ,
text_la: De filiis Issachar, per generationes et familias ac domos cognationum suarum, per nomina singulorum a vigesimo anno et supra, omnes qui ad bella procederent,
text_pt: Dos filhos de Issacar, as suas gerações, pelas suas famílias, segundo a casa de seus pais, pelo número dos nomes dos de vinte anos para cima, todos os que podiam sair à guerra,
text_el: τοῖς υἱοῖς Ζαβουλων κατὰ συγγενείας αὐτῶν κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν κατ' οἴκους πατριῶν αὐτῶν κατὰ ἀριθμὸν ὀνομάτων αὐτῶν κατὰ κεφαλὴν αὐτῶν πάντα ἀρσενικὰ ἀπὸ εἰκοσαετοῦς καὶ ἐπάνω πᾶς ὁ ἐκπορευόμενος ἐν τῇ δυνάμει

text_en: were reckoned up fifty-four thousand four hundred.
text_la: recensiti sunt quinquaginta quatuor millia quadringenti.
text_pt: Foram contados deles da tribo de Issacar, cinqüenta e quatro mil e quatrocentos.
text_el: ἡ ἐπίσκεψις αὐτῶν ἐκ τῆς φυλῆς Ζαβουλων ἑπτὰ καὶ πεντήκοντα χιλιάδες καὶ τετρακόσιοι

text_en: Of the sons of Zabulon , by the generations and families and houses of their kindreds, were reckoned up by the names of every one from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war ,
text_la: De filiis Zabulon per generationes et familias ac domos cognationum suarum recensiti sunt per nomina singulorum a vigesimo anno et supra, omnes qui poterant ad bella procedere,
text_pt: Dos filhos de Zebulom, as suas gerações, pelas suas famílias, segundo a casa de seus pais, pelo número dos nomes dos de vinte anos para cima, todos os que podiam sair à guerra,
text_el: τοῖς υἱοῖς Ιωσηφ υἱοῖς Εφραιμ κατὰ συγγενείας αὐτῶν κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν κατ' οἴκους πατριῶν αὐτῶν κατὰ ἀριθμὸν ὀνομάτων αὐτῶν κατὰ κεφαλὴν αὐτῶν πάντα ἀρσενικὰ ἀπὸ εἰκοσαετοῦς καὶ ἐπάνω πᾶς ὁ ἐκπορευόμενος ἐν τῇ δυνάμει

text_en: fifty-seven thousand four hundred.
text_la: quinquaginta septem millia quadringenti.
text_pt: Foram contados deles, da tribo de Zebulom, cinqüenta e sete mil e quatrocentos.
text_el: ἡ ἐπίσκεψις αὐτῶν ἐκ τῆς φυλῆς Εφραιμ τεσσαράκοντα χιλιάδες καὶ πεντακόσιοι

text_en: Of the sons of Joseph , namely, of the sons of Ephraim, by the generations and families and houses of their kindreds, were reckoned up by the names of every one, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war ,
text_la: De filiis Joseph, filiorum Ephraim per generationes et familias ac domos cognationum suarum recensiti sunt per nomina singulorum a vigesimo anno et supra, omnes qui poterant ad bella procedere,
text_pt: Dos filhos de José, dos filhos de Efraim, as suas gerações, pelas suas famílias, segundo a casa de seus pais, pelo número dos nomes dos de vinte anos para cima, todos os que podiam sair à guerra,
text_el: τοῖς υἱοῖς Μανασση κατὰ συγγενείας αὐτῶν κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν κατ' οἴκους πατριῶν αὐτῶν κατὰ ἀριθμὸν ὀνομάτων αὐτῶν κατὰ κεφαλὴν αὐτῶν πάντα ἀρσενικὰ ἀπὸ εἰκοσαετοῦς καὶ ἐπάνω πᾶς ὁ ἐκπορευόμενος ἐν τῇ δυνάμει

text_en: forty thousand five hundred.
text_la: quadraginta millia quingenti.
text_pt: Foram contados deles, da tribo de Efraim, quarenta mil e quinhentos.
text_el: ἡ ἐπίσκεψις αὐτῶν ἐκ τῆς φυλῆς Μανασση δύο καὶ τριάκοντα χιλιάδες καὶ διακόσιοι

text_en: Moreover of the sons of Manasses , by the generations and families and houses of their kindreds, were reckoned up by the names of every one from twenty years old and upward, all that could go forth to war ,
text_la: Porro filiorum Manasse per generationes et familias ac domos cognationum suarum recensiti sunt per nomina singulorum a viginti annis et supra, omnes qui poterant ad bella procedere,
text_pt: Dos filhos de Manassés, as suas gerações, pelas suas famílias, segundo a casa de seus pais, pelo número dos nomes dos de vinte anos para cima, todos os que podiam sair à guerra,
text_el: τοῖς υἱοῖς Βενιαμιν κατὰ συγγενείας αὐτῶν κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν κατ' οἴκους πατριῶν αὐτῶν κατὰ ἀριθμὸν ὀνομάτων αὐτῶν κατὰ κεφαλὴν αὐτῶν πάντα ἀρσενικὰ ἀπὸ εἰκοσαετοῦς καὶ ἐπάνω πᾶς ὁ ἐκπορευόμενος ἐν τῇ δυνάμει

text_en: thirty-two thousand two hundred.
text_la: triginta duo millia ducenti.
text_pt: Foram contados deles, da tribo de Manassés, trinta e dois mil e duzentos.
text_el: ἡ ἐπίσκεψις αὐτῶν ἐκ τῆς φυλῆς Βενιαμιν πέντε καὶ τριάκοντα χιλιάδες καὶ τετρακόσιοι

text_en: Of the sons of Benjamin , by their generations and families and houses of their kindreds, were reckoned up by the names of every one from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war ,
text_la: De filiis Benjamin per generationes et familias ac domos cognationum suarum recensiti sunt nominibus singulorum a vigesimo anno et supra, omnes qui poterant ad bella procedere,
text_pt: Dos filhos de Benjamim, as suas gerações, pelas suas famílias, segundo a casa de seus pais, pelo número dos nomes dos de vinte anos para cima, todos os que podiam sair à guerra,
text_el: τοῖς υἱοῖς Γαδ κατὰ συγγενείας αὐτῶν κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν κατ' οἴκους πατριῶν αὐτῶν κατὰ ἀριθμὸν ὀνομάτων αὐτῶν κατὰ κεφαλὴν αὐτῶν πάντα ἀρσενικὰ ἀπὸ εἰκοσαετοῦς καὶ ἐπάνω πᾶς ὁ ἐκπορευόμενος ἐν τῇ δυνάμει

text_en: thirty-five thousand four hundred.
text_la: triginta quinque millia quadringenti.
text_pt: Foram contados deles, da tribo de Benjamim, trinta e cinco mil e quatrocentos.
text_el: ἡ ἐπίσκεψις αὐτῶν ἐκ τῆς φυλῆς Γαδ πέντε καὶ τεσσαράκοντα χιλιάδες καὶ ἑξακόσιοι καὶ πεντήκοντα

text_en: Of the sons of Dan , by their generations and families and houses of their kindreds, were reckoned up by the names of every one from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war ,
text_la: De filiis Dan per generationes et familias ac domos cognationum suarum recensiti sunt nominibus singulorum a vigesimo anno et supra, omnes qui poterant ad bella procedere,
text_pt: Dos filhos de Dã, as suas gerações, pelas suas famílias, segundo a casa de seus pais, pelo número dos nomes dos de vinte anos para cima, todos os que podiam sair à guerra,
text_el: τοῖς υἱοῖς Δαν κατὰ συγγενείας αὐτῶν κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν κατ' οἴκους πατριῶν αὐτῶν κατὰ ἀριθμὸν ὀνομάτων αὐτῶν κατὰ κεφαλὴν αὐτῶν πάντα ἀρσενικὰ ἀπὸ εἰκοσαετοῦς καὶ ἐπάνω πᾶς ὁ ἐκπορευόμενος ἐν τῇ δυνάμει

text_en: sixty-two thousand seven hundred.
text_la: sexaginta duo millia septingenti.
text_pt: Foram contados deles, da tribo de Dã, sessenta e dois mil e setecentos.
text_el: ἡ ἐπίσκεψις αὐτῶν ἐκ τῆς φυλῆς Δαν δύο καὶ ἑξήκοντα χιλιάδες καὶ ἑπτακόσιοι

text_en: Of the sons of Aser , by their generations and families and houses of their kindreds, were reckoned up by the names of every one from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war ,
text_la: De filiis Aser per generationes et familias ac domos cognationum suarum recensiti sunt per nomina singulorum a vigesimo anno et supra, omnes qui poterant ad bella procedere,
text_pt: Dos filhos de Aser, as suas gerações, pelas suas famílias, segundo a casa de seus pais, pelo número dos nomes dos de vinte anos para cima, todos os que podiam sair à guerra,
text_el: τοῖς υἱοῖς Ασηρ κατὰ συγγενείας αὐτῶν κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν κατ' οἴκους πατριῶν αὐτῶν κατὰ ἀριθμὸν ὀνομάτων αὐτῶν κατὰ κεφαλὴν αὐτῶν πάντα ἀρσενικὰ ἀπὸ εἰκοσαετοῦς καὶ ἐπάνω πᾶς ὁ ἐκπορευόμενος ἐν τῇ δυνάμει

text_en: forty-one thousand and five hundred.
text_la: quadraginta millia et mille quingenti.
text_pt: Foram contados deles, da tribo de Aser, quarenta e um mil e quinhentos.
text_el: ἡ ἐπίσκεψις αὐτῶν ἐκ τῆς φυλῆς Ασηρ μία καὶ τεσσαράκοντα χιλιάδες καὶ πεντακόσιοι

text_en: Of the sons of Nephtali , by their generations and families and houses of their kindreds, were reckoned up by the names of every one from twenty years old and upward, were able to go forth to war ,
text_la: De filiis Nephthali per generationes et familias ac domos cognationum suarum recensiti sunt nominibus singulorum a vigesimo anno et supra, omnes qui poterant ad bella procedere,
text_pt: Dos filhos de Naftali, as suas gerações, pelas suas famílias, segundo a casa de seus pais, pelo número dos nomes dos de vinte anos para cima, todos os que podiam sair à guerra,
text_el: τοῖς υἱοῖς Νεφθαλι κατὰ συγγενείας αὐτῶν κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν κατ' οἴκους πατριῶν αὐτῶν κατὰ ἀριθμὸν ὀνομάτων αὐτῶν κατὰ κεφαλὴν αὐτῶν πάντα ἀρσενικὰ ἀπὸ εἰκοσαετοῦς καὶ ἐπάνω πᾶς ὁ ἐκπορευόμενος ἐν τῇ δυνάμει

text_en: fifty-three thousand four hundred.
text_la: quinquaginta tria millia quadringenti.
text_pt: Foram contados deles, da tribo de Naftali, cinqüenta e três mil e quatrocentos.
text_el: ἡ ἐπίσκεψις αὐτῶν ἐκ τῆς φυλῆς Νεφθαλι τρεῖς καὶ πεντήκοντα χιλιάδες καὶ τετρακόσιοι

text_en: These are they who were numbered by Moses and Aaron , and the twelve princes of Israel , every one by the houses of their kindreds.
text_la: Hi sunt, quos numeraverunt Moyses et Aaron, et duodecim principes Israël, singulos per domos cognationum suarum.
text_pt: Estes foram os contados, que contaram Moisés e Arão, e os príncipes de Israel, doze homens, cada um era pela casa de seus pais.
text_el: αὕτη ἡ ἐπίσκεψις ἣν ἐπεσκέψαντο Μωυσῆς καὶ Ααρων καὶ οἱ ἄρχοντες Ισραηλ δώδεκα ἄνδρες ἀνὴρ εἷς κατὰ φυλὴν μίαν κατὰ φυλὴν οἴκων πατριᾶς ἦσαν

text_en: And the whole number of the children of Israel by their houses and families , from twenty years old and upward, that were able to go to war ,
text_la: Fueruntque omnis numerus filiorum Israël per domos et familias suas a vigesimo anno et supra, qui poterant ad bella procedere,
text_pt: Assim foram todos os contados dos filhos de Israel, segundo a casa de seus pais, de vinte anos para cima, todos os que podiam sair à guerra em Israel;
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο πᾶσα ἡ ἐπίσκεψις υἱῶν Ισραηλ σὺν δυνάμει αὐτῶν ἀπὸ εἰκοσαετοῦς καὶ ἐπάνω πᾶς ὁ ἐκπορευόμενος παρατάξασθαι ἐν Ισραηλ

text_en: were six hundred and three thousand five hundred and fifty men .
text_la: sexcenta tria millia virorum quingenti quinquaginta.
text_pt: Todos os contados eram seiscentos e três mil e quinhentos e cinqüenta.
text_el: ἑξακόσιαι χιλιάδες καὶ τρισχίλιοι καὶ πεντακόσιοι καὶ πεντήκοντα

text_en: But the Levites in the tribes of their families were not numbered with them.
text_la: Levitæ autem in tribu familiarum suarum non sunt numerati cum eis.
text_pt: Mas os levitas, segundo a tribo de seus pais, não foram contados entre eles,
text_el: οἱ δὲ Λευῖται ἐκ τῆς φυλῆς πατριᾶς αὐτῶν οὐκ ἐπεσκέπησαν ἐν τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ

text_en: And the Lord spoke to Moses , saying:
text_la: Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen, dicens:
text_pt: Porquanto o Senhor tinha falado a Moisés, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν λέγων

text_en: Number not the tribe of Levi , neither shall you put down the sum of them with the children of Israel :
text_la: Tribum Levi noli numerare, neque pones summam eorum cum filiis Israël:
text_pt: Porém não contarás a tribo de Levi, nem tomarás a soma deles entre os filhos de Israel;
text_el: ὅρα τὴν φυλὴν τὴν Λευι οὐ συνεπισκέψῃ καὶ τὸν ἀριθμὸν αὐτῶν οὐ λήμψῃ ἐν μέσῳ τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ

text_en: But appoint them over the tabernacle of the testimony , and all the vessels thereof, and whatsoever pertains to the ceremonies . They shall carry the tabernacle and all the furniture thereof: and they shall minister, and shall encamp round about the tabernacle .
text_la: sed constitue eos super tabernaculum testimonii et cuncta vasa ejus, et quidquid ad cæremonias pertinet. Ipsi portabunt tabernaculum et omnia utensilia ejus : et erunt in ministerio, ac per gyrum tabernaculi metabuntur.
text_pt: Mas tu põe os levitas sobre o tabernáculo do testemunho, e sobre todos os seus utensílios, e sobre tudo o que pertence a ele; eles levarão o tabernáculo e todos os seus utensílios; e eles o administrarão, e acampar-se-ão ao redor do tabernáculo.
text_el: καὶ σὺ ἐπίστησον τοὺς Λευίτας ἐπὶ τὴν σκηνὴν τοῦ μαρτυρίου καὶ ἐπὶ πάντα τὰ σκεύη αὐτῆς καὶ ἐπὶ πάντα ὅσα ἐστὶν ἐν αὐτῇ αὐτοὶ ἀροῦσιν τὴν σκηνὴν καὶ πάντα τὰ σκεύη αὐτῆς καὶ αὐτοὶ λειτουργήσουσιν ἐν αὐτῇ καὶ κύκλῳ τῆς σκηνῆς παρεμβαλοῦσιν

text_en: When you are to go forward, the Levites shall take down the tabernacle : when you are to camp, they shall set it up. What stranger soever comes to it, shall be slain.
text_la: Cum proficiscendum fuerit, deponent Levitæ tabernaculum; cum castrametandum, erigent. Quisquis externorum accesserit, occidetur.
text_pt: E, quando o tabernáculo partir, os levitas o desarmarão; e, quando o tabernáculo se houver de assentar no arraial, os levitas o armarão; e o estranho que se chegar morrerá.
text_el: καὶ ἐν τῷ ἐξαίρειν τὴν σκηνὴν καθελοῦσιν αὐτὴν οἱ Λευῖται καὶ ἐν τῷ παρεμβάλλειν τὴν σκηνὴν ἀναστήσουσιν καὶ ὁ ἀλλογενὴς ὁ προσπορευόμενος ἀποθανέτω

text_en: And the children of Israel shall camp every man by his troops and bands and army.
text_la: Metabuntur autem castra filii Israël unusquisque per turmas et cuneos atque exercitum suum.
text_pt: E os filhos de Israel armarão as suas tendas, cada um no seu esquadrão, e cada um junto à sua bandeira, segundo os seus exércitos.
text_el: καὶ παρεμβαλοῦσιν οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ ἀνὴρ ἐν τῇ ἑαυτοῦ τάξει καὶ ἀνὴρ κατὰ τὴν ἑαυτοῦ ἡγεμονίαν σὺν δυνάμει αὐτῶν

text_en: But the Levites shall pitch their tents round about the tabernacle , lest there come indignation upon the multitude of the children of Israel , and they shall keep watch, and guard the tabernacle of the testimony .
text_la: Porro Levitæ per gyrum tabernaculi figent tentoria, ne fiat indignatio super multitudinem filiorum Israël, et excubabunt in custodiis tabernaculi testimonii.
text_pt: Mas os levitas armarão as suas tendas ao redor do tabernáculo do testemunho, para que não haja indignação sobre a congregação dos filhos de Israel, pelo que os levitas terão o cuidado da guarda do tabernáculo do testemunho.
text_el: οἱ δὲ Λευῖται παρεμβαλέτωσαν ἐναντίον κυρίου κύκλῳ τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου καὶ οὐκ ἔσται ἁμάρτημα ἐν υἱοῖς Ισραηλ καὶ φυλάξουσιν οἱ Λευῖται αὐτοὶ τὴν φυλακὴν τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου

text_en: And the children of Israel did according to all things which the Lord had commanded Moses .
text_la: Fecerunt ergo filii Israël juxta omnia quæ præceperat Dominus Moysi.
text_pt: Assim fizeram os filhos de Israel; conforme a tudo o que o Senhor ordenara a Moisés, assim o fizeram.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ κατὰ πάντα ἃ ἐνετείλατο κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ καὶ Ααρων οὕτως ἐποίησαν

text_en: And the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron , saying:
text_la: Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen et Aaron, dicens:
text_pt: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés e a Arão, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν καὶ Ααρων λέγων

text_en: All the children of Israel shall camp by their troops, ensigns, and standards, and the houses of their kindreds, round about the tabernacle of the covenant .
text_la: Singuli per turmas, signa, atque vexilla, et domos cognationum suarum, castrametabuntur filii Israël, per gyrum tabernaculi fœderis.
text_pt: Os filhos de Israel armarão as suas tendas, cada um debaixo da sua bandeira, segundo as insígnias da casa de seus pais; ao redor, defronte da tenda da congregação, armarão as suas tendas.
text_el: ἄνθρωπος ἐχόμενος αὐτοῦ κατὰ τάγμα κατὰ σημέας κατ' οἴκους πατριῶν αὐτῶν παρεμβαλέτωσαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ ἐναντίοι κύκλῳ τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου παρεμβαλοῦσιν οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ

text_en: On the east Juda shall pitch his tents by the bands of his army: and the prince of his sons, shall be Nahasson the son of Aminadab.
text_la: Ad orientem Judas figet tentoria per turmas exercitus sui: eritque princeps filiorum ejus Nahasson filius Aminadab.
text_pt: Os que armarem as suas tendas do lado do oriente, para o nascente, serão os da bandeira do exército de Judá, segundo os seus esquadrões, e Naassom, filho de Aminadabe, será príncipe dos filhos de Judá.
text_el: καὶ οἱ παρεμβάλλοντες πρῶτοι κατ' ἀνατολὰς τάγμα παρεμβολῆς Ιουδα σὺν δυνάμει αὐτῶν καὶ ὁ ἄρχων τῶν υἱῶν Ιουδα Ναασσων υἱὸς Αμιναδαβ

text_en: And the whole sum of the fighting men of his stock, were seventy-four thousand six hundred.
text_la: Et omnis de stirpe ejus summa pugnantium, septuaginta quatuor millia sexcenti.
text_pt: E o seu exército, os que foram contados deles, era de setenta e quatro mil e seiscentos.
text_el: δύναμις αὐτοῦ οἱ ἐπεσκεμμένοι τέσσαρες καὶ ἑβδομήκοντα χιλιάδες καὶ ἑξακόσιοι

text_en: Next unto him they of the tribe of Issachar encamped, whose prince was Nathanael, the son of Suar.
text_la: Juxta eum castrametati sunt de tribu Issachar, quorum princeps fuit Nathanaël filius Suar.
text_pt: E junto a ele armará as suas tendas a tribo de Issacar; e Natanael, filho de Zuar, será príncipe dos filhos de Issacar.
text_el: καὶ οἱ παρεμβάλλοντες ἐχόμενοι φυλῆς Ισσαχαρ καὶ ὁ ἄρχων τῶν υἱῶν Ισσαχαρ Ναθαναηλ υἱὸς Σωγαρ

text_en: And the whole number of his fighting men were fifty-four thousand four hundred.
text_la: Et omnis numerus pugnatorum ejus quinquaginta quatuor millia quadringenti.
text_pt: E o seu exército, os que foram contados deles, era de cinqüenta e quatro mil e quatrocentos.
text_el: δύναμις αὐτοῦ οἱ ἐπεσκεμμένοι τέσσαρες καὶ πεντήκοντα χιλιάδες καὶ τετρακόσιοι

text_en: In the tribe of Zabulon the prince was Eliab the son of Helon.
text_la: In tribu Zabulon princeps fuit Eliab filius Helon.
text_pt: Depois a tribo de Zebulom; e Eliabe, filho de Helam, será príncipe dos filhos de Zebulom.
text_el: καὶ οἱ παρεμβάλλοντες ἐχόμενοι φυλῆς Ζαβουλων καὶ ὁ ἄρχων τῶν υἱῶν Ζαβουλων Ελιαβ υἱὸς Χαιλων

text_en: And all the army of fighting men of his stock, were fifty-seven thousand four hundred.
text_la: Omnis de stirpe ejus exercitus pugnatorum, quinquaginta septem millia quadringenti.
text_pt: E o seu exército, os que foram contados deles, era de cinqüenta e sete mil e quatrocentos.
text_el: δύναμις αὐτοῦ οἱ ἐπεσκεμμένοι ἑπτὰ καὶ πεντήκοντα χιλιάδες καὶ τετρακόσιοι

text_en: All that were numbered in the camp of Juda , were a hundred and eighty-six thousand four hundred: and they by their troops shall march first.
text_la: Universi qui in castris Judæ enumerati sunt, fuerunt centum octoginta sex millia quadringenti : et per turmas suas primi egredientur.
text_pt: Todos os que foram contados do exército de Judá, cento e oitenta e seis mil e quatrocentos, segundo os seus esquadrões, estes marcharão primeiro.
text_el: πάντες οἱ ἐπεσκεμμένοι ἐκ τῆς παρεμβολῆς Ιουδα ἑκατὸν ὀγδοήκοντα χιλιάδες καὶ ἑξακισχίλιοι καὶ τετρακόσιοι σὺν δυνάμει αὐτῶν πρῶτοι ἐξαροῦσιν

text_en: In the camp of the sons of Ruben , on the south side, the prince shall be Elisur the son of Sedeur:
text_la: In castris filiorum Ruben ad meridianam plagam erit princeps Elisur filius Sedeur.
text_pt: A bandeira do exército de Rúben, segundo os seus esquadrões, estará para o lado do sul; e Elizur, filho de Sedeur, será príncipe dos filhos de Rúben,
text_el: τάγμα παρεμβολῆς Ρουβην πρὸς λίβα σὺν δυνάμει αὐτῶν καὶ ὁ ἄρχων τῶν υἱῶν Ρουβην Ελισουρ υἱὸς Σεδιουρ

text_en: And the whole army of his fighting men , that were numbered, were forty-six thousand five hundred.
text_la: Et cunctus exercitus pugnatorum ejus qui numerati sunt, quadraginta sex millia quingenti.
text_pt: E o seu exército, os que foram contados deles, era de quarenta e seis mil e quinhentos.
text_el: δύναμις αὐτοῦ οἱ ἐπεσκεμμένοι ἓξ καὶ τεσσαράκοντα χιλιάδες καὶ πεντακόσιοι

text_en: Beside him camped they of the tribe of Simeon : whose prince was Salamiel the son of Surisaddai.
text_la: Juxta eum castrametati sunt de tribu Simeon : quorum princeps fuit Salamiel filius Surisaddai.
text_pt: E junto a ele armará as suas tendas a tribo de Simeão; e Selumiel, filho de Zurisadai, será príncipe dos filhos de Simeão.
text_el: καὶ οἱ παρεμβάλλοντες ἐχόμενοι αὐτοῦ φυλῆς Συμεων καὶ ὁ ἄρχων τῶν υἱῶν Συμεων Σαλαμιηλ υἱὸς Σουρισαδαι

text_en: And the whole army of his fighting men , that were numbered, were fifty-nine thousand three hundred.
text_la: Et cunctus exercitus pugnatorum ejus qui numerati sunt, quinquaginta novem millia trecenti.
text_pt: E o seu exército, os que foram contados deles, era de cinqüenta e nove mil e trezentos.
text_el: δύναμις αὐτοῦ οἱ ἐπεσκεμμένοι ἐννέα καὶ πεντήκοντα χιλιάδες καὶ τριακόσιοι

text_en: In the tribe of Gad the prince was Eliasaph the son of Duel.
text_la: In tribu Gad princeps fuit Eliasaph filius Duel.
text_pt: Depois a tribo de Gade; e Eliasafe, filho de Reuel, será príncipe dos filhos de Gade.
text_el: καὶ οἱ παρεμβάλλοντες ἐχόμενοι αὐτοῦ φυλῆς Γαδ καὶ ὁ ἄρχων τῶν υἱῶν Γαδ Ελισαφ υἱὸς Ραγουηλ

text_en: And the whole army of his righting men that were numbered, were forty-five thousand six hundred and fifty.
text_la: Et cunctus exercitus pugnatorum ejus, qui numerati sunt, quadraginta quinque millia sexcenti quinquaginta.
text_pt: E o seu exército, os que foram contados deles, era de quarenta e cinco mil e seiscentos e cinqüenta.
text_el: δύναμις αὐτοῦ οἱ ἐπεσκεμμένοι πέντε καὶ τεσσαράκοντα χιλιάδες καὶ ἑξακόσιοι καὶ πεντήκοντα

text_en: All that were reckoned up in the camp of Ruben , were a hundred and fifty-one thousand four hundred and fifty, by their troops: they shall march in the second place.
text_la: Omnes qui recensiti sunt in castris Ruben, centum quinquaginta millia et mille quadringenti quinquaginta per turmas suas : in secundo loco proficiscentur.
text_pt: Todos os que foram contados no exército de Rúben foram cento e cinqüenta e um mil e quatrocentos e cinqüenta, segundo os seus esquadrões; e estes marcharão em segundo lugar.
text_el: πάντες οἱ ἐπεσκεμμένοι τῆς παρεμβολῆς Ρουβην ἑκατὸν πεντήκοντα μία χιλιάδες καὶ τετρακόσιοι καὶ πεντήκοντα σὺν δυνάμει αὐτῶν δεύτεροι ἐξαροῦσιν

text_en: And the tabernacle of the testimony shall be carried by the officers of the Levites and their troops. As it shall be set up, so shall it be taken down. Every one shall march according to their places, and ranks.
text_la: Levabitur autem tabernaculum testimonii per officia Levitarum, et turmas eorum : quomodo erigetur, ita et deponetur. Singuli per loca et ordines suos proficiscentur.
text_pt: Então partirá a tenda da congregação com o exército dos levitas no meio dos exércitos; como armaram as suas tendas, assim marcharão, cada um no seu lugar, segundo as suas bandeiras.
text_el: καὶ ἀρθήσεται ἡ σκηνὴ τοῦ μαρτυρίου καὶ ἡ παρεμβολὴ τῶν Λευιτῶν μέσον τῶν παρεμβολῶν ὡς καὶ παρεμβάλλουσιν οὕτως καὶ ἐξαροῦσιν ἕκαστος ἐχόμενος καθ' ἡγεμονίαν

text_en: On the west side shall be the camp of the sons of Ephraim, whose prince was Elisama the son of Ammiud.
text_la: Ad occidentalem plagam erunt castra filiorum Ephraim, quorum princeps fuit Elisama filius Ammiud.
text_pt: A bandeira do exército de Efraim segundo os seus esquadrões, estará para o lado do ocidente; e Elisama, filho de Amiúde, será príncipe dos filhos de Efraim.
text_el: τάγμα παρεμβολῆς Εφραιμ παρὰ θάλασσαν σὺν δυνάμει αὐτῶν καὶ ὁ ἄρχων τῶν υἱῶν Εφραιμ Ελισαμα υἱὸς Εμιουδ

text_en: The whole army of his fighting men , that were numbered, were forty thousand five hundred.
text_la: Cunctus exercitus pugnatorum ejus, qui numerati sunt, quadraginta millia quingenti.
text_pt: E o seu exército, os que foram contados deles, era de quarenta mil e quinhentos.
text_el: δύναμις αὐτοῦ οἱ ἐπεσκεμμένοι τεσσαράκοντα χιλιάδες καὶ πεντακόσιοι

text_en: And with them the tribe of the sons of Manasses , whose prince was Gamaliel the son of Phadassur.
text_la: Et cum eis tribus filiorum Manasse, quorum princeps fuit Gamaliel filius Phadassur.
text_pt: E junto a ele estará a tribo de Manassés; e Gamaliel, filho de Pedazur, será príncipe dos filhos de Manassés.
text_el: καὶ οἱ παρεμβάλλοντες ἐχόμενοι φυλῆς Μανασση καὶ ὁ ἄρχων τῶν υἱῶν Μανασση Γαμαλιηλ υἱὸς Φαδασσουρ

text_en: And the whole army of his fighting men , that were numbered, were thirty-two thousand two hundred.
text_la: Cunctusque exercitus pugnatorum ejus, qui numerati sunt, triginta duo millia ducenti.
text_pt: E o seu exército, os que foram contados deles, era de trinta e dois mil e duzentos.
text_el: δύναμις αὐτοῦ οἱ ἐπεσκεμμένοι δύο καὶ τριάκοντα χιλιάδες καὶ διακόσιοι

text_en: In the tribe of the sons of Benjamin the prince was Abidan the son of Gedeon.
text_la: In tribu filiorum Benjamin princeps fuit Abidan filius Gedeonis.
text_pt: Depois a tribo de Benjamim; e Abidã, filho de Gideoni, será príncipe dos filhos de Benjamim,
text_el: καὶ οἱ παρεμβάλλοντες ἐχόμενοι φυλῆς Βενιαμιν καὶ ὁ ἄρχων τῶν υἱῶν Βενιαμιν Αβιδαν υἱὸς Γαδεωνι

text_en: And the whole army of fighting men , that were reckoned up, were thirty-five thousand four hundred.
text_la: Et cunctus exercitus pugnatorum ejus, qui recensiti sunt, triginta quinque millia quadringenti.
text_pt: E o seu exército, os que foram contados deles, era de trinta e cinco mil e quatrocentos.
text_el: δύναμις αὐτοῦ οἱ ἐπεσκεμμένοι πέντε καὶ τριάκοντα χιλιάδες καὶ τετρακόσιοι

text_en: All that were numbered in the camp of Ephraim, were a hundred and eight-thousand one hundred by their troops: they shall march in the third place.
text_la: Omnes qui numerati sunt in castris Ephraim, centum octo millia centum per turmas suas : tertii proficiscentur.
text_pt: Todos os que foram contados no exército de Efraim foram cento e oito mil e cem, segundo os seus esquadrões; e estes marcharão em terceiro lugar.
text_el: πάντες οἱ ἐπεσκεμμένοι τῆς παρεμβολῆς Εφραιμ ἑκατὸν χιλιάδες καὶ ὀκτακισχίλιοι καὶ ἑκατὸν σὺν δυνάμει αὐτῶν τρίτοι ἐξαροῦσιν

text_en: On the north side camped the sons of Dan : whose prince was Ahiezar the son of Ammisaddai.
text_la: Ad aquilonis partem castrametati sunt filii Dan : quorum princeps fuit Ahiezer filius Ammisaddai.
text_pt: A bandeira do exército de Dã estará para o norte, segundo os seus esquadrões; e Aieser, filho de Amisadai, será príncipe dos filhos de Dã.
text_el: τάγμα παρεμβολῆς Δαν πρὸς βορρᾶν σὺν δυνάμει αὐτῶν καὶ ὁ ἄρχων τῶν υἱῶν Δαν Αχιεζερ υἱὸς Αμισαδαι

text_en: The whole army of his fighting men , that were numbered, were sixty-two thousand seven hundred.
text_la: Cunctus exercitus pugnatorum ejus, qui numerati sunt, sexaginta duo millia septingenti.
text_pt: E o seu exército, os que foram contados deles, era de sessenta e dois mil e setecentos.
text_el: δύναμις αὐτοῦ οἱ ἐπεσκεμμένοι δύο καὶ ἑξήκοντα χιλιάδες καὶ ἑπτακόσιοι

text_en: Beside him they of the tribe of Aser pitched their tents: whose prince was Phegiel the son of Ochran.
text_la: Juxta eum fixere tentoria de tribu Aser : quorum princeps fuit Phegiel filius Ochran.
text_pt: E junto a ele armará as suas tendas a tribo de Aser; e Pagiel, filho de Ocrã, será príncipe dos filhos de Aser.
text_el: καὶ οἱ παρεμβάλλοντες ἐχόμενοι αὐτοῦ φυλῆς Ασηρ καὶ ὁ ἄρχων τῶν υἱῶν Ασηρ Φαγαιηλ υἱὸς Εχραν

text_en: The whole army of his fighting men , that were numbered, were forty-one thousand five hundred.
text_la: Cunctus exercitus pugnatorum ejus, qui numerati sunt, quadraginta millia et mille quingenti.
text_pt: E o seu exército, os que foram contados deles, era de quarenta e um mil e quinhentos.
text_el: δύναμις αὐτοῦ οἱ ἐπεσκεμμένοι μία καὶ τεσσαράκοντα χιλιάδες καὶ πεντακόσιοι

text_en: Of the tribe of the sons of Nephtali the prince was Ahira the son of Enan.
text_la: De tribu filiorum Nephthali princeps fuit Ahira filius Enan.
text_pt: Depois a tribo de Naftali; e Aira, filho de Enã, será príncipe dos filhos de Naftali.
text_el: καὶ οἱ παρεμβάλλοντες ἐχόμενοι φυλῆς Νεφθαλι καὶ ὁ ἄρχων τῶν υἱῶν Νεφθαλι Αχιρε υἱὸς Αιναν

text_en: The whole army of his fighting men , were fifty-three thousand four hundred.
text_la: Cunctus exercitus pugnatorum ejus, quinquaginta tria millia quadringenti.
text_pt: E o seu exército, os que foram contados deles, era de cinqüenta e três mil e quatrocentos.
text_el: δύναμις αὐτοῦ οἱ ἐπεσκεμμένοι τρεῖς καὶ πεντήκοντα χιλιάδες καὶ τετρακόσιοι

text_en: All that were numbered in the camp of Dan , were a hundred and fifty-seven thousand six hundred: and they shall march last.
text_la: Omnes qui numerati sunt in castris Dan, fuerunt centum quinquaginta septem millia sexcenti : et novissimi proficiscentur.
text_pt: Todos os que foram contados no exército de Dã foram cento e cinqüenta e sete mil e seiscentos; estes marcharão em último lugar, segundo as suas bandeiras.
text_el: πάντες οἱ ἐπεσκεμμένοι τῆς παρεμβολῆς Δαν ἑκατὸν καὶ πεντήκοντα ἑπτὰ χιλιάδες καὶ ἑξακόσιοι ἔσχατοι ἐξαροῦσιν κατὰ τάγμα αὐτῶν

text_en: This is the number of the children of Israel , of their army divided according to the houses of their kindreds and their troops, six hundred and three thousand five hundred and fifty.
text_la: Hic numerus filiorum Israël, per domos cognationum suarum et turmas divisi exercitus, sexcenta tria millia quingenti quinquaginta.
text_pt: Estes são os que foram contados dos filhos de Israel, segundo a casa de seus pais; todos os que foram contados dos exércitos pelos seus esquadrões foram seiscentos e três mil e quinhentos e cinqüenta.
text_el: αὕτη ἡ ἐπίσκεψις τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ κατ' οἴκους πατριῶν αὐτῶν πᾶσα ἡ ἐπίσκεψις τῶν παρεμβολῶν σὺν ταῖς δυνάμεσιν αὐτῶν ἑξακόσιαι χιλιάδες καὶ τρισχίλιοι πεντακόσιοι πεντήκοντα

text_en: And the Levites were not numbered among the children of Israel : for so the Lord had commanded Moses .
text_la: Levitæ autem non sunt numerati inter filios Israël : sic enim præceperat Dominus Moysi.
text_pt: Mas os levitas não foram contados entre os filhos de Israel, como o Senhor ordenara a Moisés.
text_el: οἱ δὲ Λευῖται οὐ συνεπεσκέπησαν ἐν αὐτοῖς καθὰ ἐνετείλατο κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ

text_en: And the children of Israel did according to all things that the Lord had commanded. They camped by their troops, and marched by the families and houses of their fathers.
text_la: Feceruntque filii Israël juxta omnia quæ mandaverat Dominus. Castrametati sunt per turmas suas, et profecti per familias ac domos patrum suorum.
text_pt: E os filhos de Israel fizeram conforme a tudo o que o Senhor ordenara a Moisés; assim armaram o arraial segundo as suas bandeiras, e assim marcharam, cada qual segundo as suas gerações, segundo a casa de seus pais.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ πάντα ὅσα συνέταξεν κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ οὕτως παρενέβαλον κατὰ τάγμα αὐτῶν καὶ οὕτως ἐξῆρον ἕκαστος ἐχόμενοι κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν κατ' οἴκους πατριῶν αὐτῶν

text_en: These are the generations of Aaron and Moses in the day that the Lord spoke to Moses in mount Sinai .
text_la: Hæ sunt generationes Aaron et Moysi in die qua locutus est Dominus ad Moysen in monte Sinai.
text_pt: E estas são as gerações de Arão e de Moisés, no dia em que o SENHOR falou com Moisés, no monte Sinai.
text_el: καὶ αὗται αἱ γενέσεις Ααρων καὶ Μωυσῆ ἐν ᾗ ἡμέρᾳ ἐλάλησεν κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ ἐν ὄρει Σινα

text_en: And these the names of the sons of Aaron : his firstborn Nadab, then Abiu, and Eleazar , and Ithamar.
text_la: Et hæc nomina filiorum Aaron : primogenitus ejus Nadab, deinde Abiu, et Eleazar, et Ithamar.
text_pt: E estes são os nomes dos filhos de Arão: o primogênito Nadabe; depois Abiú, Eleazar e Itamar.
text_el: καὶ ταῦτα τὰ ὀνόματα τῶν υἱῶν Ααρων πρωτότοκος Ναδαβ καὶ Αβιουδ Ελεαζαρ καὶ Ιθαμαρ

text_en: These the names of the sons of Aaron the priests that were anointed, and whose hands were filled and consecrated , to do the functions of priesthood .
text_la: Hæc nomina filiorum Aaron sacerdotum qui uncti sunt, et quorum repletæ et consecratæ manus ut sacerdotio fungerentur.
text_pt: Estes são os nomes dos filhos de Arão, dos sacerdotes ungidos, cujas mãos foram consagradas para administrar o sacerdócio.
text_el: ταῦτα τὰ ὀνόματα τῶν υἱῶν Ααρων οἱ ἱερεῖς οἱ ἠλειμμένοι οὓς ἐτελείωσαν τὰς χεῖρας αὐτῶν ἱερατεύειν

text_en: Now Nadab and Abiu died, without children, when they offered strange fire before the Lord , in the desert of Sinai : and Eleazar and Ithamar performed the priestly office in the presence of Aaron their father.
text_la: Mortui sunt enim Nadab et Abiu cum offerrent ignem alienum in conspectu Domini in deserto Sinai, absque liberis : functique sunt sacerdotio Eleazar et Ithamar coram Aaron patre suo.
text_pt: Mas Nadabe e Abiú morreram perante o Senhor, quando ofereceram fogo estranho perante o Senhor no deserto de Sinai, e não tiveram filhos; porém Eleazar e Itamar administraram o sacerdócio diante de Arão, seu pai.
text_el: καὶ ἐτελεύτησεν Ναδαβ καὶ Αβιουδ ἔναντι κυρίου προσφερόντων αὐτῶν πῦρ ἀλλότριον ἔναντι κυρίου ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ Σινα καὶ παιδία οὐκ ἦν αὐτοῖς καὶ ἱεράτευσεν Ελεαζαρ καὶ Ιθαμαρ μετ' Ααρων τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτῶν

text_en: And the Lord spoke to Moses , saying:
text_la: Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen, dicens:
text_pt: E falou o Senhor a Moisés, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν λέγων

text_en: Bring the tribe of Levi , and make them stand in the sight of Aaron the priest to minister to him, and let them watch,
text_la: Applica tribum Levi, et fac stare in conspectu Aaron sacerdotis ut ministrent ei, et excubent,
text_pt: Faze chegar a tribo de Levi, e põe-na diante de Arão, o sacerdote, para que o sirvam,
text_el: λαβὲ τὴν φυλὴν Λευι καὶ στήσεις αὐτοὺς ἐναντίον Ααρων τοῦ ἱερέως καὶ λειτουργήσουσιν αὐτῷ

text_en: and observe whatsoever appertains to the service of the multitude before the tabernacle of the testimony ,
text_la: et observent quidquid ad cultum pertinet multitudinis coram tabernaculo testimonii,
text_pt: E tenham cuidado da sua guarda, e da guarda de toda a congregação, diante da tenda da congregação, para administrar o ministério do tabernáculo.
text_el: καὶ φυλάξουσιν τὰς φυλακὰς αὐτοῦ καὶ τὰς φυλακὰς τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ ἔναντι τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου ἐργάζεσθαι τὰ ἔργα τῆς σκηνῆς

text_en: and let them keep the vessels of the tabernacle , serving in the ministry thereof.
text_la: et custodiant vasa tabernaculi, servientes in ministerio ejus.
text_pt: E tenham cuidado de todos os utensílios da tenda da congregação, e da guarda dos filhos de Israel, para administrar o ministério do tabernáculo.
text_el: καὶ φυλάξουσιν πάντα τὰ σκεύη τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου καὶ τὰς φυλακὰς τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ κατὰ πάντα τὰ ἔργα τῆς σκηνῆς

text_en: And you shall give the Levites for a gift,
text_la: Dabisque dono Levitas
text_pt: Darás, pois, os levitas a Arão e a seus filhos; dentre os filhos de Israel lhes são dados em dádiva.
text_el: καὶ δώσεις τοὺς Λευίτας Ααρων καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς αὐτοῦ τοῖς ἱερεῦσιν δόμα δεδομένοι οὗτοί μοί εἰσιν ἀπὸ τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ

text_en: to Aaron and to his sons, to whom they are delivered by the children of Israel . But you shall appoint Aaron and his sons over the service of priesthood . The stranger that approaches to minister, shall be put to death.
text_la: Aaron et filiis ejus, quibus traditi sunt a filiis Israël. Aaron autem et filios ejus constitues super cultum sacerdotii. Externus, qui ad ministrandum accesserit, morietur.
text_pt: Mas a Arão e a seus filhos ordenarás que guardem o seu sacerdócio, e o estranho que se chegar morrerá.
text_el: καὶ Ααρων καὶ τοὺς υἱοὺς αὐτοῦ καταστήσεις ἐπὶ τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου καὶ φυλάξουσιν τὴν ἱερατείαν αὐτῶν καὶ πάντα τὰ κατὰ τὸν βωμὸν καὶ ἔσω τοῦ καταπετάσματος καὶ ὁ ἀλλογενὴς ὁ ἁπτόμενος ἀποθανεῖται

text_en: And the Lord spoke to Moses , saying:
text_la: Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen, dicens:
text_pt: E falou o Senhor a Moisés, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν λέγων

text_en: I have taken the Levites from the children of Israel , for every firstborn that opens the womb among the children of Israel , and the Levites shall be mine.
text_la: Ego tuli Levitas a filiis Israël pro omni primogenito, qui aperit vulvam in filiis Israël, eruntque Levitæ mei.
text_pt: E eu, eis que tenho tomado os levitas do meio dos filhos de Israel, em lugar de todo o primogênito, que abre a madre, entre os filhos de Israel; e os levitas serão meus.
text_el: καὶ ἐγὼ ἰδοὺ εἴληφα τοὺς Λευίτας ἐκ μέσου τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ ἀντὶ παντὸς πρωτοτόκου διανοίγοντος μήτραν παρὰ τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ λύτρα αὐτῶν ἔσονται καὶ ἔσονται ἐμοὶ οἱ Λευῖται

text_en: For every firstborn is mine: since I struck the firstborn in the land of Egypt : I have sanctified to myself whatsoever is firstborn in Israel both of man and beast, they are mine: I am the Lord .
text_la: Meum est enim omne primogenitum : ex quo percussi primogenitos in terra Ægypti, sanctificavi mihi quidquid primum nascitur in Israël : ab homine usque ad pecus, mei sunt. Ego Dominus.
text_pt: Porque todo o primogênito é meu; desde o dia em que tenho ferido a todo o primogênito na terra do Egito, santifiquei para mim todo o primogênito em Israel, desde o homem até ao animal: meus serão; Eu sou o Senhor.
text_el: ἐμοὶ γὰρ πᾶν πρωτότοκον ἐν ᾗ ἡμέρᾳ ἐπάταξα πᾶν πρωτότοκον ἐν γῇ Αἰγύπτου ἡγίασα ἐμοὶ πᾶν πρωτότοκον ἐν Ισραηλ ἀπὸ ἀνθρώπου ἕως κτήνους ἐμοὶ ἔσονται ἐγὼ κύριος

text_en: And the Lord spoke to Moses in the desert of Sinai , saying:
text_la: Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen in deserto Sinai, dicens:
text_pt: E falou o Senhor a Moisés no deserto de Sinai, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ Σινα λέγων

text_en: Number the sons of Levi by the houses of their fathers and their families , every male from one month and upward.
text_la: Numera filios Levi per domos patrum suorum et familias, omnem masculum ab uno mense et supra.
text_pt: Conta os filhos de Levi, segundo a casa de seus pais, pelas suas famílias; contarás a todo o homem da idade de um mês para cima.
text_el: ἐπίσκεψαι τοὺς υἱοὺς Λευι κατ' οἴκους πατριῶν αὐτῶν κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν κατὰ συγγενείας αὐτῶν πᾶν ἀρσενικὸν ἀπὸ μηνιαίου καὶ ἐπάνω ἐπισκέψασθε αὐτούς

text_en: Moses numbered them as the Lord had commanded.
text_la: Numeravit Moyses, ut præceperat Dominus,
text_pt: E Moisés os contou conforme ao mandado do Senhor, como lhe foi ordenado.
text_el: καὶ ἐπεσκέψαντο αὐτοὺς Μωυσῆς καὶ Ααρων διὰ φωνῆς κυρίου ὃν τρόπον συνέταξεν αὐτοῖς κύριος

text_en: And there were found sons of Levi by their names , Gerson and Caath Merari.
text_la: et inventi sunt filii Levi per nomina sua, Gerson et Caath et Merari.
text_pt: Estes, pois, foram os filhos de Levi pelos seus nomes: Gérson, e Coate e Merari.
text_el: καὶ ἦσαν οὗτοι οἱ υἱοὶ Λευι ἐξ ὀνομάτων αὐτῶν Γεδσων Κααθ καὶ Μεραρι

text_en: The sons of Gerson: Lebni and Semei.
text_la: Filii Gerson : Lebni et Semei.
text_pt: E estes são os nomes dos filhos de Gérson pelas suas famílias: Libni e Simei.
text_el: καὶ ταῦτα τὰ ὀνόματα τῶν υἱῶν Γεδσων κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν Λοβενι καὶ Σεμεϊ

text_en: The sons of Caath: Amram, and Jesaar, Hebron and Oziel:
text_la: Filii Caath : Amram et Jesaar, Hebron et Oziel.
text_pt: E os filhos de Coate pelas suas famílias: Amrão, e Izar, Hebrom e Uziel.
text_el: καὶ υἱοὶ Κααθ κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν Αμραμ καὶ Ισσααρ Χεβρων καὶ Οζιηλ

text_en: The sons of Merari, Moholi and Musi.
text_la: Filii Merari : Moholi et Musi.
text_pt: E os filhos de Merari pelas suas famílias: Mali e Musi; estas são as famílias dos levitas, segundo a casa de seus pais.
text_el: καὶ υἱοὶ Μεραρι κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν Μοολι καὶ Μουσι οὗτοί εἰσιν δῆμοι τῶν Λευιτῶν κατ' οἴκους πατριῶν αὐτῶν

text_en: Of Gerson were two families , the Lebnites, and the Semeites:
text_la: De Gerson fuere familiæ duæ, Lebnitica, et Semeitica:
text_pt: De Gérson é a família dos libnitas e a família dos simeítas; estas são as famílias dos gersonitas.
text_el: τῷ Γεδσων δῆμος τοῦ Λοβενι καὶ δῆμος τοῦ Σεμεϊ οὗτοι δῆμοι τοῦ Γεδσων

text_en: Of which were numbered, people of the male sex from one month and upward, seven thousand five hundred.
text_la: quarum numeratus est populus sexus masculini ab uno mense et supra, septem millia quingenti.
text_pt: Os que deles foram contados pelo número de todo o homem da idade de um mês para cima, sim, os que deles foram contados eram sete mil e quinhentos.
text_el: ἡ ἐπίσκεψις αὐτῶν κατὰ ἀριθμὸν παντὸς ἀρσενικοῦ ἀπὸ μηνιαίου καὶ ἐπάνω ἡ ἐπίσκεψις αὐτῶν ἑπτακισχίλιοι καὶ πεντακόσιοι

text_en: These shall pitch behind the tabernacle on the west,
text_la: Hi post tabernaculum metabuntur ad occidentem,
text_pt: As famílias dos gersonitas armarão as suas tendas atrás do tabernáculo, ao ocidente.
text_el: καὶ υἱοὶ Γεδσων ὀπίσω τῆς σκηνῆς παρὰ θάλασσαν παρεμβαλοῦσιν

text_en: under their prince Eliasaph the son of Lael.
text_la: sub principe Eliasaph filio Laël.
text_pt: E o príncipe da casa paterna dos gersonitas será Eliasafe, filho de Lael.
text_el: καὶ ὁ ἄρχων οἴκου πατριᾶς τοῦ δήμου τοῦ Γεδσων Ελισαφ υἱὸς Λαηλ

text_en: And their charge shall be in the tabernacle of the covenant :
text_la: Et habebunt excubias in tabernaculo fœderis,
text_pt: E os filhos de Gérson terão a seu cargo, na tenda da congregação, o tabernáculo, a tenda, a sua coberta, e o véu da porta da tenda da congregação.
text_el: καὶ ἡ φυλακὴ υἱῶν Γεδσων ἐν τῇ σκηνῇ τοῦ μαρτυρίου ἡ σκηνὴ καὶ τὸ κάλυμμα καὶ τὸ κατακάλυμμα τῆς θύρας τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου

text_en: The tabernacle itself and the cover thereof, the hanging that is drawn before the doors of the tabernacle of the covenant , and the curtains of the court : the hanging also that is hanged in the entry of the court of the tabernacle , and whatsoever belongs to the rite of the altar , the cords of the tabernacle , and all the furniture thereof.
text_la: ipsum tabernaculum et operimentum ejus, tentorium quod trahitur ante fores tecti fœderis, et cortinas atrii : tentorium quoque quod appenditur in introitu atrii tabernaculi, et quidquid ad ritum altaris pertinet, funes tabernaculi et omnia utensilia ejus.
text_pt: E as cortinas do pátio, e o pavilhão da porta do pátio, que estão junto ao tabernáculo e junto ao altar, em redor; como também as suas cordas para todo o seu serviço.
text_el: καὶ τὰ ἱστία τῆς αὐλῆς καὶ τὸ καταπέτασμα τῆς πύλης τῆς αὐλῆς τῆς οὔσης ἐπὶ τῆς σκηνῆς καὶ τὰ κατάλοιπα πάντων τῶν ἔργων αὐτοῦ

text_en: Of the kindred of Caath come the families of the Amramites and Jesaarites and Hebronites and Ozielites. These are the families of the Caathites reckoned up by their names :
text_la: Cognatio Caath habebit populos Amramitas et Jesaaritas et Hebronitas et Ozielitas. Hæ sunt familiæ Caathitarum recensitæ per nomina sua.
text_pt: E de Coate é a família dos amramitas, e a família dos jizaritas, e a família dos hebronitas, e a família dos uzielitas; estas são as famílias dos coatitas.
text_el: τῷ Κααθ δῆμος ὁ Αμραμις καὶ δῆμος ὁ Σααρις καὶ δῆμος ὁ Χεβρωνις καὶ δῆμος ὁ Οζιηλις οὗτοί εἰσιν δῆμοι τοῦ Κααθ

text_en: All of the male sex from one month and upward, eight thousand six hundred: they shall have the guard of the sanctuary,
text_la: Omnes generis masculini ab uno mense et supra, octo millia sexcenti habebunt excubias sanctuarii,
text_pt: Pelo número contado de todo o homem da idade de um mês para cima, eram oito mil e seiscentos, que tinham cuidado da guarda do santuário.
text_el: κατὰ ἀριθμὸν πᾶν ἀρσενικὸν ἀπὸ μηνιαίου καὶ ἐπάνω ὀκτακισχίλιοι καὶ ἑξακόσιοι φυλάσσοντες τὰς φυλακὰς τῶν ἁγίων

text_en: and shall camp on the south side.
text_la: et castrametabuntur ad meridianam plagam.
text_pt: As famílias dos filhos de Coate armarão as suas tendas ao lado do tabernáculo, do lado do sul.
text_el: οἱ δῆμοι τῶν υἱῶν Κααθ παρεμβαλοῦσιν ἐκ πλαγίων τῆς σκηνῆς κατὰ λίβα

text_en: And their prince shall be Elisaphan the son of Oziel:
text_la: Princepsque eorum erit Elisaphan filius Oziel:
text_pt: E o príncipe da casa paterna das famílias dos coatitas será Elisafã, filho de Uziel.
text_el: καὶ ὁ ἄρχων οἴκου πατριῶν τῶν δήμων τοῦ Κααθ Ελισαφαν υἱὸς Οζιηλ

text_en: And they shall keep the ark , and the table and the candlestick , the altars , and the vessels of the sanctuary, wherewith they minister, and the veil, and all the furniture of this kind.
text_la: et custodient arcam, mensamque et candelabrum, altaria et vasa sanctuarii, in quibus ministratur, et velum, cunctamque hujuscemodi supellectilem.
text_pt: E a sua guarda será a arca, e a mesa, e o candelabro, e os altares, e os utensílios do santuário com que ministram, e o véu com todo o seu serviço.
text_el: καὶ ἡ φυλακὴ αὐτῶν ἡ κιβωτὸς καὶ ἡ τράπεζα καὶ ἡ λυχνία καὶ τὰ θυσιαστήρια καὶ τὰ σκεύη τοῦ ἁγίου ὅσα λειτουργοῦσιν ἐν αὐτοῖς καὶ τὸ κατακάλυμμα καὶ πάντα τὰ ἔργα αὐτῶν

text_en: And the prince of the princes of the Levites , Eleazar , the son of Aaron the priest , shall be over them that watch for the guard of the sanctuary.
text_la: Princeps autem principum Levitarum Eleazar filius Aaron sacerdotis, erit super excubitores custodiæ sanctuarii.
text_pt: E o príncipe dos príncipes de Levi será Eleazar, filho de Arão, o sacerdote; terá a superintendência sobre os que têm cuidado da guarda do santuário.
text_el: καὶ ὁ ἄρχων ἐπὶ τῶν ἀρχόντων τῶν Λευιτῶν Ελεαζαρ ὁ υἱὸς Ααρων τοῦ ἱερέως καθεσταμένος φυλάσσειν τὰς φυλακὰς τῶν ἁγίων

text_en: And of Merari are the families of the Moholites, and Musites, reckoned up by their names :
text_la: At vero de Merari erunt populi Moholitæ et Musitæ recensiti per nomina sua:
text_pt: De Merari é a família dos malitas e a família dos musitas; estas são as famílias de Merari.
text_el: τῷ Μεραρι δῆμος ὁ Μοολι καὶ δῆμος ὁ Μουσι οὗτοί εἰσιν δῆμοι Μεραρι

text_en: All of the male kind from one month and upward, six thousand two hundred.
text_la: omnes generis masculini ab uno mense et supra, sex millia ducenti.
text_pt: E os que deles foram contados pelo número de todo o homem de um mês para cima, foram seis mil e duzentos.
text_el: ἡ ἐπίσκεψις αὐτῶν κατὰ ἀριθμόν πᾶν ἀρσενικὸν ἀπὸ μηνιαίου καὶ ἐπάνω ἑξακισχίλιοι καὶ πεντήκοντα

text_en: Their prince Suriel the son of Abihaiel: their shall camp on the north side.
text_la: Princeps eorum Suriel filius Abihaiel : in plaga septentrionali castrametabuntur.
text_pt: E o príncipe da casa paterna das famílias de Merari será Zuriel, filho de Abiail; armarão as suas tendas ao lado do tabernáculo, do lado do norte.
text_el: καὶ ὁ ἄρχων οἴκου πατριῶν τοῦ δήμου τοῦ Μεραρι Σουριηλ υἱὸς Αβιχαιλ ἐκ πλαγίων τῆς σκηνῆς παρεμβαλοῦσιν πρὸς βορρᾶν

text_en: Under their custody shall be the boards of the tabernacle , and the bars, and the pillars and their sockets, and all things that pertain to this kind of service:
text_la: Erunt sub custodia eorum tabulæ tabernaculi et vectes, et columnæ ac bases earum, et omnia quæ ad cultum hujuscemodi pertinent:
text_pt: E os filhos de Merari terão a seu cargo as tábuas do tabernáculo, os seus varais, as suas colunas, as suas bases, e todos os seus utensílios, com todo o seu serviço.
text_el: ἡ ἐπίσκεψις ἡ φυλακὴ υἱῶν Μεραρι τὰς κεφαλίδας τῆς σκηνῆς καὶ τοὺς μοχλοὺς αὐτῆς καὶ τοὺς στύλους αὐτῆς καὶ τὰς βάσεις αὐτῆς καὶ πάντα τὰ σκεύη αὐτῶν καὶ τὰ ἔργα αὐτῶν

text_en: And the pillars of the court round about with their sockets, and the pins with their cords.
text_la: columnæque atrii per circuitum cum basibus suis, et paxilli cum funibus.
text_pt: E as colunas do pátio em redor, e as suas bases, as suas estacas e as suas cordas.
text_el: καὶ τοὺς στύλους τῆς αὐλῆς κύκλῳ καὶ τὰς βάσεις αὐτῶν καὶ τοὺς πασσάλους καὶ τοὺς κάλους αὐτῶν

text_en: Before the tabernacle of the covenant , that is to say on the east side shall Moses and Aaron camp, with their sons, having the custody of the sanctuary, in the midst of the children of Israel . What stranger soever comes unto it, shall be put to death.
text_la: Castrametabuntur ante tabernaculum fœderis, id est, ad orientalem plagam, Moyses et Aaron cum filiis suis, habentes custodiam sanctuarii in medio filiorum Israël. Quisquis alienus accesserit, morietur.
text_pt: E os que armarão as suas tendas diante do tabernáculo, ao oriente, diante da tenda da congregação, para o nascente, serão Moisés e Arão, com seus filhos, tendo o cuidado da guarda do santuário, pela guarda dos filhos de Israel; e o estranho que se chegar morrerá.
text_el: καὶ οἱ παρεμβάλλοντες κατὰ πρόσωπον τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου ἀπ' ἀνατολῆς Μωυσῆς καὶ Ααρων καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ φυλάσσοντες τὰς φυλακὰς τοῦ ἁγίου εἰς τὰς φυλακὰς τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ καὶ ὁ ἀλλογενὴς ὁ ἁπτόμενος ἀποθανεῖται

text_en: All the Levites , that I Moses and Aaron numbered according to the precept of the Lord , by their families , of the male kind from one month and upward, were twenty-two thousand.
text_la: Omnes Levitæ, quos numeraverunt Moyses et Aaron juxta præceptum Domini per familias suas in genere masculino a mense uno et supra, fuerunt viginti duo millia.
text_pt: Todos os que foram contados dos levitas, que contaram Moisés e Arão por mandado do Senhor, segundo as suas famílias, todo o homem de um mês para cima, foram vinte e dois mil.
text_el: πᾶσα ἡ ἐπίσκεψις τῶν Λευιτῶν οὓς ἐπεσκέψατο Μωυσῆς καὶ Ααρων διὰ φωνῆς κυρίου κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν πᾶν ἀρσενικὸν ἀπὸ μηνιαίου καὶ ἐπάνω δύο καὶ εἴκοσι χιλιάδες

text_en: And the Lord said to Moses : Number the firstborn of the male sex of the children of Israel , from one month and upward, and you shall take the sum of them.
text_la: Et ait Dominus ad Moysen : Numera primogenitos sexus masculini de filiis Israël ab uno mense et supra, et habebis summam eorum.
text_pt: E disse o Senhor a Moisés: Conta todo o primogênito homem dos filhos de Israel, da idade de um mês para cima, e toma o número dos seus nomes,
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν λέγων ἐπίσκεψαι πᾶν πρωτότοκον ἄρσεν τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ ἀπὸ μηνιαίου καὶ ἐπάνω καὶ λαβὲ τὸν ἀριθμὸν ἐξ ὀνόματος

text_en: And you shall take the Levites to me for all the firstborn of the children of Israel , I am the Lord : and their cattle for all the firstborn of the cattle of the children of Israel :
text_la: Tollesque Levitas mihi pro omni primogenito filiorum Israël : ego sum Dominus : et pecora eorum pro universis primogenitis pecorum filiorum Israël.
text_pt: E para mim tomarás os levitas (eu sou o Senhor), em lugar de todo o primogênito dos filhos de Israel, e os animais dos levitas, em lugar de todo o primogênito entre os animais dos filhos de Israel.
text_el: καὶ λήμψῃ τοὺς Λευίτας ἐμοί ἐγὼ κύριος ἀντὶ πάντων τῶν πρωτοτόκων τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ καὶ τὰ κτήνη τῶν Λευιτῶν ἀντὶ πάντων τῶν πρωτοτόκων ἐν τοῖς κτήνεσιν τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ

text_en: Moses reckoned up, as the Lord had commanded, the firstborn of the children of Israel :
text_la: Recensuit Moyses, sicut præceperat Dominus, primogenitos filiorum Israël:
text_pt: E contou Moisés, como o Senhor lhe ordenara, todo o primogênito entre os filhos de Israel.
text_el: καὶ ἐπεσκέψατο Μωυσῆς ὃν τρόπον ἐνετείλατο κύριος πᾶν πρωτότοκον ἐν τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ

text_en: And the males by their names , from one month and upward, were twenty-two thousand two hundred and seventy-three.
text_la: et fuerunt masculi per nomina sua, a mense uno et supra, viginti duo millia ducenti septuaginta tres.
text_pt: E todos os primogênitos homens, pelo número dos nomes dos da idade de um mês para cima, segundo os que eram contados deles, foram vinte e dois mil e duzentos e setenta e três.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένοντο πάντα τὰ πρωτότοκα τὰ ἀρσενικὰ κατὰ ἀριθμὸν ἐξ ὀνόματος ἀπὸ μηνιαίου καὶ ἐπάνω ἐκ τῆς ἐπισκέψεως αὐτῶν δύο καὶ εἴκοσι χιλιάδες τρεῖς καὶ ἑβδομήκοντα καὶ διακόσιοι

text_en: And the Lord spoke to Moses , saying:
text_la: Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen, dicens:
text_pt: E falou o Senhor a Moisés, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν λέγων

text_en: Take the Levites for the firstborn of the children of Israel , and the cattle of the Levites for their cattle, and the Levites shall be mine. I am the Lord .
text_la: Tolle Levitas pro primogenitis filiorum Israël, et pecora Levitarum pro pecoribus eorum, eruntque Levitæ mei. Ego sum Dominus.
text_pt: Toma os levitas em lugar de todo o primogênito entre os filhos de Israel, e os animais dos levitas em lugar dos seus animais; porquanto os levitas serão meus: Eu sou o Senhor.
text_el: λαβὲ τοὺς Λευίτας ἀντὶ πάντων τῶν πρωτοτόκων τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ καὶ τὰ κτήνη τῶν Λευιτῶν ἀντὶ τῶν κτηνῶν αὐτῶν καὶ ἔσονται ἐμοὶ οἱ Λευῖται ἐγὼ κύριος

text_en: But for the price of the two hundred and seventy-three, of the firstborn of the children of Israel , that exceed the number of the Levites ,
text_la: In pretio autem ducentorum septuaginta trium, qui excedunt numerum Levitarum de primogenitis filiorum Israël,
text_pt: Quanto aos duzentos e setenta e três, que se houverem de resgatar dos primogênitos dos filhos de Israel, que excedem ao número dos levitas,
text_el: καὶ τὰ λύτρα τριῶν καὶ ἑβδομήκοντα καὶ διακοσίων οἱ πλεονάζοντες παρὰ τοὺς Λευίτας ἀπὸ τῶν πρωτοτόκων τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ

text_en: you shall take five sicles for every bead, according to the weight of the sanctuary. A sicle has twenty obols.
text_la: accipies quinque siclos per singula capita ad mensuram sanctuarii (siclus habet viginti obolos):
text_pt: Tomarás, por cabeça, cinco siclos; conforme ao siclo do santuário os tomarás, a vinte geras o siclo.
text_el: καὶ λήμψῃ πέντε σίκλους κατὰ κεφαλήν κατὰ τὸ δίδραχμον τὸ ἅγιον λήμψῃ εἴκοσι ὀβολοὺς τοῦ σίκλου

text_en: And you shall give the money to Aaron and his sons, the price of them that are above.
text_la: dabisque pecuniam Aaron et filiis ejus pretium eorum qui supra sunt.
text_pt: E a Arão e a seus filhos darás o dinheiro dos resgatados, dos que sobram entre eles.
text_el: καὶ δώσεις τὸ ἀργύριον Ααρων καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς αὐτοῦ λύτρα τῶν πλεοναζόντων ἐν αὐτοῖς

text_en: Moses therefore took the money of them that were above, and whom they had redeemed from the Levites ,
text_la: Tulit igitur Moyses pecuniam eorum, qui fuerant amplius, et quos redemerant a Levitis,
text_pt: Então Moisés tomou o dinheiro do resgate dos que excederam sobre os resgatados pelos levitas.
text_el: καὶ ἔλαβεν Μωυσῆς τὸ ἀργύριον τὰ λύτρα τῶν πλεοναζόντων εἰς τὴν ἐκλύτρωσιν τῶν Λευιτῶν

text_en: for the firstborn of the children of Israel , one thousand three hundred and sixty-five sicles, according to the weight of the sanctuary,
text_la: pro primogenitis filiorum Israël, mille trecentorum sexaginta quinque siclorum juxta pondus sanctuarii:
text_pt: Dos primogênitos dos filhos de Israel recebeu o dinheiro, mil e trezentos e sessenta e cinco siclos, segundo o siclo do santuário.
text_el: παρὰ τῶν πρωτοτόκων τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ ἔλαβεν τὸ ἀργύριον χιλίους τριακοσίους ἑξήκοντα πέντε σίκλους κατὰ τὸν σίκλον τὸν ἅγιον

text_en: and gave it to Aaron and his sons according to the word that the Lord had commanded him.
text_la: et dedit eam Aaron et filiis ejus juxta verbum quod præceperat sibi Dominus.
text_pt: E Moisés deu o dinheiro dos resgatados a Arão e a seus filhos, segundo o mandado do Senhor, como o Senhor ordenara a Moisés.
text_el: καὶ ἔδωκεν Μωυσῆς τὰ λύτρα τῶν πλεοναζόντων Ααρων καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς αὐτοῦ διὰ φωνῆς κυρίου ὃν τρόπον συνέταξεν κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ

text_en: And the Lord spoke to Moses , and Aaron , saying:
text_la: Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen et Aaron, dicens:
text_pt: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés e a Arão, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν καὶ Ααρων λέγων

text_en: Take the sum of the sons of Caath from the midst of the Levites , by their houses and families .
text_la: Tolle summam filiorum Caath de medio Levitarum per domos et familias suas,
text_pt: Fazei a soma dos filhos de Coate, dentre os filhos de Levi, pelas suas famílias, segundo a casa de seus pais;
text_el: λαβὲ τὸ κεφάλαιον τῶν υἱῶν Κααθ ἐκ μέσου υἱῶν Λευι κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν κατ' οἴκους πατριῶν αὐτῶν

text_en: From thirty years old and upward, to fifty years old, of all that go in to stand and to minister in the tabernacle of the covenant .
text_la: a trigesimo anno et supra, usque ad quinquagesimum annum, omnium qui ingrediuntur ut stent et ministrent in tabernaculo fœderis.
text_pt: Da idade de trinta anos para cima até aos cinqüenta anos, será todo aquele que entrar neste serviço, para fazer o trabalho na tenda da congregação.
text_el: ἀπὸ εἴκοσι καὶ πέντε ἐτῶν καὶ ἐπάνω καὶ ἕως πεντήκοντα ἐτῶν πᾶς ὁ εἰσπορευόμενος λειτουργεῖν ποιῆσαι πάντα τὰ ἔργα ἐν τῇ σκηνῇ τοῦ μαρτυρίου

text_en: This is the service of the sons of Caath:
text_la: Hic est cultus filiorum Caath : tabernaculum fœderis, et Sanctum sanctorum
text_pt: Este será o ministério dos filhos de Coate na tenda da congregação, nas coisas santíssimas.
text_el: καὶ ταῦτα τὰ ἔργα τῶν υἱῶν Κααθ ἐν τῇ σκηνῇ τοῦ μαρτυρίου ἅγιον τῶν ἁγίων

text_en: When the camp is; to set forward, Aaron and his sons shall go into the tabernacle of the covenant , and the holy of holies, and shall take down the veil that hangs before the door, and shall wrap up the ark of the testimony in it,
text_la: ingredientur Aaron et filii ejus, quando movenda sunt castra, et deponent velum quod pendet ante fores, involventque eo arcam testimonii,
text_pt: Quando partir o arraial, Arão e seus filhos virão e tirarão o véu da tenda, e com ele cobrirão a arca do testemunho;
text_el: καὶ εἰσελεύσεται Ααρων καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ ὅταν ἐξαίρῃ ἡ παρεμβολή καὶ καθελοῦσιν τὸ καταπέτασμα τὸ συσκιάζον καὶ κατακαλύψουσιν ἐν αὐτῷ τὴν κιβωτὸν τοῦ μαρτυρίου

text_en: and shall cover it again with a cover of violet skins, and shall spread over it a cloth all of violet, and shall put in the bars.
text_la: et operient rursum velamine janthinarum pellium, extendentque desuper pallium totum hyacinthinum, et inducent vectes.
text_pt: E pôr-lhe-ão por cima uma coberta de peles de texugos, e sobre ela estenderão um pano, todo azul, e lhe colocarão os varais.
text_el: καὶ ἐπιθήσουσιν ἐπ' αὐτὸ κατακάλυμμα δέρμα ὑακίνθινον καὶ ἐπιβαλοῦσιν ἐπ' αὐτὴν ἱμάτιον ὅλον ὑακίνθινον ἄνωθεν καὶ διεμβαλοῦσιν τοὺς ἀναφορεῖς

text_en: They shall wrap up also the table of proposition in a cloth of violet, and shall put with it the censers and little mortars, the cups and bowls to pour out the libations: the loaves shall be always on it:
text_la: Mensam quoque propositionis involvent hyacinthino pallio, et ponent cum ea thuribula et mortariola, cyathos et crateras ad liba fundenda : panes semper in ea erunt:
text_pt: Também sobre a mesa da proposição estenderão um pano azul; e sobre ela porão os pratos, as colheres, e as taças e os jarros para libação; também o pão contínuo estará sobre ela.
text_el: καὶ ἐπὶ τὴν τράπεζαν τὴν προκειμένην ἐπιβαλοῦσιν ἐπ' αὐτὴν ἱμάτιον ὁλοπόρφυρον καὶ τὰ τρυβλία καὶ τὰς θυίσκας καὶ τοὺς κυάθους καὶ τὰ σπονδεῖα ἐν οἷς σπένδει καὶ οἱ ἄρτοι οἱ διὰ παντὸς ἐπ' αὐτῆς ἔσονται

text_en: And they shall spread over it a cloth of scarlet, which again they shall cover with a covering of violet skins, and shall put in the bars.
text_la: extendentque desuper pallium coccineum, quod rursum operient velamento janthinarum pellium, et inducent vectes.
text_pt: Depois estenderão em cima deles um pano de carmesim, e com a coberta de peles de texugos o cobrirão, e lhe colocarão os seus varais.
text_el: καὶ ἐπιβαλοῦσιν ἐπ' αὐτὴν ἱμάτιον κόκκινον καὶ καλύψουσιν αὐτὴν καλύμματι δερματίνῳ ὑακινθίνῳ καὶ διεμβαλοῦσιν δι' αὐτῆς τοὺς ἀναφορεῖς

text_en: They shall take also a cloth of violet wherewith they shall cover the candlestick with the lamps and tongs thereof and the snuffers and all the oil vessels, which are necessary for the dressing of the lamps:
text_la: Sument et pallium hyacinthinum, quo operient candelabrum cum lucernis et forcipibus suis et emunctoriis et cunctis vasis olei, quæ ad concinnandas lucernas necessaria sunt:
text_pt: Então tomarão um pano azul, e cobrirão o candelabro da luminária, e as suas lâmpadas, e os seus espevitadores, e os seus apagadores, e todos os seus vasos de azeite, com que o servem.
text_el: καὶ λήμψονται ἱμάτιον ὑακίνθινον καὶ καλύψουσιν τὴν λυχνίαν τὴν φωτίζουσαν καὶ τοὺς λύχνους αὐτῆς καὶ τὰς λαβίδας αὐτῆς καὶ τὰς ἐπαρυστρίδας αὐτῆς καὶ πάντα τὰ ἀγγεῖα τοῦ ἐλαίου οἷς λειτουργοῦσιν ἐν αὐτοῖς

text_en: And over all they shall put a cover of violet skins and put in the bars.
text_la: et super omnia ponent operimentum janthinarum pellium, et inducent vectes.
text_pt: E envolverão, a ele e a todos os seus utensílios, na coberta de peles de texugos; e o colocarão sobre os varais.
text_el: καὶ ἐμβαλοῦσιν αὐτὴν καὶ πάντα τὰ σκεύη αὐτῆς εἰς κάλυμμα δερμάτινον ὑακίνθινον καὶ ἐπιθήσουσιν αὐτὴν ἐπ' ἀναφορέων

text_en: And they shall wrap up the golden altar also in a cloth of violet, and shall spread over it a cover of violet skins, and put in the bars.
text_la: Necnon et altare aureum involvent hyacinthino vestimento, et extendent desuper operimentum janthinarum pellium, inducentque vectes.
text_pt: E sobre o altar de ouro estenderão um pano azul, e com a coberta de peles de texugos, o cobrirão, e lhe colocarão os seus varais.
text_el: καὶ ἐπὶ τὸ θυσιαστήριον τὸ χρυσοῦν ἐπικαλύψουσιν ἱμάτιον ὑακίνθινον καὶ καλύψουσιν αὐτὸ καλύμματι δερματίνῳ ὑακινθίνῳ καὶ διεμβαλοῦσιν τοὺς ἀναφορεῖς αὐτοῦ

text_en: All the vessels wherewith they minister in the sanctuary, they shall wrap up in a cloth of violet, and shall spread over it a cover of violet skins, and put in the bars.
text_la: Omnia vasa, quibus ministratur in sanctuario, involvent hyacinthino pallio, et extendent desuper operimentum janthinarum pellium, inducentque vectes.
text_pt: Também tomarão todos os utensílios do ministério, com que servem no santuário; e os colocarão num pano azul, e os cobrirão com uma coberta de peles de texugos, e os colocarão sobre os varais.
text_el: καὶ λήμψονται πάντα τὰ σκεύη τὰ λειτουργικά ὅσα λειτουργοῦσιν ἐν αὐτοῖς ἐν τοῖς ἁγίοις καὶ ἐμβαλοῦσιν εἰς ἱμάτιον ὑακίνθινον καὶ καλύψουσιν αὐτὰ καλύμματι δερματίνῳ ὑακινθίνῳ καὶ ἐπιθήσουσιν ἐπὶ ἀναφορεῖς

text_en: They shall cleanse the altar also from the ashes, and shall wrap it up in a purple cloth,
text_la: Sed et altare mundabunt cinere, et involvent illud purpureo vestimento,
text_pt: E tirarão as cinzas do altar, e por cima dele estenderão um pano de púrpura.
text_el: καὶ τὸν καλυπτῆρα ἐπιθήσει ἐπὶ τὸ θυσιαστήριον καὶ ἐπικαλύψουσιν ἐπ' αὐτὸ ἱμάτιον ὁλοπόρφυρον

text_en: and shall put it with all the vessels that they use in the ministry thereof, that is to say, firepans, fleshhooks and forks, pothooks and shovels. They shall cover all the vessels of the altar together with a covering of violet skins, and shall put in the bars.
text_la: ponentque cum eo omnia vasa, quibus in ministerio ejus utuntur, id est, ignium receptacula, fuscinulas ac tridentes, uncinos et batilla. Cuncta vasa altaris operient simul velamine janthinarum pellium, et inducent vectes.
text_pt: E sobre ele colocarão todos os seus instrumentos com que o servem: os seus braseiros, os garfos e as pás, e as bacias; todos os pertences do altar; e por cima dele estenderão uma coberta de peles de texugos, e lhe colocarão os seus varais.
text_el: καὶ ἐπιθήσουσιν ἐπ' αὐτὸ πάντα τὰ σκεύη ὅσοις λειτουργοῦσιν ἐπ' αὐτὸ ἐν αὐτοῖς καὶ τὰ πυρεῖα καὶ τὰς κρεάγρας καὶ τὰς φιάλας καὶ τὸν καλυπτῆρα καὶ πάντα τὰ σκεύη τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου καὶ ἐπιβαλοῦσιν ἐπ' αὐτὸ κάλυμμα δερμάτινον ὑακίνθινον καὶ διεμβαλοῦσιν τοὺς ἀναφορεῖς αὐτοῦ καὶ λήμψονται ἱμάτιον πορφυροῦν καὶ συγκαλύψουσιν τὸν λουτῆρα καὶ τὴν βάσιν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐμβαλοῦσιν αὐτὰ εἰς κάλυμμα δερμάτινον ὑακίνθινον καὶ ἐπιθήσουσιν ἐπὶ ἀναφορεῖς

text_en: And when Aaron and his sons have wrapped up the sanctuary and the vessels thereof at the removing of the camp, then shall the sons of Caath enter in to carry the things wrapped up: and they shall not touch the vessels of the sanctuary, lest they die. These are the burdens of the sons of Caath: in the tabernacle of the covenant :
text_la: Cumque involverint Aaron et filii ejus sanctuarium et omnia vasa ejus in commotione castrorum, tunc intrabunt filii Caath ut portent involuta : et non tangent vasa sanctuarii, ne moriantur. Ista sunt onera filiorum Caath in tabernaculo fœderis:
text_pt: Havendo, pois, Arão e seus filhos, ao partir do arraial, acabado de cobrir o santuário, e todos os instrumentos do santuário, então os filhos de Coate virão para levá-lo; mas no santuário não tocarão para que não morram; este é o cargo dos filhos de Coate na tenda da congregação.
text_el: καὶ συντελέσουσιν Ααρων καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ καλύπτοντες τὰ ἅγια καὶ πάντα τὰ σκεύη τὰ ἅγια ἐν τῷ ἐξαίρειν τὴν παρεμβολήν καὶ μετὰ ταῦτα εἰσελεύσονται υἱοὶ Κααθ αἴρειν καὶ οὐχ ἅψονται τῶν ἁγίων ἵνα μὴ ἀποθάνωσιν ταῦτα ἀροῦσιν οἱ υἱοὶ Κααθ ἐν τῇ σκηνῇ τοῦ μαρτυρίου

text_en: And over them shall be Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest , to whose charge pertains the oil to dress the lamps, and the sweet incense , and the sacrifice , that is always offered, and the oil of unction, and whatsoever pertains to the service of the tabernacle , and of all the vessels that are in the sanctuary.
text_la: super quos erit Eleazar filius Aaron sacerdotis, ad cujus curam pertinet oleum ad concinnandas lucernas, et compositionis incensum, et sacrificium, quod semper offertur, et oleum unctionis, et quidquid ad cultum tabernaculi pertinet, omniumque vasorum, quæ in sanctuario sunt.
text_pt: Porém o cargo de Eleazar, filho de Arão, o sacerdote, será o azeite da luminária e o incenso aromático, e a contínua oferta dos alimentos, e o azeite da unção, o cargo de todo o tabernáculo, e de tudo que nele há, o santuário e os seus utensílios.
text_el: ἐπίσκοπος Ελεαζαρ υἱὸς Ααρων τοῦ ἱερέως τὸ ἔλαιον τοῦ φωτὸς καὶ τὸ θυμίαμα τῆς συνθέσεως καὶ ἡ θυσία ἡ καθ' ἡμέραν καὶ τὸ ἔλαιον τῆς χρίσεως ἡ ἐπισκοπὴ ὅλης τῆς σκηνῆς καὶ ὅσα ἐστὶν ἐν αὐτῇ ἐν τῷ ἁγίῳ ἐν πᾶσι τοῖς ἔργοις

text_en: And the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron , saying:
text_la: Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen et Aaron, dicens:
text_pt: E falou o Senhor a Moisés e a Arão, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν καὶ Ααρων λέγων

text_en: Destroy not the people of Caath from the midst of the Levites :
text_la: Nolite perdere populum Caath de medio Levitarum:
text_pt: Não deixareis extirpar a tribo das famílias dos coatitas do meio dos levitas.
text_el: μὴ ὀλεθρεύσητε τῆς φυλῆς τὸν δῆμον τὸν Κααθ ἐκ μέσου τῶν Λευιτῶν

text_en: But do this to them, that they may live, and not die, by touching the holies of holies. Aaron and his sons shall go in, and they shall appoint every man his work, and shall divide the burdens that every man is to carry.
text_la: sed hoc facite eis, ut vivant, et non moriantur, si tetigerint Sancta sanctorum. Aaron et filii ejus intrabunt, ipsique disponent opera singulorum, et divident quid portare quis debeat.
text_pt: Mas isto lhes fareis, para que vivam e não morram, quando se aproximarem das coisas santíssimas: Arão e seus filhos virão, e a cada um colocarão no seu ministério e no seu cargo,
text_el: τοῦτο ποιήσατε αὐτοῖς καὶ ζήσονται καὶ οὐ μὴ ἀποθάνωσιν προσπορευομένων αὐτῶν πρὸς τὰ ἅγια τῶν ἁγίων Ααρων καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ προσπορευέσθωσαν καὶ καταστήσουσιν αὐτοὺς ἕκαστον κατὰ τὴν ἀναφορὰν αὐτοῦ

text_en: Let not others by any curiosity see the things that are in the sanctuary before they be wrapped up, otherwise they shall die.
text_la: Alii nulla curiositate videant quæ sunt in sanctuario priusquam involvantur, alioquin morientur.
text_pt: Porém não entrarão a ver, quando cobrirem o santuário, para que não morram.
text_el: καὶ οὐ μὴ εἰσέλθωσιν ἰδεῖν ἐξάπινα τὰ ἅγια καὶ ἀποθανοῦνται

text_en: And the Lord spoke to Moses , saying:
text_la: Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen, dicens:
text_pt: Falou mais o Senhor a Moisés, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν λέγων

text_en: Take the sum of the sons of Gerson also by their houses and families and kindreds.
text_la: Tolle summam etiam filiorum Gerson per domos ac familias et cognationes suas,
text_pt: Fazei também a soma dos filhos de Gérson, segundo a casa de seus pais, segundo as suas famílias:
text_el: λαβὲ τὴν ἀρχὴν τῶν υἱῶν Γεδσων καὶ τούτους κατ' οἴκους πατριῶν αὐτῶν κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν

text_en: From thirty years old and upward, unto fifty years old. Number them all that go in and minister in the tabernacle of the covenant .
text_la: a triginta annis et supra, usque ad annos quinquaginta. Numera omnes qui ingrediuntur et ministrant in tabernaculo fœderis.
text_pt: Da idade de trinta anos para cima até aos cinqüenta, contarás a todo aquele que entrar a se ocupar no seu serviço, para executar o ministério na tenda da congregação.
text_el: ἀπὸ πεντεκαιεικοσαετοῦς καὶ ἐπάνω ἕως πεντηκονταετοῦς ἐπίσκεψαι αὐτούς πᾶς ὁ εἰσπορευόμενος λειτουργεῖν καὶ ποιεῖν τὰ ἔργα αὐτοῦ ἐν τῇ σκηνῇ τοῦ μαρτυρίου

text_en: This is the office of the family of the Gersonites:
text_la: Hoc est officium familiæ Gersonitarum,
text_pt: Este será o ministério das famílias dos gersonitas no serviço e no cargo.
text_el: αὕτη ἡ λειτουργία τοῦ δήμου τοῦ Γεδσων λειτουργεῖν καὶ αἴρειν

text_en: To carry the curtains of the tabernacle and the roof of the covenant, the other covering, and the violet covering over all, and the hanging that hangs in the entry of the tabernacle of the covenant ,
text_la: ut portent cortinas tabernaculi et tectum fœderis, operimentum aliud, et super omnia velamen janthinum tentoriumque quod pendet in introitu tabernaculi fœderis,
text_pt: Levarão, pois, as cortinas do tabernáculo, e a tenda da congregação, e a sua coberta, e a coberta de peles de texugos, que está por cima dele, e a cortina da porta da tenda da congregação,
text_el: καὶ ἀρεῖ τὰς δέρρεις τῆς σκηνῆς καὶ τὴν σκηνὴν τοῦ μαρτυρίου καὶ τὸ κάλυμμα αὐτῆς καὶ τὸ κάλυμμα τὸ ὑακίνθινον τὸ ὂν ἐπ' αὐτῆς ἄνωθεν καὶ τὸ κάλυμμα τῆς θύρας τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου

text_en: the curtains of the court , and the veil in the entry that is before tabernacle . All things that pertain to the altar , the cords and the vessels of the ministry,
