text_el: καὶ παρεγένοντο οἱ ἄνδρες οἳ ἦσαν ἀκάθαρτοι ἐπὶ ψυχῇ ἀνθρώπου καὶ οὐκ ἠδύναντο ποιῆσαι τὸ πασχα ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ καὶ προσῆλθον ἐναντίον Μωυσῆ καὶ Ααρων ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ

text_en: said to them: We are unclean by occasion of the soul of a man . Why are we kept back that we may not offer in its season the offering to the Lord among the children of Israel ?
text_la: dixerunt eis : Immundi sumus super anima hominis : quare fraudamur ut non valeamus oblationem offerre Domino in tempore suo inter filios Israël?
text_pt: E aqueles homens disseram-lhe: Imundos estamos nós pelo corpo de um homem morto; por que seríamos privados de oferecer a oferta do Senhor a seu tempo determinado no meio dos filhos de Israel?
text_el: καὶ εἶπαν οἱ ἄνδρες ἐκεῖνοι πρὸς αὐτόν ἡμεῖς ἀκάθαρτοι ἐπὶ ψυχῇ ἀνθρώπου μὴ οὖν ὑστερήσωμεν προσενέγκαι τὸ δῶρον κυρίῳ κατὰ καιρὸν αὐτοῦ ἐν μέσῳ υἱῶν Ισραηλ

text_en: And Moses answered them: Stay that I may consult the Lord what he will ordain concerning you.
text_la: Quibus respondit Moyses : State ut consulam quid præcipiat Dominus de vobis.
text_pt: E disse-lhes Moisés: Esperai, e eu ouvirei o que o Senhor vos ordenará.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτοὺς Μωυσῆς στῆτε αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀκούσομαι τί ἐντελεῖται κύριος περὶ ὑμῶν

text_en: And the Lord spoke to Moses , saying:
text_la: Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen, dicens:
text_pt: Então falou o Senhor a Moisés, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν λέγων

text_en: Say to the children of Israel : The man that shall be unclean by occasion of one that is dead, or shall be in a journey afar off in your nation, let him make the phase to the Lord .
text_la: Loquere filiis Israël : Homo, qui fuerit immundus super anima, sive in via procul in gente vestra, faciat Phase Domino
text_pt: Fala aos filhos de Israel, dizendo: Quando alguém entre vós, ou entre as vossas gerações, for imundo por tocar corpo morto, ou achar-se em jornada longe de vós, contudo ainda celebrará a páscoa ao Senhor.
text_el: λάλησον τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ λέγων ἄνθρωπος ἄνθρωπος ὃς ἐὰν γένηται ἀκάθαρτος ἐπὶ ψυχῇ ἀνθρώπου ἢ ἐν ὁδῷ μακρὰν ὑμῖν ἢ ἐν ταῖς γενεαῖς ὑμῶν καὶ ποιήσει τὸ πασχα κυρίῳ

text_en: In the second month, on the fourteenth day of the month in the evening, they shall eat it with unleavened bread and wild lettuce:
text_la: in mense secundo, quartadecima die mensis ad vesperam. Cum azymis et lactucis agrestibus comedent illud:
text_pt: No mês segundo, no dia catorze à tarde, a celebrarão; com pães ázimos e ervas amargas a comerão.
text_el: ἐν τῷ μηνὶ τῷ δευτέρῳ ἐν τῇ τεσσαρεσκαιδεκάτῃ ἡμέρᾳ τὸ πρὸς ἑσπέραν ποιήσουσιν αὐτό ἐπ' ἀζύμων καὶ πικρίδων φάγονται αὐτό

text_en: They shall not leave anything thereof until morning, nor break a bone thereof, they shall observe all the ceremonies of the phase .
text_la: non relinquent ex eo quippiam usque mane, et os ejus non confringent : omnem ritum Phase observabunt.
text_pt: Dela nada deixarão até à manhã, e dela não quebrarão osso algum; segundo todo o estatuto da páscoa a celebrarão.
text_el: οὐ καταλείψουσιν ἀπ' αὐτοῦ εἰς τὸ πρωὶ καὶ ὀστοῦν οὐ συντρίψουσιν ἀπ' αὐτοῦ κατὰ τὸν νόμον τοῦ πασχα ποιήσουσιν αὐτό

text_en: But if any man is clean, and was not on a journey, and did not make the phase , that soul shall be cut off from among his people, because he offered not sacrifice to the Lord in due season: he shall bear his sin .
text_la: Si quis autem et mundus est, et in itinere non fuit, et tamen non fecit Phase, exterminabitur anima illa de populis suis, quia sacrificium Domino non obtulit tempore suo : peccatum suum ipse portabit.
text_pt: Porém, quando um homem for limpo, e não estiver em viagem, e deixar de celebrar a páscoa, essa alma do seu povo será extirpada; porquanto não ofereceu a oferta do Senhor a seu tempo determinado; esse homem levará o seu pecado.
text_el: καὶ ἄνθρωπος ὃς ἐὰν καθαρὸς ᾖ καὶ ἐν ὁδῷ μακρᾷ οὐκ ἔστιν καὶ ὑστερήσῃ ποιῆσαι τὸ πασχα ἐξολεθρευθήσεται ἡ ψυχὴ ἐκείνη ἐκ τοῦ λαοῦ αὐτῆς ὅτι τὸ δῶρον κυρίῳ οὐ προσήνεγκεν κατὰ τὸν καιρὸν αὐτοῦ ἁμαρτίαν αὐτοῦ λήμψεται ὁ ἄνθρωπος ἐκεῖνος

text_en: The sojourner also and the stranger if they be among you, shall make the phase to the Lord according to the ceremonies and justifications thereof. The same ordinances shall be with you both for the stranger, and for him that was born in the land.
text_la: Peregrinus quoque et advena si fuerint apud vos, facient Phase Domino juxta cæremonias et justificationes ejus. Præceptum idem erit apud vos tam advenæ quam indigenæ.
text_pt: E, quando um estrangeiro peregrinar entre vós, e também celebrar a páscoa ao Senhor, segundo o estatuto da páscoa e segundo o seu rito assim a celebrará; um mesmo estatuto haverá para vós, assim para o estrangeiro, como para o natural da terra.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ προσέλθῃ πρὸς ὑμᾶς προσήλυτος ἐν τῇ γῇ ὑμῶν καὶ ποιήσει τὸ πασχα κυρίῳ κατὰ τὸν νόμον τοῦ πασχα καὶ κατὰ τὴν σύνταξιν αὐτοῦ ποιήσει αὐτό νόμος εἷς ἔσται ὑμῖν καὶ τῷ προσηλύτῳ καὶ τῷ αὐτόχθονι τῆς γῆς

text_en: Now on the day that the tabernacle was reared up, a cloud covered it. But from the evening there was over the tabernacle , as it were, the appearance of fire until the morning.
text_la: Igitur die qua erectum est tabernaculum, operuit illud nubes. A vespere autem super tentorium erat quasi species ignis usque mane.
text_pt: E no dia em que foi levantado o tabernáculo, a nuvem cobriu o tabernáculo sobre a tenda do testemunho; e à tarde estava sobre o tabernáculo com uma aparência de fogo até à manhã.
text_el: καὶ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ᾗ ἐστάθη ἡ σκηνή ἐκάλυψεν ἡ νεφέλη τὴν σκηνήν τὸν οἶκον τοῦ μαρτυρίου καὶ τὸ ἑσπέρας ἦν ἐπὶ τῆς σκηνῆς ὡς εἶδος πυρὸς ἕως πρωί

text_en: So it was always: by day the cloud covered it, and by night as it were the appearance of fire.
text_la: Sic fiebat jugiter : per diem operiebat illud nubes, et per noctem quasi species ignis.
text_pt: Assim era de contínuo: a nuvem o cobria, e de noite havia aparência de fogo.
text_el: οὕτως ἐγίνετο διὰ παντός ἡ νεφέλη ἐκάλυπτεν αὐτὴν ἡμέρας καὶ εἶδος πυρὸς τὴν νύκτα

text_en: And when the cloud that covered the tabernacle was taken up, then the children of Israel marched forward: and in the place where the cloud stood still, there they camped.
text_la: Cumque ablata fuisset nubes, quæ tabernaculum protegebat, tunc proficiscebantur filii Israël : et in loco ubi stetisset nubes, ibi castrametabantur.
text_pt: Mas sempre que a nuvem se alçava de sobre a tenda, os filhos de Israel partiam; e no lugar onde a nuvem parava, ali os filhos de Israel se acampavam.
text_el: καὶ ἡνίκα ἀνέβη ἡ νεφέλη ἀπὸ τῆς σκηνῆς καὶ μετὰ ταῦτα ἀπῆραν οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ καὶ ἐν τῷ τόπῳ οὗ ἂν ἔστη ἡ νεφέλη ἐκεῖ παρενέβαλον οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ

text_en: At the commandment of the Lord they marched, and at his commandment they pitched the tabernacle . All the days that the cloud abode over the tabernacle , they remained in the same place:
text_la: Ad imperium Domini proficiscebantur, et ad imperium illius figebant tabernaculum. Cunctis diebus quibus stabat nubes super tabernaculum, manebant in eodem loco:
text_pt: Segundo a ordem do Senhor, os filhos de Israel partiam, e segundo a ordem do Senhor se acampavam; todos os dias em que a nuvem parava sobre o tabernáculo, ficavam acampados.
text_el: διὰ προστάγματος κυρίου παρεμβαλοῦσιν οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ καὶ διὰ προστάγματος κυρίου ἀπαροῦσιν πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας ἐν αἷς σκιάζει ἡ νεφέλη ἐπὶ τῆς σκηνῆς παρεμβαλοῦσιν οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ

text_en: And if it was so that it continued over it a long time, the children of Israel kept the watches of the Lord , and marched not,
text_la: et si evenisset ut multo tempore maneret super illud, erant filii Israël in excubiis Domini, et non proficiscebantur
text_pt: E, quando a nuvem se detinha muitos dias sobre o tabernáculo, então os filhos de Israel cumpriam a ordem do Senhor, e não partiam.
text_el: καὶ ὅταν ἐφέλκηται ἡ νεφέλη ἐπὶ τῆς σκηνῆς ἡμέρας πλείους καὶ φυλάξονται οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ τὴν φυλακὴν τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ οὐ μὴ ἐξάρωσιν

text_en: for as many days soever as the cloud stayed over the tabernacle . At the commandment of the Lord they pitched their tents, and at his commandment they took them down.
text_la: quot diebus fuisset nubes super tabernaculum. Ad imperium Domini erigebant tentoria, et ad imperium illius deponebant.
text_pt: E, quando a nuvem ficava poucos dias sobre o tabernáculo, segundo a ordem do Senhor se alojavam, e segundo a ordem do Senhor partiam.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ὅταν σκεπάσῃ ἡ νεφέλη ἡμέρας ἀριθμῷ ἐπὶ τῆς σκηνῆς διὰ φωνῆς κυρίου παρεμβαλοῦσιν καὶ διὰ προστάγματος κυρίου ἀπαροῦσιν

text_en: If the cloud tarried from evening until morning, and immediately at break of day left the tabernacle , they marched forward: and if it departed after a day and a night, they took down their tents.
text_la: Si fuisset nubes a vespere usque mane, et statim diluculo tabernaculum reliquisset, proficiscebantur : et si post diem et noctem recessisset, dissipabant tentoria.
text_pt: Porém, outras vezes a nuvem ficava desde a tarde até à manhã, e quando ela se alçava pela manhã, então partiam; quer de dia quer de noite alçando-se a nuvem, partiam.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ὅταν γένηται ἡ νεφέλη ἀφ' ἑσπέρας ἕως πρωὶ καὶ ἀναβῇ ἡ νεφέλη τὸ πρωί καὶ ἀπαροῦσιν ἡμέρας ἢ νυκτός

text_en: But if it remained over the tabernacle for two days or a month or a longer time, the children of Israel remained in the same place, and marched not: but immediately as soon as it departed, they removed the camp.
text_la: Si vero biduo aut uno mense vel longiori tempore fuisset super tabernaculum, manebant filii Israël in eodem loco, et non proficiscebantur : statim autem ut recessisset, movebant castra.
text_pt: Ou, quando a nuvem sobre o tabernáculo se detinha dois dias, ou um mês, ou um ano, ficando sobre ele, então os filhos de Israel se alojavam, e não partiam; e alçando-se ela, partiam.
text_el: μηνὸς ἡμέρας πλεοναζούσης τῆς νεφέλης σκιαζούσης ἐπ' αὐτῆς παρεμβαλοῦσιν οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ καὶ οὐ μὴ ἀπάρωσιν

text_en: By the word of the Lord they pitched their tents, and by his word they marched: and kept the watches of the Lord according to his commandment by the hand of Moses .
text_la: Per verbum Domini figebant tentoria, et per verbum illius proficiscebantur : erantque in excubiis Domini juxta imperium ejus per manum Moysi.
text_pt: Segundo a ordem do Senhor se alojavam, e segundo a ordem do Senhor partiam; cumpriam o seu dever para com o Senhor, segundo a ordem do Senhor por intermédio de Moisés.
text_el: ὅτι διὰ προστάγματος κυρίου ἀπαροῦσιν τὴν φυλακὴν κυρίου ἐφυλάξαντο διὰ προστάγματος κυρίου ἐν χειρὶ Μωυσῆ

text_en: And the Lord spoke to Moses , saying:
text_la: Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen, dicens:
text_pt: Falou mais o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν λέγων

text_en: Make two trumpets of beaten silver, wherewith you may call together the multitude when the camp is to be removed.
text_la: Fac tibi duas tubas argenteas ductiles, quibus convocare possis multitudinem quando movenda sunt castra.
text_pt: Faze-te duas trombetas de prata; de obra batida as farás, e elas te servirão para a convocação da congregação, e para a partida dos arraiais.
text_el: ποίησον σεαυτῷ δύο σάλπιγγας ἀργυρᾶς ἐλατὰς ποιήσεις αὐτάς καὶ ἔσονταί σοι ἀνακαλεῖν τὴν συναγωγὴν καὶ ἐξαίρειν τὰς παρεμβολάς

text_en: And when you shall sound the trumpets, all the multitude shall gather unto you to the door of the tabernacle of the covenant .
text_la: Cumque increpueris tubis, congregabitur ad te omnis turba ad ostium tabernaculi fœderis.
text_pt: E, quando as tocarem, então toda a congregação se reunirá a ti à porta da tenda da congregação.
text_el: καὶ σαλπίσεις ἐν αὐταῖς καὶ συναχθήσεται πᾶσα ἡ συναγωγὴ ἐπὶ τὴν θύραν τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου

text_en: If you sound but once, the princes and the heads of the multitude of Israel shall come to you.
text_la: Si semel clangueris, venient ad te principes, et capita multitudinis Israël.
text_pt: Mas, quando tocar uma só, então a ti se congregarão os príncipes, os cabeças dos milhares de Israel.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ ἐν μιᾷ σαλπίσωσιν προσελεύσονται πρὸς σὲ πάντες οἱ ἄρχοντες ἀρχηγοὶ Ισραηλ

text_en: But if the sound of the trumpets be longer, and with interruptions, they that are on the east side, shall first go forward.
text_la: Si autem prolixior atque concisus clangor increpuerit, movebunt castra primi qui sunt ad orientalem plagam.
text_pt: Quando, retinindo, as tocardes, então partirão os arraiais que estão acampados do lado do oriente.
text_el: καὶ σαλπιεῖτε σημασίαν καὶ ἐξαροῦσιν αἱ παρεμβολαὶ αἱ παρεμβάλλουσαι ἀνατολάς

text_en: And at the second sounding and like noise of the trumpet, they who lie on the south side shall take up their tents. And after this manner shall the rest do, when the trumpets shall sound for a march.
text_la: In secundo autem sonitu et pari ululatu tubæ, levabunt tentoria qui habitant ad meridiem; et juxta hunc modum reliqui facient, ululantibus tubis in profectionem.
text_pt: Mas, quando a segunda vez retinindo, as tocardes, então partirão os arraiais que estão acampados do lado do sul; retinindo, as tocarão para as suas partidas.
text_el: καὶ σαλπιεῖτε σημασίαν δευτέραν καὶ ἐξαροῦσιν αἱ παρεμβολαὶ αἱ παρεμβάλλουσαι λίβα καὶ σαλπιεῖτε σημασίαν τρίτην καὶ ἐξαροῦσιν αἱ παρεμβολαὶ αἱ παρεμβάλλουσαι παρὰ θάλασσαν καὶ σαλπιεῖτε σημασίαν τετάρτην καὶ ἐξαροῦσιν αἱ παρεμβολαὶ αἱ παρεμβάλλουσαι πρὸς βορρᾶν σημασίᾳ σαλπιοῦσιν ἐν τῇ ἐξάρσει αὐτῶν

text_en: But when the people is to be gathered together, the sound of the trumpets shall be plain, and they shall not make a broken sound.
text_la: Quando autem congregandus est populus, simplex tubarum clangor erit, et non concise ululabunt.
text_pt: Porém, ajuntando a congregação, as tocareis; mas sem retinir.
text_el: καὶ ὅταν συναγάγητε τὴν συναγωγήν σαλπιεῖτε καὶ οὐ σημασίᾳ

text_en: And the sons of Aaron the priest shall sound the trumpets: and this shall be an ordinance for ever in your generations .
text_la: Filii autem Aaron sacerdotes clangent tubis : eritque hoc legitimum sempiternum in generationibus vestris.
text_pt: E os filhos de Arão, sacerdotes, tocarão as trombetas; e a vós serão por estatuto perpétuo nas vossas gerações.
text_el: καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ Ααρων οἱ ἱερεῖς σαλπιοῦσιν ταῖς σάλπιγξιν καὶ ἔσται ὑμῖν νόμιμον αἰώνιον εἰς τὰς γενεὰς ὑμῶν

text_en: If you go forth to war out of your land against the enemies that fight against you, you shall sound aloud with the trumpets, and there shall be a remembrance of you before the Lord your God , that you may be delivered out of the hands of your enemies.
text_la: Si exieritis ad bellum de terra vestra contra hostes qui dimicant adversum vos, clangetis ululantibus tubis, et erit recordatio vestri coram Domino Deo vestro, ut eruamini de manibus inimicorum vestrorum.
text_pt: E, quando na vossa terra sairdes a pelejar contra o inimigo, que vos oprime, também tocareis as trombetas retinindo, e perante o Senhor vosso Deus haverá lembrança de vós, e sereis salvos de vossos inimigos.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ ἐξέλθητε εἰς πόλεμον ἐν τῇ γῇ ὑμῶν πρὸς τοὺς ὑπεναντίους τοὺς ἀνθεστηκότας ὑμῖν καὶ σημανεῖτε ταῖς σάλπιγξιν καὶ ἀναμνησθήσεσθε ἔναντι κυρίου καὶ διασωθήσεσθε ἀπὸ τῶν ἐχθρῶν ὑμῶν

text_en: If at any time you shall have a banquet, and on your festival days, and on the first days of your months, you shall sound the trumpets over the holocausts , and the sacrifices of peace offerings , that they may be to you for a remembrance of your God . I am the Lord your God .
text_la: Siquando habebitis epulum, et dies festos, et calendas, canetis tubis super holocaustis, et pacificis victimis, ut sint vobis in recordationem Dei vestri. Ego Dominus Deus vester.
text_pt: Semelhantemente, no dia da vossa alegria e nas vossas solenidades, e nos princípios de vossos meses, também tocareis as trombetas sobre os vossos holocaustos, sobre os vossos sacrifícios pacíficos, e vos serão por memorial perante vosso Deus: Eu sou o Senhor vosso Deus.
text_el: καὶ ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις τῆς εὐφροσύνης ὑμῶν καὶ ἐν ταῖς ἑορταῖς ὑμῶν καὶ ἐν ταῖς νουμηνίαις ὑμῶν σαλπιεῖτε ταῖς σάλπιγξιν ἐπὶ τοῖς ὁλοκαυτώμασιν καὶ ἐπὶ ταῖς θυσίαις τῶν σωτηρίων ὑμῶν καὶ ἔσται ὑμῖν ἀνάμνησις ἔναντι τοῦ θεοῦ ὑμῶν ἐγὼ κύριος ὁ θεὸς ὑμῶν

text_en: The second year, in the second month, the twentieth day of the month, the cloud was taken up from the tabernacle of the covenant .
text_la: Anno secundo, mense secundo, vigesima die mensis, elevata est nubes de tabernaculo fœderis:
text_pt: E aconteceu, no ano segundo, no segundo mês, aos vinte do mês, que a nuvem se alçou de sobre o tabernáculo da congregação.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ ἐνιαυτῷ τῷ δευτέρῳ ἐν τῷ μηνὶ τῷ δευτέρῳ εἰκάδι τοῦ μηνὸς ἀνέβη ἡ νεφέλη ἀπὸ τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου

text_en: And the children of Israel marched by their troops from the desert of Sinai , and the cloud rested in the wilderness of Pharan.
text_la: profectique sunt filii Israël per turmas suas de deserto Sinai, et recubuit nubes in solitudine Pharan.
text_pt: E os filhos de Israel, segundo a ordem de marcha, partiram do deserto de Sinai; e a nuvem parou no deserto de Parã.
text_el: καὶ ἐξῆραν οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ σὺν ἀπαρτίαις αὐτῶν ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ Σινα καὶ ἔστη ἡ νεφέλη ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ τοῦ Φαραν

text_en: And the first went forward according to the commandment of the Lord by the hand of Moses .
text_la: Moveruntque castra primi juxta imperium Domini in manu Moysi.
text_pt: Assim partiram pela primeira vez segundo a ordem do Senhor, por intermédio de Moisés.
text_el: καὶ ἐξῆραν πρῶτοι διὰ φωνῆς κυρίου ἐν χειρὶ Μωυσῆ

text_en: The sons of Juda by their troops: whose prince was Nahasson the son of Aminadab.
text_la: Filii Juda per turmas suas : quorum princeps erat Nahasson filius Aminadab.
text_pt: Porque primeiramente partiu a bandeira do arraial dos filhos de Judá segundo os seus exércitos; e sobre o seu exército estava Naassom, filho de Aminadabe.
text_el: καὶ ἐξῆραν τάγμα παρεμβολῆς υἱῶν Ιουδα πρῶτοι σὺν δυνάμει αὐτῶν καὶ ἐπὶ τῆς δυνάμεως αὐτῶν Ναασσων υἱὸς Αμιναδαβ

text_en: In the tribe of the sons of Issachar , the prince was Nathanael the son of Suar.
text_la: In tribu filiorum Issachar fuit princeps Nathanaël filius Suar.
text_pt: E sobre o exército da tribo dos filhos de Issacar, Natanael, filho de Zuar.
text_el: καὶ ἐπὶ τῆς δυνάμεως φυλῆς υἱῶν Ισσαχαρ Ναθαναηλ υἱὸς Σωγαρ

text_en: In the tribe of Zabulon , the prince was Eliab the son of Helon.
text_la: In tribu Zabulon erat princeps Eliab filius Helon.
text_pt: E sobre o exército da tribo dos filhos de Zebulom, Eliabe, filho de Helom.
text_el: καὶ ἐπὶ τῆς δυνάμεως φυλῆς υἱῶν Ζαβουλων Ελιαβ υἱὸς Χαιλων

text_en: And the tabernacle was taken down, and the sons of Gerson and Merari set forward, bearing it.
text_la: Depositumque est tabernaculum, quod portantes egressi sunt filii Gerson et Merari.
text_pt: Então desarmaram o tabernáculo, e os filhos de Gérson e os filhos de Merari partiram, levando o tabernáculo.
text_el: καὶ καθελοῦσιν τὴν σκηνὴν καὶ ἐξαροῦσιν οἱ υἱοὶ Γεδσων καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ Μεραρι αἴροντες τὴν σκηνήν

text_en: And the sons of Ruben also marched, by their troops and ranks, whose prince was Helisur the son of Sedeur.
text_la: Profectique sunt et filii Ruben, per turmas et ordinem suum : quorum princeps erat Helisur filius Sedeur.
text_pt: Depois partiu a bandeira do arraial de Rúben segundo os seus exércitos; e sobre o seu exército estava Elizur, filho de Sedeur.
text_el: καὶ ἐξῆραν τάγμα παρεμβολῆς Ρουβην σὺν δυνάμει αὐτῶν καὶ ἐπὶ τῆς δυνάμεως αὐτῶν Ελισουρ υἱὸς Σεδιουρ

text_en: And in the tribe of Simeon , the prince was Salamiel the son of Surisaddai.
text_la: In tribu autem filiorum Simeon, princeps fuit Salamiel filius Surisaddai.
text_pt: E sobre o exército da tribo dos filhos de Simeão, Selumiel, filho de Zurisadai.
text_el: καὶ ἐπὶ τῆς δυνάμεως φυλῆς υἱῶν Συμεων Σαλαμιηλ υἱὸς Σουρισαδαι

text_en: And in the tribe of Gad , the prince was Eliasaph the son of Duel.
text_la: Porro in tribu Gad erat princeps Eliasaph filius Duel.
text_pt: E sobre o exército da tribo dos filhos de Gade, Eliasafe, filho de Deuel.
text_el: καὶ ἐπὶ τῆς δυνάμεως φυλῆς υἱῶν Γαδ Ελισαφ ὁ τοῦ Ραγουηλ

text_en: Then the Caathites also marched carrying the sanctuary. So long was the tabernacle carried, till they came to the place of setting it up.
text_la: Profectique sunt et Caathitæ portantes sanctuarium. Tamdiu tabernaculum portabatur, donec venirent ad erectionis locum.
text_pt: Então partiram os coatitas, levando o santuário; e os outros levantaram o tabernáculo, enquanto estes vinham.
text_el: καὶ ἐξαροῦσιν οἱ υἱοὶ Κααθ αἴροντες τὰ ἅγια καὶ στήσουσιν τὴν σκηνήν ἕως παραγένωνται

text_en: The sons of Ephraim also moved their camp by their troops, in whose army the prince was Elisama the son of Ammiud.
text_la: Moverunt castra et filii Ephraim per turmas suas, in quorum exercitu princeps erat Elisama filius Ammiud.
text_pt: Depois partiu a bandeira do arraial dos filhos de Efraim segundo os seus exércitos; e sobre o seu exército estava Elisama, filho de Amiúde.
text_el: καὶ ἐξαροῦσιν τάγμα παρεμβολῆς Εφραιμ σὺν δυνάμει αὐτῶν καὶ ἐπὶ τῆς δυνάμεως αὐτῶν Ελισαμα υἱὸς Εμιουδ

text_en: And in the tribe of the sons of Manasses , the prince was Gamaliel the son of Phadassur.
text_la: In tribu autem filiorum Manasse princeps fuit Gamaliel filius Phadassur.
text_pt: E sobre o exército da tribo dos filhos de Manassés, Gamaliel, filho de Pedazur.
text_el: καὶ ἐπὶ τῆς δυνάμεως φυλῆς υἱῶν Μανασση Γαμαλιηλ ὁ τοῦ Φαδασσουρ

text_en: And in the tribe of Benjamin , the prince was Abidan the son of Gedeon.
text_la: Et in tribu Benjamin erat dux Abidan filius Gedeonis.
text_pt: E sobre o exército da tribo dos filhos de Benjamim, Abidã, filho de Gideoni.
text_el: καὶ ἐπὶ τῆς δυνάμεως φυλῆς υἱῶν Βενιαμιν Αβιδαν ὁ τοῦ Γαδεωνι

text_en: The last of all the camp marched the sons of Dan by their troops, in whose army the prince was Ahiezer the son of Ammisaddai.
text_la: Novissimi castrorum omnium profecti sunt filii Dan per turmas suas, in quorum exercitu princeps fuit Ahiezer filius Ammisaddai.
text_pt: Então partiu a bandeira do arraial dos filhos de Dã, fechando todos os arraiais segundo os seus exércitos; e sobre o seu exército estava Aieser, filho de Amisadai.
text_el: καὶ ἐξαροῦσιν τάγμα παρεμβολῆς υἱῶν Δαν ἔσχατοι πασῶν τῶν παρεμβολῶν σὺν δυνάμει αὐτῶν καὶ ἐπὶ τῆς δυνάμεως αὐτῶν Αχιεζερ ὁ τοῦ Αμισαδαι

text_en: And in the tribe of the sons of Aser , the prince was Phegiel the son of Ochran.
text_la: In tribu autem filiorum Aser erat princeps Phegiel filius Ochran.
text_pt: E sobre o exército da tribo dos filhos de Aser, Pagiel, filho de Ocrã.
text_el: καὶ ἐπὶ τῆς δυνάμεως φυλῆς υἱῶν Ασηρ Φαγαιηλ υἱὸς Εχραν

text_en: And in the tribe of the sons of Nephtali , the prince was Ahira the son of Enan.
text_la: Et in tribu filiorum Nephthali princeps fuit Ahira filius Enan.
text_pt: E sobre o exército da tribo dos filhos de Naftali, Aira, filho de Enã.
text_el: καὶ ἐπὶ τῆς δυνάμεως φυλῆς υἱῶν Νεφθαλι Αχιρε υἱὸς Αιναν

text_en: This was the order of the camps, and marches of the children of Israel by their troops, when they set forward.
text_la: Hæc sunt castra, et profectiones filiorum Israël per turmas suas quando egrediebantur.
text_pt: Esta era a ordem das partidas dos filhos de Israel segundo os seus exércitos, quando partiam.
text_el: αὗται αἱ στρατιαὶ υἱῶν Ισραηλ καὶ ἐξῆραν σὺν δυνάμει αὐτῶν

text_en: And Moses said to Hobab the son of Raguel the Madianite , his kinsman: We are going towards the place which the Lord will give us: come with us, that we may do you good : for the Lord has promised good things to Israel .
text_la: Dixitque Moyses Hobab filio Raguel Madianitæ, cognato suo : Proficiscimur ad locum quem Dominus daturus est nobis : veni nobiscum, ut benefaciamus tibi, quia Dominus bona promisit Israëli.
text_pt: Disse então Moisés a Hobabe, filho de Reuel, o midianita, sogro de Moisés: Nós caminhamos para aquele lugar, de que o Senhor disse: Vo-lo darei; vai conosco e te faremos bem; porque o Senhor falou bem sobre Israel.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Μωυσῆς τῷ Ιωβαβ υἱῷ Ραγουηλ τῷ Μαδιανίτῃ τῷ γαμβρῷ Μωυσῆ ἐξαίρομεν ἡμεῖς εἰς τὸν τόπον ὃν εἶπεν κύριος τοῦτον δώσω ὑμῖν δεῦρο μεθ' ἡμῶν καὶ εὖ σε ποιήσομεν ὅτι κύριος ἐλάλησεν καλὰ περὶ Ισραηλ

text_en: But he answered him: I will not go with you, but I will return to my country, wherein I was born.
text_la: Cui ille respondit : Non vadam tecum, sed revertar in terram meam, in qua natus sum.
text_pt: Porém ele lhe disse: Não irei; antes irei à minha terra e à minha parentela.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτόν οὐ πορεύσομαι ἀλλὰ εἰς τὴν γῆν μου καὶ εἰς τὴν γενεάν μου

text_en: And he said: Do not leave us: for you know in what places we should encamp in the wilderness , and you shall be our guide.
text_la: Et ille : Noli, inquit, nos relinquere : tu enim nosti in quibus locis per desertum castra ponere debeamus, et eris ductor noster.
text_pt: E ele disse: Ora, não nos deixes; porque tu sabes onde devemos acampar no deserto; nos servirás de guia.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν μὴ ἐγκαταλίπῃς ἡμᾶς οὗ εἵνεκεν ἦσθα μεθ' ἡμῶν ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ καὶ ἔσῃ ἐν ἡμῖν πρεσβύτης

text_en: And if you come with us, we will give you what is the best of the riches which the Lord shall deliver to us.
text_la: Cumque nobiscum veneris, quidquid optimum fuerit ex opibus, quas nobis traditurus est Dominus, dabimus tibi.
text_pt: E será que, vindo tu conosco, e sucedendo o bem que o Senhor nos fizer, também nós te faremos bem.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ἐὰν πορευθῇς μεθ' ἡμῶν καὶ ἔσται τὰ ἀγαθὰ ἐκεῖνα ὅσα ἐὰν ἀγαθοποιήσῃ κύριος ἡμᾶς καὶ εὖ σε ποιήσομεν

text_en: So they marched from the mount of the Lord three days' journey, and the ark of the covenant of the Lord went before them, for three days providing a place for the camp.
text_la: Profecti sunt ergo de monte Domini viam trium dierum, arcaque fœderis Domini præcedebat eos, per dies tres providens castrorum locum.
text_pt: Assim partiram do monte do Senhor caminho de três dias; e a arca da aliança do Senhor caminhou diante deles caminho de três dias, para lhes buscar lugar de descanso.
text_el: καὶ ἐξῆραν ἐκ τοῦ ὄρους κυρίου ὁδὸν τριῶν ἡμερῶν καὶ ἡ κιβωτὸς τῆς διαθήκης κυρίου προεπορεύετο προτέρα αὐτῶν ὁδὸν τριῶν ἡμερῶν κατασκέψασθαι αὐτοῖς ἀνάπαυσιν

text_en: The cloud also of the Lord was over them by day when they marched.
text_la: Nubes quoque Domini super eos erat per diem cum incederent.
text_pt: E a nuvem do Senhor ia sobre eles de dia, quando partiam do arraial.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ ἐξαίρειν τὴν κιβωτὸν καὶ εἶπεν Μωυσῆς ἐξεγέρθητι κύριε διασκορπισθήτωσαν οἱ ἐχθροί σου φυγέτωσαν πάντες οἱ μισοῦντές σε

text_en: And when the ark was lifted up, Moses said: Arise, O Lord , and let your enemies be scattered, and let them that hate you, flee from before your face.
text_la: Cumque elevaretur arca, dicebat Moyses : Surge, Domine, et dissipentur inimici tui, et fugiant qui oderunt te, a facie tua.
text_pt: Acontecia que, partindo a arca, Moisés dizia: Levanta-te, Senhor, e dissipados sejam os teus inimigos, e fujam diante de ti os que te odeiam.
text_el: καὶ ἐν τῇ καταπαύσει εἶπεν ἐπίστρεφε κύριε χιλιάδας μυριάδας ἐν τῷ Ισραηλ

text_en: And when it was set down, he said: Return, O Lord , to the multitude of the host of Israel .
text_la: Cum autem deponeretur, aiebat : Revertere, Domine, ad multitudinem exercitus Israël.
text_pt: E, pousando ela, dizia: Volta, ó Senhor, para os muitos milhares de Israel.
text_el: καὶ ἡ νεφέλη ἐγένετο σκιάζουσα ἐπ' αὐτοῖς ἡμέρας ἐν τῷ ἐξαίρειν αὐτοὺς ἐκ τῆς παρεμβολῆς

text_en: In the mean time there arose a murmuring of the people against the Lord , as it were repining at their fatigue. And when the Lord heard it he was angry . And the fire of the Lord being kindled against them, devoured them that were at the uttermost part of the camp.
text_la: Interea ortum est murmur populi, quasi dolentium pro labore, contra Dominum. Quod cum audisset Dominus, iratus est. Et accensus in eos ignis Domini, devoravit extremam castrorum partem.
text_pt: E aconteceu que, queixou-se o povo falando o que era mal aos ouvidos do SENHOR; e ouvindo o SENHOR a sua ira se acendeu; e o fogo do SENHOR ardeu entre eles e consumiu os que estavam na última parte do arraial.
text_el: καὶ ἦν ὁ λαὸς γογγύζων πονηρὰ ἔναντι κυρίου καὶ ἤκουσεν κύριος καὶ ἐθυμώθη ὀργῇ καὶ ἐξεκαύθη ἐν αὐτοῖς πῦρ παρὰ κυρίου καὶ κατέφαγεν μέρος τι τῆς παρεμβολῆς

text_en: And when the people cried to Moses , Moses prayed to the Lord , and the fire was swallowed up.
text_la: Cumque clamasset populus ad Moysen, oravit Moyses ad Dominum, et absorptus est ignis.
text_pt: Então o povo clamou a Moisés, e Moisés orou ao Senhor, e o fogo se apagou.
text_el: καὶ ἐκέκραξεν ὁ λαὸς πρὸς Μωυσῆν καὶ ηὔξατο Μωυσῆς πρὸς κύριον καὶ ἐκόπασεν τὸ πῦρ

text_en: And he called the name of that place, The burning : for that the fire of the Lord had been kindled against them.
text_la: Vocavitque nomen loci illius, Incensio : eo quod incensus fuisset contra eos ignis Domini.
text_pt: Pelo que chamou aquele lugar Taberá, porquanto o fogo do Senhor se acendera entre eles.
text_el: καὶ ἐκλήθη τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ τόπου ἐκείνου ἐμπυρισμός ὅτι ἐξεκαύθη ἐν αὐτοῖς πῦρ παρὰ κυρίου

text_en: For a mixt multitude of people, that came up with them, burned with desire, sitting and weeping, the children of Israel also being joined with them, and said: Who shall give us flesh to eat?
text_la: Vulgus quippe promiscuum, quod ascenderat cum eis, flagravit desiderio, sedens et flens, junctis sibi pariter filiis Israël, et ait : Quis dabit nobis ad vescendum carnes?
text_pt: E o vulgo, que estava no meio deles, veio a ter grande desejo; pelo que os filhos de Israel tornaram a chorar, e disseram: Quem nos dará carne a comer?
text_el: καὶ ὁ ἐπίμικτος ὁ ἐν αὐτοῖς ἐπεθύμησαν ἐπιθυμίαν καὶ καθίσαντες ἔκλαιον καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ καὶ εἶπαν τίς ἡμᾶς ψωμιεῖ κρέα

text_en: We remember the fish that we ate in Egypt free cost: the cucumbers come into our mind, and the melons, and the leeks, and the onions, and the garlic.
text_la: recordamur piscium quos comedebamus in Ægypto gratis : in mentem nobis veniunt cucumeres, et pepones, porrique, et cæpe, et allia.
text_pt: Lembramo-nos dos peixes que no Egito comíamos de graça; e dos pepinos, e dos melões, e dos porros, e das cebolas, e dos alhos.
text_el: ἐμνήσθημεν τοὺς ἰχθύας οὓς ἠσθίομεν ἐν Αἰγύπτῳ δωρεάν καὶ τοὺς σικύας καὶ τοὺς πέπονας καὶ τὰ πράσα καὶ τὰ κρόμμυα καὶ τὰ σκόρδα

text_en: Our soul is dry, our eyes behold nothing else but manna .
text_la: Anima nostra arida est : nihil aliud respiciunt oculi nostri nisi man.
text_pt: Mas agora a nossa alma se seca; coisa nenhuma há senão este maná diante dos nossos olhos.
text_el: νυνὶ δὲ ἡ ψυχὴ ἡμῶν κατάξηρος οὐδὲν πλὴν εἰς τὸ μαννα οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ ἡμῶν

text_en: Now the manna was like coriander seed, of the colour of bdellium.
text_la: Erat autem man quasi semen coriandri, coloris bdellii.
text_pt: E era o maná como semente de coentro, e a sua cor como a cor de bdélio.
text_el: τὸ δὲ μαννα ὡσεὶ σπέρμα κορίου ἐστίν καὶ τὸ εἶδος αὐτοῦ εἶδος κρυστάλλου

text_en: And the people went about, and gathering it, ground it in a mill, or beat it in a mortar, and boiled it in a pot, and made cakes thereof of the taste of bread tempered with oil.
text_la: Circuibatque populus, et colligens illud, frangebat mola, sive terebat in mortario, coquens in olla, et faciens ex eo tortulas saporis quasi panis oleati.
text_pt: Espalhava-se o povo e o colhia, e em moinhos o moía, ou num gral o pisava, e em panelas o cozia, e dele fazia bolos; e o seu sabor era como o sabor de azeite fresco.
text_el: καὶ διεπορεύετο ὁ λαὸς καὶ συνέλεγον καὶ ἤληθον αὐτὸ ἐν τῷ μύλῳ καὶ ἔτριβον ἐν τῇ θυίᾳ καὶ ἥψουν αὐτὸ ἐν τῇ χύτρᾳ καὶ ἐποίουν αὐτὸ ἐγκρυφίας καὶ ἦν ἡ ἡδονὴ αὐτοῦ ὡσεὶ γεῦμα ἐγκρὶς ἐξ ἐλαίου

text_en: And when the dew fell in the night upon the camp, the manna also fell with it.
text_la: Cumque descenderet nocte super castra ros, descendebat pariter et man.
text_pt: E, quando o orvalho descia de noite sobre o arraial, o maná descia sobre ele.
text_el: καὶ ὅταν κατέβη ἡ δρόσος ἐπὶ τὴν παρεμβολὴν νυκτός κατέβαινεν τὸ μαννα ἐπ' αὐτῆς

text_en: Now Moses heard the people weeping by their families , every one at the door of his tent. And the wrath of the Lord was exceedingly enkindled: to Moses also the thing seemed insupportable.
text_la: Audivit ergo Moyses flentem populum per familias, singulos per ostia tentorii sui. Iratusque est furor Domini valde : sed et Moysi intoleranda res visa est,
text_pt: Então Moisés ouviu chorar o povo pelas suas famílias, cada qual à porta da sua tenda; e a ira do Senhor grandemente se acendeu, e pareceu mal aos olhos de Moisés.
text_el: καὶ ἤκουσεν Μωυσῆς κλαιόντων αὐτῶν κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν ἕκαστον ἐπὶ τῆς θύρας αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐθυμώθη ὀργῇ κύριος σφόδρα καὶ ἔναντι Μωυσῆ ἦν πονηρόν

text_en: And he said to the Lord : Why have you afflicted your servant? Wherefore do I not find favour before you? And why have you laid the weight of all this people upon me?
text_la: et ait ad Dominum : Cur afflixisti servum tuum? quare non invenio gratiam coram te? et cur imposuisti pondus universi populi hujus super me?
text_pt: E disse Moisés ao Senhor: Por que fizeste mal a teu servo, e por que não achei graça aos teus olhos, visto que puseste sobre mim o cargo de todo este povo?
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Μωυσῆς πρὸς κύριον ἵνα τί ἐκάκωσας τὸν θεράποντά σου καὶ διὰ τί οὐχ εὕρηκα χάριν ἐναντίον σου ἐπιθεῖναι τὴν ὁρμὴν τοῦ λαοῦ τούτου ἐπ' ἐμέ

text_en: Have I conceived all this multitude, or begotten them, that you should say to me: Carry them in your bosom as the nurse is wont to carry the little infant, and bear them into the land, for which you have sworn to their fathers?
text_la: Numquid ego concepi omnem hanc multitudinem, vel genui eam, ut dicas mihi : Porta eos in sinu tuo sicut portare solet nutrix infantulum, et defer in terram, pro qua jurasti patribus eorum?
text_pt: Concebi eu porventura todo este povo? Dei-o eu à luz? para que me dissesses: leva-o ao teu colo, como a ama leva a criança que mama, à terra que juraste a seus pais?
text_el: μὴ ἐγὼ ἐν γαστρὶ ἔλαβον πάντα τὸν λαὸν τοῦτον ἢ ἐγὼ ἔτεκον αὐτούς ὅτι λέγεις μοι λαβὲ αὐτὸν εἰς τὸν κόλπον σου ὡσεὶ ἄραι τιθηνὸς τὸν θηλάζοντα εἰς τὴν γῆν ἣν ὤμοσας τοῖς πατράσιν αὐτῶν

text_en: Whence should I have flesh to give to so great a multitude? They weep against me, saying: Give us flesh that we may eat.
text_la: Unde mihi carnes ut dem tantæ multitudini? flent contra me, dicentes : Da nobis carnes ut comedamus.
text_pt: De onde teria eu carne para dar a todo este povo? Porquanto contra mim choram, dizendo: Dá-nos carne a comer;
text_el: πόθεν μοι κρέα δοῦναι παντὶ τῷ λαῷ τούτῳ ὅτι κλαίουσιν ἐπ' ἐμοὶ λέγοντες δὸς ἡμῖν κρέα ἵνα φάγωμεν

text_en: I am not able alone to bear all this people, because it is too heavy for me.
text_la: Non possum solus sustinere omnem hunc populum, quia gravis est mihi.
text_pt: Eu só não posso levar a todo este povo, porque muito pesado é para mim.
text_el: οὐ δυνήσομαι ἐγὼ μόνος φέρειν τὸν λαὸν τοῦτον ὅτι βαρύτερόν μοί ἐστιν τὸ ῥῆμα τοῦτο

text_en: But if it seem unto you otherwise, I beseech you to kill me, and let me find grace in your eyes, that I be not afflicted with so great evils .
text_la: Sin aliter tibi videtur, obsecro ut interficias me, et inveniam gratiam in oculis tuis, ne tantis afficiar malis.
text_pt: E se assim fazes comigo, mata-me, peço-te, se tenho achado graça aos teus olhos, e não me deixes ver o meu mal.
text_el: εἰ δὲ οὕτως σὺ ποιεῖς μοι ἀπόκτεινόν με ἀναιρέσει εἰ εὕρηκα ἔλεος παρὰ σοί ἵνα μὴ ἴδω μου τὴν κάκωσιν

text_en: And the Lord said to Moses : Gather unto me seventy men of the ancients of Israel , whom you know to be ancients and masters of the people: and you shall bring them to the door of the tabernacle of the covenant , and shall make them stand there with you,
text_la: Et dixit Dominus ad Moysen : Congrega mihi septuaginta viros de senibus Israël, quos tu nosti quod senes populi sint ac magistri : et duces eos ad ostium tabernaculi fœderis, faciesque ibi stare tecum,
text_pt: E disse o Senhor a Moisés: Ajunta-me setenta homens dos anciãos de Israel, que sabes serem anciãos do povo e seus oficiais; e os trarás perante a tenda da congregação, e ali estejam contigo.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν συνάγαγέ μοι ἑβδομήκοντα ἄνδρας ἀπὸ τῶν πρεσβυτέρων Ισραηλ οὓς αὐτὸς σὺ οἶδας ὅτι οὗτοί εἰσιν πρεσβύτεροι τοῦ λαοῦ καὶ γραμματεῖς αὐτῶν καὶ ἄξεις αὐτοὺς πρὸς τὴν σκηνὴν τοῦ μαρτυρίου καὶ στήσονται ἐκεῖ μετὰ σοῦ

text_en: that I may come down and speak with you: and I will take of your spirit , and will give to them, that they may bear with you the burden of the people, and you may not be burthened alone.
text_la: ut descendam et loquar tibi : et auferam de spiritu tuo, tradamque eis, ut sustentent tecum onus populi, et non tu solus graveris.
text_pt: Então eu descerei e ali falarei contigo, e tirarei do espírito que está sobre ti, e o porei sobre eles; e contigo levarão a carga do povo, para que tu não a leves sozinho.
text_el: καὶ καταβήσομαι καὶ λαλήσω ἐκεῖ μετὰ σοῦ καὶ ἀφελῶ ἀπὸ τοῦ πνεύματος τοῦ ἐπὶ σοὶ καὶ ἐπιθήσω ἐπ' αὐτούς καὶ συναντιλήμψονται μετὰ σοῦ τὴν ὁρμὴν τοῦ λαοῦ καὶ οὐκ οἴσεις αὐτοὺς σὺ μόνος

text_en: And you shall say to the people: Be sanctified : tomorrow you shall eat flesh: for I have heard you say: Who will give us flesh to eat? It was well with us in Egypt . That the Lord may give you flesh, and you may eat:
text_la: Populo quoque dices : Sanctificamini (cras comedetis carnes : ego enim audivi vos dicere : Quis dabit nobis escas carnium? bene nobis erat in Ægypto), ut det vobis Dominus carnes, et comedatis:
text_pt: E dirás ao povo: Santificai-vos para amanhã, e comereis carne; porquanto chorastes aos ouvidos do Senhor, dizendo: Quem nos dará carne a comer? Pois íamos bem no Egito; por isso o Senhor vos dará carne, e comereis;
text_el: καὶ τῷ λαῷ ἐρεῖς ἁγνίσασθε εἰς αὔριον καὶ φάγεσθε κρέα ὅτι ἐκλαύσατε ἔναντι κυρίου λέγοντες τίς ἡμᾶς ψωμιεῖ κρέα ὅτι καλὸν ἡμῖν ἐστιν ἐν Αἰγύπτῳ καὶ δώσει κύριος ὑμῖν κρέα φαγεῖν καὶ φάγεσθε κρέα

text_en: Not for one day, nor two, nor five, nor ten, no nor for twenty.
text_la: non uno die, nec duobus, vel quinque aut decem, nec viginti quidem,
text_pt: Não comereis um dia, nem dois dias, nem cinco dias, nem dez dias, nem vinte dias;
text_el: οὐχ ἡμέραν μίαν φάγεσθε οὐδὲ δύο οὐδὲ πέντε ἡμέρας οὐδὲ δέκα ἡμέρας οὐδὲ εἴκοσι ἡμέρας

text_en: But even for a month of days, till it come out at your nostrils, and become loathsome to you, because you have cast off the Lord , who is in the midst of you, and have wept before him, saying: Why came we out of Egypt ?
text_la: sed usque ad mensem dierum, donec exeat per nares vestras, et vertatur in nauseam, eo quod repuleritis Dominum, qui in medio vestri est, et fleveritis coram eo, dicentes : Quare egressi sumus ex Ægypto?
text_pt: Mas um mês inteiro, até vos sair pelas narinas, até que vos enfastieis dela; porquanto rejeitastes ao Senhor, que está no meio de vós, e chorastes diante dele, dizendo: Por que saímos do Egito?
text_el: ἕως μηνὸς ἡμερῶν φάγεσθε ἕως ἂν ἐξέλθῃ ἐκ τῶν μυκτήρων ὑμῶν καὶ ἔσται ὑμῖν εἰς χολέραν ὅτι ἠπειθήσατε κυρίῳ ὅς ἐστιν ἐν ὑμῖν καὶ ἐκλαύσατε ἐναντίον αὐτοῦ λέγοντες ἵνα τί ἡμῖν ἐξελθεῖν ἐξ Αἰγύπτου

text_en: And Moses said: There are six hundred thousand footmen of this people, and say: I will give them flesh to eat a whole month?
text_la: Et ait Moyses : Sexcenta millia peditum hujus populi sunt : et tu dicis : Dabo eis esum carnium mense integro?
text_pt: E disse Moisés: Seiscentos mil homens de pé é este povo, no meio do qual estou; e tu tens dito: Dar-lhes-ei carne, e comerão um mês inteiro.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Μωυσῆς ἑξακόσιαι χιλιάδες πεζῶν ὁ λαός ἐν οἷς εἰμι ἐν αὐτοῖς καὶ σὺ εἶπας κρέα δώσω αὐτοῖς φαγεῖν καὶ φάγονται μῆνα ἡμερῶν

text_en: Shall then a multitude of sheep and oxen be killed, that it may suffice for their food? Or shall the fishes of the sea be gathered together to fill them?
text_la: numquid ovium et boum multitudo cædetur, ut possit sufficere ad cibum? vel omnes pisces maris in unum congregabuntur, ut eos satient?
text_pt: Degolar-se-ão para eles ovelhas e vacas que lhes bastem? Ou ajuntar-se-ão para eles todos os peixes do mar, que lhes bastem?
text_el: μὴ πρόβατα καὶ βόες σφαγήσονται αὐτοῖς καὶ ἀρκέσει αὐτοῖς ἢ πᾶν τὸ ὄψος τῆς θαλάσσης συναχθήσεται αὐτοῖς καὶ ἀρκέσει αὐτοῖς

text_en: And the Lord answered him: Is the hand of the Lord unable? You shall presently see whether my word shall come to pass or no.
text_la: Cui respondit Dominus : Numquid manus Domini invalida est? jam nunc videbis utrum meus sermo opere compleatur.
text_pt: Porém, o Senhor disse a Moisés: Teria sido encurtada a mão do Senhor? Agora verás se a minha palavra se há de cumprir ou não.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν μὴ χεὶρ κυρίου οὐκ ἐξαρκέσει ἤδη γνώσει εἰ ἐπικαταλήμψεταί σε ὁ λόγος μου ἢ οὔ

text_en: Moses therefore came, and told the people the words of the Lord , and assembled seventy men of the ancients of Israel , and made them to stand about the tabernacle .
text_la: Venit igitur Moyses, et narravit populo verba Domini, congregans septuaginta viros de senibus Israël, quos stare fecit circa tabernaculum.
text_pt: E saiu Moisés, e falou as palavras do Senhor ao povo, e ajuntou setenta homens dos anciãos do povo e os pôs ao redor da tenda.
text_el: καὶ ἐξῆλθεν Μωυσῆς καὶ ἐλάλησεν πρὸς τὸν λαὸν τὰ ῥήματα κυρίου καὶ συνήγαγεν ἑβδομήκοντα ἄνδρας ἀπὸ τῶν πρεσβυτέρων τοῦ λαοῦ καὶ ἔστησεν αὐτοὺς κύκλῳ τῆς σκηνῆς

text_en: And the Lord came down in a cloud, and spoke to him, taking away of the spirit that was in Moses , and giving to the seventy men . And when the spirit had rested on them they prophesied , nor did they cease afterwards.
text_la: Descenditque Dominus per nubem, et locutus est ad eum, auferens de spiritu qui erat in Moyse, et dans septuaginta viris. Cumque requievisset in eis spiritus, prophetaverunt, nec ultra cessaverunt.
text_pt: Então o Senhor desceu na nuvem, e lhe falou; e, tirando do espírito, que estava sobre ele, o pôs sobre aqueles setenta anciãos; e aconteceu que, quando o espírito repousou sobre eles, profetizaram; mas depois nunca mais.
text_el: καὶ κατέβη κύριος ἐν νεφέλῃ καὶ ἐλάλησεν πρὸς αὐτόν καὶ παρείλατο ἀπὸ τοῦ πνεύματος τοῦ ἐπ' αὐτῷ καὶ ἐπέθηκεν ἐπὶ τοὺς ἑβδομήκοντα ἄνδρας τοὺς πρεσβυτέρους ὡς δὲ ἐπανεπαύσατο τὸ πνεῦμα ἐπ' αὐτούς καὶ ἐπροφήτευσαν καὶ οὐκέτι προσέθεντο

text_en: Now there remained in the camp two of the men , of whom one was called Eldad, and the other Medad, upon whom the spirit rested; for they also had been enrolled, but were not gone forth to the tabernacle .
text_la: Remanserat autem in castris duo viri, quorum unus vocabatur Eldad, et alter Medad, super quos requievit spiritus. Nam et ipsi descripti fuerant, et non exierant ad tabernaculum.
text_pt: Porém no arraial ficaram dois homens; o nome de um era Eldade, e do outro Medade; e repousou sobre eles o espírito (porquanto estavam entre os inscritos, ainda que não saíram à tenda), e profetizavam no arraial.
text_el: καὶ κατελείφθησαν δύο ἄνδρες ἐν τῇ παρεμβολῇ ὄνομα τῷ ἑνὶ Ελδαδ καὶ ὄνομα τῷ δευτέρῳ Μωδαδ καὶ ἐπανεπαύσατο ἐπ' αὐτοὺς τὸ πνεῦμα καὶ οὗτοι ἦσαν τῶν καταγεγραμμένων καὶ οὐκ ἦλθον πρὸς τὴν σκηνήν καὶ ἐπροφήτευσαν ἐν τῇ παρεμβολῇ

text_en: And when they prophesied in the camp, there ran a young man, and told Moses , saying: Eldad and Medad prophesy in the camp.
text_la: Cumque prophetarent in castris, cucurrit puer, et nuntiavit Moysi, dicens : Eldad et Medad prophetant in castris.
text_pt: Então correu um moço e anunciou a Moisés e disse: Eldade e Medade profetizam no arraial.
text_el: καὶ προσδραμὼν ὁ νεανίσκος ἀπήγγειλεν Μωυσῇ καὶ εἶπεν λέγων Ελδαδ καὶ Μωδαδ προφητεύουσιν ἐν τῇ παρεμβολῇ

text_en: Forthwith Joshua the son of Nun , the minister of Moses , and chosen out of many, said: My lord Moses forbid them.
text_la: Statim Josue filius Nun, minister Moysi, et electus e pluribus, ait : Domine mi Moyses, prohibe eos.
text_pt: E Josué, filho de Num, servidor de Moisés, um dos seus jovens escolhidos, respondeu e disse: Moisés, meu senhor, proíbe-lho.
text_el: καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς Ἰησοῦς ὁ τοῦ Ναυη ὁ παρεστηκὼς Μωυσῇ ὁ ἐκελεκτὸς εἶπεν κύριε Μωυσῆ κώλυσον αὐτούς

text_en: But he said: Why have you emulation for me? O that all the people might prophesy , and that the Lord would give them his spirit !
text_la: At ille : Quid, inquit æmularis pro me? quis tribuat ut omnis populus prophetet, et det eis Dominus spiritum suum?
text_pt: Porém, Moisés lhe disse: Tens tu ciúmes por mim? Quem dera que todo o povo do Senhor fosse profeta, e que o Senhor pusesse o seu espírito sobre ele!
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Μωυσῆς μὴ ζηλοῖς σύ μοι καὶ τίς δῴη πάντα τὸν λαὸν κυρίου προφήτας ὅταν δῷ κύριος τὸ πνεῦμα αὐτοῦ ἐπ' αὐτούς

text_en: And Moses returned, with the ancients of Israel , into the camp.
text_la: Reversusque est Moyses, et majores natu Israël in castra.
text_pt: Depois Moisés se recolheu ao arraial, ele e os anciãos de Israel.
text_el: καὶ ἀπῆλθεν Μωυσῆς εἰς τὴν παρεμβολήν αὐτὸς καὶ οἱ πρεσβύτεροι Ισραηλ

text_en: And a wind going out from the Lord , taking quails up beyond the sea brought them, and cast them into the camp for the space of one day's journey, on every side of the camp round about, and they flew in the air two cubits high above the ground.
text_la: Ventus autem egrediens a Domino, arreptans trans mare coturnices detulit, et demisit in castra itinere quantum uno die confici potest, ex omni parte castrorum per circuitum, volabantque in aëre duobus cubitis altitudine super terram.
text_pt: Então soprou um vento do Senhor e trouxe codornizes do mar, e as espalhou pelo arraial quase caminho de um dia, de um lado e de outro lado, ao redor do arraial; quase dois côvados sobre a terra.
text_el: καὶ πνεῦμα ἐξῆλθεν παρὰ κυρίου καὶ ἐξεπέρασεν ὀρτυγομήτραν ἀπὸ τῆς θαλάσσης καὶ ἐπέβαλεν ἐπὶ τὴν παρεμβολὴν ὁδὸν ἡμέρας ἐντεῦθεν καὶ ὁδὸν ἡμέρας ἐντεῦθεν κύκλῳ τῆς παρεμβολῆς ὡσεὶ δίπηχυ ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς

text_en: The people therefore rising up all that day, and night, and the next day, gathered together of quails, he that did least, ten cores: and they dried them round about the camp.
text_la: Surgens ergo populus toto die illo, et nocte, ac die altero, congregavit coturnicum : qui parum, decem coros : et siccaverunt eas per gyrum castrorum.
text_pt: Então o povo se levantou todo aquele dia e toda aquela noite, e todo o dia seguinte, e colheram as codornizes; o que menos tinha, colhera dez ômeres; e as estenderam para si ao redor do arraial.
text_el: καὶ ἀναστὰς ὁ λαὸς ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν καὶ ὅλην τὴν νύκτα καὶ ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν τὴν ἐπαύριον καὶ συνήγαγον τὴν ὀρτυγομήτραν ὁ τὸ ὀλίγον συνήγαγεν δέκα κόρους καὶ ἔψυξαν ἑαυτοῖς ψυγμοὺς κύκλῳ τῆς παρεμβολῆς

text_en: As yet the flesh was between their teeth, neither had that kind of meat failed: when behold the wrath of the Lord being provoked against the people, struck them with an exceeding great plague.
text_la: Adhuc carnes erant in dentibus eorum, nec defecerat hujuscemodi cibus : et ecce furor Domini concitatus in populum, percussit eum plaga magna nimis.
text_pt: Quando a carne estava entre os seus dentes, antes que fosse mastigada, se acendeu a ira do Senhor contra o povo, e feriu o Senhor o povo com uma praga mui grande.
text_el: τὰ κρέα ἔτι ἦν ἐν τοῖς ὀδοῦσιν αὐτῶν πρὶν ἢ ἐκλείπειν καὶ κύριος ἐθυμώθη εἰς τὸν λαόν καὶ ἐπάταξεν κύριος τὸν λαὸν πληγὴν μεγάλην σφόδρα

text_en: And that place was called, The graves of lust : for there they buried the people that had lusted .
text_la: Vocatusque est ille locus, Sepulchra concupiscentiæ : ibi enim sepelierunt populum qui desideraverat.
text_pt: Por isso o nome daquele lugar se chamou Quibrote-Ataavá, porquanto ali enterraram o povo que teve o desejo.
text_el: καὶ ἐκλήθη τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ τόπου ἐκείνου μνήματα τῆς ἐπιθυμίας ὅτι ἐκεῖ ἔθαψαν τὸν λαὸν τὸν ἐπιθυμητήν

text_en: And departing from the graves of lust , they came unto Haseroth, and abode there.
text_la: Egressi autem de Sepulchris concupiscentiæ, venerunt in Haseroth, et manserunt ibi.
text_pt: De Quibrote-Ataavá caminhou o povo para Hazerote, e pararam em Hazerote.
text_el: ἀπὸ μνημάτων ἐπιθυμίας ἐξῆρεν ὁ λαὸς εἰς Ασηρωθ καὶ ἐγένετο ὁ λαὸς ἐν Ασηρωθ

text_en: And Mary and Aaron spoke against Moses , because of his wife the Ethiopian ,
text_la: Locutaque est Maria et Aaron contra Moysen propter uxorem ejus Æthiopissam,
text_pt: E falaram Miriã e Arão contra Moisés, por causa da mulher cusita, com quem casara; porquanto tinha casado com uma mulher cusita.
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν Μαριαμ καὶ Ααρων κατὰ Μωυσῆ ἕνεκεν τῆς γυναικὸς τῆς Αἰθιοπίσσης ἣν ἔλαβεν Μωυσῆς ὅτι γυναῖκα Αἰθιόπισσαν ἔλαβεν

text_en: and they said: Hath the Lord spoken by Moses only? Hath he not also spoken to us in like manner? And when the Lord heard this,
text_la: et dixerunt : Num per solum Moysen locutus est Dominus? nonne et nobis similiter est locutus? Quod cum audisset Dominus
text_pt: E disseram: Porventura falou o Senhor somente por Moisés? Não falou também por nós? E o Senhor o ouviu.
text_el: καὶ εἶπαν μὴ Μωυσῇ μόνῳ λελάληκεν κύριος οὐχὶ καὶ ἡμῖν ἐλάλησεν καὶ ἤκουσεν κύριος

text_en: (for Moses was a man exceeding meek above all men that dwelt upon earth)
text_la: (erat enim Moyses vir mitissimus super omnes homines qui morabantur in terra),
text_pt: E era o homem Moisés mui manso, mais do que todos os homens que havia sobre a terra.
text_el: καὶ ὁ ἄνθρωπος Μωυσῆς πραῢς σφόδρα παρὰ πάντας τοὺς ἀνθρώπους τοὺς ὄντας ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς

text_en: immediately he spoke to him, and to Aaron and Mary: Come out you three only to the tabernacle of the covenant . And when they had come out,
text_la: statim locutus est ad eum, et ad Aaron et Mariam : Egredimini vos tantum tres ad tabernaculum fœderis. Cumque fuissent egressi,
text_pt: E logo o Senhor disse a Moisés, a Arão e a Miriã: Vós três saí à tenda da congregação. E saíram eles três.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος παραχρῆμα πρὸς Μωυσῆν καὶ Μαριαμ καὶ Ααρων ἐξέλθατε ὑμεῖς οἱ τρεῖς εἰς τὴν σκηνὴν τοῦ μαρτυρίου καὶ ἐξῆλθον οἱ τρεῖς εἰς τὴν σκηνὴν τοῦ μαρτυρίου

text_en: the Lord came down in a pillar of the cloud , and stood in the entry of the tabernacle calling to Aaron and Mary. And when they had come,
text_la: descendit Dominus in columna nubis, et stetit in introitu tabernaculi, vocans Aaron et Mariam. Qui cum issent,
text_pt: Então o Senhor desceu na coluna de nuvem, e se pôs à porta da tenda; depois chamou a Arão e a Miriã e ambos saíram.
text_el: καὶ κατέβη κύριος ἐν στύλῳ νεφέλης καὶ ἔστη ἐπὶ τῆς θύρας τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου καὶ ἐκλήθησαν Ααρων καὶ Μαριαμ καὶ ἐξήλθοσαν ἀμφότεροι

text_en: he said to them: Hear my words: if there be among you a prophet of the Lord , I will appear to him in a vision , or I will speak to him in a dream .
text_la: dixit ad eos : Audite sermones meos : si quis fuerit inter vos propheta Domini, in visione apparebo ei, vel per somnium loquar ad illum.
text_pt: E disse: Ouvi agora as minhas palavras; se entre vós houver profeta, eu, o Senhor, em visão a ele me farei conhecer, ou em sonhos falarei com ele.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς ἀκούσατε τῶν λόγων μου ἐὰν γένηται προφήτης ὑμῶν κυρίῳ ἐν ὁράματι αὐτῷ γνωσθήσομαι καὶ ἐν ὕπνῳ λαλήσω αὐτῷ

text_en: But it is not so with my servant Moses who is most faithful in all my house:
text_la: At non talis servus meus Moyses, qui in omni domo mea fidelissimus est:
text_pt: Não é assim com o meu servo Moisés que é fiel em toda a minha casa.
text_el: οὐχ οὕτως ὁ θεράπων μου Μωυσῆς ἐν ὅλῳ τῷ οἴκῳ μου πιστός ἐστιν

text_en: For I speak to him mouth to mouth: and plainly, and not by riddles and figures does he see the Lord . Why then were you not afraid to speak ill of my servant Moses ?
text_la: ore enim ad os loquor ei : et palam, et non per ænigmata et figuras Dominum videt. Quare ergo non timuistis detrahere servo meo Moysi?
text_pt: Boca a boca falo com ele, claramente e não por enigmas; pois ele vê a semelhança do Senhor; por que, pois, não tivestes temor de falar contra o meu servo, contra Moisés?
text_el: στόμα κατὰ στόμα λαλήσω αὐτῷ ἐν εἴδει καὶ οὐ δι' αἰνιγμάτων καὶ τὴν δόξαν κυρίου εἶδεν καὶ διὰ τί οὐκ ἐφοβήθητε καταλαλῆσαι κατὰ τοῦ θεράποντός μου Μωυσῆ

text_en: And being angry with them he went away:
text_la: Iratusque contra eos, abiit:
text_pt: Assim a ira do Senhor contra eles se acendeu; e retirou-se.
text_el: καὶ ὀργὴ θυμοῦ κυρίου ἐπ' αὐτοῖς καὶ ἀπῆλθεν

text_en: The cloud also that was over the tabernacle departed: and behold Mary appeared white as snow with a leprosy . And when Aaron had looked on her, and saw her all covered with leprosy ,
text_la: nubes quoque recessit quæ erat super tabernaculum : et ecce Maria apparuit candens lepra quasi nix. Cumque respexisset eam Aaron, et vidisset perfusam lepra,
text_pt: E a nuvem se retirou de sobre a tenda; e eis que Miriã ficou leprosa como a neve; e olhou Arão para Miriã, e eis que estava leprosa.
text_el: καὶ ἡ νεφέλη ἀπέστη ἀπὸ τῆς σκηνῆς καὶ ἰδοὺ Μαριαμ λεπρῶσα ὡσεὶ χιών καὶ ἐπέβλεψεν Ααρων ἐπὶ Μαριαμ καὶ ἰδοὺ λεπρῶσα

text_en: he said to Moses : I beseech you, my lord, lay not upon us this sin , which we have foolishly committed:
text_la: ait ad Moysen : Obsecro, domine mi, ne imponas nobis hoc peccatum quod stulte commisimus,
text_pt: Por isso Arão disse a Moisés: Ai, senhor meu, não ponhas sobre nós este pecado, pois agimos loucamente, e temos pecado.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ααρων πρὸς Μωυσῆν δέομαι κύριε μὴ συνεπιθῇ ἡμῖν ἁμαρτίαν διότι ἠγνοήσαμεν καθότι ἡμάρτομεν

text_en: Let her not be as one dead, and as an abortive that is cast forth from the mother's womb. Lo, now one half of her flesh is consumed with the leprosy .
text_la: ne fiat hæc quasi mortua, et ut abortivum quod projicitur de vulva matris suæ : ecce jam medium carnis ejus devoratum est a lepra.
text_pt: Ora, não seja ela como um morto, que saindo do ventre de sua mãe, a metade da sua carne já esteja consumida.
text_el: μὴ γένηται ὡσεὶ ἴσον θανάτῳ ὡσεὶ ἔκτρωμα ἐκπορευόμενον ἐκ μήτρας μητρὸς καὶ κατεσθίει τὸ ἥμισυ τῶν σαρκῶν αὐτῆς

text_en: And Moses cried to the Lord , saying O God , I beseech you heal her.
text_la: Clamavitque Moyses ad Dominum, dicens : Deus, obsecro, sana eam.
text_pt: Clamou, pois, Moisés ao Senhor, dizendo: Ó Deus, rogo-te que a cures.
text_el: καὶ ἐβόησεν Μωυσῆς πρὸς κύριον λέγων ὁ θεός δέομαί σου ἴασαι αὐτήν

text_en: And the Lord answered him: If her father had spitten upon her face, ought she not to have been ashamed for seven days at least? Let her be separated seven days without the camp, and afterwards she shall be called again.
text_la: Cui respondit Dominus : Si pater ejus spuisset in faciem illius, nonne debuerat saltem septem diebus rubore suffundi? separetur septem diebus extra castra, et postea revocabitur.
text_pt: E disse o Senhor a Moisés: Se seu pai cuspira em seu rosto, não seria envergonhada sete dias? Esteja fechada sete dias fora do arraial, e depois a recolham.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν εἰ ὁ πατὴρ αὐτῆς πτύων ἐνέπτυσεν εἰς τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτῆς οὐκ ἐντραπήσεται ἑπτὰ ἡμέρας ἀφορισθήτω ἑπτὰ ἡμέρας ἔξω τῆς παρεμβολῆς καὶ μετὰ ταῦτα εἰσελεύσεται

text_en: Mary therefore was put out of the camp seven days: and the people moved not from that place until Mary was called again.
text_la: Exclusa est itaque Maria extra castra septem diebus : et populus non est motus de loco illo, donec revocata est Maria.
text_pt: Assim Miriã esteve fechada fora do arraial sete dias, e o povo não partiu, até que recolheram a Miriã.
text_el: καὶ ἀφωρίσθη Μαριαμ ἔξω τῆς παρεμβολῆς ἑπτὰ ἡμέρας καὶ ὁ λαὸς οὐκ ἐξῆρεν ἕως ἐκαθαρίσθη Μαριαμ

text_en: And the people marched from Haseroth, and pitched their tents in the desert of Pharan.
text_la: Profectusque est populus de Haseroth, fixis tentoriis in deserto Pharan.
text_pt: Porém, depois o povo partiu de Hazerote; e acampou-se no deserto de Parã.
text_el: καὶ μετὰ ταῦτα ἐξῆρεν ὁ λαὸς ἐξ Ασηρωθ καὶ παρενέβαλον ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ τοῦ Φαραν

text_en: And there the Lord spoke to Moses , saying.
text_la: Ibique locutus est Dominus ad Moysen, dicens:
text_pt: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν λέγων

text_en: Send men to view the land of Chanaan , which I will give to the children of Israel , one of every tribe , of the rulers.
text_la: Mitte viros, qui considerent terram Chanaan, quam daturus sum filiis Israël, singulos de singulis tribubus, ex principibus.
text_pt: Envia homens que espiem a terra de Canaã, que eu hei de dar aos filhos de Israel; de cada tribo de seus pais enviareis um homem, sendo cada um príncipe entre eles.
text_el: ἀπόστειλον σεαυτῷ ἄνδρας καὶ κατασκεψάσθωσαν τὴν γῆν τῶν Χαναναίων ἣν ἐγὼ δίδωμι τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ εἰς κατάσχεσιν ἄνδρα ἕνα κατὰ φυλὴν κατὰ δήμους πατριῶν αὐτῶν ἀποστελεῖς αὐτούς πάντα ἀρχηγὸν ἐξ αὐτῶν

text_en: Moses did what the Lord had commanded, sending from the desert of Pharan, principal men ,
text_la: Fecit Moyses quod Dominus imperaverat, de deserto Pharan mittens principes viros,
text_pt: E enviou-os Moisés do deserto de Parã, segundo a ordem do Senhor; todos aqueles homens eram cabeças dos filhos de Israel.
text_el: καὶ ἐξαπέστειλεν αὐτοὺς Μωυσῆς ἐκ τῆς ἐρήμου Φαραν διὰ φωνῆς κυρίου πάντες ἄνδρες ἀρχηγοὶ υἱῶν Ισραηλ οὗτοι

text_en: whose names are these:
text_la: quorum ista sunt nomina.
text_pt: E estes são os seus nomes: Da tribo de Rúben, Samua, filho de Zacur;
text_el: καὶ ταῦτα τὰ ὀνόματα αὐτῶν

text_en: Of the tribe of Ruben , Sammua the son of Zechur.
text_la: De tribu Ruben, Sammua filium Zechur.
text_pt: Da tribo de Simeão, Safate, filho de Hori;
text_el: τῆς φυλῆς Ρουβην Σαλαμιηλ υἱὸς Ζακχουρ

text_en: Of the tribe of Simeon , Saphat the son of Huri.
text_la: De tribu Simeon, Saphat filium Huri.
text_pt: Da tribo de Judá, Calebe, filho de Jefoné;
text_el: τῆς φυλῆς Συμεων Σαφατ υἱὸς Σουρι

text_en: Of the tribe of Juda , Caleb the son of Jephone .
text_la: De tribu Juda, Caleb filium Jephone.
text_pt: Da tribo de Issacar, Jigeal, filho de José;
text_el: τῆς φυλῆς Ιουδα Χαλεβ υἱὸς Ιεφοννη

text_en: Of the tribe of Issachar , Igal the son of Joseph .
text_la: De tribu Issachar, Igal filium Joseph.
text_pt: Da tribo de Efraim, Oséias, filho de Num;
text_el: τῆς φυλῆς Ισσαχαρ Ιγααλ υἱὸς Ιωσηφ

text_en: Of the tribe of Ephraim, Osee the son of Nun.
text_la: De tribu Ephraim, Osee filium Nun.
text_pt: Da tribo de Benjamim, Palti, filho de Rafu;
text_el: τῆς φυλῆς Εφραιμ Αυση υἱὸς Ναυη

text_en: Of the tribe of Benjamin , Phalti the son of Raphu.
text_la: De tribu Benjamin, Phalti filium Raphu.
text_pt: Da tribo de Zebulom, Gadiel, filho de Sodi;
text_el: τῆς φυλῆς Βενιαμιν Φαλτι υἱὸς Ραφου

text_en: Of the tribe of Zabulon , Geddiel the son of Sodi.
text_la: De tribu Zabulon, Geddiel filium Sodi.
text_pt: Da tribo de José, pela tribo de Manassés, Gadi filho de Susi;
text_el: τῆς φυλῆς Ζαβουλων Γουδιηλ υἱὸς Σουδι

text_en: Of the tribe of Joseph , of the sceptre of Manasses , Gaddi the son of Susi.
text_la: De tribu Joseph, sceptri Manasse, Gaddi filium Susi.
text_pt: Da tribo de Dã, Amiel, filho de Gemali;
text_el: τῆς φυλῆς Ιωσηφ τῶν υἱῶν Μανασση Γαδδι υἱὸς Σουσι

text_en: Of the tribe of Dan , Ammiel the son of Gemalli.
text_la: De tribu Dan, Ammiel filium Gemalli.
text_pt: Da tribo de Aser, Setur, filho de Micael;
text_el: τῆς φυλῆς Δαν Αμιηλ υἱὸς Γαμαλι

text_en: Of the tribe of Aser , Sthur the son of Michael.
text_la: De tribu Aser, Sthur filium Michaël.
text_pt: Da tribo de Naftali, Nabi, filho de Vofsi;
text_el: τῆς φυλῆς Ασηρ Σαθουρ υἱὸς Μιχαηλ

text_en: Of the tribe of Nephtali , Nahabi the son of Vapsi.
text_la: De tribu Nephthali, Nahabi filium Vapsi.
text_pt: Da tribo de Gade, Geuel, filho de Maqui.
text_el: τῆς φυλῆς Νεφθαλι Ναβι υἱὸς Ιαβι

text_en: Of the tribe of Gad , Guel the son of Machi.
text_la: De tribu Gad, Guel filium Machi.
text_pt: Estes são os nomes dos homens que Moisés enviou a espiar aquela terra; e a Oséias, filho de Num, Moisés chamou Josué.
text_el: τῆς φυλῆς Γαδ Γουδιηλ υἱὸς Μακχι

text_en: These are the names of the men , whom Moses sent to view the land: and he called Osee the son of Nun, Joshua .
text_la: Hæc sunt nomina virorum, quos misit Moyses ad considerandam terram : vocavitque Osee filium Nun, Josue.
text_pt: Enviou-os, pois, Moisés a espiar a terra de Canaã; e disse-lhes: Subi por aqui para o lado do sul, e subi à montanha:
text_el: ταῦτα τὰ ὀνόματα τῶν ἀνδρῶν οὓς ἀπέστειλεν Μωυσῆς κατασκέψασθαι τὴν γῆν καὶ ἐπωνόμασεν Μωυσῆς τὸν Αυση υἱὸν Ναυη Ἰησοῦν

text_en: And Moses sent them to view the land of Chanaan , and said to them: Go you up by the south side. And when you shall come to the mountains,
text_la: Misit ergo eos Moyses ad considerandam terram Chanaan, et dixit ad eos : Ascendite per meridianam plagam. Cumque veneritis ad montes,
text_pt: E vede que terra é, e o povo que nela habita; se é forte ou fraco; se pouco ou muito.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν αὐτοὺς Μωυσῆς κατασκέψασθαι τὴν γῆν Χανααν καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς ἀνάβητε ταύτῃ τῇ ἐρήμῳ καὶ ἀναβήσεσθε εἰς τὸ ὄρος

text_en: view the land, of what sort it is, and the people that are the inhabitants thereof, whether they be strong or weak: few in number or many:
text_la: considerate terram, qualis sit : et populum qui habitator est ejus, utrum fortis sit an infirmus : si pauci numero an plures:
text_pt: E como é a terra em que habita, se boa ou má; e quais são as cidades em que eles habitam; se em arraiais, ou em fortalezas.
text_el: καὶ ὄψεσθε τὴν γῆν τίς ἐστιν καὶ τὸν λαὸν τὸν ἐγκαθήμενον ἐπ' αὐτῆς εἰ ἰσχυρότερός ἐστιν ἢ ἀσθενής εἰ ὀλίγοι εἰσὶν ἢ πολλοί

text_en: The land itself, whether it be good or bad: what manner of cities, walled or without walls:
text_la: ipsa terra, bona an mala : urbes quales, muratæ an absque muris:
text_pt: Também como é a terra, se fértil ou estéril; se nela há árvores, ou não; e esforçai-vos, e tomai do fruto da terra. E eram aqueles dias os dias das primícias das uvas.
text_el: καὶ τίς ἡ γῆ εἰς ἣν οὗτοι ἐγκάθηνται ἐπ' αὐτῆς εἰ καλή ἐστιν ἢ πονηρά καὶ τίνες αἱ πόλεις εἰς ἃς οὗτοι κατοικοῦσιν ἐν αὐταῖς εἰ ἐν τειχήρεσιν ἢ ἐν ἀτειχίστοις

text_en: The ground, fat or barren, woody or without trees. Be of good courage , and bring us of the fruits of the land. Now it was the time when the firstripe grapes are fit to be eaten.
text_la: humus, pinguis an sterilis, nemorosa an absque arboribus. Confortamini, et afferte nobis de fructibus terræ. Erat autem tempus quando jam præcoquæ uvæ vesci possunt.
text_pt: Assim subiram e espiaram a terra desde o deserto de Zim, até Reobe, à entrada de Hamate.
text_el: καὶ τίς ἡ γῆ εἰ πίων ἢ παρειμένη εἰ ἔστιν ἐν αὐτῇ δένδρα ἢ οὔ καὶ προσκαρτερήσαντες λήμψεσθε ἀπὸ τῶν καρπῶν τῆς γῆς καὶ αἱ ἡμέραι ἡμέραι ἔαρος πρόδρομοι σταφυλῆς

text_en: And when they had gone up, they viewed the land from the desert of Sin, unto Rohob as you enter into Emath.
text_la: Cumque ascendissent, exploraverunt terram a deserto Sin, usque Rohob intrantibus Emath.
text_pt: E subiram para o lado do sul, e vieram até Hebrom; e estavam ali Aimã, Sesai e Talmai, filhos de Anaque (Hebrom foi edificada sete anos antes de Zoã no Egito).
text_el: καὶ ἀναβάντες κατεσκέψαντο τὴν γῆν ἀπὸ τῆς ἐρήμου Σιν ἕως Ρααβ εἰσπορευομένων Εφααθ

text_en: And they went up at the south side, and came to Hebron , where were Achiman and Sisai and Tholmai the sons of Enac. For Hebron was built seven years before Tanis the city of Egypt .
text_la: Ascenderuntque ad meridiem, et venerunt in Hebron, ubi erant Achiman et Sisai et Tholmai filii Enac : nam Hebron septem annis ante Tanim urbem Ægypti condita est.
text_pt: Depois foram até ao vale de Escol, e dali cortaram um ramo de vide com um cacho de uvas, o qual trouxeram dois homens, sobre uma vara; como também das romãs e dos figos.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέβησαν κατὰ τὴν ἔρημον καὶ ἦλθον ἕως Χεβρων καὶ ἐκεῖ Αχιμαν καὶ Σεσσι καὶ Θελαμιν γενεαὶ Εναχ καὶ Χεβρων ἑπτὰ ἔτεσιν ᾠκοδομήθη πρὸ τοῦ Τάνιν Αἰγύπτου

text_en: And forward as far as the torrent of the cluster of grapes, they cut off a branch with its cluster of grapes, which two men carried upon a lever. They took also of the pomegranates and of the figs of that place:
text_la: Pergentesque usque ad Torrentem botri, absciderunt palmitem cum uva sua, quem portaverunt in vecte duo viri. De malis quoque granatis et de ficis loci illius tulerunt:
text_pt: Chamaram àquele lugar o vale de Escol, por causa do cacho que dali cortaram os filhos de Israel.
text_el: καὶ ἤλθοσαν ἕως Φάραγγος βότρυος καὶ κατεσκέψαντο αὐτήν καὶ ἔκοψαν ἐκεῖθεν κλῆμα καὶ βότρυν σταφυλῆς ἕνα ἐπ' αὐτοῦ καὶ ἦραν αὐτὸν ἐπ' ἀναφορεῦσιν καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν ῥοῶν καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν συκῶν

text_en: Which was called Nehelescol, that is to say, the torrent of the cluster of grapes, because from thence the children of Israel had carried a cluster of grapes.
text_la: qui appellatus est Nehelescol, id est Torrens botri, eo quod botrum portassent inde filii Israël.
text_pt: E eles voltaram de espiar a terra, ao fim de quarenta dias.
text_el: τὸν τόπον ἐκεῖνον ἐπωνόμασαν Φάραγξ βότρυος διὰ τὸν βότρυν ὃν ἔκοψαν ἐκεῖθεν οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ

text_en: And they that went to spy out the land returned after forty days, having gone round all the country,
text_la: Reversique exploratores terræ post quadraginta dies, omni regione circuita,
text_pt: E caminharam, e vieram a Moisés e a Arão, e a toda a congregação dos filhos de Israel no deserto de Parã, em Cades; e deram-lhes notícias, a eles, e a toda a congregação, e mostraram-lhes o fruto da terra.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστρεψαν ἐκεῖθεν κατασκεψάμενοι τὴν γῆν μετὰ τεσσαράκοντα ἡμέρας

text_en: and came to Moses and Aaron and to all the assembly of the children of Israel to the desert of Pharan, which is in Cades . And speaking to them and to all the multitude, they showed them the fruits of the land:
text_la: venerunt ad Moysen et Aaron et ad omnem cœtum filiorum Israël in desertum Pharan, quod est in Cades. Locutique eis et omni multitudini ostenderunt fructus terræ:
text_pt: E contaram-lhe, e disseram: Fomos à terra a que nos enviaste; e verdadeiramente mana leite e mel, e este é o seu fruto.
text_el: καὶ πορευθέντες ἦλθον πρὸς Μωυσῆν καὶ Ααρων καὶ πρὸς πᾶσαν συναγωγὴν υἱῶν Ισραηλ εἰς τὴν ἔρημον Φαραν Καδης καὶ ἀπεκρίθησαν αὐτοῖς ῥῆμα καὶ πάσῃ τῇ συναγωγῇ καὶ ἔδειξαν τὸν καρπὸν τῆς γῆς

text_en: And they related and said: We came into the land to which you sent us, which in very deed flows with milk and honey as may be known by these fruits:
text_la: et narraverunt, dicentes : Venimus in terram, ad quam misisti nos, quæ revera fluit lacte et melle, ut ex his fructibus cognosci potest:
text_pt: O povo, porém, que habita nessa terra é poderoso, e as cidades fortificadas e mui grandes; e também ali vimos os filhos de Anaque.
text_el: καὶ διηγήσαντο αὐτῷ καὶ εἶπαν ἤλθαμεν εἰς τὴν γῆν εἰς ἣν ἀπέστειλας ἡμᾶς γῆν ῥέουσαν γάλα καὶ μέλι καὶ οὗτος ὁ καρπὸς αὐτῆς

text_en: But it has very strong inhabitants, and the cities are great and walled. We saw there the race of Enac.
text_la: sed cultores fortissimos habet, et urbes grandes atque muratas. Stirpem Enac vidimus ibi.
text_pt: Os amalequitas habitam na terra do sul; e os heteus, e os jebuseus, e os amorreus habitam na montanha; e os cananeus habitam junto do mar, e pela margem do Jordão.
text_el: ἀλλ' ἢ ὅτι θρασὺ τὸ ἔθνος τὸ κατοικοῦν ἐπ' αὐτῆς καὶ αἱ πόλεις ὀχυραὶ τετειχισμέναι καὶ μεγάλαι σφόδρα καὶ τὴν γενεὰν Εναχ ἑωράκαμεν ἐκεῖ

text_en: Amalec dwells in the south, the Hethite and the Jebusite and the Amorrhite in the mountains: but the Chanaanite abides by the sea and near the streams of the Jordan .
text_la: Amalec habitat in meridie, Hethæus et Jebusæus et Amorrhæus in montanis : Chananæus vero moratur juxta mare et circa fluenta Jordanis.
text_pt: Então Calebe fez calar o povo perante Moisés, e disse: Certamente subiremos e a possuiremos em herança; porque seguramente prevaleceremos contra ela.
text_el: καὶ Αμαληκ κατοικεῖ ἐν τῇ γῇ τῇ πρὸς νότον καὶ ὁ Χετταῖος καὶ ὁ Ευαῖος καὶ ὁ Ιεβουσαῖος καὶ ὁ Αμορραῖος κατοικεῖ ἐν τῇ ὀρεινῇ καὶ ὁ Χαναναῖος κατοικεῖ παρὰ θάλασσαν καὶ παρὰ τὸν Ιορδάνην ποταμόν

text_en: In the mean time Caleb , to still the murmuring of the people that rose against Moses , said: Let us go up and possess the land, for we shall be able to conquer it.
text_la: Inter hæc Caleb compescens murmur populi, qui oriebatur contra Moysen, ait : Ascendamus, et possideamus terram, quoniam poterimus obtinere eam.
text_pt: Porém, os homens que com ele subiram disseram: Não poderemos subir contra aquele povo, porque é mais forte do que nós.
text_el: καὶ κατεσιώπησεν Χαλεβ τὸν λαὸν πρὸς Μωυσῆν καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ οὐχί ἀλλὰ ἀναβάντες ἀναβησόμεθα καὶ κατακληρονομήσομεν αὐτήν ὅτι δυνατοὶ δυνησόμεθα πρὸς αὐτούς

text_en: But the others, that had been with him, said: No, we are not able to go up to this people, because they are stronger than we.
text_la: Alii vero, qui fuerant cum eo, dicebant : Nequaquam ad hunc populum valemus ascendere, quia fortior nobis est.
text_pt: E infamaram a terra que tinham espiado, dizendo aos filhos de Israel: A terra, pela qual passamos a espiá-la, é terra que consome os seus moradores; e todo o povo que vimos nela são homens de grande estatura.
text_el: καὶ οἱ ἄνθρωποι οἱ συναναβάντες μετ' αὐτοῦ εἶπαν οὐκ ἀναβαίνομεν ὅτι οὐ μὴ δυνώμεθα ἀναβῆναι πρὸς τὸ ἔθνος ὅτι ἰσχυρότερόν ἐστιν ἡμῶν μᾶλλον

text_en: And they spoke ill of the land, which they had viewed, before the children of Israel , saying: The land which we have viewed, devours its inhabitants: the people, that we beheld are of a tall stature.
text_la: Detraxeruntque terræ, quam inspexerant, apud filios Israël, dicentes : Terra, quam lustravimus, devorat habitatores suos : populus, quem aspeximus, proceræ staturæ est.
text_pt: Também vimos ali gigantes, filhos de Anaque, descendentes dos gigantes; e éramos aos nossos olhos como gafanhotos, e assim também éramos aos seus olhos.
text_el: καὶ ἐξήνεγκαν ἔκστασιν τῆς γῆς ἣν κατεσκέψαντο αὐτήν πρὸς τοὺς υἱοὺς Ισραηλ λέγοντες τὴν γῆν ἣν παρήλθομεν αὐτὴν κατασκέψασθαι γῆ κατέσθουσα τοὺς κατοικοῦντας ἐπ' αὐτῆς ἐστιν πᾶς ὁ λαός ὃν ἑωράκαμεν ἐν αὐτῇ ἄνδρες ὑπερμήκεις

text_en: There we saw certain monsters of the sons of Enac, of the giant kind: in comparison of whom, we seemed like locusts.
text_la: Ibi vidimus monstra quædam filiorum Enac de genere giganteo : quibus comparati, quasi locustæ videbamur.
text_el: καὶ ἐκεῖ ἑωράκαμεν τοὺς γίγαντας καὶ ἦμεν ἐνώπιον αὐτῶν ὡσεὶ ἀκρίδες ἀλλὰ καὶ οὕτως ἦμεν ἐνώπιον αὐτῶν

text_en: Therefore the whole multitude crying wept that night.
text_la: Igitur vociferans omnis turba flevit nocte illa,
text_pt: Então toda a congregação levantou a sua voz; e o povo chorou naquela noite.
text_el: καὶ ἀναλαβοῦσα πᾶσα ἡ συναγωγὴ ἔδωκεν φωνήν καὶ ἔκλαιεν ὁ λαὸς ὅλην τὴν νύκτα ἐκείνην

text_en: And all the children of Israel murmured against Moses and Aaron , saying:
text_la: et murmurati sunt contra Moysen et Aaron cuncti filii Israël, dicentes:
text_pt: E todos os filhos de Israel murmuraram contra Moisés e contra Arão; e toda a congregação lhes disse: Quem dera tivéssemos morrido na terra do Egito! ou, mesmo neste deserto!
text_el: καὶ διεγόγγυζον ἐπὶ Μωυσῆν καὶ Ααρων πάντες οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ καὶ εἶπαν πρὸς αὐτοὺς πᾶσα ἡ συναγωγή ὄφελον ἀπεθάνομεν ἐν γῇ Αἰγύπτῳ ἢ ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ ταύτῃ εἰ ἀπεθάνομεν

text_en: Would God that we had died in Egypt : and would God we may die in this vast wilderness , and that the Lord may not bring us into this land, lest we fall by the sword, and our wives and children be led away captives . Is it not better to return into Egypt ?
text_la: Utinam mortui essemus in Ægypto : et in hac vasta solitudine utinam pereamus, et non inducat nos Dominus in terram istam, ne cadamus gladio, et uxores ac liberi nostri ducantur captivi. Nonne melius est reverti in Ægyptum?
text_pt: E por que o Senhor nos traz a esta terra, para cairmos à espada, e para que nossas mulheres e nossas crianças sejam por presa? Não nos seria melhor voltarmos ao Egito?
text_el: καὶ ἵνα τί κύριος εἰσάγει ἡμᾶς εἰς τὴν γῆν ταύτην πεσεῖν ἐν πολέμῳ αἱ γυναῖκες ἡμῶν καὶ τὰ παιδία ἔσονται εἰς διαρπαγήν νῦν οὖν βέλτιον ἡμῖν ἐστιν ἀποστραφῆναι εἰς Αἴγυπτον

text_en: And they said one to another: Let us appoint a captain , and let us return into Egypt .
text_la: Dixeruntque alter ad alterum : Constituamus nobis ducem, et revertamur in Ægyptum.
text_pt: E diziam uns aos outros: Constituamos um líder, e voltemos ao Egito.
text_el: καὶ εἶπαν ἕτερος τῷ ἑτέρῳ δῶμεν ἀρχηγὸν καὶ ἀποστρέψωμεν εἰς Αἴγυπτον

text_en: And when Moses and Aaron heard this, they fell down flat upon the ground before the multitude of the children of Israel .
text_la: Quo audito, Moyses et Aaron ceciderunt proni in terram coram omni multitudine filiorum Israël.
text_pt: Então Moisés e Arão caíram sobre os seus rostos perante toda a congregação dos filhos de Israel.
text_el: καὶ ἔπεσεν Μωυσῆς καὶ Ααρων ἐπὶ πρόσωπον ἐναντίον πάσης συναγωγῆς υἱῶν Ισραηλ

text_en: But Joshua the son of Nun , and Caleb the son of Jephone , who themselves also had viewed the land, rent their garments,
text_la: At vero Josue filius Nun et Caleb filius Jephone, qui et ipsi lustraverant terram, sciderunt vestimenta sua,
text_pt: E Josué, filho de Num, e Calebe filho de Jefoné, dos que espiaram a terra, rasgaram as suas vestes.
text_el: Ἰησοῦς δὲ ὁ τοῦ Ναυη καὶ Χαλεβ ὁ τοῦ Ιεφοννη τῶν κατασκεψαμένων τὴν γῆν διέρρηξαν τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτῶν

text_en: and said to all the multitude of the children of Israel : The land which we have gone round is very good :
text_la: et ad omnem multitudinem filiorum Israël locuti sunt : Terra, quam circuivimus, valde bona est.
text_pt: E falaram a toda a congregação dos filhos de Israel, dizendo: A terra pela qual passamos a espiar é terra muito boa.
text_el: καὶ εἶπαν πρὸς πᾶσαν συναγωγὴν υἱῶν Ισραηλ λέγοντες ἡ γῆ ἣν κατεσκεψάμεθα αὐτήν ἀγαθή ἐστιν σφόδρα σφόδρα

text_en: If the Lord be favourable, he will bring us into it, and give us a land flowing with milk and honey.
text_la: Si propitius fuerit Dominus, inducet nos in eam, et tradet humum lacte et melle manantem.
text_pt: Se o Senhor se agradar de nós, então nos porá nesta terra, e no-la dará; terra que mana leite e mel.
text_el: εἰ αἱρετίζει ἡμᾶς κύριος εἰσάξει ἡμᾶς εἰς τὴν γῆν ταύτην καὶ δώσει αὐτὴν ἡμῖν γῆ ἥτις ἐστὶν ῥέουσα γάλα καὶ μέλι

text_en: Be not rebellious against the Lord : and fear not the people of this land, for we are able to eat them up as bread. All aid has gone from them: the Lord is with us, fear not.
text_la: Nolite rebelles esse contra Dominum : neque timeatis populum terræ hujus, quia sicut panem ita eos possumus devorare. Recessit ab eis omne præsidium : Dominus nobiscum est, nolite metuere.
text_pt: Tão-somente não sejais rebeldes contra o Senhor, e não temais o povo dessa terra, porquanto são eles nosso pão; retirou-se deles o seu amparo, e o Senhor é conosco; não os temais.
text_el: ἀλλὰ ἀπὸ τοῦ κυρίου μὴ ἀποστάται γίνεσθε ὑμεῖς δὲ μὴ φοβηθῆτε τὸν λαὸν τῆς γῆς ὅτι κατάβρωμα ἡμῖν ἐστιν ἀφέστηκεν γὰρ ὁ καιρὸς ἀπ' αὐτῶν ὁ δὲ κύριος ἐν ἡμῖν μὴ φοβηθῆτε αὐτούς

text_en: And when all the multitude cried out, and would have stoned them, the glory of the Lord appeared over the tabernacle of the covenant to all the children of Israel .
text_la: Cumque clamaret omnis multitudo, et lapidibus eos vellet opprimere, apparuit gloria Domini super tectum fœderis cunctis filiis Israël.
text_pt: Mas toda a congregação disse que os apedrejassem; porém a glória do Senhor apareceu na tenda da congregação a todos os filhos de Israel.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πᾶσα ἡ συναγωγὴ καταλιθοβολῆσαι αὐτοὺς ἐν λίθοις καὶ ἡ δόξα κυρίου ὤφθη ἐν νεφέλῃ ἐπὶ τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου ἐν πᾶσι τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ

text_en: And the Lord said to Moses : How long will this people detract me? How long will they not believe me for all the signs that I have wrought before them?
text_la: Et dixit Dominus ad Moysen : Usquequo detrahet mihi populus iste? quousque non credent mihi, in omnibus signis quæ feci coram eis?
text_pt: E disse o Senhor a Moisés: Até quando me provocará este povo? e até quando não crerá em mim, apesar de todos os sinais que fiz no meio dele?
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν ἕως τίνος παροξύνει με ὁ λαὸς οὗτος καὶ ἕως τίνος οὐ πιστεύουσίν μοι ἐν πᾶσιν τοῖς σημείοις οἷς ἐποίησα ἐν αὐτοῖς

text_en: I will strike them therefore with pestilence, and will consume them: but you I will make a ruler over a great nation, and a mightier than this is.
text_la: Feriam igitur eos pestilentia, atque consumam : te autem faciam principem super gentem magnam, et fortiorem quam hæc est.
text_pt: Com pestilência o ferirei, e o rejeitarei; e te farei a ti povo maior e mais forte do que este.
text_el: πατάξω αὐτοὺς θανάτῳ καὶ ἀπολῶ αὐτοὺς καὶ ποιήσω σὲ καὶ τὸν οἶκον τοῦ πατρός σου εἰς ἔθνος μέγα καὶ πολὺ μᾶλλον ἢ τοῦτο

text_en: And Moses said to the Lord : That the Egyptians , from the midst of whom you have brought forth this people,
text_la: Et ait Moyses ad Dominum : Ut audiant Ægyptii, de quorum medio eduxisti populum istum,
text_pt: E disse Moisés ao Senhor: Assim os egípcios o ouvirão; porquanto com a tua força fizeste subir este povo do meio deles.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Μωυσῆς πρὸς κύριον καὶ ἀκούσεται Αἴγυπτος ὅτι ἀνήγαγες τῇ ἰσχύι σου τὸν λαὸν τοῦτον ἐξ αὐτῶν

text_en: and the inhabitants of this land, (who have heard that you, O Lord , are among this people, and are seen face to face, and your cloud protects them, and you go before them in a pillar of a cloud by day, and in a pillar of fire by night),
text_la: et habitatores terræ hujus, qui audierunt quod tu, Domine, in populo isto sis, et facie videaris ad faciem, et nubes tua protegat illos, et in columna nubis præcedas eos per diem, et in columna ignis per noctem:
text_pt: E dirão aos moradores desta terra, os quais ouviram que tu, ó Senhor, estás no meio deste povo, que face a face, ó Senhor, lhes apareces, que tua nuvem está sobre ele e que vais adiante dele numa coluna de nuvem de dia, e numa coluna de fogo de noite.
text_el: ἀλλὰ καὶ πάντες οἱ κατοικοῦντες ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ταύτης ἀκηκόασιν ὅτι σὺ εἶ κύριος ἐν τῷ λαῷ τούτῳ ὅστις ὀφθαλμοῖς κατ' ὀφθαλμοὺς ὀπτάζῃ κύριε καὶ ἡ νεφέλη σου ἐφέστηκεν ἐπ' αὐτῶν καὶ ἐν στύλῳ νεφέλης σὺ πορεύῃ πρότερος αὐτῶν τὴν ἡμέραν καὶ ἐν στύλῳ πυρὸς τὴν νύκτα

text_en: may hear that you have killed so great a multitude as it were one man and may say:
text_la: quod occideris tantam multitudinem quasi unum hominem, et dicant:
text_pt: E se matares este povo como a um só homem, então as nações, que antes ouviram a tua fama, falarão, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐκτρίψεις τὸν λαὸν τοῦτον ὡσεὶ ἄνθρωπον ἕνα καὶ ἐροῦσιν τὰ ἔθνη ὅσοι ἀκηκόασιν τὸ ὄνομά σου λέγοντες

text_en: He could not bring the people into the land for which he had sworn, therefore did he kill them in the wilderness .
text_la: Non poterat introducere populum in terram pro qua juraverat : idcirco occidit eos in solitudine?
text_pt: Porquanto o Senhor não podia pôr este povo na terra que lhe tinha jurado; por isso os matou no deserto.
text_el: παρὰ τὸ μὴ δύνασθαι κύριον εἰσαγαγεῖν τὸν λαὸν τοῦτον εἰς τὴν γῆν ἣν ὤμοσεν αὐτοῖς κατέστρωσεν αὐτοὺς ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ

text_en: Let then the strength of the Lord be magnified, as you have sworn, saying:
text_la: Magnificetur ergo fortitudo Domini sicut jurasti, dicens:
text_pt: Agora, pois, rogo-te que a força do meu Senhor se engrandeça; como tens falado, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ νῦν ὑψωθήτω ἡ ἰσχύς σου κύριε ὃν τρόπον εἶπας λέγων

text_en: The Lord is patient and full of mercy, by taking away iniquity and wickedness , and leaving no man clear, who visits the sins of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation .
text_la: Dominus patiens et multæ misericordiæ, auferens iniquitatem et scelera, nullumque innoxium derelinquens, qui visitas peccata patrum in filios in tertiam et quartam generationem.
text_pt: O Senhor é longânimo, e grande em misericórdia, que perdoa a iniqüidade e a transgressão, que o culpado não tem por inocente, e visita a iniqüidade dos pais sobre os filhos até a terceira e quarta geração.
