text_el: κύριος μακρόθυμος καὶ πολυέλεος καὶ ἀληθινός ἀφαιρῶν ἀνομίας καὶ ἀδικίας καὶ ἁμαρτίας καὶ καθαρισμῷ οὐ καθαριεῖ τὸν ἔνοχον ἀποδιδοὺς ἁμαρτίας πατέρων ἐπὶ τέκνα ἕως τρίτης καὶ τετάρτης

text_en: Forgive, I beseech you, the sins of this people, according to the greatness of your mercy, as you have been merciful to them from their going out of Egypt unto this place.
text_la: Dimitte, obsecro, peccatum populi hujus secundum magnitudinem misericordiæ tuæ, sicut propitius fuisti egredientibus de Ægypto usque ad locum istum.
text_pt: Perdoa, pois, a iniqüidade deste povo, segundo a grandeza da tua misericórdia; e como também perdoaste a este povo desde a terra do Egito até aqui.
text_el: ἄφες τὴν ἁμαρτίαν τῷ λαῷ τούτῳ κατὰ τὸ μέγα ἔλεός σου καθάπερ ἵλεως αὐτοῖς ἐγένου ἀπ' Αἰγύπτου ἕως τοῦ νῦν

text_en: And the Lord said: I have forgiven according to your word.
text_la: Dixitque Dominus : Dimisi juxta verbum tuum.
text_pt: E disse o Senhor: Conforme à tua palavra lhe perdoei.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν ἵλεως αὐτοῖς εἰμι κατὰ τὸ ῥῆμά σου

text_en: As I live: and the whole earth shall be filled with the glory of the Lord .
text_la: Vivo ego : et implebitur gloria Domini universa terra.
text_pt: Porém, tão certamente como eu vivo, e como a glória do Senhor encherá toda a terra,
text_el: ἀλλὰ ζῶ ἐγὼ καὶ ζῶν τὸ ὄνομά μου καὶ ἐμπλήσει ἡ δόξα κυρίου πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν

text_en: But yet all the men that have seen my majesty, and the signs that I have done in Egypt , and in the wilderness , and have tempted me now ten times, and have not obeyed my voice,
text_la: Attamen omnes homines qui viderunt majestatem meam, et signa quæ feci in Ægypto et in solitudine, et tentaverunt me jam per decem vices, nec obedierunt voci meæ,
text_pt: E que todos os homens que viram a minha glória e os meus sinais, que fiz no Egito e no deserto, e me tentaram estas dez vezes, e não obedeceram à minha voz,
text_el: ὅτι πάντες οἱ ἄνδρες οἱ ὁρῶντες τὴν δόξαν μου καὶ τὰ σημεῖα ἃ ἐποίησα ἐν Αἰγύπτῳ καὶ ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ ταύτῃ καὶ ἐπείρασάν με τοῦτο δέκατον καὶ οὐκ εἰσήκουσάν μου τῆς φωνῆς

text_en: shall not see the land for which I swore to their fathers, neither shall any one of them that has detracted me behold it.
text_la: non videbunt terram pro qua juravi patribus eorum, nec quisquam ex illis qui detraxit mihi, intuebitur eam.
text_pt: Não verão a terra de que a seus pais jurei, e nenhum daqueles que me provocaram a verá.
text_el: ἦ μὴν οὐκ ὄψονται τὴν γῆν ἣν ὤμοσα τοῖς πατράσιν αὐτῶν ἀλλ' ἢ τὰ τέκνα αὐτῶν ἅ ἐστιν μετ' ἐμοῦ ὧδε ὅσοι οὐκ οἴδασιν ἀγαθὸν οὐδὲ κακόν πᾶς νεώτερος ἄπειρος τούτοις δώσω τὴν γῆν πάντες δὲ οἱ παροξύναντές με οὐκ ὄψονται αὐτήν

text_en: My servant Caleb , who being full of another spirit has followed me, I will bring into this land which he has gone round: and his seed shall possess it.
text_la: Servum meum Caleb, qui plenus alio spiritu secutus est me, inducam in terram hanc, quam circuivit; et semen ejus possidebit eam.
text_pt: Porém o meu servo Calebe, porquanto nele houve outro espírito, e perseverou em seguir-me, eu o levarei à terra em que entrou, e a sua descendência a possuirá em herança.
text_el: ὁ δὲ παῖς μου Χαλεβ ὅτι ἐγενήθη πνεῦμα ἕτερον ἐν αὐτῷ καὶ ἐπηκολούθησέν μοι εἰσάξω αὐτὸν εἰς τὴν γῆν εἰς ἣν εἰσῆλθεν ἐκεῖ καὶ τὸ σπέρμα αὐτοῦ κληρονομήσει αὐτήν

text_en: For the Amalecite and the Chanaanite dwell in the valleys. Tomorrow remove the camp, and return into the wilderness by the way of the Red Sea .
text_la: Quoniam Amalecites et Chananæus habitant in vallibus. Cras movete castra, et revertimini in solitudinem per viam maris Rubri.
text_pt: Ora, os amalequitas e os cananeus habitam no vale; tornai-vos amanhã e caminhai para o deserto pelo caminho do Mar Vermelho.
text_el: ὁ δὲ Αμαληκ καὶ ὁ Χαναναῖος κατοικοῦσιν ἐν τῇ κοιλάδι αὔριον ἐπιστράφητε ὑμεῖς καὶ ἀπάρατε εἰς τὴν ἔρημον ὁδὸν θάλασσαν ἐρυθράν

text_en: And the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron , saying:
text_la: Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen et Aaron, dicens:
text_pt: Depois falou o Senhor a Moisés e a Arão dizendo:
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν καὶ Ααρων λέγων

text_en: How long does this wicked multitude murmur against me? I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel .
text_la: Usquequo multitudo hæc pessima murmurat contra me? querelas filiorum Israël audivi.
text_pt: Até quando sofrerei esta má congregação, que murmura contra mim? Tenho ouvido as murmurações dos filhos de Israel, com que murmuram contra mim.
text_el: ἕως τίνος τὴν συναγωγὴν τὴν πονηρὰν ταύτην ἃ αὐτοὶ γογγύζουσιν ἐναντίον ἐμοῦ τὴν γόγγυσιν τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ ἣν ἐγόγγυσαν περὶ ὑμῶν ἀκήκοα

text_en: Say therefore to them: As I live, says the Lord : According as you have spoken in my hearing, so will I do to you.
text_la: Dic ergo eis : Vivo ego, ait Dominus : sicut locuti estis audiente me, sic faciam vobis.
text_pt: Dize-lhes: Vivo eu, diz o Senhor, que, como falastes aos meus ouvidos, assim farei a vós outros.
text_el: εἰπὸν αὐτοῖς ζῶ ἐγώ λέγει κύριος ἦ μὴν ὃν τρόπον λελαλήκατε εἰς τὰ ὦτά μου οὕτως ποιήσω ὑμῖν

text_en: In the wilderness shall your carcasses lie. All you that were numbered from twenty years old and upward, and have murmured against me,
text_la: In solitudine hac jacebunt cadavera vestra. Omnes qui numerati estis a viginti annis et supra, et murmurastis contra me,
text_pt: Neste deserto cairão os vossos cadáveres, como também todos os que de vós foram contados segundo toda a vossa conta, de vinte anos para cima, os que dentre vós contra mim murmurastes;
text_el: ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ ταύτῃ πεσεῖται τὰ κῶλα ὑμῶν καὶ πᾶσα ἡ ἐπισκοπὴ ὑμῶν καὶ οἱ κατηριθμημένοι ὑμῶν ἀπὸ εἰκοσαετοῦς καὶ ἐπάνω ὅσοι ἐγόγγυσαν ἐπ' ἐμοί

text_en: shall not enter into the land, over which I lifted up my hand to make you dwell therein, except Caleb the son of Jephone , and Joshua the son of Nun .
text_la: non intrabitis terram, super quam levavi manum meam ut habitare vos facerem, præter Caleb filium Jephone, et Josue filium Nun.
text_pt: Não entrareis na terra, pela qual levantei a minha mão que vos faria habitar nela, salvo Calebe, filho de Jefoné, e Josué, filho de Num.
text_el: εἰ ὑμεῖς εἰσελεύσεσθε εἰς τὴν γῆν ἐφ' ἣν ἐξέτεινα τὴν χεῖρά μου κατασκηνῶσαι ὑμᾶς ἐπ' αὐτῆς ἀλλ' ἢ Χαλεβ υἱὸς Ιεφοννη καὶ Ἰησοῦς ὁ τοῦ Ναυη

text_en: But your children, of whom you said, that they should be a prey to the enemies, will I bring in: that they may see the land which you have despised .
text_la: Parvulos autem vestros, de quibus dixistis quod prædæ hostibus forent, introducam, ut videant terram, quæ vobis displicuit.
text_pt: Mas os vossos filhos, de que dizeis: Por presa serão, porei nela; e eles conhecerão a terra que vós desprezastes.
text_el: καὶ τὰ παιδία ἃ εἴπατε ἐν διαρπαγῇ ἔσεσθαι εἰσάξω αὐτοὺς εἰς τὴν γῆν καὶ κληρονομήσουσιν τὴν γῆν ἣν ὑμεῖς ἀπέστητε ἀπ' αὐτῆς

text_en: Your carcasses shall lie in the wilderness .
text_la: Vestra cadavera jacebunt in solitudine.
text_pt: Porém, quanto a vós, os vossos cadáveres cairão neste deserto.
text_el: καὶ τὰ κῶλα ὑμῶν πεσεῖται ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ ταύτῃ

text_en: Your children shall wander in the desert forty years, and shall bear your fornication, until the carcasses of their fathers be consumed in the desert ,
text_la: Filii vestri erunt vagi in deserto annis quadraginta, et portabunt fornicationem vestram, donec consumantur cadavera patrum in deserto,
text_pt: E vossos filhos pastorearão neste deserto quarenta anos, e levarão sobre si as vossas infidelidades, até que os vossos cadáveres se consumam neste deserto.
text_el: οἱ δὲ υἱοὶ ὑμῶν ἔσονται νεμόμενοι ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ τεσσαράκοντα ἔτη καὶ ἀνοίσουσιν τὴν πορνείαν ὑμῶν ἕως ἂν ἀναλωθῇ τὰ κῶλα ὑμῶν ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ

text_en: according to the number of the forty days, wherein you viewed the land: a year shall be counted for a day. And forty years you shall receive your iniquities , and shall know my revenge:
text_la: juxta numerum quadraginta dierum, quibus considerastis terram : annus pro die imputabitur. Et quadraginta annis recipietis iniquitates vestras, et scietis ultionem meam:
text_pt: Segundo o número dos dias em que espiastes esta terra, quarenta dias, cada dia representando um ano, levareis sobre vós as vossas iniqüidades quarenta anos, e conhecereis o meu afastamento.
text_el: κατὰ τὸν ἀριθμὸν τῶν ἡμερῶν ὅσας κατεσκέψασθε τὴν γῆν τεσσαράκοντα ἡμέρας ἡμέραν τοῦ ἐνιαυτοῦ λήμψεσθε τὰς ἁμαρτίας ὑμῶν τεσσαράκοντα ἔτη καὶ γνώσεσθε τὸν θυμὸν τῆς ὀργῆς μου

text_en: For as I have spoken, so will I do to all this wicked multitude, that has risen up together against me: in this wilderness shall it faint away and die.
text_la: quoniam sicut locutus sum, ita faciam omni multitudini huic pessimæ, quæ consurrexit adversum me : in solitudine hac deficiet, et morietur.
text_pt: Eu, o Senhor, falei; assim farei a toda esta má congregação, que se levantou contra mim; neste deserto se consumirão, e aí falecerão.
text_el: ἐγὼ κύριος ἐλάλησα ἦ μὴν οὕτως ποιήσω τῇ συναγωγῇ τῇ πονηρᾷ ταύτῃ τῇ ἐπισυνεσταμένῃ ἐπ' ἐμέ ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ ταύτῃ ἐξαναλωθήσονται καὶ ἐκεῖ ἀποθανοῦνται

text_en: Therefore all the men , whom Moses had sent to view the land, and who at their return had made the whole multitude to murmur against him, speaking ill of the land that it was naught,
text_la: Igitur omnes viri, quos miserat Moyses ad contemplandam terram, et qui reversi murmurare fecerant contra eum omnem multitudinem, detrahentes terræ quod esset mala,
text_pt: E os homens que Moisés mandara a espiar a terra, e que, voltando, fizeram murmurar toda a congregação contra ele, infamando a terra,
text_el: καὶ οἱ ἄνθρωποι οὓς ἀπέστειλεν Μωυσῆς κατασκέψασθαι τὴν γῆν καὶ παραγενηθέντες διεγόγγυσαν κατ' αὐτῆς πρὸς τὴν συναγωγὴν ἐξενέγκαι ῥήματα πονηρὰ περὶ τῆς γῆς

text_en: died and were struck in the sight of the Lord .
text_la: mortui sunt atque percussi in conspectu Domini.
text_pt: Aqueles mesmos homens que infamaram a terra, morreram de praga perante o Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέθανον οἱ ἄνθρωποι οἱ κατείπαντες κατὰ τῆς γῆς πονηρὰ ἐν τῇ πληγῇ ἔναντι κυρίου

text_en: But Joshua the son of Nun , and Caleb had gone to view the land.
text_la: Josue autem filius Nun, et Caleb filius Jephone, vixerunt ex omnibus qui perrexerant ad considerandam terram.
text_pt: Mas Josué, filho de Num, e Calebe, filho de Jefoné, que eram dos homens que foram espiar a terra, ficaram com vida.
text_el: καὶ Ἰησοῦς υἱὸς Ναυη καὶ Χαλεβ υἱὸς Ιεφοννη ἔζησαν ἀπὸ τῶν ἀνθρώπων ἐκείνων τῶν πεπορευμένων κατασκέψασθαι τὴν γῆν

text_en: And Moses spoke all these words to all the children of Israel , and the people mourned exceedingly.
text_la: Locutusque est Moyses universa verba hæc ad omnes filios Israël, et luxit populus nimis.
text_pt: E falou Moisés estas palavras a todos os filhos de Israel; então o povo se contristou muito.
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν Μωυσῆς τὰ ῥήματα ταῦτα πρὸς πάντας υἱοὺς Ισραηλ καὶ ἐπένθησεν ὁ λαὸς σφόδρα

text_en: And behold rising up very early in the morning, they went up to the top of the mountain, and said: We are ready to go up to the place, of which the Lord has spoken: for we have sinned .
text_la: Et ecce mane primo surgentes ascenderunt verticem montis, atque dixerunt : Parati sumus ascendere ad locum, de quo Dominus locutus est : quia peccavimus.
text_pt: E levantaram-se pela manhã de madrugada, e subiram ao cume do monte, dizendo: Eis-nos aqui, e subiremos ao lugar que o Senhor tem falado; porquanto havemos pecado.
text_el: καὶ ὀρθρίσαντες τὸ πρωὶ ἀνέβησαν εἰς τὴν κορυφὴν τοῦ ὄρους λέγοντες ἰδοὺ οἵδε ἡμεῖς ἀναβησόμεθα εἰς τὸν τόπον ὃν εἶπεν κύριος ὅτι ἡμάρτομεν

text_en: And Moses said to them: Why transgress you the word of the Lord , which shall not succeed prosperously with you?
text_la: Quibus Moyses : Cur, inquit, transgredimini verbum Domini, quod vobis non cedet in prosperum?
text_pt: Mas Moisés disse: Por que transgredis o mandado do Senhor? Pois isso não prosperará.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Μωυσῆς ἵνα τί ὑμεῖς παραβαίνετε τὸ ῥῆμα κυρίου οὐκ εὔοδα ἔσται ὑμῖν

text_en: Go not up, for the Lord is not with you: lest you fall before your enemies.
text_la: nolite ascendere : non enim est Dominus vobiscum : ne corruatis coram inimicis vestris.
text_pt: Não subais, pois o Senhor não estará no meio de vós, para que não sejais feridos diante dos vossos inimigos.
text_el: μὴ ἀναβαίνετε οὐ γάρ ἐστιν κύριος μεθ' ὑμῶν καὶ πεσεῖσθε πρὸ προσώπου τῶν ἐχθρῶν ὑμῶν

text_en: The Amalecite and the Chanaanite are before you, and by their sword you shall fall, because you would not consent to the Lord , neither will the Lord be with you.
text_la: Amalecites et Chananæus ante vos sunt, quorum gladio corruetis, eo quod nolueritis acquiescere Domino : nec erit Dominus vobiscum.
text_pt: Porque os amalequitas e os cananeus estão ali diante da vossa face, e caireis à espada; pois, porquanto vos desviastes do Senhor, o Senhor não estará convosco.
text_el: ὅτι ὁ Αμαληκ καὶ ὁ Χαναναῖος ἐκεῖ ἔμπροσθεν ὑμῶν καὶ πεσεῖσθε μαχαίρᾳ οὗ εἵνεκεν ἀπεστράφητε ἀπειθοῦντες κυρίῳ καὶ οὐκ ἔσται κύριος ἐν ὑμῖν

text_en: But they being blinded went up to the top of the mountain. But the ark of the testament of the Lord and Moses departed not from the camp.
text_la: At illi contenebrati ascenderunt in verticem montis. Arca autem testamenti Domini et Moyses non recesserunt de castris.
text_pt: Contudo, temerariamente, tentaram subir ao cume do monte; mas a arca da aliança do Senhor e Moisés não se apartaram do meio do arraial.
text_el: καὶ διαβιασάμενοι ἀνέβησαν ἐπὶ τὴν κορυφὴν τοῦ ὄρους ἡ δὲ κιβωτὸς τῆς διαθήκης κυρίου καὶ Μωυσῆς οὐκ ἐκινήθησαν ἐκ τῆς παρεμβολῆς

text_en: And the Amalecite came down, and the Chanaanite that dwelt in the mountain: and smiting and slaying them pursued them as far as Horma.
text_la: Descenditque Amalecites et Chananæus, qui habitabat in monte : et percutiens eos atque concidens, persecutus est eos usque Horma.
text_pt: Então desceram os amalequitas e os cananeus, que habitavam na montanha, e os feriram, derrotando-os até Hormá.
text_el: καὶ κατέβη ὁ Αμαληκ καὶ ὁ Χαναναῖος ὁ ἐγκαθήμενος ἐν τῷ ὄρει ἐκείνῳ καὶ ἐτρέψαντο αὐτοὺς καὶ κατέκοψαν αὐτοὺς ἕως Ερμαν καὶ ἀπεστράφησαν εἰς τὴν παρεμβολήν

text_en: And the Lord spoke to Moses , saying:
text_la: Locutus est Dominus ad Moysen, dicens:
text_pt: Depois falou o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν λέγων

text_en: Speak to the children of Israel and you shall say to them: When you shall be come unto the land of your habitation, which I will give you,
text_la: Loquere ad filios Israël, et dices ad eos : Cum ingressi fueritis terram habitationis vestræ, quam ego dabo vobis,
text_pt: Fala aos filhos de Israel, e dize-lhes: Quando entrardes na terra das vossas habitações, que eu vos hei de dar,
text_el: λάλησον τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ καὶ ἐρεῖς πρὸς αὐτούς ὅταν εἰσέλθητε εἰς τὴν γῆν τῆς κατοικήσεως ὑμῶν ἣν ἐγὼ δίδωμι ὑμῖν

text_en: and shall make an offering to the Lord , for a holocaust , or a victim, paying your vows , or voluntarily offering gifts, or in your solemnities burning a sweet savour unto the Lord , of oxen or of sheep:
text_la: et feceritis oblationem Domino in holocaustum, aut victimam, vota solventes, vel sponte offerentes munera, aut in solemnitatibus vestris adolentes odorem suavitatis Domino, de bobus sive de ovibus:
text_pt: E ao Senhor fizerdes oferta queimada, holocausto, ou sacrifício, para cumprir um voto, ou em oferta voluntária, ou nas vossas solenidades, para fazerdes ao Senhor um cheiro suave de ovelhas ou gado,
text_el: καὶ ποιήσεις ὁλοκαυτώματα κυρίῳ ὁλοκάρπωμα ἢ θυσίαν μεγαλῦναι εὐχὴν ἢ καθ' ἑκούσιον ἢ ἐν ταῖς ἑορταῖς ὑμῶν ποιῆσαι ὀσμὴν εὐωδίας κυρίῳ εἰ μὲν ἀπὸ τῶν βοῶν ἢ ἀπὸ τῶν προβάτων

text_en: Whosoever immolates the victim, shall offer a sacrifice of fine flour, the tenth part of an ephi, tempered with the fourth part of a hin of oil:
text_la: offeret quicumque immolaverit victimam, sacrificium similæ, decimam partem ephi, conspersæ oleo, quod mensuram habebit quartam partem hin:
text_pt: Então aquele que apresentar a sua oferta ao Senhor, por oferta de alimentos trará uma décima de flor de farinha misturada com a quarta parte de um him de azeite.
text_el: καὶ προσοίσει ὁ προσφέρων τὸ δῶρον αὐτοῦ κυρίῳ θυσίαν σεμιδάλεως δέκατον τοῦ οιφι ἀναπεποιημένης ἐν ἐλαίῳ ἐν τετάρτῳ τοῦ ιν

text_en: And he shall give the same measure of wine to pour out in libations for the holocaust or for the victim. For every lamb,
text_la: et vinum ad liba fundenda ejusdem mensuræ dabit in holocaustum sive in victimam. Per agnos singulos
text_pt: E de vinho para libação prepararás a quarta parte de um him, para holocausto, ou para sacrifício para cada cordeiro;
text_el: καὶ οἶνον εἰς σπονδὴν τὸ τέταρτον τοῦ ιν ποιήσετε ἐπὶ τῆς ὁλοκαυτώσεως ἢ ἐπὶ τῆς θυσίας τῷ ἀμνῷ τῷ ἑνὶ ποιήσεις τοσοῦτο κάρπωμα ὀσμὴν εὐωδίας τῷ κυρίῳ

text_en: and for every ram there shall be a sacrifice of flour of two tenths, which shall be tempered with the third part of a hin of oil:
text_la: et arietes erit sacrificium similæ duarum decimarum, quæ conspersa sit oleo tertiæ partis hin:
text_pt: E para cada carneiro prepararás uma oferta de alimentos de duas décimas de flor de farinha, misturada com a terça parte de um him de azeite.
text_el: καὶ τῷ κριῷ ὅταν ποιῆτε αὐτὸν ἢ εἰς ὁλοκαύτωμα ἢ εἰς θυσίαν ποιήσεις θυσίαν σεμιδάλεως δύο δέκατα ἀναπεποιημένης ἐν ἐλαίῳ τὸ τρίτον τοῦ ιν

text_en: And he shall offer the third part the same measure of wine for the libation, for a sweet savour to the Lord .
text_la: et vinum ad libamentum tertiæ partis ejusdem mensuræ offeret in odorem suavitatis Domino.
text_pt: E de vinho para a libação oferecerás a terça parte de um him ao Senhor, em cheiro suave.
text_el: καὶ οἶνον εἰς σπονδὴν τὸ τρίτον τοῦ ιν προσοίσετε εἰς ὀσμὴν εὐωδίας κυρίῳ

text_en: But when you offer a holocaust or sacrifice of oxen, to fulfil your vow or for victims of peace offerings ,
text_la: Quando vero de bobus feceris holocaustum aut hostiam, ut impleas votum vel pacificas victimas,
text_pt: E, quando preparares novilho para holocausto ou sacrifício, para cumprir um voto, ou um sacrifício pacífico ao Senhor,
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ ἀπὸ τῶν βοῶν ποιῆτε εἰς ὁλοκαύτωμα ἢ εἰς θυσίαν μεγαλῦναι εὐχὴν ἢ εἰς σωτήριον κυρίῳ

text_en: you shall give for every ox three tenths of flour tempered with half a hin of oil,
text_la: dabis per singulos boves similæ tres decimas conspersæ oleo, quod habeat medium mensuræ hin:
text_pt: Com o novilho apresentarás uma oferta de alimentos de três décimas de flor de farinha misturada com a metade de um him de azeite.
text_el: καὶ προσοίσει ἐπὶ τοῦ μόσχου θυσίαν σεμιδάλεως τρία δέκατα ἀναπεποιημένης ἐν ἐλαίῳ ἥμισυ τοῦ ιν

text_en: and wine for libations of the same measure, for an offering of most sweet savour to the Lord .
text_la: et vinum ad liba fundenda ejusdem mensuræ in oblationem suavissimi odoris Domino.
text_pt: E de vinho para a libação oferecerás a metade de um him, oferta queimada em cheiro suave ao Senhor.
text_el: καὶ οἶνον εἰς σπονδὴν τὸ ἥμισυ τοῦ ιν κάρπωμα ὀσμὴν εὐωδίας κυρίῳ

text_en: Thus shall you do
text_la: Sic facies
text_pt: Assim se fará com cada boi, ou com cada carneiro, ou com cada um dos cordeiros ou cabritos.
text_el: οὕτως ποιήσεις τῷ μόσχῳ τῷ ἑνὶ ἢ τῷ κριῷ τῷ ἑνὶ ἢ τῷ ἀμνῷ τῷ ἑνὶ ἐκ τῶν προβάτων ἢ ἐκ τῶν αἰγῶν

text_en: for every ox and ram and lamb and kid.
text_la: per singulos boves et arietis et agnos et hædos.
text_pt: Segundo o número que oferecerdes, assim o fareis com cada um, segundo o número deles.
text_el: κατὰ τὸν ἀριθμὸν ὧν ἐὰν ποιήσητε οὕτω ποιήσετε τῷ ἑνὶ κατὰ τὸν ἀριθμὸν αὐτῶν

text_en: Both they that are born in the land, and the strangers
text_la: Tam indigenæ quam peregrini
text_pt: Todo o natural assim fará estas coisas, oferecendo oferta queimada em cheiro suave ao Senhor.
text_el: πᾶς ὁ αὐτόχθων ποιήσει οὕτως τοιαῦτα προσενέγκαι καρπώματα εἰς ὀσμὴν εὐωδίας κυρίῳ

text_en: shall offer sacrifices after the same rite.
text_la: eodem ritu offerent sacrificia.
text_pt: Quando também peregrinar convosco algum estrangeiro, ou que estiver no meio de vós nas vossas gerações, e ele apresentar uma oferta queimada de cheiro suave ao Senhor, como vós fizerdes, assim fará ele.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ προσήλυτος ἐν ὑμῖν προσγένηται ἐν τῇ γῇ ὑμῶν ἢ ὃς ἂν γένηται ἐν ὑμῖν ἐν ταῖς γενεαῖς ὑμῶν καὶ ποιήσει κάρπωμα ὀσμὴν εὐωδίας κυρίῳ ὃν τρόπον ποιεῖτε ὑμεῖς οὕτως ποιήσει ἡ συναγωγὴ κυρίῳ

text_en: There shall be all one law and judgment both for you and for them who are strangers in the land.
text_la: Unum præceptum erit atque judicium tam vobis quam advenis terræ.
text_pt: Um mesmo estatuto haja para vós, ó congregação, e para o estrangeiro que entre vós peregrina, por estatuto perpétuo nas vossas gerações; como vós, assim será o peregrino perante o Senhor.
text_el: νόμος εἷς ἔσται ὑμῖν καὶ τοῖς προσηλύτοις τοῖς προσκειμένοις ἐν ὑμῖν νόμος αἰώνιος εἰς γενεὰς ὑμῶν ὡς ὑμεῖς καὶ ὁ προσήλυτος ἔσται ἔναντι κυρίου

text_en: And the Lord spoke to Moses , saying:
text_la: Locutus est Dominus ad Moysen, dicens:
text_pt: Uma mesma lei e um mesmo direito haverá para vós e para o estrangeiro que peregrina convosco.
text_el: νόμος εἷς ἔσται καὶ δικαίωμα ἓν ἔσται ὑμῖν καὶ τῷ προσηλύτῳ τῷ προσκειμένῳ ἐν ὑμῖν

text_en: Speak to the children of Israel , and you shall say to them:
text_la: Loquere filiis Israël, et dices ad eos:
text_pt: Falou mais o Senhor a Moisés, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν λέγων

text_en: When you have come into the land which I will give you,
text_la: Cum veneritis in terram, quam dabo vobis,
text_pt: Fala aos filhos de Israel, e dize-lhes: Quando entrardes na terra em que vos hei de introduzir,
text_el: λάλησον τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ καὶ ἐρεῖς πρὸς αὐτούς ἐν τῷ εἰσπορεύεσθαι ὑμᾶς εἰς τὴν γῆν εἰς ἣν ἐγὼ εἰσάγω ὑμᾶς ἐκεῖ

text_en: and shall eat of the bread of that country, you shall separate firstfruits to the Lord ,
text_la: et comederitis de panibus regionis illius, separabitis primitias Domino
text_pt: Acontecerá que, quando comerdes do pão da terra, então oferecereis ao Senhor oferta alçada.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ὅταν ἔσθητε ὑμεῖς ἀπὸ τῶν ἄρτων τῆς γῆς ἀφελεῖτε ἀφαίρεμα ἀφόρισμα κυρίῳ

text_en: of the things you eat. As you separate firstfruits of your barnfloors:
text_la: de cibis vestris. Sicut de areis primitias separatis,
text_pt: Das primícias da vossa massa oferecereis um bolo em oferta alçada; como a oferta da eira, assim o oferecereis.
text_el: ἀπαρχὴν φυράματος ὑμῶν ἄρτον ἀφαίρεμα ἀφοριεῖτε αὐτό ὡς ἀφαίρεμα ἀπὸ ἅλω οὕτως ἀφελεῖτε αὐτόν

text_en: So also shall you give firstfruits of your dough to the Lord .
text_la: ita et de pulmentis dabitis primitiva Domino.
text_pt: Das primícias das vossas massas dareis ao Senhor oferta alçada nas vossas gerações.
text_el: ἀπαρχὴν φυράματος ὑμῶν καὶ δώσετε κυρίῳ ἀφαίρεμα εἰς τὰς γενεὰς ὑμῶν

text_en: And if through ignorance you omit any of these things, which the Lord has spoken to Moses ,
text_la: Quod si per ignorantiam præterieritis quidquam horum, quæ locutus est Dominus ad Moysen,
text_pt: E, quando vierdes a errar, e não cumprirdes todos estes mandamentos, que o Senhor falou a Moisés,
text_el: ὅταν δὲ διαμάρτητε καὶ μὴ ποιήσητε πάσας τὰς ἐντολὰς ταύτας ἃς ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν

text_en: and by him has commanded you from the day that he began to command and thenceforward,
text_la: et mandavit per eum ad vos, a die qua cœpit jubere et ultra,
text_pt: Tudo quanto o Senhor vos tem mandado por intermédio de Moisés, desde o dia que o Senhor ordenou, e dali em diante, nas vossas gerações,
text_el: καθὰ συνέταξεν κύριος πρὸς ὑμᾶς ἐν χειρὶ Μωυσῆ ἀπὸ τῆς ἡμέρας ἧς συνέταξεν κύριος πρὸς ὑμᾶς καὶ ἐπέκεινα εἰς τὰς γενεὰς ὑμῶν

text_en: and the multitude have forgotten to do it: they shall offer a calf out of the herd, a holocaust for a most sweet savour to the Lord , and the sacrifice and libations thereof, as the ceremonies require, and a buck goat for sin :
text_la: oblitaque fuerit facere multitudo : offeret vitulum de armento, holocaustum in odorem suavissimum Domino, et sacrificum ejus ac liba, ut cæremoniæ postulant, hircumque pro peccato:
text_pt: Será que, quando se fizer alguma coisa por ignorância, e for encoberto aos olhos da congregação, toda a congregação oferecerá um novilho para holocausto em cheiro suave ao Senhor, com a sua oferta de alimentos e libação conforme ao estatuto, e um bode para expiação do pecado.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ἐὰν ἐξ ὀφθαλμῶν τῆς συναγωγῆς γενηθῇ ἀκουσίως καὶ ποιήσει πᾶσα ἡ συναγωγὴ μόσχον ἕνα ἐκ βοῶν ἄμωμον εἰς ὁλοκαύτωμα εἰς ὀσμὴν εὐωδίας κυρίῳ καὶ θυσίαν τούτου καὶ σπονδὴν αὐτοῦ κατὰ τὴν σύνταξιν καὶ χίμαρον ἐξ αἰγῶν ἕνα περὶ ἁμαρτίας

text_en: And the priest shall pray for all the multitude of the children of Israel : and it shall be forgiven them, because they sinned ignorantly , offering notwithstanding a burnt offering to the Lord for themselves and for their sin and their ignorance :
text_la: et rogabit sacerdos pro omni multitudine filiorum Israël, et dimittetur eis, quoniam non sponte peccaverunt, nihilominus offerentes incensum Domino pro se et pro peccato atque errore suo:
text_pt: E o sacerdote fará expiação por toda a congregação dos filhos de Israel, e lhes será perdoado, porquanto foi por ignorância; e trouxeram a sua oferta, oferta queimada ao Senhor, e a sua expiação do pecado perante o Senhor, por causa da sua ignorância.
text_el: καὶ ἐξιλάσεται ὁ ἱερεὺς περὶ πάσης συναγωγῆς υἱῶν Ισραηλ καὶ ἀφεθήσεται αὐτοῖς ὅτι ἀκούσιόν ἐστιν καὶ αὐτοὶ ἤνεγκαν τὸ δῶρον αὐτῶν κάρπωμα κυρίῳ περὶ τῆς ἁμαρτίας αὐτῶν ἔναντι κυρίου περὶ τῶν ἀκουσίων αὐτῶν

text_en: And it shall be forgiven all the people of the children of Israel : and the strangers that sojourn among them: because it is the fault of all the people through ignorance .
text_la: et dimittetur universæ plebi filiorum Israël, et advenis qui peregrinantur inter eos : quoniam culpa est omnis populi per ignorantiam.
text_pt: Será, pois, perdoado a toda a congregação dos filhos de Israel, e mais ao estrangeiro que peregrina no meio deles, porquanto por ignorância sobreveio a todo o povo.
text_el: καὶ ἀφεθήσεται κατὰ πᾶσαν συναγωγὴν υἱῶν Ισραηλ καὶ τῷ προσηλύτῳ τῷ προσκειμένῳ πρὸς ὑμᾶς ὅτι παντὶ τῷ λαῷ ἀκούσιον

text_en: But if one soul shall sin ignorantly , he shall offer a she goat of a year old for his sin .
text_la: Quod si anima una nesciens peccaverit, offeret capram anniculam pro peccato suo:
text_pt: E, se alguma alma pecar por ignorância, para expiação do pecado oferecerá uma cabra de um ano.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ ψυχὴ μία ἁμάρτῃ ἀκουσίως προσάξει αἶγα μίαν ἐνιαυσίαν περὶ ἁμαρτίας

text_en: And the priest shall pray for him, because he sinned ignorantly before the Lord : and he shall obtain his pardon, and it shall be forgiven him.
text_la: et deprecabitur pro ea sacerdos, quod inscia peccaverit coram Domino : impetrabitque ei veniam, et dimittetur illi.
text_pt: E o sacerdote fará expiação pela pessoa que pecou, quando pecar por ignorância, perante o Senhor, fazendo expiação por ela, e lhe será perdoado.
text_el: καὶ ἐξιλάσεται ὁ ἱερεὺς περὶ τῆς ψυχῆς τῆς ἀκουσιασθείσης καὶ ἁμαρτούσης ἀκουσίως ἔναντι κυρίου ἐξιλάσασθαι περὶ αὐτοῦ

text_en: The same law shall be for all that sin by ignorance , whether they be natives or strangers.
text_la: Tam indigenis quam advenis una lex erit omnium, qui peccaverint ignorantes.
text_pt: Para o natural dos filhos de Israel, e para o estrangeiro que no meio deles peregrina, uma mesma lei vos será, para aquele que pecar por ignorância.
text_el: τῷ ἐγχωρίῳ ἐν υἱοῖς Ισραηλ καὶ τῷ προσηλύτῳ τῷ προσκειμένῳ ἐν αὐτοῖς νόμος εἷς ἔσται αὐτοῖς ὃς ἂν ποιήσῃ ἀκουσίως

text_en: But the soul that commits anything through pride , whether he be born in the land or a stranger (because he has been rebellious against the Lord ) shall be cut off from among his people:
text_la: Anima vero, quæ per superbiam aliquid commiserit, sive civis sit ille, sive peregrinus (quoniam adversus Dominum rebellis fuit), peribit de populo suo:
text_pt: Mas a pessoa que fizer alguma coisa temerariamente, quer seja dos naturais quer dos estrangeiros, injuria ao Senhor; tal pessoa será extirpada do meio do seu povo.
text_el: καὶ ψυχή ἥτις ποιήσει ἐν χειρὶ ὑπερηφανίας ἀπὸ τῶν αὐτοχθόνων ἢ ἀπὸ τῶν προσηλύτων τὸν θεὸν οὗτος παροξύνει ἐξολεθρευθήσεται ἡ ψυχὴ ἐκείνη ἐκ τοῦ λαοῦ αὐτῆς

text_en: For he has contemned the word of the Lord , and made void his precept : therefore shall he be destroyed, and shall bear his iniquity .
text_la: verbum enim Domini contempsit, et præceptum illius fecit irritum : idcirco delebitur, et portabit iniquitatem suam.
text_pt: Pois desprezou a palavra do Senhor, e anulou o seu mandamento; totalmente será extirpada aquela pessoa, a sua iniqüidade será sobre ela.
text_el: ὅτι τὸ ῥῆμα κυρίου ἐφαύλισεν καὶ τὰς ἐντολὰς αὐτοῦ διεσκέδασεν ἐκτρίψει ἐκτριβήσεται ἡ ψυχὴ ἐκείνη ἡ ἁμαρτία αὐτῆς ἐν αὐτῇ

text_en: And it came to pass, when the children of Israel were in the wilderness , and had found a man gathering sticks on the sabbath day ,
text_la: Factum est autem, cum essent filii Israël in solitudine, et invenissent hominem colligentem ligna in die sabbati,
text_pt: Estando, pois, os filhos de Israel no deserto, acharam um homem apanhando lenha no dia de sábado.
text_el: καὶ ἦσαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ καὶ εὗρον ἄνδρα συλλέγοντα ξύλα τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῶν σαββάτων

text_en: that they brought him to Moses and Aaron and the whole multitude.
text_la: obtulerunt eum Moysi et Aaron et universæ multitudini.
text_pt: E os que o acharam apanhando lenha o trouxeram a Moisés e a Arão, e a toda a congregação.
text_el: καὶ προσήγαγον αὐτὸν οἱ εὑρόντες αὐτὸν συλλέγοντα ξύλα τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῶν σαββάτων πρὸς Μωυσῆν καὶ Ααρων καὶ πρὸς πᾶσαν συναγωγὴν υἱῶν Ισραηλ

text_en: And they put him into prison , not knowing what they should do with him.
text_la: Qui recluserunt eum in carcerem, nescientes quid super eo facere deberent.
text_pt: E o puseram em guarda; porquanto ainda não estava declarado o que se lhe devia fazer.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέθεντο αὐτὸν εἰς φυλακήν οὐ γὰρ συνέκριναν τί ποιήσωσιν αὐτόν

text_en: And the Lord said to Moses : Let that man die , let all the multitude stone him without the camp.
text_la: Dixitque Dominus ad Moysen : Morte moriatur homo iste : obruat eum lapidibus omnis turba extra castra.
text_pt: Disse, pois, o Senhor a Moisés: Certamente morrerá aquele homem; toda a congregação o apedrejará fora do arraial.
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν λέγων θανάτῳ θανατούσθω ὁ ἄνθρωπος λιθοβολήσατε αὐτὸν λίθοις πᾶσα ἡ συναγωγή

text_en: And when they had brought him out, they stoned him, and he died as the Lord had commanded.
text_la: Cumque eduxissent eum foras, obruerunt lapidibus, et mortuus est, sicut præceperat Dominus.
text_pt: Então toda a congregação o tirou para fora do arraial, e o apedrejaram, e morreu, como o Senhor ordenara a Moisés.
text_el: καὶ ἐξήγαγον αὐτὸν πᾶσα ἡ συναγωγὴ ἔξω τῆς παρεμβολῆς καὶ ἐλιθοβόλησαν αὐτὸν πᾶσα ἡ συναγωγὴ λίθοις ἔξω τῆς παρεμβολῆς καθὰ συνέταξεν κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ

text_en: The Lord also said to Moses :
text_la: Dixit quoque Dominus ad Moysen:
text_pt: E falou o Senhor a Moisés, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν λέγων

text_en: Speak to the children of Israel , and you shall tell them to make to themselves fringes in the corners of their garments, putting in them ribands of blue:
text_la: Loquere filiis Israël, et dices ad eos ut faciant sibi fimbrias per angulos palliorum, ponentes in eis vittas hyacinthinas:
text_pt: Fala aos filhos de Israel, e dize-lhes: Que nas bordas das suas vestes façam franjas pelas suas gerações; e nas franjas das bordas ponham um cordão de azul.
text_el: λάλησον τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ καὶ ἐρεῖς πρὸς αὐτοὺς καὶ ποιησάτωσαν ἑαυτοῖς κράσπεδα ἐπὶ τὰ πτερύγια τῶν ἱματίων αὐτῶν εἰς τὰς γενεὰς αὐτῶν καὶ ἐπιθήσετε ἐπὶ τὰ κράσπεδα τῶν πτερυγίων κλῶσμα ὑακίνθινον

text_en: That when they shall see them, they may remember all the commandments of the Lord , and not follow their own thoughts and eyes going astray after divers things,
text_la: quas cum viderint, recordentur omnium mandatorum Domini, nec sequantur cogitationes suas et oculos per res varias fornicantes,
text_pt: E as franjas vos serão para que, vendo-as, vos lembreis de todos os mandamentos do Senhor, e os cumprais; e não seguireis o vosso coração, nem após os vossos olhos, pelos quais andais vos prostituindo.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ὑμῖν ἐν τοῖς κρασπέδοις καὶ ὄψεσθε αὐτὰ καὶ μνησθήσεσθε πασῶν τῶν ἐντολῶν κυρίου καὶ ποιήσετε αὐτὰς καὶ οὐ διαστραφήσεσθε ὀπίσω τῶν διανοιῶν ὑμῶν καὶ ὀπίσω τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν ὑμῶν ἐν οἷς ὑμεῖς ἐκπορνεύετε ὀπίσω αὐτῶν

text_en: but rather being mindful of the precepts of the Lord , may do them and be holy to their God .
text_la: sed magis memores præceptorum Domini faciant ea, sintque sancti Deo suo.
text_pt: Para que vos lembreis de todos os meus mandamentos, e os cumprais, e santos sejais a vosso Deus.
text_el: ὅπως ἂν μνησθῆτε καὶ ποιήσητε πάσας τὰς ἐντολάς μου καὶ ἔσεσθε ἅγιοι τῷ θεῷ ὑμῶν

text_en: I am the Lord your God , who brought you out of the land of Egypt , that I might be your God .
text_la: Ego Dominus Deus vester, qui eduxi vos de terra Ægypti, ut essem Deus vester.
text_pt: Eu sou o Senhor vosso Deus, que vos tirei da terra do Egito, para ser vosso Deus. Eu sou o Senhor vosso Deus.
text_el: ἐγὼ κύριος ὁ θεὸς ὑμῶν ὁ ἐξαγαγῶν ὑμᾶς ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου εἶναι ὑμῶν θεός ἐγὼ κύριος ὁ θεὸς ὑμῶν

text_en: And behold Core the son of Isaar, the son of Caath, the son of Levi , and Dathan and Abiron the sons of Eliab, and Hon the son of Pheleth of the children of Ruben ,
text_la: Ecce autem Core filius Isaar, filii Caath, filii Levi, et Dathan atque Abiron filii Eliab, Hon quoque filius Pheleth de filiis Ruben,
text_pt: E Coré, filho de Izar, filho de Coate, filho de Levi, tomou consigo a Datã e a Abirão, filhos de Eliabe, e a Om, filho de Pelete, filhos de Rúben.
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν Κορε υἱὸς Ισσααρ υἱοῦ Κααθ υἱοῦ Λευι καὶ Δαθαν καὶ Αβιρων υἱοὶ Ελιαβ καὶ Αυν υἱὸς Φαλεθ υἱοῦ Ρουβην

text_en: rose up against Moses , and with them two hundred and fifty others of the children of Israel , leading men of the synagogue , and who in the time of assembly were called by name .
text_la: surrexerunt contra Moysen, aliique filiorum Israël ducenti quinquaginta viri proceres synagogæ, et qui tempore concilii per nomina vocabantur.
text_pt: E levantaram-se perante Moisés com duzentos e cinqüenta homens dos filhos de Israel, príncipes da congregação, chamados à assembléia, homens de posição,
text_el: καὶ ἀνέστησαν ἔναντι Μωυσῆ καὶ ἄνδρες τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ πεντήκοντα καὶ διακόσιοι ἀρχηγοὶ συναγωγῆς σύγκλητοι βουλῆς καὶ ἄνδρες ὀνομαστοί

text_en: And when they had stood up against Moses and Aaron , they said: Let it be enough for you, that all the multitude consists of holy ones, and the Lord is among them: Why lift you up yourselves above the people of the Lord ?
text_la: Cumque stetissent adversum Moysen et Aaron, dixerunt : Sufficiat vobis, quia omnis multitudo sanctorum est, et in ipsis est Dominus : cur elevamini super populum Domini?
text_pt: E se congregaram contra Moisés e contra Arão, e lhes disseram: Basta-vos, pois que toda a congregação é santa, todos são santos, e o Senhor está no meio deles; por que, pois, vos elevais sobre a congregação do Senhor?
text_el: συνέστησαν ἐπὶ Μωυσῆν καὶ Ααρων καὶ εἶπαν ἐχέτω ὑμῖν ὅτι πᾶσα ἡ συναγωγὴ πάντες ἅγιοι καὶ ἐν αὐτοῖς κύριος καὶ διὰ τί κατανίστασθε ἐπὶ τὴν συναγωγὴν κυρίου

text_en: When Moses heard this, he fell flat on his face:
text_la: Quod cum audisset Moyses, cecidit pronus in faciem:
text_pt: Quando Moisés ouviu isso, caiu sobre o seu rosto.
text_el: καὶ ἀκούσας Μωυσῆς ἔπεσεν ἐπὶ πρόσωπον

text_en: And speaking to Core and all the multitude, he said: In the morning the Lord will make known who belong to him, and the holy he will join to himself: and whom he shall choose, they shall approach to him.
text_la: locutusque ad Core et ad omnem multitudinem : Mane, inquit, notum faciet Dominus qui ad se pertineant, et sanctos applicabit sibi : et quos elegerit, appropinquabunt ei.
text_pt: E falou a Coré e a toda a sua congregação, dizendo: Amanhã pela manhã o Senhor fará saber quem é seu, e quem é o santo que ele fará chegar a si; e aquele a quem escolher fará chegar a si.
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν πρὸς Κορε καὶ πρὸς πᾶσαν αὐτοῦ τὴν συναγωγὴν λέγων ἐπέσκεπται καὶ ἔγνω ὁ θεὸς τοὺς ὄντας αὐτοῦ καὶ τοὺς ἁγίους καὶ προσηγάγετο πρὸς ἑαυτόν καὶ οὓς ἐξελέξατο ἑαυτῷ προσηγάγετο πρὸς ἑαυτόν

text_en: Do this therefore: Take every man of you your censers , you Core , and all your company.
text_la: Hoc igitur facite : tollat unusquisque thuribula sua, tu Core, et omne concilium tuum:
text_pt: Fazei isto: Tomai vós incensários, Coré e todo seu grupo;
text_el: τοῦτο ποιήσατε λάβετε ὑμῖν αὐτοῖς πυρεῖα Κορε καὶ πᾶσα ἡ συναγωγὴ αὐτοῦ

text_en: And putting fire in them tomorrow, put incense upon it before the Lord : and whomsoever he shall choose, the same shall be holy : you take too much upon you, you sons of Levi .
text_la: et hausto cras igne, ponite desuper thymiama coram Domino : et quemcumque elegerit, ipse erit sanctus : multum erigimini filii Levi.
text_pt: E, pondo fogo neles amanhã, sobre eles deitai incenso perante o Senhor; e será que o homem a quem o Senhor escolher, este será o santo; basta-vos, filhos de Levi.
text_el: καὶ ἐπίθετε ἐπ' αὐτὰ πῦρ καὶ ἐπίθετε ἐπ' αὐτὰ θυμίαμα ἔναντι κυρίου αὔριον καὶ ἔσται ὁ ἀνήρ ὃν ἂν ἐκλέξηται κύριος οὗτος ἅγιος ἱκανούσθω ὑμῖν υἱοὶ Λευι

text_en: And he said again to Core : Hear you sons of Levi .
text_la: Dixitque rursum ad Core : Audite, filii Levi:
text_pt: Disse mais Moisés a Coré: Ouvi agora, filhos de Levi:
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Μωυσῆς πρὸς Κορε εἰσακούσατέ μου υἱοὶ Λευι

text_en: Is it a small thing unto you, that the God of Israel has spared you from all the people, and joined you to himself, that you should serve him in the service of the tabernacle , and should stand before the congregation of the people, and should minister to him?
text_la: num parum vobis est quod separavit vos Deus Israël ab omni populo, et junxit sibi, ut serviretis ei in cultu tabernaculi, et staretis coram frequentia populi, et ministraretis ei?
text_pt: Porventura pouco para vós é que o Deus de Israel vos tenha separado da congregação de Israel, para vos fazer chegar a si, e administrar o ministério do tabernáculo do Senhor e estar perante a congregação para ministrar-lhe;
text_el: μὴ μικρόν ἐστιν τοῦτο ὑμῖν ὅτι διέστειλεν ὁ θεὸς Ισραηλ ὑμᾶς ἐκ συναγωγῆς Ισραηλ καὶ προσηγάγετο ὑμᾶς πρὸς ἑαυτὸν λειτουργεῖν τὰς λειτουργίας τῆς σκηνῆς κυρίου καὶ παρίστασθαι ἔναντι τῆς συναγωγῆς λατρεύειν αὐτοῖς

text_en: Did he therefore make you and all your brethren the sons of Levi to approach unto him, that you should challenge to yourselves the priesthood also,
text_la: idcirco ad se fecit accedere te et omnes fratres tuos filios Levi, ut vobis etiam sacerdotium vindicetis,
text_pt: E te fez chegar, e todos os teus irmãos, os filhos de Levi, contigo? ainda também procurais o sacerdócio?
text_el: καὶ προσηγάγετό σε καὶ πάντας τοὺς ἀδελφούς σου υἱοὺς Λευι μετὰ σοῦ καὶ ζητεῖτε ἱερατεύειν

text_en: and that all your company should stand against the Lord ? For what is Aaron that you murmur against him?
text_la: et omnis globus tuus stet contra Dominum? quid est enim Aaron ut murmuretis contra eum?
text_pt: Assim tu e todo o teu grupo estais contra o Senhor; e Arão, quem é ele, que murmureis contra ele?
text_el: οὕτως σὺ καὶ πᾶσα ἡ συναγωγή σου ἡ συνηθροισμένη πρὸς τὸν θεόν καὶ Ααρων τίς ἐστιν ὅτι διαγογγύζετε κατ' αὐτοῦ

text_en: Then Moses sent to call Dathan and Abiron the sons of Eliab. But they answered: We will not come.
text_la: Misit ergo Moyses ut vocaret Dathan et Abiron filios Eliab. Qui responderunt : Non venimus.
text_pt: E Moisés mandou chamar a Datã e a Abirão, filhos de Eliabe; porém eles disseram: Não subiremos;
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν Μωυσῆς καλέσαι Δαθαν καὶ Αβιρων υἱοὺς Ελιαβ καὶ εἶπαν οὐκ ἀναβαίνομεν

text_en: Is it a small matter to you, that you have brought us out of a land that flowed with milk and honey, to kill us in the desert , unless you rule also like a lord over us?
text_la: Numquid parum est tibi quod eduxisti nos de terra, quæ lacte et melle manabat, ut occideres in deserto, nisi et dominatus fueris nostri?
text_pt: Porventura pouco é que nos fizeste subir de uma terra que mana leite e mel, para nos matares neste deserto, senão que também queres fazer-te príncipe sobre nós?
text_el: μὴ μικρὸν τοῦτο ὅτι ἀνήγαγες ἡμᾶς ἐκ γῆς ῥεούσης γάλα καὶ μέλι ἀποκτεῖναι ἡμᾶς ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ ὅτι κατάρχεις ἡμῶν ἄρχων

text_en: You have brought us indeed into a land that flows with rivers of milk and honey, and have given us possessions of fields and vineyards; will you also pull out our eyes? We will not come.
text_la: Revera induxisti nos in terram, quæ fluit rivis lactis et mellis, et dedisti nobis possessiones agrorum et vinearum : an et oculos nostros vis eruere? non venimus.
text_pt: Nem tampouco nos trouxeste a uma terra que mana leite e mel, nem nos deste campo e vinhas em herança; porventura arrancarás os olhos a estes homens? Não subiremos.
text_el: εἰ καὶ εἰς γῆν ῥέουσαν γάλα καὶ μέλι εἰσήγαγες ἡμᾶς καὶ ἔδωκας ἡμῖν κλῆρον ἀγροῦ καὶ ἀμπελῶνας τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς τῶν ἀνθρώπων ἐκείνων ἂν ἐξέκοψας οὐκ ἀναβαίνομεν

text_en: Moses therefore being very angry , said to the Lord : Respect not their sacrifices : you know that I have not taken of them so much as a young ass at any time, nor have injured any of them.
text_la: Iratusque Moyses valde, ait ad Dominum : Ne respicias sacrificia eorum : tu scis quod ne asellum quidem umquam acceperim ab eis, nec afflixerim quempiam eorum.
text_pt: Então Moisés irou-se muito, e disse ao Senhor: Não atentes para a sua oferta; nem um só jumento tomei deles, nem a nenhum deles fiz mal.
text_el: καὶ ἐβαρυθύμησεν Μωυσῆς σφόδρα καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς κύριον μὴ προσχῇς εἰς τὴν θυσίαν αὐτῶν οὐκ ἐπιθύμημα οὐδενὸς αὐτῶν εἴληφα οὐδὲ ἐκάκωσα οὐδένα αὐτῶν

text_en: And he said to Core : Do thou and your congregation stand apart before the Lord tomorrow, and Aaron apart.
text_la: Dixitque ad Core : Tu, et omnis congregatio tua, state seorsum coram Domino, et Aaron die crastino separatim.
text_pt: Disse mais Moisés a Coré: Tu e todo o teu grupo ponde-vos perante o Senhor, tu e eles, e Arão, amanhã.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Μωυσῆς πρὸς Κορε ἁγίασον τὴν συναγωγήν σου καὶ γίνεσθε ἕτοιμοι ἔναντι κυρίου σὺ καὶ αὐτοὶ καὶ Ααρων αὔριον

text_en: Take every one of you censers , and put incense upon them, offering to the Lord two hundred and fifty censers : let Aaron also hold his censer .
text_la: Tollite singuli thuribula vestra, et ponite super ea incensum, offerentes Domino ducenta quinquaginta thuribula : Aaron quoque teneat thuribulum suum.
text_pt: E tomai cada um o seu incensário, e neles ponde incenso; e trazei cada um o seu incensário perante o Senhor, duzentos e cinqüenta incensários; também tu e Arão, cada um o seu incensário.
text_el: καὶ λάβετε ἕκαστος τὸ πυρεῖον αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπιθήσετε ἐπ' αὐτὰ θυμίαμα καὶ προσάξετε ἔναντι κυρίου ἕκαστος τὸ πυρεῖον αὐτοῦ πεντήκοντα καὶ διακόσια πυρεῖα καὶ σὺ καὶ Ααρων ἕκαστος τὸ πυρεῖον αὐτοῦ

text_en: When they had done this, Moses and Aaron standing,
text_la: Quod cum fecissent, stantibus Moyses et Aaron,
text_pt: Tomaram, pois, cada um o seu incensário, e neles puseram fogo, e neles deitaram incenso, e se puseram perante a porta da tenda da congregação com Moisés e Arão.
text_el: καὶ ἔλαβεν ἕκαστος τὸ πυρεῖον αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπέθηκαν ἐπ' αὐτὰ πῦρ καὶ ἐπέβαλον ἐπ' αὐτὸ θυμίαμα καὶ ἔστησαν παρὰ τὰς θύρας τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου Μωυσῆς καὶ Ααρων

text_en: and had drawn up all the multitude against them to the door of the tabernacle , the glory of the Lord appeared to them all.
text_la: et coacervassent adversum eos omnem multitudinem ad ostium tabernaculi, apparuit cunctis gloria Domini.
text_pt: E Coré fez ajuntar contra eles todo o povo à porta da tenda da congregação; então a glória do Senhor apareceu a toda a congregação.
text_el: καὶ ἐπισυνέστησεν ἐπ' αὐτοὺς Κορε τὴν πᾶσαν αὐτοῦ συναγωγὴν παρὰ τὴν θύραν τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου καὶ ὤφθη ἡ δόξα κυρίου πάσῃ τῇ συναγωγῇ

text_en: And the Lord speaking to Moses and Aaron , said:
text_la: Locutusque Dominus ad Moysen et Aaron, ait:
text_pt: E falou o Senhor a Moisés e a Arão, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν καὶ Ααρων λέγων

text_en: Separate yourselves from among this congregation, that I may presently destroy them.
text_la: Separamini de medio congregationis hujus, ut eos repente disperdam.
text_pt: Apartai-vos do meio desta congregação, e os consumirei num momento.
text_el: ἀποσχίσθητε ἐκ μέσου τῆς συναγωγῆς ταύτης καὶ ἐξαναλώσω αὐτοὺς εἰς ἅπαξ

text_en: They fell flat on their face, and said: O most mighty, the God of the spirits of all flesh, for one man's sin shall your wrath rage against all?
text_la: Qui ceciderunt proni in faciem, atque dixerunt : Fortissime Deus spirituum universæ carnis, num uno peccante, contra omnes ira tua desæviet?
text_pt: Mas eles se prostraram sobre os seus rostos, e disseram: Ó Deus, Deus dos espíritos de toda a carne, pecará um só homem, e indignar-te-ás tu contra toda esta congregação?
text_el: καὶ ἔπεσαν ἐπὶ πρόσωπον αὐτῶν καὶ εἶπαν θεὸς θεὸς τῶν πνευμάτων καὶ πάσης σαρκός εἰ ἄνθρωπος εἷς ἥμαρτεν ἐπὶ πᾶσαν τὴν συναγωγὴν ὀργὴ κυρίου

text_en: And the Lord said to Moses :
text_la: Et ait Dominus ad Moysen:
text_pt: E falou o Senhor a Moisés, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν λέγων

text_en: Command the whole people to separate themselves from the tents of Core and Dathan and Abiron .
text_la: Præcipe universo populo ut separetur a tabernaculis Core et Dathan et Abiron.
text_pt: Fala a toda esta congregação, dizendo: Subi do derredor da habitação de Coré, Datã e Abirão.
text_el: λάλησον τῇ συναγωγῇ λέγων ἀναχωρήσατε κύκλῳ ἀπὸ τῆς συναγωγῆς Κορε

text_en: And Moses arose, and went to Dathan and Abiron : and the ancients of Israel following him,
text_la: Surrexitque Moyses, et abiit ad Dathan et Abiron : et sequentibus eum senioribus Israël,
text_pt: Então Moisés levantou-se, e foi a Datã e a Abirão; e após ele seguiram os anciãos de Israel.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέστη Μωυσῆς καὶ ἐπορεύθη πρὸς Δαθαν καὶ Αβιρων καὶ συνεπορεύθησαν μετ' αὐτοῦ πάντες οἱ πρεσβύτεροι Ισραηλ

text_en: he said to the multitude: Depart from the tents of these wicked men , and touch nothing of theirs, lest you be involved in their sins .
text_la: dixit ad turbam : Recedite a tabernaculis hominum impiorum, et nolite tangere quæ ad eos pertinent, ne involvamini in peccatis eorum.
text_pt: E falou à congregação, dizendo: Desviai-vos, peço-vos, das tendas destes homens ímpios, e não toqueis nada do que é seu para que porventura não pereçais em todos os seus pecados.
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν πρὸς τὴν συναγωγὴν λέγων ἀποσχίσθητε ἀπὸ τῶν σκηνῶν τῶν ἀνθρώπων τῶν σκληρῶν τούτων καὶ μὴ ἅπτεσθε ἀπὸ πάντων ὧν ἐστιν αὐτοῖς μὴ συναπόλησθε ἐν πάσῃ τῇ ἁμαρτίᾳ αὐτῶν

text_en: And when they were departed from their tents round about, Dathan and Abiron coming out stood in the entry of their pavilions with their wives and children, and all the people.
text_la: Cumque recessissent a tentoriis eorum per circuitum, Dathan et Abiron egressi stabant in introitu papilionum suorum cum uxoribus et liberis, omnique frequentia.
text_pt: Subiram, pois, do derredor da habitação de Coré, Datã e Abirão. E Datã e Abirão saíram, e se puseram à porta das suas tendas, juntamente com as suas mulheres, e seus filhos, e suas crianças.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστησαν ἀπὸ τῆς σκηνῆς Κορε κύκλῳ καὶ Δαθαν καὶ Αβιρων ἐξῆλθον καὶ εἱστήκεισαν παρὰ τὰς θύρας τῶν σκηνῶν αὐτῶν καὶ αἱ γυναῖκες αὐτῶν καὶ τὰ τέκνα αὐτῶν καὶ ἡ ἀποσκευὴ αὐτῶν

text_en: And Moses said: By this you shall know that the Lord has sent me to do all things that you see, and that I have not forged them of my own head:
text_la: Et ait Moyses : In hoc scietis quod Dominus miserit me ut facerem universa quæ cernitis, et non ex proprio ea corde protulerim:
text_pt: Então disse Moisés: Nisto conhecereis que o Senhor me enviou a fazer todos estes feitos, que de meu coração não procedem.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Μωυσῆς ἐν τούτῳ γνώσεσθε ὅτι κύριος ἀπέστειλέν με ποιῆσαι πάντα τὰ ἔργα ταῦτα ὅτι οὐκ ἀπ' ἐμαυτοῦ

text_en: If these men die the common death of men , and if they be visited with a plague, wherewith others also are wont to be visited, the Lord did not send me.
text_la: si consueta hominum morte interierint, et visitaverit eos plaga, qua et ceteri visitari solent, non misit me Dominus:
text_pt: Se estes morrerem como morrem todos os homens, e se forem visitados como são visitados todos os homens, então o Senhor não me enviou.
text_el: εἰ κατὰ θάνατον πάντων ἀνθρώπων ἀποθανοῦνται οὗτοι εἰ καὶ κατ' ἐπίσκεψιν πάντων ἀνθρώπων ἐπισκοπὴ ἔσται αὐτῶν οὐχὶ κύριος ἀπέσταλκέν με

text_en: But if the Lord do a new thing, and the earth opening her mouth swallow them down, and all things that belong to them, and they go down alive into hell , you shall know that they have blasphemed the Lord .
text_la: sin autem novam rem fecerit Dominus, ut aperiens terra os suum deglutiat eos et omnia quæ ad illos pertinent, descenderintque viventes in infernum, scietis quod blasphemaverint Dominum.
text_pt: Mas, se o Senhor criar alguma coisa nova, e a terra abrir a sua boca e os tragar com tudo o que é seu, e vivos descerem ao abismo, então conhecereis que estes homens irritaram ao Senhor.
text_el: ἀλλ' ἢ ἐν φάσματι δείξει κύριος καὶ ἀνοίξασα ἡ γῆ τὸ στόμα αὐτῆς καταπίεται αὐτοὺς καὶ τοὺς οἴκους αὐτῶν καὶ τὰς σκηνὰς αὐτῶν καὶ πάντα ὅσα ἐστὶν αὐτοῖς καὶ καταβήσονται ζῶντες εἰς ᾅδου καὶ γνώσεσθε ὅτι παρώξυναν οἱ ἄνθρωποι οὗτοι τὸν κύριον

text_en: And immediately as he had made an end of speaking, the earth broke asunder under their feet:
text_la: Confestim igitur ut cessavit loqui, dirupta est terra sub pedibus eorum:
text_pt: E aconteceu que, acabando ele de falar todas estas palavras, a terra que estava debaixo deles se fendeu.
text_el: ὡς δὲ ἐπαύσατο λαλῶν πάντας τοὺς λόγους τούτους ἐρράγη ἡ γῆ ὑποκάτω αὐτῶν

text_en: And opening her mouth, devoured them with their tents and all their substance .
text_la: et aperiens os suum, devoravit illos cum tabernaculis suis et universa substantia eorum,
text_pt: E a terra abriu a sua boca, e os tragou com as suas casas, como também a todos os homens que pertenciam a Coré, e a todos os seus bens.
text_el: καὶ ἠνοίχθη ἡ γῆ καὶ κατέπιεν αὐτοὺς καὶ τοὺς οἴκους αὐτῶν καὶ πάντας τοὺς ἀνθρώπους τοὺς ὄντας μετὰ Κορε καὶ τὰ κτήνη αὐτῶν

text_en: And they went down alive into hell , the ground closing upon them, and they perished from among the people.
text_la: descenderuntque vivi in infernum operti humo, et perierunt de medio multitudinis.
text_pt: E eles e tudo o que era seu desceram vivos ao abismo, e a terra os cobriu, e pereceram do meio da congregação.
text_el: καὶ κατέβησαν αὐτοὶ καὶ ὅσα ἐστὶν αὐτῶν ζῶντα εἰς ᾅδου καὶ ἐκάλυψεν αὐτοὺς ἡ γῆ καὶ ἀπώλοντο ἐκ μέσου τῆς συναγωγῆς

text_en: But all Israel , that was standing round about, fled at the cry of them that were perishing: saying: Lest perhaps the earth swallow us up also.
text_la: At vero omnis Israël, qui stabat per gyrum, fugit ad clamorem pereuntium, dicens : Ne forte et nos terra deglutiat.
text_pt: E todo o Israel, que estava ao redor deles, fugiu ao clamor deles; porque diziam: Para que não nos trague a terra também a nós.
text_el: καὶ πᾶς Ισραηλ οἱ κύκλῳ αὐτῶν ἔφυγον ἀπὸ τῆς φωνῆς αὐτῶν ὅτι λέγοντες μήποτε καταπίῃ ἡμᾶς ἡ γῆ

text_en: And a fire coming out from the Lord , destroyed the two hundred and fifty men that offered the incense .
text_la: Sed et ignis egressus a Domino interfecit ducentos quinquaginta viros, qui offerebant incensum.
text_pt: Então saiu fogo do Senhor, e consumiu os duzentos e cinqüenta homens que ofereciam o incenso.
text_el: καὶ πῦρ ἐξῆλθεν παρὰ κυρίου καὶ κατέφαγεν τοὺς πεντήκοντα καὶ διακοσίους ἄνδρας τοὺς προσφέροντας τὸ θυμίαμα

text_en: And the Lord spoke to Moses , saying:
text_la: Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen, dicens:
text_pt: E falou o Senhor a Moisés, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν

text_en: Command Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest to take up the censers that lie in the burning, and to scatter the fire of one side and the other: because they are sanctified
text_la: Præcipe Eleazaro filio Aaron sacerdoti ut tollat thuribula quæ jacent in incendio, et ignem huc illucque dispergat : quoniam sanctificata sunt
text_pt: Dize a Eleazar, filho de Arão, o sacerdote, que tome os incensários do meio do incêndio, e espalhe o fogo longe, porque santos são;
text_el: καὶ πρὸς Ελεαζαρ τὸν υἱὸν Ααρων τὸν ἱερέα ἀνέλεσθε τὰ πυρεῖα τὰ χαλκᾶ ἐκ μέσου τῶν κατακεκαυμένων καὶ τὸ πῦρ τὸ ἀλλότριον τοῦτο σπεῖρον ἐκεῖ ὅτι ἡγίασαν

text_en: in the deaths of the sinners: and let him beat them into plates, and fasten them to the altar , because incense has been offered in them to the Lord , and they are sanctified , that the children of Israel may see them for a sign and a memorial.
text_la: in mortibus peccatorum : producatque ea in laminas, et affigat altari, eo quod oblatum sit in eis incensum Domino, et sanctificata sint, ut cernant ea pro signo et monimento filii Israël.
text_pt: Quanto aos incensários daqueles que pecaram contra as suas almas, deles se façam folhas estendidas para cobertura do altar; porquanto os trouxeram perante o Senhor; pelo que santos são; e serão por sinal aos filhos de Israel.
text_el: τὰ πυρεῖα τῶν ἁμαρτωλῶν τούτων ἐν ταῖς ψυχαῖς αὐτῶν καὶ ποίησον αὐτὰ λεπίδας ἐλατάς περίθεμα τῷ θυσιαστηρίῳ ὅτι προσηνέχθησαν ἔναντι κυρίου καὶ ἡγιάσθησαν καὶ ἐγένοντο εἰς σημεῖον τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ

text_en: Then Eleazar the priest took the brazen censers , wherein they had offered, whom the burning fire had devoured, and beat them into plates, fastening them to the altar :
text_la: Tulit ergo Eleazar sacerdos thuribula ænea, in quibus obtulerant hi quos incendium devoravit, et produxit ea in laminas, affigens altari:
text_pt: E Eleazar, o sacerdote, tomou os incensários de metal, que trouxeram aqueles que foram queimados, e os estenderam em folhas para cobertura do altar,
text_el: καὶ ἔλαβεν Ελεαζαρ υἱὸς Ααρων τοῦ ἱερέως τὰ πυρεῖα τὰ χαλκᾶ ὅσα προσήνεγκαν οἱ κατακεκαυμένοι καὶ προσέθηκαν αὐτὰ περίθεμα τῷ θυσιαστηρίῳ

text_en: That the children of Israel might have for the time to come wherewith they should be admonished, that no stranger or any one that is not of the seed of Aaron should come near to offer incense to the Lord , lest he should suffer as Core suffered, and all his congregation, according as the Lord spoke to Moses .
text_la: ut haberent postea filii Israël, quibus commonerentur ne quis accedat alienigena, et qui non est de semine Aaron ad offerendum incensum Domino, ne patiatur sicut passus est Core, et omnis congregatio ejus, loquente Domino ad Moysen.
text_pt: Por memorial para os filhos de Israel, que nenhum estranho, que não for da descendência de Arão, se chegue para acender incenso perante o Senhor; para que não seja como Coré e a sua congregação, como o Senhor lhe tinha dito por intermédio de Moisés,
text_el: μνημόσυνον τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ ὅπως ἂν μὴ προσέλθῃ μηθεὶς ἀλλογενής ὃς οὐκ ἔστιν ἐκ τοῦ σπέρματος Ααρων ἐπιθεῖναι θυμίαμα ἔναντι κυρίου καὶ οὐκ ἔσται ὥσπερ Κορε καὶ ἡ ἐπισύστασις αὐτοῦ καθὰ ἐλάλησεν κύριος ἐν χειρὶ Μωυσῆ

text_en: The following day all the multitude of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and Aaron , saying: You have killed the people of the Lord .
text_la: Murmuravit autem omnis multitudo filiorum Israël sequenti die contra Moysen et Aaron, dicens : Vos interfecistis populum Domini.
text_pt: Mas no dia seguinte toda a congregação dos filhos de Israel murmurou contra Moisés e contra Arão, dizendo: Vós matastes o povo do Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἐγόγγυσαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ τῇ ἐπαύριον ἐπὶ Μωυσῆν καὶ Ααρων λέγοντες ὑμεῖς ἀπεκτάγκατε τὸν λαὸν κυρίου

text_en: And when there arose a sedition, and the tumult increased,
text_la: Cumque oriretur seditio, et tumultus incresceret,
text_pt: E aconteceu que, ajuntando-se a congregação contra Moisés e Arão, e virando-se para a tenda da congregação, eis que a nuvem a cobriu, e a glória do Senhor apareceu.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ ἐπισυστρέφεσθαι τὴν συναγωγὴν ἐπὶ Μωυσῆν καὶ Ααρων καὶ ὥρμησαν ἐπὶ τὴν σκηνὴν τοῦ μαρτυρίου καὶ τήνδε ἐκάλυψεν αὐτὴν ἡ νεφέλη καὶ ὤφθη ἡ δόξα κυρίου

text_en: Moses and Aaron fled to the tabernacle of the covenant . And when they had gone into it, the cloud covered it, and the glory of the Lord appeared.
text_la: Moyses et Aaron fugerunt ad tabernaculum fœderis. Quod, postquam ingressi sunt, operuit nubes, et apparuit gloria Domini.
text_pt: Vieram, pois, Moisés e Arão perante a tenda da congregação.
text_el: καὶ εἰσῆλθεν Μωυσῆς καὶ Ααρων κατὰ πρόσωπον τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου

text_en: And the Lord said to Moses :
text_la: Dixitque Dominus ad Moysen:
text_pt: Então falou o Senhor a Moisés, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν καὶ Ααρων λέγων

text_en: Get you out from the midst of this multitude, this moment will I destroy them. And as they were lying on the ground,
text_la: Recedite de medio hujus multitudinis, etiam nunc delebo eos. Cumque jacerent in terra,
text_pt: Levantai-vos do meio desta congregação, e a consumirei num momento; então se prostraram sobre os seus rostos,
text_el: ἐκχωρήσατε ἐκ μέσου τῆς συναγωγῆς ταύτης καὶ ἐξαναλώσω αὐτοὺς εἰς ἅπαξ καὶ ἔπεσον ἐπὶ πρόσωπον αὐτῶν

text_en: Moses said to Aaron : Take the censer , and putting fire in it from the altar , put incense upon it, and go quickly to the people to pray for them: for already wrath has gone out from the Lord , and the plague rages.
text_la: dixit Moyses ad Aaron : Tolle thuribulum, et hausto igne de altari, mitte incensum desuper, pergens cito ad populum, ut roges pro eis : jam enim egressa est ira a Domino, et plaga desævit.
text_pt: E disse Moisés a Arão: Toma o teu incensário, e põe nele fogo do altar, e deita incenso sobre ele, e vai depressa à congregação, e faze expiação por eles; porque grande indignação saiu de diante do Senhor; já começou a praga.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Μωυσῆς πρὸς Ααρων λαβὲ τὸ πυρεῖον καὶ ἐπίθες ἐπ' αὐτὸ πῦρ ἀπὸ τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου καὶ ἐπίβαλε ἐπ' αὐτὸ θυμίαμα καὶ ἀπένεγκε τὸ τάχος εἰς τὴν παρεμβολὴν καὶ ἐξίλασαι περὶ αὐτῶν ἐξῆλθεν γὰρ ὀργὴ ἀπὸ προσώπου κυρίου ἦρκται θραύειν τὸν λαόν

text_en: When Aaron had done this, and had run to the midst of the multitude which the burning fire was now destroying, he offered the incense :
text_la: Quod cum fecisset Aaron, et cucurrisset ad mediam multitudinem, quam jam vastabat incendium, obtulit thymiama:
text_pt: E tomou-o Arão, como Moisés tinha falado, e correu ao meio da congregação; e eis que já a praga havia começado entre o povo; e deitou incenso nele, e fez expiação pelo povo.
text_el: καὶ ἔλαβεν Ααρων καθάπερ ἐλάλησεν αὐτῷ Μωυσῆς καὶ ἔδραμεν εἰς τὴν συναγωγήν καὶ ἤδη ἐνῆρκτο ἡ θραῦσις ἐν τῷ λαῷ καὶ ἐπέβαλεν τὸ θυμίαμα καὶ ἐξιλάσατο περὶ τοῦ λαοῦ

text_en: And standing between the dead and the living, he prayed for the people, and the plague ceased.
text_la: et stans inter mortuos ac viventes, pro populo deprecatus est, et plaga cessavit.
text_pt: E estava em pé entre os mortos e os vivos; e cessou a praga.
text_el: καὶ ἔστη ἀνὰ μέσον τῶν τεθνηκότων καὶ τῶν ζώντων καὶ ἐκόπασεν ἡ θραῦσις

text_en: And the number of them that were slain was fourteen thousand and seven hundred men , besides them that had perished in the sedition of Core .
text_la: Fuerunt autem qui percussi sunt, quatuordecim millia hominum, et septingenti, absque his qui perierant in seditione Core.
text_pt: E os que morreram daquela praga foram catorze mil e setecentos, fora os que morreram pela causa de Coré.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένοντο οἱ τεθνηκότες ἐν τῇ θραύσει τέσσαρες καὶ δέκα χιλιάδες καὶ ἑπτακόσιοι χωρὶς τῶν τεθνηκότων ἕνεκεν Κορε

text_en: And Aaron returned to Moses to the door of the tabernacle of the covenant after the destruction was over.
text_la: Reversusque est Aaron ad Moysen ad ostium tabernaculi fœderis postquam quievit interitus.
text_pt: E voltou Arão a Moisés à porta da tenda da congregação; e cessou a praga.
text_el: καὶ ἐπέστρεψεν Ααρων πρὸς Μωυσῆν ἐπὶ τὴν θύραν τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου καὶ ἐκόπασεν ἡ θραῦσις

text_en: And the Lord spoke to Moses , saying:
text_la: Et locutus est Dominus ad Moysen, dicens:
text_pt: Então falou o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν λέγων

text_en: Speak to the children of Israel , and take of every one of them a rod by their kindreds, of all the princes of the tribes , twelve rods, and write the name of every man upon his rod.
text_la: Loquere ad filios Israël, et accipe ab eis virgas singulas per cognationes suas, a cunctis principibus tribuum, virgas duodecim, et uniuscujusque nomen superscribes virgæ suæ.
text_pt: Fala aos filhos de Israel, e toma deles uma vara para cada casa paterna de todos os seus príncipes, segundo as casas de seus pais, doze varas; e escreverás o nome de cada um sobre a sua vara.
text_el: λάλησον τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ καὶ λαβὲ παρ' αὐτῶν ῥάβδον ῥάβδον κατ' οἴκους πατριῶν παρὰ πάντων τῶν ἀρχόντων αὐτῶν κατ' οἴκους πατριῶν αὐτῶν δώδεκα ῥάβδους καὶ ἑκάστου τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ ἐπίγραψον ἐπὶ τῆς ῥάβδου αὐτοῦ

text_en: And the name of Aaron shall be for the tribe of Levi , and one rod shall contain all their families :
text_la: Nomen autem Aaron erit in tribu Levi, et una virga cunctas seorsum familias continebit:
text_pt: Porém o nome de Arão escreverás sobre a vara de Levi; porque cada cabeça da casa de seus pais terá uma vara.
text_el: καὶ τὸ ὄνομα Ααρων ἐπίγραψον ἐπὶ τῆς ῥάβδου Λευι ἔστιν γὰρ ῥάβδος μία κατὰ φυλὴν οἴκου πατριῶν αὐτῶν δώσουσιν

text_en: And you shall lay them up in the tabernacle of the covenant before the testimony , where I will speak to you.
text_la: ponesque eas in tabernaculo fœderis coram testimonio, ubi loquar ad te.
text_pt: E as porás na tenda da congregação, perante o testemunho, onde eu virei a vós.
text_el: καὶ θήσεις αὐτὰς ἐν τῇ σκηνῇ τοῦ μαρτυρίου κατέναντι τοῦ μαρτυρίου ἐν οἷς γνωσθήσομαί σοι ἐκεῖ

text_en: Whomsoever of these I shall choose, his rod shall blossom: and I will make to cease from me the murmurings of the children of Israel , wherewith they murmur against you.
text_la: Quem ex his elegero, germinabit virga ejus : et cohibebo a me querimonias filiorum Israël, quibus contra vos murmurant.
text_pt: E será que a vara do homem que eu tiver escolhido florescerá; assim farei cessar as murmurações dos filhos de Israel contra mim, com que murmuram contra vós.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ὁ ἄνθρωπος ὃν ἐὰν ἐκλέξωμαι αὐτόν ἡ ῥάβδος αὐτοῦ ἐκβλαστήσει καὶ περιελῶ ἀπ' ἐμοῦ τὸν γογγυσμὸν τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ ἃ αὐτοὶ γογγύζουσιν ἐφ' ὑμῖν

text_en: And Moses spoke to the children of Israel : and all the princes gave him rods one for every tribe: and there were twelve rods besides the rod of Aaron .
text_la: Locutusque est Moyses ad filios Israël : et dederunt ei omnes principes virgas per singulas tribus : fueruntque virgæ duodecim absque virga Aaron.
text_pt: Falou, pois, Moisés aos filhos de Israel; e todos os seus príncipes deram-lhe cada um uma vara, para cada príncipe uma vara, segundo as casas de seus pais, doze varas; e a vara de Arão estava entre as deles.
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν Μωυσῆς τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ καὶ ἔδωκαν αὐτῷ πάντες οἱ ἄρχοντες αὐτῶν ῥάβδον τῷ ἄρχοντι τῷ ἑνὶ ῥάβδον κατὰ ἄρχοντα κατ' οἴκους πατριῶν αὐτῶν δώδεκα ῥάβδους καὶ ἡ ῥάβδος Ααρων ἀνὰ μέσον τῶν ῥάβδων αὐτῶν

text_en: And when Moses had laid them up before the Lord in the tabernacle of the testimony :
text_la: Quas cum posuisset Moyses coram Domino in tabernaculo testimonii,
text_pt: E Moisés pôs estas varas perante o Senhor na tenda do testemunho.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέθηκεν Μωυσῆς τὰς ῥάβδους ἔναντι κυρίου ἐν τῇ σκηνῇ τοῦ μαρτυρίου

text_en: He returned on the following day, and found that the rod of Aaron for the house of Levi , was budded: and that the buds swelling it hid bloomed blossoms, which spreading the leaves, were formed into almonds.
text_la: sequenti die regressus invenit germinasse virgam Aaron in domo Levi : et turgentibus gemmis eruperant flores, qui, foliis dilatatis, in amygdalas deformati sunt.
text_pt: Sucedeu, pois, que no dia seguinte Moisés entrou na tenda do testemunho, e eis que a vara de Arão, pela casa de Levi, florescia; porque produzira flores e brotara renovos e dera amêndoas.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο τῇ ἐπαύριον καὶ εἰσῆλθεν Μωυσῆς καὶ Ααρων εἰς τὴν σκηνὴν τοῦ μαρτυρίου καὶ ἰδοὺ ἐβλάστησεν ἡ ῥάβδος Ααρων εἰς οἶκον Λευι καὶ ἐξήνεγκεν βλαστὸν καὶ ἐξήνθησεν ἄνθη καὶ ἐβλάστησεν κάρυα

text_en: Moses therefore brought out all the rods from before the Lord to all the children of Israel : and they saw, and every one received their rods.
text_la: Protulit ergo Moyses omnes virgas de conspectu Domini ad cunctos filios Israël : videruntque, et receperunt singuli virgas suas.
text_pt: Então Moisés tirou todas as varas de diante do Senhor a todos os filhos de Israel; e eles o viram, e tomaram cada um a sua vara.
text_el: καὶ ἐξήνεγκεν Μωυσῆς πάσας τὰς ῥάβδους ἀπὸ προσώπου κυρίου πρὸς πάντας υἱοὺς Ισραηλ καὶ εἶδον καὶ ἔλαβον ἕκαστος τὴν ῥάβδον αὐτοῦ

text_en: And the Lord said to Moses : Carry back the rod of Aaron into the tabernacle of the testimony , that it may be kept there for a token of the rebellious children of Israel , and that their complaints may cease from me lest they die.
text_la: Dixitque Dominus ad Moysen : Refer virgam Aaron in tabernaculum testimonii, ut servetur ibi in signum rebellium filiorum Israël, et quiescant querelæ eorum a me, ne moriantur.
text_pt: Então o Senhor disse a Moisés: Torna a pôr a vara de Arão perante o testemunho, para que se guarde por sinal para os filhos rebeldes; assim farás acabar as suas murmurações contra mim, e não morrerão.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν ἀπόθες τὴν ῥάβδον Ααρων ἐνώπιον τῶν μαρτυρίων εἰς διατήρησιν σημεῖον τοῖς υἱοῖς τῶν ἀνηκόων καὶ παυσάσθω ὁ γογγυσμὸς αὐτῶν ἀπ' ἐμοῦ καὶ οὐ μὴ ἀποθάνωσιν

text_en: And Moses did as the Lord had commanded.
text_la: Fecitque Moyses sicut præceperat Dominus.
text_pt: E Moisés fez assim; como lhe ordenara o Senhor, assim fez.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησεν Μωυσῆς καὶ Ααρων καθὰ συνέταξεν κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ οὕτως ἐποίησαν

text_en: And the children of Israel said to Moses : Behold we are consumed, we all perish.
text_la: Dixerunt autem filii Israël ad Moysen : Ecce consumpti sumus, omnes perivimus.
text_pt: Então falaram os filhos de Israel a Moisés, dizendo: Eis aqui, nós expiramos, perecemos, nós todos perecemos.
text_el: καὶ εἶπαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ πρὸς Μωυσῆν λέγοντες ἰδοὺ ἐξανηλώμεθα ἀπολώλαμεν παρανηλώμεθα

text_en: Whosoever approaches to the tabernacle of the Lord , he dies. Are we all to a man to be utterly destroyed?
text_la: Quicumque accedit ad tabernaculum Domini, moritur. Num usque ad internecionem cuncti delendi sumus?
text_pt: Todo aquele que se aproximar do tabernáculo do Senhor, morrerá; seremos pois todos consumidos?
text_el: πᾶς ὁ ἁπτόμενος τῆς σκηνῆς κυρίου ἀποθνῄσκει ἕως εἰς τέλος ἀποθάνωμεν

text_en: And the Lord said to Aaron : You, and your sons, and your father's house with you shall bear the iniquity of the sanctuary: and you and your sons with you shall bear the sins of your priesthood .
text_la: Dixitque Dominus ad Aaron : Tu, et filii tui, et domus patris tui tecum, portabitis iniquitatem sanctuarii : et tu et filii tui simul sustinebitis peccata sacerdotii vestri.
text_pt: Então disse o SENHOR a Arão: Tu, e teus filhos, e a casa de teu pai contigo, levareis sobre vós a iniqüidade do santuário; e tu e teus filhos contigo levareis sobre vós a iniqüidade do vosso sacerdócio.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρὸς Ααρων λέγων σὺ καὶ οἱ υἱοί σου καὶ ὁ οἶκος πατριᾶς σου λήμψεσθε τὰς ἁμαρτίας τῶν ἁγίων καὶ σὺ καὶ οἱ υἱοί σου λήμψεσθε τὰς ἁμαρτίας τῆς ἱερατείας ὑμῶν

text_en: And take with you your brethren also of the tribe of Levi , and the sceptre of your father, and let them be ready in hand, and minister to you: but you and your sons shall minister in the tabernacle of the testimony .
text_la: Sed et fratres tuos de tribu Levi, et sceptrum patris tui sume tecum, præstoque sint, et ministrent tibi : tu autem et filii tui ministrabitis in tabernaculo testimonii.
text_pt: E também farás chegar contigo a teus irmãos, a tribo de Levi, a tribo de teu pai, para que se ajuntem a ti, e te sirvam; mas tu e teus filhos contigo estareis perante a tenda do testemunho.
text_el: καὶ τοὺς ἀδελφούς σου φυλὴν Λευι δῆμον τοῦ πατρός σου προσαγάγου πρὸς σεαυτόν καὶ προστεθήτωσάν σοι καὶ λειτουργείτωσάν σοι καὶ σὺ καὶ οἱ υἱοί σου μετὰ σοῦ ἀπέναντι τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου

text_en: And the Levites shall watch to do your commands, and about all the works of the tabernacle : only they shall not come near the vessels of the sanctuary nor the altar , lest both they die, and you also perish with them.
text_la: Excubabuntque Levitæ ad præcepta tua, et ad cuncta opera tabernaculi : ita dumtaxat ut ad vasa sanctuarii et ad altare non accedant, ne et illi moriantur, et vos pereatis simul.
text_pt: E eles cumprirão as tuas ordens e terão o encargo de toda a tenda; mas não se chegarão aos utensílios do santuário, nem ao altar, para que não morram, tanto eles como vós.
text_el: καὶ φυλάξονται τὰς φυλακάς σου καὶ τὰς φυλακὰς τῆς σκηνῆς πλὴν πρὸς τὰ σκεύη τὰ ἅγια καὶ πρὸς τὸ θυσιαστήριον οὐ προσελεύσονται καὶ οὐκ ἀποθανοῦνται καὶ οὗτοι καὶ ὑμεῖς

text_en: But let them be with you, and watch in the charge of the tabernacle , and in all the ceremonies thereof. A stranger shall not join himself with you.
text_la: Sint autem tecum, et excubent in custodiis tabernaculi, et in omnibus cæremoniis ejus. Alienigena non miscebitur vobis.
text_pt: Mas se ajuntarão a ti, e farão o serviço da tenda da congregação em todo o ministério da tenda; e o estranho não se chegará a vós.
text_el: καὶ προστεθήσονται πρὸς σὲ καὶ φυλάξονται τὰς φυλακὰς τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου κατὰ πάσας τὰς λειτουργίας τῆς σκηνῆς καὶ ὁ ἀλλογενὴς οὐ προσελεύσεται πρὸς σέ

text_en: Watch in the charge of the sanctuary, and in the ministry of the altar : lest indignation rise upon the children of Israel .
text_la: Excubate in custodia sanctuarii, et in ministerio altaris : ne oriatur indignatio super filios Israël.
text_pt: Vós, pois, fareis o serviço do santuário e o serviço do altar; para que não haja outra vez furor sobre os filhos de Israel.
text_el: καὶ φυλάξεσθε τὰς φυλακὰς τῶν ἁγίων καὶ τὰς φυλακὰς τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου καὶ οὐκ ἔσται θυμὸς ἐν τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ

text_en: I have given you your brethren the Levites from among the children of Israel , and have delivered them for a gift to the Lord , to serve in the ministries of the tabernacle .
text_la: Ego dedi vobis fratres vestros Levitas de medio filiorum Israël, et tradidi donum Domino, ut serviant in ministeriis tabernaculi ejus.
text_pt: E eu, eis que tenho tomado vossos irmãos, os levitas, do meio dos filhos de Israel; são dados a vós em dádiva pelo Senhor, para que sirvam ao ministério da tenda da congregação.
text_el: καὶ ἐγὼ εἴληφα τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς ὑμῶν τοὺς Λευίτας ἐκ μέσου τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ δόμα δεδομένον κυρίῳ λειτουργεῖν τὰς λειτουργίας τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου

text_en: But you and your sons, look to the priesthood : and all things that pertain to the service of the altar , and that are within the veil, shall be executed by the priests . If any stranger shall approach, he shall be slain .
text_la: Tu autem et filii tui custodite sacerdotium vestrum : et omnia quæ ad cultum altaris pertinent, et intra velum sunt, per sacerdotes administrabuntur : si quis externus accesserit, occidetur.
text_pt: Mas tu e teus filhos contigo cumprireis o vosso sacerdócio no tocante a tudo o que é do altar, e a tudo o que está dentro do véu, nisso servireis; eu vos tenho dado o vosso sacerdócio em dádiva ministerial e o estranho que se chegar morrerá.
text_el: καὶ σὺ καὶ οἱ υἱοί σου μετὰ σοῦ διατηρήσετε τὴν ἱερατείαν ὑμῶν κατὰ πάντα τρόπον τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου καὶ τὸ ἔνδοθεν τοῦ καταπετάσματος καὶ λειτουργήσετε τὰς λειτουργίας δόμα τῆς ἱερατείας ὑμῶν καὶ ὁ ἀλλογενὴς ὁ προσπορευόμενος ἀποθανεῖται

text_en: And the Lord said to Aaron : Behold I have given you the charge of my firstfruits . All things that are sanctified by the children of Israel , I have delivered to you and to your sons for the priestly office , by everlasting ordinances .
text_la: Locutusque est Dominus ad Aaron : Ecce dedi tibi custodiam primitiarum mearum. Omnia quæ sanctificantur a filiis Israël, tradidi tibi et filiis tuis pro officio sacerdotali legitima sempiterna.
text_pt: Disse mais o Senhor a Arão: Eis que eu te tenho dado a guarda das minhas ofertas alçadas, com todas as coisas santas dos filhos de Israel; por causa da unção as tenho dado a ti e a teus filhos por estatuto perpétuo.
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρὸς Ααρων καὶ ἐγὼ ἰδοὺ δέδωκα ὑμῖν τὴν διατήρησιν τῶν ἀπαρχῶν ἀπὸ πάντων τῶν ἡγιασμένων μοι παρὰ τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ σοὶ δέδωκα αὐτὰ εἰς γέρας καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς σου μετὰ σέ νόμιμον αἰώνιον

text_en: These therefore shall you take of the things that are sanctified , and are offered to the Lord . Every offering , and sacrifice , and whatsoever is rendered to me for sin and for trespass, and becomes holy of holies, shall be for you and your sons.
text_la: Hæc ergo accipies de his, quæ sanctificantur et oblata sunt Domino. Omnis oblatio, et sacrificium, et quidquid pro peccato atque delicto redditur mihi, et cedit in Sancta sanctorum, tuum erit, et filiorum tuorum.
text_pt: Isto terás das coisas santíssimas do fogo; todas as suas ofertas com todas as suas ofertas de alimentos, e com todas as suas expiações pelo pecado, e com todas as suas expiações pela culpa, que me apresentarão; serão coisas santíssimas para ti e para teus filhos.
text_el: καὶ τοῦτο ἔστω ὑμῖν ἀπὸ τῶν ἡγιασμένων ἁγίων τῶν καρπωμάτων ἀπὸ πάντων τῶν δώρων αὐτῶν καὶ ἀπὸ πάντων τῶν θυσιασμάτων αὐτῶν καὶ ἀπὸ πάσης πλημμελείας αὐτῶν καὶ ἀπὸ πασῶν τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν ὅσα ἀποδιδόασίν μοι ἀπὸ πάντων τῶν ἁγίων σοὶ ἔσται καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς σου

text_en: You shall eat it in the sanctuary: the males only shall eat thereof, because it is a consecrated thing to you.
text_la: In sanctuario comedes illud : mares tantum edent ex eo, quia consecratum est tibi.
text_pt: No lugar santíssimo as comerás; todo o homem a comerá; santas serão para ti.
text_el: ἐν τῷ ἁγίῳ τῶν ἁγίων φάγεσθε αὐτά πᾶν ἀρσενικὸν φάγεται αὐτά σὺ καὶ οἱ υἱοί σου ἅγια ἔσται σοι

text_en: But the firstfruits , which the children of Israel shall vow and offer, I have given to you, and to your sons, and to your daughters, by a perpetual law . He that is clean in your house, shall eat them.
text_la: Primitias autem, quas voverint et obtulerint filii Israël, tibi dedi, et filiis tuis, ac filiabus tuis, jure perpetuo : qui mundus est in domo tua, vescetur eis.
text_pt: Também isto será teu: a oferta alçada dos seus dons com todas as ofertas movidas dos filhos de Israel; a ti, a teus filhos, e a tuas filhas contigo, as tenho dado por estatuto perpétuo; todo o que estiver limpo na tua casa, delas comerá.
text_el: καὶ τοῦτο ἔσται ὑμῖν ἀπαρχὴ δομάτων αὐτῶν ἀπὸ πάντων τῶν ἐπιθεμάτων τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ σοὶ δέδωκα αὐτὰ καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς σου καὶ ταῖς θυγατράσιν σου μετὰ σοῦ νόμιμον αἰώνιον πᾶς καθαρὸς ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ σου ἔδεται αὐτά

text_en: All the best of the oil, and of the wine, and of the corn, whatsoever firstfruits they offer to the Lord , I have given them to you.
text_la: Omnem medullam olei, et vini, ac frumenti, quidquid offerunt primitiarum Domino, tibi dedi.
text_pt: Todo o melhor do azeite, e todo o melhor do mosto e do grão, as suas primícias que derem ao Senhor, as tenho dado a ti.
text_el: πᾶσα ἀπαρχὴ ἐλαίου καὶ πᾶσα ἀπαρχὴ οἴνου καὶ σίτου ἀπαρχὴ αὐτῶν ὅσα ἂν δῶσι τῷ κυρίῳ σοὶ δέδωκα αὐτά

text_en: All the firstripe of the fruits, that the ground brings forth, and which are brought to the Lord , shall be for your use: he that is clean in your house, shall eat them.
text_la: Universa frugum initia, quas gignit humus, et Domino deportantur, cedent in usus tuos : qui mundus est in domo tua, vescetur eis.
text_pt: Os primeiros frutos de tudo que houver na terra, que trouxerem ao Senhor, serão teus; todo o que estiver limpo na tua casa os comerá.
text_el: τὰ πρωτογενήματα πάντα ὅσα ἐν τῇ γῇ αὐτῶν ὅσα ἂν ἐνέγκωσιν κυρίῳ σοὶ ἔσται πᾶς καθαρὸς ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ σου ἔδεται αὐτά

text_en: Every thing that the children of Israel shall give by vow , shall be yours.
text_la: Omne quod ex voto reddiderint filii Israël, tuum erit.
text_pt: Toda a coisa consagrada em Israel será tua.
text_el: πᾶν ἀνατεθεματισμένον ἐν υἱοῖς Ισραηλ σοὶ ἔσται

text_en: Whatsoever is firstborn of all flesh, which they offer to the Lord , whether it be of men , or of beasts, shall belong to you: only for the firstborn of man you shall take a price, and every beast that is unclean you shall cause to be redeemed ,
text_la: Quidquid primum erumpit e vulva cunctæ carnis, quam offerunt Domino, sive ex hominibus, sive de pecoribus fuerit, tui juris erit : ita dumtaxat ut pro hominis primogenito pretium accipias, et omne animal quod immundum est redimi facias,
text_pt: Tudo que abrir a madre, e toda a carne que trouxerem ao Senhor, tanto de homens como de animais, será teu; porém os primogênitos dos homens resgatarás; também os primogênitos dos animais imundos resgatarás.
text_el: καὶ πᾶν διανοῖγον μήτραν ἀπὸ πάσης σαρκός ἃ προσφέρουσιν κυρίῳ ἀπὸ ἀνθρώπου ἕως κτήνους σοὶ ἔσται ἀλλ' ἢ λύτροις λυτρωθήσεται τὰ πρωτότοκα τῶν ἀνθρώπων καὶ τὰ πρωτότοκα τῶν κτηνῶν τῶν ἀκαθάρτων λυτρώσῃ

text_en: and the redemption of it shall be after one month, for five sicles of silver, by the weight of the sanctuary. A sicle has twenty obols.
text_la: cujus redemptio erit post unum mensem, siclis argenti quinque, pondere sanctuarii. Siclus viginti obolos habet.
text_pt: Os que deles se houverem de resgatar resgatarás, da idade de um mês, segundo a tua avaliação, por cinco siclos de dinheiro, segundo o siclo do santuário, que é de vinte geras.
text_el: καὶ ἡ λύτρωσις αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ μηνιαίου ἡ συντίμησις πέντε σίκλων κατὰ τὸν σίκλον τὸν ἅγιον εἴκοσι ὄβολοί εἰσιν

text_en: But the firstling of a cow, and of a sheep and of a goat you shall not cause to be redeemed , because they are sanctified to the Lord . Their blood only you shall pour upon the altar , and their fat you shall burn for a most sweet odour to the Lord .
text_la: Primogenitum autem bovis, et ovis, et capræ, non facies redimi, quia sanctificata sunt Domino. Sanguinem tantum eorum fundes super altare, et adipes adolebis in suavissimum odorem Domino.
text_pt: Mas o primogênito de vaca, ou primogênito de ovelha, ou primogênito de cabra, não resgatarás, santos são; o seu sangue espargirás sobre o altar, e a sua gordura queimarás em oferta queimada de cheiro suave ao Senhor.
text_el: πλὴν πρωτότοκα μόσχων καὶ πρωτότοκα προβάτων καὶ πρωτότοκα αἰγῶν οὐ λυτρώσῃ ἅγιά ἐστιν καὶ τὸ αἷμα αὐτῶν προσχεεῖς πρὸς τὸ θυσιαστήριον καὶ τὸ στέαρ ἀνοίσεις κάρπωμα εἰς ὀσμὴν εὐωδίας κυρίῳ

text_en: But the flesh shall fall to your use, as the consecrated breast, and the right shoulder shall be yours.
text_la: Carnes vero in usum tuum cedent, sicut pectusculum consecratum, et armus dexter : tua erunt.
text_pt: E a carne deles será tua; assim como o peito da oferta de movimento, e o ombro direito, teus serão.
text_el: καὶ τὰ κρέα ἔσται σοί καθὰ καὶ τὸ στηθύνιον τοῦ ἐπιθέματος καὶ κατὰ τὸν βραχίονα τὸν δεξιὸν σοὶ ἔσται

text_en: All the firstfruits of the sanctuary which the children of Israel offer to the Lord , I have given to you and to your sons and daughters, by a perpetual ordinance . It is a covenant of salt for ever before the Lord , to you and to your sons.
text_la: Omnes primitias sanctuarii, quas offerunt filii Israël Domino, tibi dedi, et filiis, ac filiabus tuis, jure perpetuo. Pactum salis est sempiternum coram Domino, tibi ac filiis tuis.
text_pt: Todas as ofertas alçadas das coisas santas, que os filhos de Israel oferecerem ao Senhor, tenho dado a ti, e a teus filhos e a tuas filhas contigo, por estatuto perpétuo; aliança perpétua de sal perante o Senhor é, para ti e para a tua descendência contigo.
