text_el: πᾶν ἀφαίρεμα τῶν ἁγίων ὅσα ἂν ἀφέλωσιν οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ κυρίῳ σοὶ δέδωκα καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς σου καὶ ταῖς θυγατράσιν σου μετὰ σοῦ νόμιμον αἰώνιον διαθήκη ἁλὸς αἰωνίου ἐστὶν ἔναντι κυρίου σοὶ καὶ τῷ σπέρματί σου μετὰ σέ

text_en: And the Lord said to Aaron : You shall possess nothing in their land, neither shall you have a portion among them: I am your portion and inheritance in the midst of the children of Israel .
text_la: Dixitque Dominus ad Aaron : In terra eorum nihil possidebitis, nec habebitis partem inter eos : ego pars et hæreditas tua in medio filiorum Israël.
text_pt: Disse também o Senhor a Arão: Na sua terra herança nenhuma terás, e no meio deles, nenhuma parte terás; eu sou a tua parte e a tua herança no meio dos filhos de Israel.
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρὸς Ααρων ἐν τῇ γῇ αὐτῶν οὐ κληρονομήσεις καὶ μερὶς οὐκ ἔσται σοι ἐν αὐτοῖς ὅτι ἐγὼ μερίς σου καὶ κληρονομία σου ἐν μέσῳ τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ

text_en: And I have given to the sons of Levi all the tithes of Israel for a possession, for the ministry wherewith they serve me in the tabernacle of the covenant :
text_la: Filiis autem Levi dedi omnes decimas Israëlis in possessionem, pro ministerio, quo serviunt mihi in tabernaculo fœderis:
text_pt: E eis que aos filhos de Levi tenho dado todos os dízimos em Israel por herança, pelo ministério que executam, o ministério da tenda da congregação.
text_el: καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς Λευι ἰδοὺ δέδωκα πᾶν ἐπιδέκατον ἐν Ισραηλ ἐν κλήρῳ ἀντὶ τῶν λειτουργιῶν αὐτῶν ὅσα αὐτοὶ λειτουργοῦσιν λειτουργίαν ἐν τῇ σκηνῇ τοῦ μαρτυρίου

text_en: That the children of Israel may not approach any more to the tabernacle , nor commit deadly sin ,
text_la: ut non accedant ultra filii Israël ad tabernaculum, nec committant peccatum mortiferum,
text_pt: E nunca mais os filhos de Israel se chegarão à tenda da congregação, para que não levem sobre si o pecado e morram.
text_el: καὶ οὐ προσελεύσονται ἔτι οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ εἰς τὴν σκηνὴν τοῦ μαρτυρίου λαβεῖν ἁμαρτίαν θανατηφόρον

text_en: but only the sons of Levi may serve me in the tabernacle , and bear the sins of the people. It shall be an everlasting ordinance in your generations . They shall not possess any other thing ,
text_la: solis filiis Levi mihi in tabernaculo servientibus, et portantibus peccata populi. Legitimum sempiternum erit in generationibus vestris. Nihil aliud possidebunt,
text_pt: Mas os levitas executarão o ministério da tenda da congregação, e eles levarão sobre si a sua iniqüidade; pelas vossas gerações estatuto perpétuo será; e no meio dos filhos de Israel nenhuma herança terão,
text_el: καὶ λειτουργήσει ὁ Λευίτης αὐτὸς τὴν λειτουργίαν τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου καὶ αὐτοὶ λήμψονται τὰ ἁμαρτήματα αὐτῶν νόμιμον αἰώνιον εἰς τὰς γενεὰς αὐτῶν καὶ ἐν μέσῳ υἱῶν Ισραηλ οὐ κληρονομήσουσιν κληρονομίαν

text_en: but be content with the oblation or tithes , which I have separated for their uses and necessities.
text_la: decimarum oblatione contenti, quas in usus eorum et necessaria separavi.
text_pt: Porque os dízimos dos filhos de Israel, que oferecerem ao Senhor em oferta alçada, tenho dado por herança aos levitas; porquanto eu lhes disse: No meio dos filhos de Israel nenhuma herança terão.
text_el: ὅτι τὰ ἐπιδέκατα τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ ὅσα ἂν ἀφορίσωσιν κυρίῳ ἀφαίρεμα δέδωκα τοῖς Λευίταις ἐν κλήρῳ διὰ τοῦτο εἴρηκα αὐτοῖς ἐν μέσῳ υἱῶν Ισραηλ οὐ κληρονομήσουσιν κλῆρον

text_en: And the Lord spoke to Moses , saying:
text_la: Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen, dicens:
text_pt: E falou o Senhor a Moisés, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν λέγων

text_en: Command the Levites , and declare unto them: When you shall receive of the children of Israel the tithes , which I have given you, offer the firstfruits of them to the Lord , that is to say, the tenth part of the tenth:
text_la: Præcipe Levitis, atque denuntia : Cum acceperitis a filiis Israël decimas, quas dedi vobis, primitias earum offerte Domino, id est, decimam partem decimæ,
text_pt: Também falarás aos levitas, e dir-lhes-ás: Quando receberdes os dízimos dos filhos de Israel, que eu deles vos tenho dado por vossa herança, deles oferecereis uma oferta alçada ao Senhor, os dízimos dos dízimos.
text_el: καὶ τοῖς Λευίταις λαλήσεις καὶ ἐρεῖς πρὸς αὐτούς ἐὰν λάβητε παρὰ τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ τὸ ἐπιδέκατον ὃ δέδωκα ὑμῖν παρ' αὐτῶν ἐν κλήρῳ καὶ ἀφελεῖτε ὑμεῖς ἀπ' αὐτοῦ ἀφαίρεμα κυρίῳ ἐπιδέκατον ἀπὸ τοῦ ἐπιδεκάτου

text_en: That it may be reckoned to you as an oblation of firstfruits , as well of the barnfloors as of the winepresses:
text_la: ut reputetur vobis in oblationem primitivorum, tam de areis quam de torcularibus:
text_pt: E contar-se-vos-á a vossa oferta alçada, como grão da eira, e como plenitude do lagar.
text_el: καὶ λογισθήσεται ὑμῖν τὰ ἀφαιρέματα ὑμῶν ὡς σῖτος ἀπὸ ἅλω καὶ ἀφαίρεμα ἀπὸ ληνοῦ

text_en: And of all the things of which you receive tithes , offer the firstfruits to the Lord , and give them to Aaron the priest .
text_la: et universis quorum accipitis primitias, offerte Domino, et date Aaron sacerdoti.
text_pt: Assim também oferecereis ao Senhor uma oferta alçada de todos os vossos dízimos, que receberdes dos filhos de Israel, e deles dareis a oferta alçada do Senhor a Arão, o sacerdote.
text_el: οὕτως ἀφελεῖτε καὶ ὑμεῖς ἀπὸ τῶν ἀφαιρεμάτων κυρίου ἀπὸ πάντων ἐπιδεκάτων ὑμῶν ὅσα ἐὰν λάβητε παρὰ τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ καὶ δώσετε ἀπ' αὐτῶν ἀφαίρεμα κυρίῳ Ααρων τῷ ἱερεῖ

text_en: All the things that you shall offer of the tithes , and shall separate for the gifts of the Lord , shall be the best and choicest things.
text_la: Omnia quæ offeretis ex decimis, et in donaria Domini separabitis, optima et electa erunt.
text_pt: De todas as vossas dádivas oferecereis toda a oferta alçada do Senhor; de tudo o melhor deles, a sua santa parte.
text_el: ἀπὸ πάντων τῶν δομάτων ὑμῶν ἀφελεῖτε ἀφαίρεμα κυρίῳ ἢ ἀπὸ πάντων τῶν ἀπαρχῶν τὸ ἡγιασμένον ἀπ' αὐτοῦ

text_en: And you shall say to them: If you offer all the goodly and the better things of the tithes , it shall be reckoned to you as if you had given the firstfruits of the barnfloor and the winepress:
text_la: Dicesque ad eos : Si præclara et meliora quæque obtuleritis ex decimis, reputabitur vobis quasi de area, et torculari dederitis primitias:
text_pt: Dir-lhes-ás pois: Quando oferecerdes o melhor deles, como novidade da eira, e como novidade do lagar, se contará aos levitas.
text_el: καὶ ἐρεῖς πρὸς αὐτούς ὅταν ἀφαιρῆτε τὴν ἀπαρχὴν ἀπ' αὐτοῦ καὶ λογισθήσεται τοῖς Λευίταις ὡς γένημα ἀπὸ ἅλω καὶ ὡς γένημα ἀπὸ ληνοῦ

text_en: And you shall eat them in all your places, both you and your families : because it is your reward for the ministry, wherewith you serve in the tabernacle of the testimony .
text_la: et comedetis eas in omnibus locis vestris, tam vos quam familiæ vestræ : quia pretium est pro ministerio, quo servitis in tabernaculo testimonii.
text_pt: E o comereis em todo o lugar, vós e as vossas famílias, porque vosso galardão é pelo vosso ministério na tenda da congregação.
text_el: καὶ ἔδεσθε αὐτὸ ἐν παντὶ τόπῳ ὑμεῖς καὶ οἱ οἶκοι ὑμῶν ὅτι μισθὸς οὗτος ὑμῖν ἐστιν ἀντὶ τῶν λειτουργιῶν ὑμῶν τῶν ἐν τῇ σκηνῇ τοῦ μαρτυρίου

text_en: And you shall not sin in this point, by reserving the choicest and fat things to yourselves, lest you profane the oblations of the children of Israel , and die.
text_la: Et non peccabitis super hoc, egregia vobis et pinguia reservantes, ne polluatis oblationes filiorum Israël, et moriamini.
text_pt: Assim, não levareis sobre vós o pecado, quando deles oferecerdes o melhor; e não profanareis as coisas santas dos filhos de Israel, para que não morrais.
text_el: καὶ οὐ λήμψεσθε δι' αὐτὸ ἁμαρτίαν ὅτι ἂν ἀφαιρῆτε τὴν ἀπαρχὴν ἀπ' αὐτοῦ καὶ τὰ ἅγια τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ οὐ βεβηλώσετε ἵνα μὴ ἀποθάνητε

text_en: And the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron , saying:
text_la: Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen et Aaron, dicens:
text_pt: Falou mais o SENHOR a Moisés e a Arão dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν καὶ Ααρων λέγων

text_en: This is the observance of the victim, which the Lord has ordained. Command the children of Israel , that they bring unto you a red cow of full age, in which there is no blemish, and which has not carried the yoke:
text_la: Ista est religio victimæ, quam constituit Dominus. Præcipe filiis Israël, ut adducant ad te vaccam rufam ætatis integræ, in qua nulla sit macula, nec portaverit jugum:
text_pt: Este é o estatuto da lei, que o Senhor ordenou, dizendo: Dize aos filhos de Israel que te tragam uma novilha ruiva, que não tenha defeito, e sobre a qual não tenha sido posto jugo.
text_el: αὕτη ἡ διαστολὴ τοῦ νόμου ὅσα συνέταξεν κύριος λέγων λάλησον τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ καὶ λαβέτωσαν πρὸς σὲ δάμαλιν πυρρὰν ἄμωμον ἥτις οὐκ ἔχει ἐν αὐτῇ μῶμον καὶ ᾗ οὐκ ἐπεβλήθη ἐπ' αὐτὴν ζυγός

text_en: And you shall deliver her to Eleazar the priest , who shall bring her forth without the camp, and shall immolate her in the sight of all:
text_la: tradetisque eam Eleazaro sacerdoti, qui eductam extra castra, immolabit in conspectu omnium:
text_pt: E a dareis a Eleazar, o sacerdote; ele a tirará para fora do arraial, e degolar-se-á diante dele.
text_el: καὶ δώσεις αὐτὴν πρὸς Ελεαζαρ τὸν ἱερέα καὶ ἐξάξουσιν αὐτὴν ἔξω τῆς παρεμβολῆς εἰς τόπον καθαρὸν καὶ σφάξουσιν αὐτὴν ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ

text_en: And dipping his finger in her blood, shall sprinkle it over against the door of the tabernacle seven times,
text_la: et tingens digitum in sanguine ejus, asperget contra fores tabernaculi septem vicibus,
text_pt: E Eleazar, o sacerdote, tomará do seu sangue com o seu dedo, e dele espargirá para a frente da tenda da congregação sete vezes.
text_el: καὶ λήμψεται Ελεαζαρ ἀπὸ τοῦ αἵματος αὐτῆς καὶ ῥανεῖ ἀπέναντι τοῦ προσώπου τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου ἀπὸ τοῦ αἵματος αὐτῆς ἑπτάκις

text_en: and shall burn her in the sight of all delivering up to the fire her skin, and her flesh, and her blood, and her dung.
text_la: comburetque eam cunctis videntibus, tam pelle et carnibus ejus quam sanguine et fimo flammæ traditis.
text_pt: Então queimará a novilha perante os seus olhos; o seu couro, e a sua carne, e o seu sangue, com o seu esterco, se queimará.
text_el: καὶ κατακαύσουσιν αὐτὴν ἐναντίον αὐτοῦ καὶ τὸ δέρμα καὶ τὰ κρέα αὐτῆς καὶ τὸ αἷμα αὐτῆς σὺν τῇ κόπρῳ αὐτῆς κατακαυθήσεται

text_en: The priest shall also take cedar wood , and hyssop , and scarlet twice dyed, and cast it into the flame, with which the cow is consumed.
text_la: Lignum quoque cedrinum, et hyssopum, coccumque bis tinctum sacerdos mittet in flammam, quæ vaccam vorat.
text_pt: E o sacerdote tomará pau de cedro, e hissopo, e carmesim, e os lançará no meio do fogo que queima a novilha.
text_el: καὶ λήμψεται ὁ ἱερεὺς ξύλον κέδρινον καὶ ὕσσωπον καὶ κόκκινον καὶ ἐμβαλοῦσιν εἰς μέσον τοῦ κατακαύματος τῆς δαμάλεως

text_en: And then after washing his garments, and body, he shall enter into the camp, and shall be unclean until the evening.
text_la: Et tunc demum, lotis vestibus et corpore suo, ingredietur in castra, commaculatusque erit usque ad vesperum.
text_pt: Então o sacerdote lavará as suas vestes, e banhará a sua carne na água, e depois entrará no arraial; e o sacerdote será imundo até à tarde.
text_el: καὶ πλυνεῖ τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτοῦ ὁ ἱερεὺς καὶ λούσεται τὸ σῶμα αὐτοῦ ὕδατι καὶ μετὰ ταῦτα εἰσελεύσεται εἰς τὴν παρεμβολήν καὶ ἀκάθαρτος ἔσται ὁ ἱερεὺς ἕως ἑσπέρας

text_en: He also that has burned her, shall wash his garments, and his body, and shall be unclean until the evening.
text_la: Sed et ille qui combusserit eam, lavabit vestimenta sua et corpus, et immundus erit usque ad vesperum.
text_pt: Também o que a queimou lavará as suas vestes com água, e em água banhará a sua carne, e imundo será até à tarde.
text_el: καὶ ὁ κατακαίων αὐτὴν πλυνεῖ τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτοῦ καὶ λούσεται τὸ σῶμα αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀκάθαρτος ἔσται ἕως ἑσπέρας

text_en: And a man that is clean shall gather up the ashes of the cow, and shall pour them forth without the camp in a most clean place, that they may be reserved for the multitude of the children of Israel , and for a water of aspersion: because the cow was burnt for sin .
text_la: Colliget autem vir mundus cineres vaccæ, et effundet eos extra castra in loco purissimo, ut sint multitudini filiorum Israël in custodiam, et in aquam aspersionis : quia pro peccato vacca combusta est.
text_pt: E um homem limpo ajuntará a cinza da novilha, e a porá fora do arraial, num lugar limpo, e ficará ela guardada para a congregação dos filhos de Israel, para a água da separação; expiação é.
text_el: καὶ συνάξει ἄνθρωπος καθαρὸς τὴν σποδὸν τῆς δαμάλεως καὶ ἀποθήσει ἔξω τῆς παρεμβολῆς εἰς τόπον καθαρόν καὶ ἔσται τῇ συναγωγῇ υἱῶν Ισραηλ εἰς διατήρησιν ὕδωρ ῥαντισμοῦ ἅγνισμά ἐστιν

text_en: And when he that carried the ashes of the cow, has washed his garments, he shall be unclean until the evening. The children of Israel , and the strangers that dwell among them, shall observe this for a holy thing by a perpetual ordinance .
text_la: Cumque laverit qui vaccæ portaverat cineres vestimenta sua, immundus erit usque ad vesperum. Habebunt hoc filii Israël, et advenæ qui habitant inter eos, sanctum jure perpetuo.
text_pt: E o que apanhou a cinza da novilha lavará as suas vestes, e será imundo até à tarde; isto será por estatuto perpétuo aos filhos de Israel e ao estrangeiro que peregrina no meio deles.
text_el: καὶ πλυνεῖ τὰ ἱμάτια ὁ συνάγων τὴν σποδιὰν τῆς δαμάλεως καὶ ἀκάθαρτος ἔσται ἕως ἑσπέρας καὶ ἔσται τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ καὶ τοῖς προσκειμένοις προσηλύτοις νόμιμον αἰώνιον

text_en: He that touches the corpse of a man , and is therefore unclean seven days,
text_la: Qui tetigerit cadaver hominis, et propter hoc septem diebus fuerit immundus,
text_pt: Aquele que tocar em algum morto, cadáver de algum homem, imundo será sete dias.
text_el: ὁ ἁπτόμενος τοῦ τεθνηκότος πάσης ψυχῆς ἀνθρώπου ἀκάθαρτος ἔσται ἑπτὰ ἡμέρας

text_en: shall be sprinkled with this water on the third day, and on the seventh, and so shall be cleansed. If he were not sprinkled on the third day, he cannot be cleansed on the seventh.
text_la: aspergetur ex hac aqua die tertio et septimo, et sic mundabitur. Si die tertio aspersus non fuerit, septimo non poterit emundari.
text_pt: Ao terceiro dia se purificará com aquela água, e ao sétimo dia será limpo; mas, se ao terceiro dia se não purificar, não será limpo ao sétimo dia.
text_el: οὗτος ἁγνισθήσεται τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ τρίτῃ καὶ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ ἑβδόμῃ καὶ καθαρὸς ἔσται ἐὰν δὲ μὴ ἀφαγνισθῇ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ τρίτῃ καὶ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ ἑβδόμῃ οὐ καθαρὸς ἔσται

text_en: Every one that touches the corpse of a man , and is not sprinkled with this mixture, shall profane the tabernacle of the Lord , and shall perish out of Israel : because he was not sprinkled with the water of expiation, he shall be unclean , and his uncleanness shall remain upon him.
text_la: Omnis qui tetigerit humanæ animæ morticinum, et aspersus hac commistione non fuerit, polluet tabernaculum Domini et peribit ex Israël : quia aqua expiationis non est aspersus, immundus erit, et manebit spurcitia ejus super eum.
text_pt: Todo aquele que tocar em algum morto, cadáver de algum homem, e não se purificar, contamina o tabernáculo do Senhor; e aquela pessoa será extirpada de Israel; porque a água da separação não foi espargida sobre ele, imundo será; está nele ainda a sua imundícia.
text_el: πᾶς ὁ ἁπτόμενος τοῦ τεθνηκότος ἀπὸ ψυχῆς ἀνθρώπου ἐὰν ἀποθάνῃ καὶ μὴ ἀφαγνισθῇ τὴν σκηνὴν κυρίου ἐμίανεν ἐκτριβήσεται ἡ ψυχὴ ἐκείνη ἐξ Ισραηλ ὅτι ὕδωρ ῥαντισμοῦ οὐ περιερραντίσθη ἐπ' αὐτόν ἀκάθαρτός ἐστιν ἔτι ἡ ἀκαθαρσία αὐτοῦ ἐν αὐτῷ ἐστιν

text_en: This is the law of a man that dies in a tent: All that go into his tent and all the vessels that are there, shall be unclean seven days.
text_la: Ista est lex hominis qui moritur in tabernaculo : omnes qui ingrediuntur tentorium illius, et universa vasa quæ ibi sunt, polluta erunt septem diebus.
text_pt: Esta é a lei, quando morrer algum homem em alguma tenda, todo aquele que entrar naquela tenda, e todo aquele que nela estiver, será imundo sete dias.
text_el: καὶ οὗτος ὁ νόμος ἄνθρωπος ἐὰν ἀποθάνῃ ἐν οἰκίᾳ πᾶς ὁ εἰσπορευόμενος εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν καὶ ὅσα ἐστὶν ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ ἀκάθαρτα ἔσται ἑπτὰ ἡμέρας

text_en: The vessel that has no cover, nor binding over it, shall be unclean .
text_la: Vas, quod non habuerit operculum nec ligaturam desuper, immundum erit.
text_pt: Também todo o vaso aberto, sobre o qual não houver pano atado, será imundo.
text_el: καὶ πᾶν σκεῦος ἀνεῳγμένον ὅσα οὐχὶ δεσμὸν καταδέδεται ἐπ' αὐτῷ ἀκάθαρτά ἐστιν

text_en: If any man in the field touch the corpse of a man that was slain , or that died of himself, or his bone, or his grave, he shall be unclean seven days.
text_la: Si quis in agro tetigerit cadaver occisi hominis, aut per se mortui, sive os illius, vel sepulchrum, immundus erit septem diebus.
text_pt: E todo aquele que sobre a face do campo tocar em alguém que for morto pela espada, ou em outro morto ou nos ossos de algum homem, ou numa sepultura, será imundo sete dias.
text_el: καὶ πᾶς ὃς ἐὰν ἅψηται ἐπὶ προσώπου τοῦ πεδίου τραυματίου ἢ νεκροῦ ἢ ὀστέου ἀνθρωπίνου ἢ μνήματος ἑπτὰ ἡμέρας ἀκάθαρτος ἔσται

text_en: And they shall take of the ashes of the burning and of the sin offering , and shall pour living waters upon them into a vessel.
text_la: Tollentque de cineribus combustionis atque peccati, et mittent aquas vivas super eos in vas:
text_pt: Para um imundo, pois, tomarão da cinza da queima da expiação, e sobre ela colocarão água corrente num vaso.
text_el: καὶ λήμψονται τῷ ἀκαθάρτῳ ἀπὸ τῆς σποδιᾶς τῆς κατακεκαυμένης τοῦ ἁγνισμοῦ καὶ ἐκχεοῦσιν ἐπ' αὐτὴν ὕδωρ ζῶν εἰς σκεῦος

text_en: And a man that is clean shall dip hyssop in them, and shall sprinkle therewith all the tent, and all the furniture, and the men that are defiled with touching any such thing:
text_la: in quibus cum homo mundus tinxerit hyssopum, asperget ex eo omne tentorium, et cunctam supellectilem, et homines hujuscemodi contagione pollutos:
text_pt: E um homem limpo tomará hissopo, e o molhará naquela água, e a espargirá sobre aquela tenda, e sobre todos os móveis, e sobre as pessoas que ali estiverem, como também sobre aquele que tocar os ossos, ou em alguém que foi morto, ou que faleceu, ou numa sepultura.
text_el: καὶ λήμψεται ὕσσωπον καὶ βάψει εἰς τὸ ὕδωρ ἀνὴρ καθαρὸς καὶ περιρρανεῖ ἐπὶ τὸν οἶκον καὶ ἐπὶ τὰ σκεύη καὶ ἐπὶ τὰς ψυχάς ὅσαι ἐὰν ὦσιν ἐκεῖ καὶ ἐπὶ τὸν ἡμμένον τοῦ ὀστέου τοῦ ἀνθρωπίνου ἢ τοῦ τραυματίου ἢ τοῦ τεθνηκότος ἢ τοῦ μνήματος

text_en: And in this manner he that is clean shall purify the unclean on the third and on the seventh day. And being expiated the seventh day, he shall wash both himself and his garments, and be unclean until the evening.
text_la: atque hoc modo mundus lustrabit immundum tertio et septimo die : expiatusque die septimo, lavabit et se et vestimenta sua, et immundus erit usque ad vesperum.
text_pt: E o limpo ao terceiro e sétimo dia espargirá sobre o imundo; e ao sétimo dia o purificará; e lavará as suas vestes, e se banhará na água, e à tarde será limpo.
text_el: καὶ περιρρανεῖ ὁ καθαρὸς ἐπὶ τὸν ἀκάθαρτον ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ τρίτῃ καὶ ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ ἑβδόμῃ καὶ ἀφαγνισθήσεται τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ ἑβδόμῃ καὶ πλυνεῖ τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτοῦ καὶ λούσεται ὕδατι καὶ ἀκάθαρτος ἔσται ἕως ἑσπέρας

text_en: If any man be not expiated after this rite , his soul shall perish out of the midst of the church : because he has profaned the sanctuary of the Lord , and was not sprinkled with the water of purification.
text_la: Si quis hoc ritu non fuerit expiatus, peribit anima illius de medio ecclesiæ : quia sanctuarium Domini polluit, et non est aqua lustrationis aspersus.
text_pt: Porém o que for imundo, e se não purificar, do meio da congregação será ele extirpado; porquanto contaminou o santuário do Senhor; água de separação sobre ele não foi espargida; imundo é.
text_el: καὶ ἄνθρωπος ὃς ἐὰν μιανθῇ καὶ μὴ ἀφαγνισθῇ ἐξολεθρευθήσεται ἡ ψυχὴ ἐκείνη ἐκ μέσου τῆς συναγωγῆς ὅτι τὰ ἅγια κυρίου ἐμίανεν ὅτι ὕδωρ ῥαντισμοῦ οὐ περιερραντίσθη ἐπ' αὐτόν ἀκάθαρτός ἐστιν

text_en: This precept shall be an ordinance for ever. He also that sprinkled the water, shall wash his garments. Every one that shall touch the waters of expiation, shall be unclean until the evening.
text_la: Erit hoc præceptum legitimum sempiternum. Ipse quoque qui aspergit aquas, lavabit vestimenta sua. Omnis qui tetigerit aquas expiationis, immundus erit usque ad vesperum.
text_pt: Isto lhes será por estatuto perpétuo; e o que espargir a água da separação lavará as suas vestes; e o que tocar a água da separação será imundo até à tarde,
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ὑμῖν νόμιμον αἰώνιον καὶ ὁ περιρραίνων ὕδωρ ῥαντισμοῦ πλυνεῖ τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτοῦ καὶ ὁ ἁπτόμενος τοῦ ὕδατος τοῦ ῥαντισμοῦ ἀκάθαρτος ἔσται ἕως ἑσπέρας

text_en: Whatsoever a person touches who is unclean , he shall make it unclean : and the person that touches any of these things, shall be unclean until the evening.
text_la: Quidquid tetigerit immundus, immundum faciet : et anima, quæ horum quippiam tetigerit, immunda erit usque ad vesperum.
text_pt: E tudo o que tocar o imundo também será imundo; e a pessoa que o tocar será imunda até à tarde.
text_el: καὶ παντός οὗ ἐὰν ἅψηται αὐτοῦ ὁ ἀκάθαρτος ἀκάθαρτον ἔσται καὶ ἡ ψυχὴ ἡ ἁπτομένη ἀκάθαρτος ἔσται ἕως ἑσπέρας

text_en: And the children of Israel , and all the multitude came into the desert of Sin, in the first month: and the people abode in Cades . And Mary died there, and was buried in the same place.
text_la: Veneruntque filii Israël et omnis multitudo in desertum Sin, mense primo, et mansit populus in Cades. Mortuaque est ibi Maria, et sepulta in eodem loco.
text_pt: Chegando os filhos de Israel, toda a congregação, ao deserto de Zim, no mês primeiro, o povo ficou em Cades; e Miriã morreu ali, e ali foi sepultada.
text_el: καὶ ἦλθον οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ πᾶσα ἡ συναγωγή εἰς τὴν ἔρημον Σιν ἐν τῷ μηνὶ τῷ πρώτῳ καὶ κατέμεινεν ὁ λαὸς ἐν Καδης καὶ ἐτελεύτησεν ἐκεῖ Μαριαμ καὶ ἐτάφη ἐκεῖ

text_en: And the people wanting water, came together against Moses and Aaron :
text_la: Cumque indigeret aqua populus, convenerunt adversum Moysen et Aaron:
text_pt: E não havia água para a congregação; então se reuniram contra Moisés e contra Arão.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἦν ὕδωρ τῇ συναγωγῇ καὶ ἠθροίσθησαν ἐπὶ Μωυσῆν καὶ Ααρων

text_en: And making a sedition, they said: Would God we had perished among our brethren before the Lord .
text_la: et versi in seditionem, dixerunt : Utinam periissemus inter fratres nostros coram Domino.
text_pt: E o povo contendeu com Moisés, dizendo: Quem dera tivéssemos perecido quando pereceram nossos irmãos perante o Senhor!
text_el: καὶ ἐλοιδορεῖτο ὁ λαὸς πρὸς Μωυσῆν λέγοντες ὄφελον ἀπεθάνομεν ἐν τῇ ἀπωλείᾳ τῶν ἀδελφῶν ἡμῶν ἔναντι κυρίου

text_en: Why have you brought out the church of the Lord into the wilderness , that both we and our cattle should die?
text_la: Cur eduxistis ecclesiam Domini in solitudinem, ut et nos et nostra jumenta moriamur?
text_pt: E por que trouxestes a congregação do Senhor a este deserto, para que morramos aqui, nós e os nossos animais?
text_el: καὶ ἵνα τί ἀνηγάγετε τὴν συναγωγὴν κυρίου εἰς τὴν ἔρημον ταύτην ἀποκτεῖναι ἡμᾶς καὶ τὰ κτήνη ἡμῶν

text_en: Why have you made us come up out of Egypt , and have brought us into this wretched place which cannot be sowed, nor brings forth figs, nor vines, nor pomegranates, neither is there any water to drink?
text_la: quare nos fecistis ascendere de Ægypto, et adduxistis in locum istum pessimum, qui seri non potest, qui nec ficum gignit, nec vineas, nec malogranata, insuper et aquam non habet ad bibendum?
text_pt: E por que nos fizestes subir do Egito, para nos trazer a este lugar mau? lugar onde não há semente, nem de figos, nem de vides, nem de romãs, nem tem água para beber.
text_el: καὶ ἵνα τί τοῦτο ἀνηγάγετε ἡμᾶς ἐξ Αἰγύπτου παραγενέσθαι εἰς τὸν τόπον τὸν πονηρὸν τοῦτον τόπος οὗ οὐ σπείρεται οὐδὲ συκαῖ οὐδὲ ἄμπελοι οὐδὲ ῥόαι οὐδὲ ὕδωρ ἐστὶν πιεῖν

text_en: And Moses and Aaron leaving the multitude, went into the tabernacle of the covenant , and fell flat upon the ground, and cried to the Lord , and said. O Lord God , hear the cry of this people, and open to them your treasure, a fountain of living water, that being satisfied, they may cease to murmur. And the glory of the Lord appeared over them.
text_la: Ingressusque Moyses et Aaron, dimissa multitudine, tabernaculum fœderis, corruerunt proni in terram, clamaveruntque ad Dominum, atque dixerunt : Domine Deus, audi clamorem hujus populi, et aperi eis thesaurum tuum fontem aquæ vivæ, ut satiati, cesset murmuratio eorum. Et apparuit gloria Domini super eos.
text_pt: Então Moisés e Arão se foram de diante do povo à porta da tenda da congregação, e se lançaram sobre os seus rostos; e a glória do Senhor lhes apareceu.
text_el: καὶ ἦλθεν Μωυσῆς καὶ Ααρων ἀπὸ προσώπου τῆς συναγωγῆς ἐπὶ τὴν θύραν τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου καὶ ἔπεσαν ἐπὶ πρόσωπον καὶ ὤφθη ἡ δόξα κυρίου πρὸς αὐτούς

text_en: And the Lord spoke to Moses , saying:
text_la: Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen, dicens:
text_pt: E o Senhor falou a Moisés dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν λέγων

text_en: Take the rod, and assemble the people together, you and Aaron your brother, and speak to the rock before them, and it shall yield waters. And when you have brought forth water out of the rock, all the multitude and their cattle shall drink.
text_la: Tolle virgam, et congrega populum, tu et Aaron frater tuus, et loquimini ad petram coram eis, et illa dabit aquas. Cumque eduxeris aquam de petra, bibet omnis multitudo et jumenta ejus.
text_pt: Toma a vara, e ajunta a congregação, tu e Arão, teu irmão, e falai à rocha, perante os seus olhos, e dará a sua água; assim lhes tirarás água da rocha, e darás a beber à congregação e aos seus animais.
text_el: λαβὲ τὴν ῥάβδον καὶ ἐκκλησίασον τὴν συναγωγὴν σὺ καὶ Ααρων ὁ ἀδελφός σου καὶ λαλήσατε πρὸς τὴν πέτραν ἔναντι αὐτῶν καὶ δώσει τὰ ὕδατα αὐτῆς καὶ ἐξοίσετε αὐτοῖς ὕδωρ ἐκ τῆς πέτρας καὶ ποτιεῖτε τὴν συναγωγὴν καὶ τὰ κτήνη αὐτῶν

text_en: Moses therefore took the rod, which was before the Lord , as he had commanded him,
text_la: Tulit igitur Moyses virgam, quæ erat in conspectu Domini, sicut præceperat ei,
text_pt: Então Moisés tomou a vara de diante do Senhor, como lhe tinha ordenado.
text_el: καὶ ἔλαβεν Μωυσῆς τὴν ῥάβδον τὴν ἀπέναντι κυρίου καθὰ συνέταξεν κύριος

text_en: and having gathered together the multitude before the rock, he said to them: Hear, you rebellious and incredulous: Can we bring you forth water out of this rock?
text_la: congregata multitudine ante petram : dixitque eis : Audite, rebelles et increduli : num de petra hac vobis aquam poterimus ejicere?
text_pt: E Moisés e Arão reuniram a congregação diante da rocha, e Moisés disse-lhes: Ouvi agora, rebeldes, porventura tiraremos água desta rocha para vós?
text_el: καὶ ἐξεκκλησίασεν Μωυσῆς καὶ Ααρων τὴν συναγωγὴν ἀπέναντι τῆς πέτρας καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς ἀκούσατέ μου οἱ ἀπειθεῖς μὴ ἐκ τῆς πέτρας ταύτης ἐξάξομεν ὑμῖν ὕδωρ

text_en: And when Moses had lifted up his hand, and struck the rock twice with the rod, there came forth water in great abundance, so that the people and their cattle drank,
text_la: Cumque elevasset Moyses manum, percutiens virga bis silicem, egressæ sunt aquæ largissimæ, ita ut populus biberet et jumenta.
text_pt: Então Moisés levantou a sua mão, e feriu a rocha duas vezes com a sua vara, e saiu muita água; e bebeu a congregação e os seus animais.
text_el: καὶ ἐπάρας Μωυσῆς τὴν χεῖρα αὐτοῦ ἐπάταξεν τὴν πέτραν τῇ ῥάβδῳ δίς καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ὕδωρ πολύ καὶ ἔπιεν ἡ συναγωγὴ καὶ τὰ κτήνη αὐτῶν

text_en: and the Lord said to Moses and Aaron : Because you have not believed me, to sanctify me before the children of Israel , you shall not bring these people into the land, which I will give them.
text_la: Dixitque Dominus ad Moysen et Aaron : Quia non credidistis mihi, ut sanctificaretis me coram filiis Israël, non introducetis hos populos in terram, quam dabo eis.
text_pt: E o Senhor disse a Moisés e a Arão: Porquanto não crestes em mim, para me santificardes diante dos filhos de Israel, por isso não introduzireis esta congregação na terra que lhes tenho dado.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν καὶ Ααρων ὅτι οὐκ ἐπιστεύσατε ἁγιάσαι με ἐναντίον υἱῶν Ισραηλ διὰ τοῦτο οὐκ εἰσάξετε ὑμεῖς τὴν συναγωγὴν ταύτην εἰς τὴν γῆν ἣν δέδωκα αὐτοῖς

text_en: This is the Water of contradiction , where the children of Israel strove with words against the Lord , and he was sanctified in them.
text_la: Hæc est aqua contradictionis, ubi jurgati sunt filii Israël contra Dominum, et sanctificatus est in eis.
text_pt: Estas são as águas de Meribá, porque os filhos de Israel contenderam com o Senhor; e se santificou neles.
text_el: τοῦτο ὕδωρ ἀντιλογίας ὅτι ἐλοιδορήθησαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ ἔναντι κυρίου καὶ ἡγιάσθη ἐν αὐτοῖς

text_en: In the mean time Moses sent messengers from Cades to the king of Edom , to say: Thus says your brother Israel : You know all the labour that has come upon us:
text_la: Misit interea nuntios Moyses de Cades ad regem Edom, qui dicerent : Hæc mandat frater tuus Israël : Nosti omnem laborem qui apprehendit nos,
text_pt: Depois Moisés, de Cades, mandou mensageiros ao rei de Edom, dizendo: Assim diz teu irmão Israel: Sabes todo o trabalho que nos sobreveio,
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν Μωυσῆς ἀγγέλους ἐκ Καδης πρὸς βασιλέα Εδωμ λέγων τάδε λέγει ὁ ἀδελφός σου Ισραηλ σὺ ἐπίστῃ πάντα τὸν μόχθον τὸν εὑρόντα ἡμᾶς

text_en: In what manner our fathers went down into Egypt , and there we dwelt a long time, and the Egyptians afflicted us and our fathers.
text_la: quomodo descenderint patres nostri in Ægyptum, et habitaverimus ibi multo tempore, afflixerintque nos Ægyptii, et patres nostros:
text_pt: Como nossos pais desceram ao Egito, e nós no Egito habitamos muitos dias; e como os egípcios nos maltrataram, a nós e a nossos pais;
text_el: καὶ κατέβησαν οἱ πατέρες ἡμῶν εἰς Αἴγυπτον καὶ παρῳκήσαμεν ἐν Αἰγύπτῳ ἡμέρας πλείους καὶ ἐκάκωσαν ἡμᾶς οἱ Αἰγύπτιοι καὶ τοὺς πατέρας ἡμῶν

text_en: And how we cried to the Lord , and he heard us, and sent an angel , who has brought us out of Egypt . Lo, we are now in the city of Cades , which is in the uttermost of your borders,
text_la: et quomodo clamaverimus ad Dominum, et exaudierit nos, miseritque angelum, qui eduxerit nos de Ægypto. Ecce in urbe Cades, quæ est in extremis finibus tuis, positi,
text_pt: E clamamos ao Senhor, e ele ouviu a nossa voz, e mandou um anjo, e nos tirou do Egito; e eis que estamos em Cades, cidade na extremidade dos teus termos.
text_el: καὶ ἀνεβοήσαμεν πρὸς κύριον καὶ εἰσήκουσεν κύριος τῆς φωνῆς ἡμῶν καὶ ἀποστείλας ἄγγελον ἐξήγαγεν ἡμᾶς ἐξ Αἰγύπτου καὶ νῦν ἐσμεν ἐν Καδης πόλει ἐκ μέρους τῶν ὁρίων σου

text_en: and we beseech you that we may have leave to pass through your country. We will not go through the fields, nor through the vineyards, we will not drink the waters of your wells , but we will go by the common highway, neither turning aside to the right hand, nor to the left, till we are past your borders.
text_la: obsecramus ut nobis transire liceat per terram tuam. Non ibimus per agros, nec per vineas; non bibemus aquas de puteis tuis : sed gradiemur via publica, nec ad dexteram nec ad sinistram declinantes, donec transeamus terminos tuos.
text_pt: Deixa-nos, pois, passar pela tua terra; não passaremos pelo campo, nem pelas vinhas, nem beberemos a água dos poços; iremos pela estrada real; não nos desviaremos para a direita nem para a esquerda, até que passemos pelos teus termos.
text_el: παρελευσόμεθα διὰ τῆς γῆς σου οὐ διελευσόμεθα δι' ἀγρῶν οὐδὲ δι' ἀμπελώνων οὐδὲ πιόμεθα ὕδωρ ἐκ λάκκου σου ὁδῷ βασιλικῇ πορευσόμεθα οὐκ ἐκκλινοῦμεν δεξιὰ οὐδὲ εὐώνυμα ἕως ἂν παρέλθωμεν τὰ ὅριά σου

text_en: And Edom answered them: You shall not pass by me: if you do I will come out armed against you.
text_la: Cui respondit Edom : Non transibis per me, alioquin armatus occurram tibi.
text_pt: Porém Edom lhe disse: Não passarás por mim, para que eu não saia com a espada ao teu encontro.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτὸν Εδωμ οὐ διελεύσῃ δι' ἐμοῦ εἰ δὲ μή ἐν πολέμῳ ἐξελεύσομαι εἰς συνάντησίν σοι

text_en: And the children of Israel said: We will go by the beaten way: and if we and our cattle drink of your waters, we will give you what is just : there shall be no difficulty in the price, only let us pass speedily.
text_la: Dixeruntque filii Israël : Per tritam gradiemur viam : et si biberimus aquas tuas, nos et pecora nostra, dabimus quod justum est : nulla erit in pretio difficultas, tantum velociter transeamus.
text_pt: Então os filhos de Israel lhe disseram: Subiremos pelo caminho aplanado, e se eu e o meu gado bebermos das tuas águas, darei o preço delas; não desejo alguma outra coisa, senão passar a pé.
text_el: καὶ λέγουσιν αὐτῷ οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ παρὰ τὸ ὄρος παρελευσόμεθα ἐὰν δὲ τοῦ ὕδατός σου πίωμεν ἐγώ τε καὶ τὰ κτήνη δώσω τιμήν σοι ἀλλὰ τὸ πρᾶγμα οὐδέν ἐστιν παρὰ τὸ ὄρος παρελευσόμεθα

text_en: But he answered: You shall not pass. And immediately he came forth to meet them with an infinite multitude, and a strong hand; neither would he condescend to their desire to grant them passage through his borders. Wherefore Israel turned another way from him.
text_la: At ille respondit : Non transibis. Statimque egressus est obvius, cum infinita multitudo, et manu forti; nec voluit acquiescere deprecanti, ut concederet transitum per fines suos. Quam ob rem divertit ab eo Israël.
text_pt: Porém ele disse: Não passarás. E saiu-lhe Edom ao encontro com muita gente, e com mão forte.
text_el: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν οὐ διελεύσῃ δι' ἐμοῦ καὶ ἐξῆλθεν Εδωμ εἰς συνάντησιν αὐτῷ ἐν ὄχλῳ βαρεῖ καὶ ἐν χειρὶ ἰσχυρᾷ

text_en: And when they had removed the camp from Cades , they came to mount Hor, which is in the borders of the land of Edom :
text_la: Cumque castra movissent de Cades, venerunt in montem Hor, qui est in finibus terræ Edom:
text_pt: Assim recusou Edom deixar passar a Israel pelo seu termo; por isso Israel se desviou dele.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἠθέλησεν Εδωμ δοῦναι τῷ Ισραηλ παρελθεῖν διὰ τῶν ὁρίων αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐξέκλινεν Ισραηλ ἀπ' αὐτοῦ

text_en: Where the Lord spoke to Moses :
text_la: ubi locutus est Dominus ad Moysen:
text_pt: Então partiram de Cades; e os filhos de Israel, toda a congregação, chegaram ao monte Hor.
text_el: καὶ ἀπῆραν ἐκ Καδης καὶ παρεγένοντο οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ πᾶσα ἡ συναγωγή εἰς Ωρ τὸ ὄρος

text_en: Let Aaron , says he, go to his people: for he shall not go into the land which I have given the children of Israel , because he was incredulous to my words, at the waters of contradiction .
text_la: Pergat, inquit, Aaron ad populos suos : non enim intrabit terram, quam dedi filiis Israël, eo quod incredulus fuerit ori meo, ad aquas contradictionis.
text_pt: E falou o Senhor a Moisés e a Arão no monte Hor, nos termos da terra de Edom, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν καὶ Ααρων ἐν Ωρ τῷ ὄρει ἐπὶ τῶν ὁρίων γῆς Εδωμ λέγων

text_en: Take Aaron and his son with him, and bring them up into mount Hor:
text_la: Tolle Aaron et filium ejus cum eo, et duces eos in montem Hor.
text_pt: Arão será recolhido a seu povo, porque não entrará na terra que tenho dado aos filhos de Israel, porquanto rebeldes fostes à minha ordem, nas águas de Meribá.
text_el: προστεθήτω Ααρων πρὸς τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ ὅτι οὐ μὴ εἰσέλθητε εἰς τὴν γῆν ἣν δέδωκα τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ διότι παρωξύνατέ με ἐπὶ τοῦ ὕδατος τῆς λοιδορίας

text_en: And when you have stripped the father of his vesture , you shall vest therewith Eleazar his son: Aaron shall be gathered to his people , and die there.
text_la: Cumque nudaveris patrem veste sua, indues ea Eleazarum filium ejus : Aaron colligetur, et morietur ibi.
text_pt: Toma a Arão e a Eleazar, seu filho, e faze-os subir ao monte Hor.
text_el: λαβὲ τὸν Ααρων καὶ Ελεαζαρ τὸν υἱὸν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀναβίβασον αὐτοὺς εἰς Ωρ τὸ ὄρος ἔναντι πάσης τῆς συναγωγῆς

text_en: Moses did as the Lord had commanded: and they went up into mount Hor before all the multitude.
text_la: Fecit Moyses ut præceperat Dominus : et ascenderunt in montem Hor coram omni multitudine.
text_pt: E despe a Arão as suas vestes, e veste-as em Eleazar, seu filho, porque Arão será recolhido, e morrerá ali.
text_el: καὶ ἔκδυσον Ααρων τὴν στολὴν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἔνδυσον Ελεαζαρ τὸν υἱὸν αὐτοῦ καὶ Ααρων προστεθεὶς ἀποθανέτω ἐκεῖ

text_en: And when he had stripped Aaron of his vestments , he vested Eleazar his son with them.
text_la: Cumque Aaron spoliasset vestibus suis, induit eis Eleazarum filium ejus.
text_pt: Fez, pois, Moisés como o Senhor lhe ordenara; e subiram ao monte Hor perante os olhos de toda a congregação.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησεν Μωυσῆς καθὰ συνέταξεν κύριος καὶ ἀνεβίβασεν αὐτὸν εἰς Ωρ τὸ ὄρος ἐναντίον πάσης τῆς συναγωγῆς

text_en: And Aaron being dead in the top of the mountain, he came down with Eleazar .
text_la: Illo mortuo in montis supercilio, descendit cum Eleazaro.
text_pt: E Moisés despiu a Arão de suas vestes, e as vestiu em Eleazar, seu filho; e morreu Arão ali sobre o cume do monte; e desceram Moisés e Eleazar do monte.
text_el: καὶ ἐξέδυσεν Ααρων τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐνέδυσεν αὐτὰ Ελεαζαρ τὸν υἱὸν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀπέθανεν Ααρων ἐπὶ τῆς κορυφῆς τοῦ ὄρους καὶ κατέβη Μωυσῆς καὶ Ελεαζαρ ἐκ τοῦ ὄρους

text_en: And all the multitude seeing that Aaron was dead, mourned for him thirty days throughout all their families .
text_la: Omnis autem multitudo videns occubuisse Aaron, flevit super eo triginta diebus per cunctas familias suas.
text_pt: Vendo, pois, toda a congregação que Arão era morto, choraram a Arão trinta dias, toda a casa de Israel.
text_el: καὶ εἶδεν πᾶσα ἡ συναγωγὴ ὅτι ἀπελύθη Ααρων καὶ ἔκλαυσαν τὸν Ααρων τριάκοντα ἡμέρας πᾶς οἶκος Ισραηλ

text_en: And when King Arad the Chanaanite , who dwelt towards the south, had heard this, to wit, that Israel had come by the way of the spies, he fought against them, and overcoming them carried off their spoils.
text_la: Quod cum audisset Chananæus rex Arad, qui habitabat ad meridiem, venisse scilicet Israël per exploratorum viam, pugnavit contra illum, et victor existens, duxit ex eo prædam.
text_pt: Ouvindo o cananeu, rei de Arade, que habitava para o lado sul, que Israel vinha pelo caminho dos espias, pelejou contra Israel, e dele levou alguns prisioneiros.
text_el: καὶ ἤκουσεν ὁ Χανανις βασιλεὺς Αραδ ὁ κατοικῶν κατὰ τὴν ἔρημον ἦλθεν γὰρ Ισραηλ ὁδὸν Αθαριν καὶ ἐπολέμησεν πρὸς Ισραηλ καὶ κατεπρονόμευσαν ἐξ αὐτῶν αἰχμαλωσίαν

text_en: But Israel binding himself by vow to the Lord , said: If you will deliver thus people into my hand, I will utterly destroy their cities.
text_la: At Israël voto se Domino obligans, ait : Si tradideris populum istum in manu mea, delebo urbes ejus.
text_pt: Então Israel fez um voto ao Senhor, dizendo: Se de fato entregares este povo na minha mão, destruirei totalmente as suas cidades.
text_el: καὶ ηὔξατο Ισραηλ εὐχὴν κυρίῳ καὶ εἶπεν ἐάν μοι παραδῷς τὸν λαὸν τοῦτον ὑποχείριον ἀναθεματιῶ αὐτὸν καὶ τὰς πόλεις αὐτοῦ

text_en: And the Lord heard the prayers of Israel , and delivered up the Chanaanite , and they cut them off and destroyed their cities: and they called the name of that place Horma, that is to say, Anathema .
text_la: Exaudivitque Dominus preces Israël, et tradidit Chananæum, quem ille interfecit subversis urbibus ejus : et vocavit nomen loci illius Horma, id est, anathema.
text_pt: O Senhor, pois, ouviu a voz de Israel, e lhe entregou os cananeus; e os israelitas destruíram totalmente, a eles e às suas cidades; e o nome daquele lugar chamou Hormá.
text_el: καὶ εἰσήκουσεν κύριος τῆς φωνῆς Ισραηλ καὶ παρέδωκεν τὸν Χανανιν ὑποχείριον αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀνεθεμάτισεν αὐτὸν καὶ τὰς πόλεις αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπεκάλεσαν τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ τόπου ἐκείνου ἀνάθεμα

text_en: And they marched from mount Hor, by the way that leads to the Red Sea , to compass the land of Edom . And the people began to be weary of their journey and labour:
text_la: Profecti sunt autem et de monte Hor, per viam quæ ducit ad mare Rubrum, ut circumirent terram Edom. Et tædere cœpit populum itineris ac laboris:
text_pt: Então partiram do monte Hor, pelo caminho do Mar Vermelho, a rodear a terra de Edom; porém a alma do povo angustiou-se naquele caminho.
text_el: καὶ ἀπάραντες ἐξ Ωρ τοῦ ὄρους ὁδὸν ἐπὶ θάλασσαν ἐρυθρὰν περιεκύκλωσαν γῆν Εδωμ καὶ ὠλιγοψύχησεν ὁ λαὸς ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ

text_en: And speaking against God and Moses , they said: Why did you bring us out of Egypt , to die in the wilderness ? There is no bread, nor have we any waters: our soul now loathes this very light food.
text_la: locutusque contra Deum et Moysen, ait : Cur eduxisti nos de Ægypto, ut moreremur in solitudine? deest panis, non sunt aquæ : anima nostra jam nauseat super cibo isto levissimo.
text_pt: E o povo falou contra Deus e contra Moisés: Por que nos fizestes subir do Egito para que morrêssemos neste deserto? Pois aqui nem pão nem água há; e a nossa alma tem fastio deste pão tão vil.
text_el: καὶ κατελάλει ὁ λαὸς πρὸς τὸν θεὸν καὶ κατὰ Μωυσῆ λέγοντες ἵνα τί ἐξήγαγες ἡμᾶς ἐξ Αἰγύπτου ἀποκτεῖναι ἡμᾶς ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ ὅτι οὐκ ἔστιν ἄρτος οὐδὲ ὕδωρ ἡ δὲ ψυχὴ ἡμῶν προσώχθισεν ἐν τῷ ἄρτῳ τῷ διακένῳ

text_en: Wherefore the Lord sent among the people fiery serpents, which bit them and killed many of them.
text_la: Quam ob rem misit Dominus in populum ignitos serpentes, ad quorum plagas et mortes plurimorum,
text_pt: Então o Senhor mandou entre o povo serpentes ardentes, que picaram o povo; e morreu muita gente em Israel.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν κύριος εἰς τὸν λαὸν τοὺς ὄφεις τοὺς θανατοῦντας καὶ ἔδακνον τὸν λαόν καὶ ἀπέθανεν λαὸς πολὺς τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ

text_en: Upon which they came to Moses , and said; We have sinned , because we have spoken against the Lord and you: pray that he may take away these serpents from us. And Moses prayed for the people.
text_la: venerunt ad Moysen, atque dixerunt : Peccavimus, quia locuti sumus contra Dominum et te : ora ut tollat a nobis serpentes. Oravitque Moyses pro populo,
text_pt: Por isso o povo veio a Moisés, e disse: Havemos pecado, porquanto temos falado contra o Senhor e contra ti; ora ao Senhor que tire de nós estas serpentes. Então Moisés orou pelo povo.
text_el: καὶ παραγενόμενος ὁ λαὸς πρὸς Μωυσῆν ἔλεγον ὅτι ἡμάρτομεν ὅτι κατελαλήσαμεν κατὰ τοῦ κυρίου καὶ κατὰ σοῦ εὖξαι οὖν πρὸς κύριον καὶ ἀφελέτω ἀφ' ἡμῶν τὸν ὄφιν καὶ ηὔξατο Μωυσῆς πρὸς κύριον περὶ τοῦ λαοῦ

text_en: And the Lord said to him: Make a brazen serpent, and set it up for a sign : whosoever being struck shall look on it, shall live.
text_la: et locutus est Dominus ad eum : Fac serpentem æneum, et pone eum pro signo : qui percussus aspexerit eum, vivet.
text_pt: E disse o Senhor a Moisés: Faze-te uma serpente ardente, e põe-na sobre uma haste; e será que viverá todo o que, tendo sido picado, olhar para ela.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν ποίησον σεαυτῷ ὄφιν καὶ θὲς αὐτὸν ἐπὶ σημείου καὶ ἔσται ἐὰν δάκῃ ὄφις ἄνθρωπον πᾶς ὁ δεδηγμένος ἰδὼν αὐτὸν ζήσεται

text_en: Moses therefore made a brazen serpent, and set it up for a sign : which when they that were bitten looked upon, they were healed.
text_la: Fecit ergo Moyses serpentem æneum, et posuit eum pro signo : quem cum percussi aspicerent, sanabantur.
text_pt: E Moisés fez uma serpente de metal, e pô-la sobre uma haste; e sucedia que, picando alguma serpente a alguém, quando esse olhava para a serpente de metal, vivia.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησεν Μωυσῆς ὄφιν χαλκοῦν καὶ ἔστησεν αὐτὸν ἐπὶ σημείου καὶ ἐγένετο ὅταν ἔδακνεν ὄφις ἄνθρωπον καὶ ἐπέβλεψεν ἐπὶ τὸν ὄφιν τὸν χαλκοῦν καὶ ἔζη

text_en: And the children of Israel setting forwards camped in Oboth.
text_la: Profectique filii Israël castrametati sunt in Oboth.
text_pt: Então os filhos de Israel partiram, e alojaram-se em Obote.
text_el: καὶ ἀπῆραν οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ καὶ παρενέβαλον ἐν Ωβωθ

text_en: And departing thence they pitched their tents in Jeabarim, in the wilderness , that faces Moab toward the east.
text_la: Unde egressi fixere tentoria in Jeabarim, in solitudine quæ respicit Moab contra orientalem plagam.
text_pt: Depois partiram de Obote e alojaram-se nos outeiros de Ije-Abarim, no deserto que está defronte de Moabe, ao nascente do sol.
text_el: καὶ ἐξάραντες ἐξ Ωβωθ παρενέβαλον ἐν Αχελγαι ἐκ τοῦ πέραν ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ ἥ ἐστιν κατὰ πρόσωπον Μωαβ κατὰ ἀνατολὰς ἡλίου

text_en: And removing from thence, they came to the torrent Zared:
text_la: Et inde moventes, venerunt ad torrentem Zared.
text_pt: Dali partiram, e alojaram-se junto ao ribeiro de Zerede.
text_el: ἐκεῖθεν ἀπῆραν καὶ παρενέβαλον εἰς φάραγγα Ζαρετ

text_en: Which they left and encamped over against Arnon, which is in the desert and stands out on the borders of the Amorrhite . For Arnon is the border of Moab , dividing the Moabites and the Amorrhites .
text_la: Quem relinquentes castrametati sunt contra Arnon, quæ est in deserto, et prominet in finibus Amorrhæi. Siquidem Arnon terminus est Moab, dividens Moabitas et Amorrhæos.
text_pt: E dali partiram e alojaram-se no lado de Arnom, que está no deserto e sai dos termos dos amorreus; porque Arnom é o termo de Moabe, entre Moabe e os amorreus.
text_el: καὶ ἐκεῖθεν ἀπάραντες παρενέβαλον εἰς τὸ πέραν Αρνων ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ τὸ ἐξέχον ἀπὸ τῶν ὁρίων τῶν Αμορραίων ἔστιν γὰρ Αρνων ὅρια Μωαβ ἀνὰ μέσον Μωαβ καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον τοῦ Αμορραίου

text_en: Wherefore it is said in the book of the wars of the Lord : As he did in the Red Sea , so will he do in the streams of Arnon.
text_la: Unde dicitur in libro bellorum Domini : Sicut fecit in mari Rubro, sic faciet in torrentibus Arnon.
text_pt: Por isso se diz no livro das guerras do Senhor: O que fiz no Mar Vermelho e nos ribeiros de Arnom,
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο λέγεται ἐν βιβλίῳ πόλεμος τοῦ κυρίου τὴν Ζωοβ ἐφλόγισεν καὶ τοὺς χειμάρρους Αρνων

text_en: The rocks of the torrents were bowed down that they might rest in Ar, and lie down in the borders of the Moabites .
text_la: Scopuli torrentium inclinati sunt, ut requiescerent in Ar, et recumberent in finibus Moabitarum.
text_pt: E à corrente dos ribeiros, que descendo para a situação de Ar, se encosta aos termos de Moabe.
text_el: καὶ τοὺς χειμάρρους κατέστησεν κατοικίσαι Ηρ καὶ πρόσκειται τοῖς ὁρίοις Μωαβ

text_en: When they went from that place, the well appeared whereof the Lord said to Moses : Gather the people together, and I will give them water.
text_la: Ex eo loco apparuit puteus, super quo locutus est Dominus ad Moysen : Congrega populum, et dabo ei aquam.
text_pt: E dali partiram para Beer; este é o poço do qual o Senhor disse a Moisés: Ajunta o povo e lhe darei água.
text_el: καὶ ἐκεῖθεν τὸ φρέαρ τοῦτό ἐστιν τὸ φρέαρ ὃ εἶπεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν συνάγαγε τὸν λαόν καὶ δώσω αὐτοῖς ὕδωρ πιεῖν

text_en: Then Israel sung this song: Let the well spring up. They sung thereto:
text_la: Tunc cecinit Israël carmen istud : Ascendat puteus. Concinebant:
text_pt: Então Israel cantou este cântico: Brota, ó poço! Cantai dele:
text_el: τότε ᾖσεν Ισραηλ τὸ ᾆσμα τοῦτο ἐπὶ τοῦ φρέατος ἐξάρχετε αὐτῷ

text_en: The well , which the princes dug, and the chiefs of the people prepared by the direction of the lawgiver , and with their staves. And they marched from the wilderness to Mathana.
text_la: Puteus, quem foderunt principes et paraverunt duces multitudinis in datore legis, et in baculis suis. De solitudine, Matthana.
text_pt: Tu, poço, que cavaram os príncipes, que escavaram os nobres do povo, e o legislador com os seus bordões; e do deserto partiram para Mataná;
text_el: φρέαρ ὤρυξαν αὐτὸ ἄρχοντες ἐξελατόμησαν αὐτὸ βασιλεῖς ἐθνῶν ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ αὐτῶν ἐν τῷ κυριεῦσαι αὐτῶν καὶ ἀπὸ φρέατος εἰς Μανθαναιν

text_en: From Mathana unto Nahaliel: from Nahaliel unto Bamoth.
text_la: De Matthana in Nahaliel : de Nahaliel in Bamoth.
text_pt: E de Mataná a Naaliel, e de Naaliel a Bamote.
text_el: καὶ ἀπὸ Μανθαναιν εἰς Νααλιηλ καὶ ἀπὸ Νααλιηλ εἰς Βαμωθ

text_en: From Bamoth, is a valley in the country of Moab , to the top of Phasga , which looked towards the desert .
text_la: De Bamoth, vallis est in regione Moab, in vertice Phasga, quod respicit contra desertum.
text_pt: E de Bamote ao vale que está no campo de Moabe, no cume de Pisga, e à vista do deserto.
text_el: καὶ ἀπὸ Βαμωθ εἰς νάπην ἥ ἐστιν ἐν τῷ πεδίῳ Μωαβ ἀπὸ κορυφῆς τοῦ λελαξευμένου τὸ βλέπον κατὰ πρόσωπον τῆς ἐρήμου

text_en: And Israel sent messengers to Sehon king of the Amorrhites , saying:
text_la: Misit autem Israël nuntios ad Sehon regem Amorrhæorum, dicens:
text_pt: Então Israel mandou mensageiros a Siom, rei dos amorreus, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν Μωυσῆς πρέσβεις πρὸς Σηων βασιλέα Αμορραίων λόγοις εἰρηνικοῖς λέγων

text_en: I beseech you that I may have leave to pass through your land: we will not go aside into the fields or the vineyards, we will not drink waters of the wells , we will go the king's highway, till we be past your borders.
text_la: Obsecro ut transire mihi liceat per terram tuam : non declinabimus in agros et vineas; non bibemus aquas ex puteis : via regia gradiemur, donec transeamus terminos tuos.
text_pt: Deixa-me passar pela tua terra; não nos desviaremos pelos campos nem pelas vinhas; as águas dos poços não beberemos; iremos pela estrada real até que passemos os teus termos.
text_el: παρελευσόμεθα διὰ τῆς γῆς σου τῇ ὁδῷ πορευσόμεθα οὐκ ἐκκλινοῦμεν οὔτε εἰς ἀγρὸν οὔτε εἰς ἀμπελῶνα οὐ πιόμεθα ὕδωρ ἐκ φρέατός σου ὁδῷ βασιλικῇ πορευσόμεθα ἕως παρέλθωμεν τὰ ὅριά σου

text_en: And he would not grant that Israel should pass by his borders: but rather gathering an army, went forth to meet them in the desert , and came to Jasa and fought against them.
text_la: Qui concedere noluit ut transiret Israël per fines suos : quin potius exercitu congregato, egressus est obviam in desertum, et venit in Jasa, pugnavitque contra eum.
text_pt: Porém Siom não deixou passar a Israel pelos seus termos; antes Siom congregou todo o seu povo, e saiu ao encontro de Israel no deserto, e veio a Jaza, e pelejou contra Israel.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἔδωκεν Σηων τῷ Ισραηλ παρελθεῖν διὰ τῶν ὁρίων αὐτοῦ καὶ συνήγαγεν Σηων πάντα τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐξῆλθεν παρατάξασθαι τῷ Ισραηλ εἰς τὴν ἔρημον καὶ ἦλθεν εἰς Ιασσα καὶ παρετάξατο τῷ Ισραηλ

text_en: And he was slain by them with the edge of the sword, and they possessed his land from the Arnon unto the Jeboc, and to the confines of the children of Ammon : for the borders of the Ammonites , were kept with a strong garrison.
text_la: A quo percussus est in ore gladii, et possessa est terra ejus ab Arnon usque Jeboc, et filios Ammon : quia forti præsidio tenebantur termini Ammonitarum.
text_pt: Mas Israel o feriu ao fio da espada, e tomou a sua terra em possessão, desde Arnom até Jaboque, até aos filhos de Amom; porquanto o termo dos filhos de Amom era forte.
text_el: καὶ ἐπάταξεν αὐτὸν Ισραηλ φόνῳ μαχαίρης καὶ κατεκυρίευσαν τῆς γῆς αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ Αρνων ἕως Ιαβοκ ἕως υἱῶν Αμμαν ὅτι Ιαζηρ ὅρια υἱῶν Αμμων ἐστίν

text_en: So Israel took all his cities, and dwelt in the cities of the Amorrhite , to wit, in Hesebon , and in the villages thereof.
text_la: Tulit ergo Israël omnes civitates ejus, et habitavit in urbibus Amorrhæi, in Hesebon scilicet, et viculis ejus.
text_pt: Assim Israel tomou todas as cidades; e habitou em todas elas, em Hesbom e em todas as suas aldeias.
text_el: καὶ ἔλαβεν Ισραηλ πάσας τὰς πόλεις ταύτας καὶ κατῴκησεν Ισραηλ ἐν πάσαις ταῖς πόλεσιν τῶν Αμορραίων ἐν Εσεβων καὶ ἐν πάσαις ταῖς συγκυρούσαις αὐτῇ

text_en: Hesebon was the city of Sehon the king of the Amorrhites , who fought against the king of Moab : and took all the land, that had been of his dominion, as far as the Arnon.
text_la: Urbs Hesebon fuit Sehon regis Amorrhæi, qui pugnavit contra regem Moab : et tulit omnem terram, quæ ditionis illius fuerat usque Arnon.
text_pt: Porque Hesbom era cidade de Siom, rei dos amorreus, que tinha pelejado contra o precedente rei dos moabitas, e tinha tomado da sua mão toda a sua terra até Arnom.
text_el: ἔστιν γὰρ Εσεβων πόλις Σηων τοῦ βασιλέως τῶν Αμορραίων καὶ οὗτος ἐπολέμησεν βασιλέα Μωαβ τὸ πρότερον καὶ ἔλαβον πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ Αροηρ ἕως Αρνων

text_en: Therefore it is said in the proverb: Come into Hesebon , let the city of Sehon be built and set up:
text_la: Idcirco dicitur in proverbio : Venite in Hesebon : ædificetur, et construatur civitas Sehon :
text_pt: Por isso dizem os que falam em provérbios: Vinde a Hesbom; edifique-se e estabeleça-se a cidade de Siom.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο ἐροῦσιν οἱ αἰνιγματισταί ἔλθετε εἰς Εσεβων ἵνα οἰκοδομηθῇ καὶ κατασκευασθῇ πόλις Σηων

text_en: A fire has gone out of Hesebon , a flame from the city of Sehon, and has consumed Ar of the Moabites , and the inhabitants of the high places of the Arnon.
text_la: ignis egressus est de Hesebon, flamma de oppido Sehon, et devoravit Ar Moabitarum, et habitatores excelsorum Arnon.
text_pt: Porque fogo saiu de Hesbom, e uma chama da cidade de Siom; e consumiu a Ar dos moabitas, e os senhores dos altos de Arnom.
text_el: ὅτι πῦρ ἐξῆλθεν ἐξ Εσεβων φλὸξ ἐκ πόλεως Σηων καὶ κατέφαγεν ἕως Μωαβ καὶ κατέπιεν στήλας Αρνων

text_en: Woe to you Moab : you are undone, O people of Chamos. He has given his sons to flight, and his daughters into captivity to Sehon the king of the Amorrhites .
text_la: Væ tibi Moab; peristi popule Chamos. Dedit filios ejus in fugam, et filias in captivitatem regi Amorrhæorum Sehon.
text_pt: Ai de ti, Moabe! perdido és, povo de Quemos! entregou seus filhos, que iam fugindo, e suas filhas, como cativas a Siom, rei dos amorreus.
text_el: οὐαί σοι Μωαβ ἀπώλου λαὸς Χαμως ἀπεδόθησαν οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτῶν διασῴζεσθαι καὶ αἱ θυγατέρες αὐτῶν αἰχμάλωτοι τῷ βασιλεῖ τῶν Αμορραίων Σηων

text_en: Their yoke is perished from Hesebon unto Dibon , they came weary to Nophe, and unto Medaba.
text_la: Jugum ipsorum disperiit ad Hesebon usque Dibon : lassi pervenerunt in Nophe, et usque Medaba.
text_pt: E nós os derribamos; Hesbom perdida é até Dibom, e os assolamos até Nofá, que se estende até Medeba.
text_el: καὶ τὸ σπέρμα αὐτῶν ἀπολεῖται Εσεβων ἕως Δαιβων καὶ αἱ γυναῖκες ἔτι προσεξέκαυσαν πῦρ ἐπὶ Μωαβ

text_en: So Israel dwelt in the land of the Amorrhite .
text_la: Habitavit itaque Israël in terra Amorrhæi.
text_pt: Assim Israel habitou na terra dos amorreus.
text_el: κατῴκησεν δὲ Ισραηλ ἐν πάσαις ταῖς πόλεσιν τῶν Αμορραίων

text_en: And Moses sent some to take a view of Jazer: and they took the villages of it, and conquered the inhabitants.
text_la: Misitque Moyses qui explorarent Jazer : cujus ceperunt viculos, et possederunt habitatores.
text_pt: Depois mandou Moisés espiar a Jazer, e tomaram as suas aldeias, e daquela possessão lançaram os amorreus que estavam ali.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν Μωυσῆς κατασκέψασθαι τὴν Ιαζηρ καὶ κατελάβοντο αὐτὴν καὶ τὰς κώμας αὐτῆς καὶ ἐξέβαλον τὸν Αμορραῖον τὸν κατοικοῦντα ἐκεῖ

text_en: And they turned themselves, and went up by the way of Basan, and Og the king of Basan came against them with all his people, to fight in Edrai.
text_la: Verteruntque se, et ascenderunt per viam Basan, et occurrit eis Og, rex Basan, cum omni populo suo, pugnaturus in Edrai.
text_pt: Então viraram-se, e subiram o caminho de Basã; e Ogue, rei de Basã, saiu contra eles, ele e todo o seu povo, à peleja em Edrei.
text_el: καὶ ἐπιστρέψαντες ἀνέβησαν ὁδὸν τὴν εἰς Βασαν καὶ ἐξῆλθεν Ωγ βασιλεὺς τῆς Βασαν εἰς συνάντησιν αὐτοῖς καὶ πᾶς ὁ λαὸς αὐτοῦ εἰς πόλεμον εἰς Εδραϊν

text_en: And the Lord said to Moses : Fear him not, for I have delivered him and all his people, and his country into your hand: and you shall do to him as you did to Sehon the king of the Amorrhites , the inhabitant of Hesebon .
text_la: Dixitque Dominus ad Moysen : Ne timeas eum, quia in manu tua tradidi illum, et omnem populum ac terram ejus : faciesque illi sicut fecisti Sehon, regi Amorrhæorum habitatori Hesebon.
text_pt: E disse o Senhor a Moisés: Não o temas, porque eu o tenho dado na tua mão, a ele, e a todo o seu povo, e a sua terra, e far-lhe-ás como fizeste a Siom, rei dos amorreus, que habitava em Hesbom.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν μὴ φοβηθῇς αὐτόν ὅτι εἰς τὰς χεῖράς σου παραδέδωκα αὐτὸν καὶ πάντα τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ καὶ πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν αὐτοῦ καὶ ποιήσεις αὐτῷ καθὼς ἐποίησας τῷ Σηων βασιλεῖ τῶν Αμορραίων ὃς κατῴκει ἐν Εσεβων

text_en: So they slew him also with his sons, and all his people, not letting any one escape, and they possessed his land.
text_la: Percusserunt igitur et hunc cum filiis suis, universumque populum ejus usque ad internecionem, et possederunt terram illius.
text_pt: E de tal maneira o feriram, a ele e a seus filhos, e a todo o seu povo, que nenhum deles escapou; e tomaram a sua terra em possessão.
text_el: καὶ ἐπάταξεν αὐτὸν καὶ τοὺς υἱοὺς αὐτοῦ καὶ πάντα τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ ἕως τοῦ μὴ καταλιπεῖν αὐτοῦ ζωγρείαν καὶ ἐκληρονόμησαν τὴν γῆν αὐτῶν

text_en: And they went forward and encamped in the plains of Moab , over against where Jericho is situate beyond the Jordan .
text_la: Profectique castrametati sunt in campestribus Moab, ubi trans Jordanem Jericho sita est.
text_pt: Depois partiram os filhos de Israel, e acamparam-se nas campinas de Moabe, além do Jordão na altura de Jericó.
text_el: καὶ ἀπάραντες οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ παρενέβαλον ἐπὶ δυσμῶν Μωαβ παρὰ τὸν Ιορδάνην κατὰ Ιεριχω

text_en: And Balac the son of Sephor, seeing all that Israel had done to the Amorrhite ,
text_la: Videns autem Balac filius Sephor omnia quæ fecerat Israël Amorrhæo,
text_pt: Vendo, pois, Balaque, filho de Zipor, tudo o que Israel fizera aos amorreus,
text_el: καὶ ἰδὼν Βαλακ υἱὸς Σεπφωρ πάντα ὅσα ἐποίησεν Ισραηλ τῷ Αμορραίῳ

text_en: and that the Moabites were in great fear of him, and were not able to sustain his assault,
text_la: et quod pertimuissent eum Moabitæ, et impetum ejus ferre non possent,
text_pt: Moabe temeu muito diante deste povo, porque era numeroso; e Moabe andava angustiado por causa dos filhos de Israel.
text_el: καὶ ἐφοβήθη Μωαβ τὸν λαὸν σφόδρα ὅτι πολλοὶ ἦσαν καὶ προσώχθισεν Μωαβ ἀπὸ προσώπου υἱῶν Ισραηλ

text_en: he said to the elders of Madian : So will this people destroy all that dwell in our borders, as the ox is wont to eat the grass to the very roots. Now he was at that time king in Moab .
text_la: dixit ad majores natu Madian : Ita delebit hic populus omnes, qui in nostris finibus commorantur, quomodo solet bos herbas usque ad radices carpere. Ipse erat eo tempore rex in Moab.
text_pt: Por isso Moabe disse aos anciãos dos midianitas: Agora lamberá esta congregação tudo quanto houver ao redor de nós, como o boi lambe a erva do campo. Naquele tempo Balaque, filho de Zipor, era rei dos moabitas.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Μωαβ τῇ γερουσίᾳ Μαδιαμ νῦν ἐκλείξει ἡ συναγωγὴ αὕτη πάντας τοὺς κύκλῳ ἡμῶν ὡς ἐκλείξαι ὁ μόσχος τὰ χλωρὰ ἐκ τοῦ πεδίου καὶ Βαλακ υἱὸς Σεπφωρ βασιλεὺς Μωαβ ἦν κατὰ τὸν καιρὸν ἐκεῖνον

text_en: He sent therefore messengers to Balaam the son of Beor , a soothsayer , who dwelt by the river of the land of the children of Ammon , to call him, and to say: Behold a people has come out of Egypt , that has covered the face of the earth, sitting over against me.
text_la: Misit ergo nuntios ad Balaam filium Beor ariolum, qui habitabat super flumen terræ filiorum Ammon, ut vocarent eum, et dicerent : Ecce egressus est populus ex Ægypto, qui operuit superficiem terræ, sedens contra me.
text_pt: Este enviou mensageiros a Balaão, filho de Beor, a Petor, que está junto ao rio, na terra dos filhos do seu povo, a chamá-lo, dizendo: Eis que um povo saiu do Egito; eis que cobre a face da terra, e está parado defronte de mim.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν πρέσβεις πρὸς Βαλααμ υἱὸν Βεωρ Φαθουρα ὅ ἐστιν ἐπὶ τοῦ ποταμοῦ γῆς υἱῶν λαοῦ αὐτοῦ καλέσαι αὐτὸν λέγων ἰδοὺ λαὸς ἐξελήλυθεν ἐξ Αἰγύπτου καὶ ἰδοὺ κατεκάλυψεν τὴν ὄψιν τῆς γῆς καὶ οὗτος ἐγκάθηται ἐχόμενός μου

text_en: Come therefore, and curse this people, because it is mightier than I: if by any means I may beat them and drive them out of my land: for I know that he whom you shall bless is blessed , and he whom you shall curse is cursed .
text_la: Veni igitur, et maledic populo huic, quia fortior me est : si quomodo possim percutere et ejicere eum de terra mea. Novi enim quod benedictus sit cui benedixeris, et maledictus in quem maledicta congesseris.
text_pt: Vem, pois, agora, rogo-te, amaldiçoa-me este povo, pois mais poderoso é do que eu; talvez o poderei ferir e lançar fora da terra; porque eu sei que, a quem tu abençoares será abençoado, e a quem tu amaldiçoares será amaldiçoado.
text_el: καὶ νῦν δεῦρο ἄρασαί μοι τὸν λαὸν τοῦτον ὅτι ἰσχύει οὗτος ἢ ἡμεῖς ἐὰν δυνώμεθα πατάξαι ἐξ αὐτῶν καὶ ἐκβαλῶ αὐτοὺς ἐκ τῆς γῆς ὅτι οἶδα οὓς ἐὰν εὐλογήσῃς σύ εὐλόγηνται καὶ οὓς ἐὰν καταράσῃ σύ κεκατήρανται

text_en: And the ancients of Moab , and the elders of Madian , went with the price of divination in their hands. And where they had come to Balaam , and had told him all the words of Balac:
text_la: Perrexeruntque seniores Moab, et majores natu Madian, habentes divinationis pretium in manibus. Cumque venissent ad Balaam, et narrassent ei omnia verba Balac,
text_pt: Então foram-se os anciãos dos moabitas e os anciãos dos midianitas com o preço dos encantamentos nas suas mãos; e chegaram a Balaão, e disseram-lhe as palavras de Balaque.
text_el: καὶ ἐπορεύθη ἡ γερουσία Μωαβ καὶ ἡ γερουσία Μαδιαμ καὶ τὰ μαντεῖα ἐν ταῖς χερσὶν αὐτῶν καὶ ἦλθον πρὸς Βαλααμ καὶ εἶπαν αὐτῷ τὰ ῥήματα Βαλακ

text_en: He answered: Tarry here this night and I will answer whatsoever the Lord shall say to me. And while they stayed with Balaam , God came and said to him:
text_la: ille respondit : Manete hic nocte, et respondebo quidquid mihi dixerit Dominus. Manentibus illis apud Balaam, venit Deus, et ait ad eum:
text_pt: E ele lhes disse: Passai aqui esta noite, e vos trarei a resposta, como o Senhor me falar; então os príncipes dos moabitas ficaram com Balaão.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς καταλύσατε αὐτοῦ τὴν νύκτα καὶ ἀποκριθήσομαι ὑμῖν πράγματα ἃ ἐὰν λαλήσῃ κύριος πρός με καὶ κατέμειναν οἱ ἄρχοντες Μωαβ παρὰ Βαλααμ

text_en: What mean these men that are with you?
text_la: Quid sibi volunt homines isti apud te?
text_pt: E veio Deus a Balaão, e disse: Quem são estes homens que estão contigo?
text_el: καὶ ἦλθεν ὁ θεὸς πρὸς Βαλααμ καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ τί οἱ ἄνθρωποι οὗτοι παρὰ σοί

text_en: He answered: Balac the son of Sephor king of the Moabites has sent to me,
text_la: Respondit : Balac filius Sephor rex Moabitarum misit ad me,
text_pt: E Balaão disse a Deus: Balaque, filho de Zipor, rei dos moabitas, os enviou, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Βαλααμ πρὸς τὸν θεόν Βαλακ υἱὸς Σεπφωρ βασιλεὺς Μωαβ ἀπέστειλεν αὐτοὺς πρός με λέγων

text_en: saying: Behold a people that has come out of Egypt , has covered the face of the land: come and curse them, if by any means I may fight with them and drive them away.
text_la: dicens : Ecce populus qui egressus est de Ægypto, operuit superficiem terræ : veni, et maledic ei, si quomodo possim pugnans abigere eum.
text_pt: Eis que o povo que saiu do Egito cobre a face da terra; vem agora, amaldiçoa-o; porventura poderei pelejar contra ele e expulsá-lo.
text_el: ἰδοὺ λαὸς ἐξελήλυθεν ἐξ Αἰγύπτου καὶ ἰδοὺ κεκάλυφεν τὴν ὄψιν τῆς γῆς καὶ οὗτος ἐγκάθηται ἐχόμενός μου καὶ νῦν δεῦρο ἄρασαί μοι αὐτόν εἰ ἄρα δυνήσομαι πατάξαι αὐτὸν καὶ ἐκβαλῶ αὐτὸν ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς

text_en: And God said to Balaam : You shall not go with them, nor shall you curse the people: because it is blessed .
text_la: Dixitque Deus ad Balaam : Noli ire cum eis, neque maledicas populo : quia benedictus est.
text_pt: Então disse Deus a Balaão: Não irás com eles, nem amaldiçoarás a este povo, porquanto é bendito.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ θεὸς πρὸς Βαλααμ οὐ πορεύσῃ μετ' αὐτῶν οὐδὲ καταράσῃ τὸν λαόν ἔστιν γὰρ εὐλογημένος

text_en: And he rose in the morning and said to the princes: Go into your country, because the Lord has forbid me to come with you.
text_la: Qui mane consurgens dixit ad principes : Ite in terram vestram, quia prohibuit me Dominus venire vobiscum.
text_pt: Então Balaão levantou-se pela manhã, e disse aos príncipes de Balaque: Ide à vossa terra, porque o Senhor recusa deixar-me ir convosco.
text_el: καὶ ἀναστὰς Βαλααμ τὸ πρωὶ εἶπεν τοῖς ἄρχουσιν Βαλακ ἀποτρέχετε πρὸς τὸν κύριον ὑμῶν οὐκ ἀφίησίν με ὁ θεὸς πορεύεσθαι μεθ' ὑμῶν

text_en: The princes returning, said to Balac: Balaam would not come with us.
text_la: Reversi principes dixerunt ad Balac: Noluit Balaam venire nobiscum.
text_pt: E levantaram-se os príncipes dos moabitas, e vieram a Balaque, e disseram: Balaão recusou vir conosco.
text_el: καὶ ἀναστάντες οἱ ἄρχοντες Μωαβ ἦλθον πρὸς Βαλακ καὶ εἶπαν οὐ θέλει Βαλααμ πορευθῆναι μεθ' ἡμῶν

text_en: Then he sent many more and more noble than he had sent before:
text_la: Rursum ille multo plures et nobiliores quam ante miserat, misit.
text_pt: Porém Balaque tornou a enviar mais príncipes, mais honrados do que aqueles.
text_el: καὶ προσέθετο Βαλακ ἔτι ἀποστεῖλαι ἄρχοντας πλείους καὶ ἐντιμοτέρους τούτων

text_en: Who, when they had come to Balaam , said: Thus says Balac the son of Sephor, Delay not to come to me:
text_la: Qui cum venissent ad Balaam, dixerunt : Sic dicit Balac filius Sephor : Ne cuncteris venire ad me:
text_pt: Os quais foram a Balaão, e lhe disseram: Assim diz Balaque, filho de Zipor: Rogo-te que não te demores em vir a mim.
text_el: καὶ ἦλθον πρὸς Βαλααμ καὶ λέγουσιν αὐτῷ τάδε λέγει Βαλακ ὁ τοῦ Σεπφωρ ἀξιῶ σε μὴ ὀκνήσῃς ἐλθεῖν πρός με

text_en: For I am ready to honour you, and will give you whatsoever you will: come and curse this people.
text_la: paratus sum honorare te, et quidquid volueris, dabo tibi : veni, et maledic populo isti.
text_pt: Porque grandemente te honrarei, e farei tudo o que me disseres; vem pois, rogo-te, amaldiçoa-me este povo.
text_el: ἐντίμως γὰρ τιμήσω σε καὶ ὅσα ἐὰν εἴπῃς ποιήσω σοι καὶ δεῦρο ἐπικατάρασαί μοι τὸν λαὸν τοῦτον

text_en: Balaam answered: If Balac would give me his house full of silver and gold, I cannot alter the word of the Lord my God , to speak either more or less.
text_la: Respondit Balaam : Si dederit mihi Balac plenam domum suam argenti et auri, non potero immutare verbum Domini Dei mei, ut vel plus, vel minus loquar.
text_pt: Então Balaão respondeu, e disse aos servos de Balaque: Ainda que Balaque me desse a sua casa cheia de prata e de ouro, eu não poderia ir além da ordem do Senhor meu Deus, para fazer coisa pequena ou grande;
text_el: καὶ ἀπεκρίθη Βαλααμ καὶ εἶπεν τοῖς ἄρχουσιν Βαλακ ἐὰν δῷ μοι Βαλακ πλήρη τὸν οἶκον αὐτοῦ ἀργυρίου καὶ χρυσίου οὐ δυνήσομαι παραβῆναι τὸ ῥῆμα κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ ποιῆσαι αὐτὸ μικρὸν ἢ μέγα ἐν τῇ διανοίᾳ μου

text_en: I pray you to stay here this night also, that I may know what the Lord will answer me once more.
text_la: Obsecro ut hic maneatis etiam hac nocte, et scire queam quid mihi rursum respondeat Dominus.
text_pt: Agora, pois, rogo-vos que também aqui fiqueis esta noite, para que eu saiba o que mais o Senhor me dirá.
text_el: καὶ νῦν ὑπομείνατε αὐτοῦ καὶ ὑμεῖς τὴν νύκτα ταύτην καὶ γνώσομαι τί προσθήσει κύριος λαλῆσαι πρός με

text_en: God therefore came to Balaam in the night, and said to him: If these men be come to call you, arise and go with them: yet so, that you do what I shall command you.
text_la: Venit ergo Deus ad Balaam nocte, et ait ei : Si vocare te venerunt homines isti, surge, et vade cum eis : ita dumtaxat, ut quod tibi præcepero, facias.
text_pt: Veio, pois, Deus a Balaão, de noite, e disse-lhe: Se aqueles homens te vieram chamar, levanta-te, vai com eles; todavia, farás o que eu te disser.
text_el: καὶ ἦλθεν ὁ θεὸς πρὸς Βαλααμ νυκτὸς καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ εἰ καλέσαι σε πάρεισιν οἱ ἄνθρωποι οὗτοι ἀναστὰς ἀκολούθησον αὐτοῖς ἀλλὰ τὸ ῥῆμα ὃ ἂν λαλήσω πρὸς σέ τοῦτο ποιήσεις

text_en: Balaam arose in the morning, and saddling his ass went with them.
text_la: Surrexit Balaam mane, et strata asina sua profectus est cum eis.
text_pt: Então Balaão levantou-se pela manhã, e albardou a sua jumenta, e foi com os príncipes de Moabe.
text_el: καὶ ἀναστὰς Βαλααμ τὸ πρωὶ ἐπέσαξεν τὴν ὄνον αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπορεύθη μετὰ τῶν ἀρχόντων Μωαβ

text_en: And God was angry . And an angel of the Lord stood in the way against Balaam , who sat on the ass, and had two servants with him.
text_la: Et iratus est Deus. Stetitque angelus Domini in via contra Balaam, qui insidebat asinæ, et duos pueros habebat secum.
text_pt: E a ira de Deus acendeu-se, porque ele se ia; e o anjo do Senhor pôs-se-lhe no caminho por adversário; e ele ia caminhando, montado na sua jumenta, e dois de seus servos com ele.
text_el: καὶ ὠργίσθη θυμῷ ὁ θεὸς ὅτι ἐπορεύθη αὐτός καὶ ἀνέστη ὁ ἄγγελος τοῦ θεοῦ ἐνδιαβάλλειν αὐτόν καὶ αὐτὸς ἐπιβεβήκει ἐπὶ τῆς ὄνου αὐτοῦ καὶ δύο παῖδες αὐτοῦ μετ' αὐτοῦ

text_en: The ass seeing the angel standing in the way, with a drawn sword, turned herself out of the way, and went into the field. And when Balaam beat her, and had a mind to bring her again to the way,
text_la: Cernens asina angelum stantem in via, evaginato gladio, avertit se de itinere, et ibat per agrum. Quam cum verberaret Balaam, et vellet ad semitam reducere,
text_pt: Viu, pois, a jumenta o anjo do Senhor, que estava no caminho, com a sua espada desembainhada na mão; pelo que desviou-se a jumenta do caminho, indo pelo campo; então Balaão espancou a jumenta para fazê-la tornar ao caminho.
text_el: καὶ ἰδοῦσα ἡ ὄνος τὸν ἄγγελον τοῦ θεοῦ ἀνθεστηκότα ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ καὶ τὴν ῥομφαίαν ἐσπασμένην ἐν τῇ χειρὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐξέκλινεν ἡ ὄνος ἐκ τῆς ὁδοῦ καὶ ἐπορεύετο εἰς τὸ πεδίον καὶ ἐπάταξεν τὴν ὄνον τῇ ῥάβδῳ τοῦ εὐθῦναι αὐτὴν ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ

text_en: the angel stood in a narrow place between two walls, wherewith the vineyards were enclosed.
text_la: stetit angelus in angustiis duarum maceriarum, quibus vineæ cingebantur.
text_pt: Mas o anjo do Senhor pôs-se numa vereda entre as vinhas, havendo uma parede de um e de outro lado.
text_el: καὶ ἔστη ὁ ἄγγελος τοῦ θεοῦ ἐν ταῖς αὔλαξιν τῶν ἀμπέλων φραγμὸς ἐντεῦθεν καὶ φραγμὸς ἐντεῦθεν

text_en: And the ass seeing him, thrust herself close to the wall, and bruised the foot of the rider. But he beat her again:
text_la: Quem videns asina, junxit se parieti, et attrivit sedentis pedem. At ille iterum verberabat eam:
text_pt: Vendo, pois, a jumenta, o anjo do Senhor, encostou-se contra a parede, e apertou contra a parede o pé de Balaão; por isso tornou a espancá-la.
text_el: καὶ ἰδοῦσα ἡ ὄνος τὸν ἄγγελον τοῦ θεοῦ προσέθλιψεν ἑαυτὴν πρὸς τὸν τοῖχον καὶ ἀπέθλιψεν τὸν πόδα Βαλααμ καὶ προσέθετο ἔτι μαστίξαι αὐτήν

text_en: And nevertheless the angel going on to a narrow place, where there was no way to turn aside either to the right hand or to the left, stood to meet him.
text_la: et nihilominus angelus ad locum angustum transiens, ubi nec ad dexteram, nec ad sinistram poterat deviare, obvius stetit.
text_pt: Então o anjo do Senhor passou mais adiante, e pôs-se num lugar estreito, onde não havia caminho para se desviar nem para a direita nem para a esquerda.
text_el: καὶ προσέθετο ὁ ἄγγελος τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ ἀπελθὼν ὑπέστη ἐν τόπῳ στενῷ εἰς ὃν οὐκ ἦν ἐκκλῖναι δεξιὰν οὐδὲ ἀριστεράν

text_en: And when the ass saw the angel standing, she fell under the feet of the rider: who being angry beat her sides more vehemently with a staff.
text_la: Cumque vidisset asina stantem angelum, concidit sub pedibus sedentis : qui iratus, vehementius cædebat fuste latera ejus.
text_pt: E, vendo a jumenta o anjo do Senhor, deitou-se debaixo de Balaão; e a ira de Balaão acendeu-se, e espancou a jumenta com o bordão.
text_el: καὶ ἰδοῦσα ἡ ὄνος τὸν ἄγγελον τοῦ θεοῦ συνεκάθισεν ὑποκάτω Βαλααμ καὶ ἐθυμώθη Βαλααμ καὶ ἔτυπτεν τὴν ὄνον τῇ ῥάβδῳ

text_en: And the Lord opened the mouth of the ass, and she said: What have I done to you? Why do you strike me, lo, now this third time?
text_la: Aperuitque Dominus os asinæ, et locuta est : Quid feci tibi? cur percutis me ecce jam tertio?
text_pt: Então o Senhor abriu a boca da jumenta, a qual disse a Balaão: Que te fiz eu, que me espancaste estas três vezes?
text_el: καὶ ἤνοιξεν ὁ θεὸς τὸ στόμα τῆς ὄνου καὶ λέγει τῷ Βαλααμ τί ἐποίησά σοι ὅτι πέπαικάς με τοῦτο τρίτον

text_en: Balaam answered: Because you have deserved it, and have served me ill: I would I had a sword that I might kill you.
text_la: Respondit Balaam : Quia commeruisti, et illusisti mihi : utinam haberem gladium, ut te percuterem!
text_pt: E Balaão disse à jumenta: Por que zombaste de mim; quem dera tivesse eu uma espada na mão, porque agora te mataria.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Βαλααμ τῇ ὄνῳ ὅτι ἐμπέπαιχάς μοι καὶ εἰ εἶχον μάχαιραν ἐν τῇ χειρί μου ἤδη ἂν ἐξεκέντησά σε

text_en: The ass said: Am not I your beast, on which you have been always accustomed to ride until this present day? Tell me if I ever did the like thing to you. But he said: Never.
text_la: Dixit asina : Nonne animal tuum sum, cui semper sedere consuevisti usque in præsentem diem? dic quid simile umquam fecerim tibi. At ille ait : Numquam.
text_pt: E a jumenta disse a Balaão: Porventura não sou a tua jumenta, em que cavalgaste desde o tempo em que me tornei tua até hoje? Acaso tem sido o meu costume fazer assim contigo? E ele respondeu: Não.
text_el: καὶ λέγει ἡ ὄνος τῷ Βαλααμ οὐκ ἐγὼ ἡ ὄνος σου ἐφ' ἧς ἐπέβαινες ἀπὸ νεότητός σου ἕως τῆς σήμερον ἡμέρας μὴ ὑπεροράσει ὑπεριδοῦσα ἐποίησά σοι οὕτως ὁ δὲ εἶπεν οὐχί

text_en: Forthwith the Lord opened the eyes of Balaam , and he saw the angel standing in the way with a drawn sword, and he worshipped him falling flat on the ground.
text_la: Protinus aperuit Dominus oculos Balaam, et vidit angelum stantem in via, evaginato gladio, adoravitque eum pronus in terram.
text_pt: Então o Senhor abriu os olhos a Balaão, e ele viu o anjo do Senhor, que estava no caminho e a sua espada desembainhada na mão; pelo que inclinou a cabeça, e prostrou-se sobre a sua face.
text_el: ἀπεκάλυψεν δὲ ὁ θεὸς τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς Βαλααμ καὶ ὁρᾷ τὸν ἄγγελον κυρίου ἀνθεστηκότα ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ καὶ τὴν μάχαιραν ἐσπασμένην ἐν τῇ χειρὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ κύψας προσεκύνησεν τῷ προσώπῳ αὐτοῦ

text_en: And the angel said to him: Why do you beat your ass these three times? I have come to withstand you, because your way is perverse, and contrary to me:
text_la: Cui angelus : Cur, inquit, tertio verberas asinam tuam? ego veni ut adversarer tibi, quia perversa est via tua, mihique contraria:
text_pt: Então o anjo do Senhor lhe disse: Por que já três vezes espancaste a tua jumenta? Eis que eu saí para ser teu adversário, porquanto o teu caminho é perverso diante de mim;
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ ὁ ἄγγελος τοῦ θεοῦ διὰ τί ἐπάταξας τὴν ὄνον σου τοῦτο τρίτον καὶ ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἐξῆλθον εἰς διαβολήν σου ὅτι οὐκ ἀστεία ἡ ὁδός σου ἐναντίον μου

text_en: And unless the ass had turned out of the way, giving place to me who stood against you, I had slain you, and she should have lived.
text_la: et nisi asina declinasset de via, dans locum resistenti, te occidissem, et illa viveret.
text_pt: Porém a jumenta me viu, e já três vezes se desviou de diante de mim; se ela não se desviasse de diante de mim, na verdade que eu agora te haveria matado, e a ela deixaria com vida.
text_el: καὶ ἰδοῦσά με ἡ ὄνος ἐξέκλινεν ἀπ' ἐμοῦ τρίτον τοῦτο καὶ εἰ μὴ ἐξέκλινεν νῦν οὖν σὲ μὲν ἀπέκτεινα ἐκείνην δὲ περιεποιησάμην

text_en: Balaam said: I have sinned , not knowing that you stood against me: and now if it displease you that I go, I will return.
text_la: Dixit Balaam : Peccavi, nesciens quod tu stares contra me : et nunc si displicet tibi ut vadam, revertar.
text_pt: Então Balaão disse ao anjo do Senhor: Pequei, porque não sabia que estavas neste caminho para te opores a mim; e agora, se parece mal aos teus olhos, voltarei.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Βαλααμ τῷ ἀγγέλῳ κυρίου ἡμάρτηκα οὐ γὰρ ἠπιστάμην ὅτι σύ μοι ἀνθέστηκας ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ εἰς συνάντησιν καὶ νῦν εἰ μή σοι ἀρέσκει ἀποστραφήσομαι

text_en: The angel said: Go with these men , and see that you speak no other thing than what I shall command you. He went therefore with the princes.
text_la: Ait angelus : Vade cum istis, et cave ne aliud quam præcepero tibi loquaris. Ivit igitur cum principibus.
text_pt: E disse o anjo do Senhor a Balaão: Vai-te com estes homens; mas somente a palavra que eu falar a ti, esta falarás. Assim Balaão se foi com os príncipes de Balaque.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ ἄγγελος τοῦ θεοῦ πρὸς Βαλααμ συμπορεύθητι μετὰ τῶν ἀνθρώπων πλὴν τὸ ῥῆμα ὃ ἐὰν εἴπω πρὸς σέ τοῦτο φυλάξῃ λαλῆσαι καὶ ἐπορεύθη Βαλααμ μετὰ τῶν ἀρχόντων Βαλακ

text_en: And when Balac heard it he came forth to meet him in a town of the Moabites , that is situate in the uttermost borders of Arnon.
text_la: Quod cum audisset Balac, egressus est in occursum ejus in oppido Moabitarum, quod situm est in extremis finibus Arnon.
text_pt: Ouvindo, pois, Balaque que Balaão vinha, saiu-lhe ao encontro até à cidade de Moabe, que está no termo de Arnom, na extremidade do termo dele.
text_el: καὶ ἀκούσας Βαλακ ὅτι ἥκει Βαλααμ ἐξῆλθεν εἰς συνάντησιν αὐτῷ εἰς πόλιν Μωαβ ἥ ἐστιν ἐπὶ τῶν ὁρίων Αρνων ὅ ἐστιν ἐκ μέρους τῶν ὁρίων

text_en: And he said to Balaam : I sent messengers to call you, why did you not come immediately to me? Was it because I am not able to reward your coming?
text_la: Dixitque ad Balaam : Misi nuntios ut vocarent te : cur non statim venisti ad me? an quia mercedem adventui tuo reddere nequeo?
text_pt: E Balaque disse a Balaão: Porventura não enviei diligentemente a chamar-te? Por que não vieste a mim? Não posso eu na verdade honrar-te?
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Βαλακ πρὸς Βαλααμ οὐχὶ ἀπέστειλα πρὸς σὲ καλέσαι σε διὰ τί οὐκ ἤρχου πρός με ὄντως οὐ δυνήσομαι τιμῆσαί σε

text_en: He answered him: Lo, here I am: shall I have power to speak any other thing but that which God shall put in my mouth?
text_la: Cui ille respondit : Ecce adsum : numquid loqui potero aliud, nisi quod Deus posuerit in ore meo?
text_pt: Então Balaão disse a Balaque: Eis que eu tenho vindo a ti; porventura poderei eu agora de alguma forma falar alguma coisa? A palavra que Deus puser na minha boca, essa falarei.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Βαλααμ πρὸς Βαλακ ἰδοὺ ἥκω πρὸς σέ νῦν δυνατὸς ἔσομαι λαλῆσαί τι τὸ ῥῆμα ὃ ἐὰν βάλῃ ὁ θεὸς εἰς τὸ στόμα μου τοῦτο λαλήσω

text_en: So they went on together, and came into a city, that was in the uttermost borders of his kingdom.
text_la: Perrexerunt ergo simul, et venerunt in urbem, quæ in extremis regni ejus finibus erat.
text_pt: E Balaão foi com Balaque, e chegaram a Quiriate-Huzote.
text_el: καὶ ἐπορεύθη Βαλααμ μετὰ Βαλακ καὶ ἦλθον εἰς πόλεις ἐπαύλεων

text_en: And when Balac had killed oxen and sheep, he sent presents to Balaam , and to the princes that were with him.
text_la: Cumque occidisset Balac boves et oves, misit ad Balaam, et principes qui cum eo erant, munera.
text_pt: Então Balaque matou bois e ovelhas; e deles enviou a Balaão e aos príncipes que estavam com ele.
text_el: καὶ ἔθυσεν Βαλακ πρόβατα καὶ μόσχους καὶ ἀπέστειλεν τῷ Βαλααμ καὶ τοῖς ἄρχουσι τοῖς μετ' αὐτοῦ

text_en: And when morning had come, he brought him to the high places of Baal , and he beheld the uttermost part of the people.
text_la: Mane autem facto, duxit eum ad excelsa Baal, et intuitus est extremam partem populi.
text_pt: E sucedeu que, pela manhã Balaque tomou a Balaão, e o fez subir aos altos de Baal, e viu ele dali a última parte do povo.
text_el: καὶ ἐγενήθη πρωὶ καὶ παραλαβὼν Βαλακ τὸν Βαλααμ ἀνεβίβασεν αὐτὸν ἐπὶ τὴν στήλην τοῦ Βααλ καὶ ἔδειξεν αὐτῷ ἐκεῖθεν μέρος τι τοῦ λαοῦ

text_en: And Balaam said to Balac: Build me here seven altars , and prepare as many calves, and the same number of rams.
text_la: Dixitque Balaam ad Balac : Ædifica mihi hic septem aras, et para totidem vitulos, ejusdemque numeri arietes.
text_pt: Então Balaão disse a Balaque: Edifica-me aqui sete altares, e prepara-me aqui sete novilhos e sete carneiros.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Βαλααμ τῷ Βαλακ οἰκοδόμησόν μοι ἐνταῦθα ἑπτὰ βωμοὺς καὶ ἑτοίμασόν μοι ἐνταῦθα ἑπτὰ μόσχους καὶ ἑπτὰ κριούς

text_en: And when he had done according to the word of Balaam , they laid together a calf and a ram upon every altar .
text_la: Cumque fecisset juxta sermonem Balaam, imposuerunt simul vitulum et arietem super aram.
text_pt: Fez, pois, Balaque como Balaão dissera: e Balaque e Balaão ofereceram um novilho e um carneiro sobre cada altar.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησεν Βαλακ ὃν τρόπον εἶπεν αὐτῷ Βαλααμ καὶ ἀνήνεγκεν μόσχον καὶ κριὸν ἐπὶ τὸν βωμόν

text_en: And Balaam said to Balac: Stand a while by your burnt offering , until I go, to see if perhaps the Lord will meet me, and whatsoever he shall command, I will speak to you.
