text_la: Dixitque Balaam ad Balac : Sta paulisper juxta holocaustum tuum, donec vadam, si forte occurrat mihi Dominus, et quodcumque imperaverit, loquar tibi.
text_pt: Então Balaão disse a Balaque: Fica-te junto do teu holocausto, e eu irei; porventura o Senhor me sairá ao encontro, e o que me mostrar te notificarei. Então foi a um lugar alto.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Βαλααμ πρὸς Βαλακ παράστηθι ἐπὶ τῆς θυσίας σου καὶ πορεύσομαι εἴ μοι φανεῖται ὁ θεὸς ἐν συναντήσει καὶ ῥῆμα ὃ ἐάν μοι δείξῃ ἀναγγελῶ σοι καὶ παρέστη Βαλακ ἐπὶ τῆς θυσίας αὐτοῦ καὶ Βαλααμ ἐπορεύθη ἐπερωτῆσαι τὸν θεὸν καὶ ἐπορεύθη εὐθεῖαν

text_en: And when he had gone with speed, God met him. And Balaam speaking to him, said: I have erected seven altars , and have laid on everyone a calf and a ram.
text_la: Cumque abiisset velociter, occurrit illi Deus. Locutusque ad eum Balaam : Septem, inquit, aras erexi, et imposui vitulum et arietem desuper.
text_pt: E encontrando-se Deus com Balaão, este lhe disse: Preparei sete altares, e ofereci um novilho e um carneiro sobre cada altar.
text_el: καὶ ἐφάνη ὁ θεὸς τῷ Βαλααμ καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτὸν Βαλααμ τοὺς ἑπτὰ βωμοὺς ἡτοίμασα καὶ ἀνεβίβασα μόσχον καὶ κριὸν ἐπὶ τὸν βωμόν

text_en: And the Lord put the word in his mouth, and said: Return to Balac, and thus shall you speak.
text_la: Dominus autem posuit verbum in ore ejus, et ait : Revertere ad Balac, et hæc loqueris.
text_pt: Então o Senhor pôs a palavra na boca de Balaão, e disse: Torna-te para Balaque, e assim falarás.
text_el: καὶ ἐνέβαλεν ὁ θεὸς ῥῆμα εἰς τὸ στόμα Βαλααμ καὶ εἶπεν ἐπιστραφεὶς πρὸς Βαλακ οὕτως λαλήσεις

text_en: Returning he found Balac standing by his burnt offering , with all the princes of the Moabites :
text_la: Reversus invenit stantem Balac juxta holocaustum suum, et omnes principes Moabitarum:
text_pt: E tornando para ele, eis que estava junto do seu holocausto, ele e todos os príncipes dos moabitas.
text_el: καὶ ἀπεστράφη πρὸς αὐτόν καὶ ὅδε ἐφειστήκει ἐπὶ τῶν ὁλοκαυτωμάτων αὐτοῦ καὶ πάντες οἱ ἄρχοντες Μωαβ μετ' αὐτοῦ

text_en: And taking up his parable , he said: Balac king of the Moabites has brought me from Aram, from the mountains of the east: Come, said he, and curse Jacob : make haste and detest Israel .
text_la: assumptaque parabola sua, dixit : De Aram adduxit me Balac rex Moabitarum, de montibus orientis : Veni, inquit, et maledic Jacob; propera, et detestare Israël.
text_pt: Então proferiu a sua parábola, e disse: De Arã, me mandou trazer Balaque, rei dos moabitas, das montanhas do oriente, dizendo: Vem, amaldiçoa-me a Jacó; e vem, denuncia a Israel.
text_el: καὶ ἐγενήθη πνεῦμα θεοῦ ἐπ' αὐτῷ καὶ ἀναλαβὼν τὴν παραβολὴν αὐτοῦ εἶπεν ἐκ Μεσοποταμίας μετεπέμψατό με Βαλακ βασιλεὺς Μωαβ ἐξ ὀρέων ἀπ' ἀνατολῶν λέγων δεῦρο ἄρασαί μοι τὸν Ιακωβ καὶ δεῦρο ἐπικατάρασαί μοι τὸν Ισραηλ

text_en: How shall I curse him, whom God has not cursed ? By what means should I detest him, whom the Lord detests not?
text_la: Quomodo maledicam, cui non maledixit Deus? qua ratione detester, quem Dominus non detestatur?
text_pt: Como amaldiçoarei o que Deus não amaldiçoa? E como denunciarei, quando o Senhor não denuncia?
text_el: τί ἀράσωμαι ὃν μὴ καταρᾶται κύριος ἢ τί καταράσωμαι ὃν μὴ καταρᾶται ὁ θεός

text_en: I shall see him from the tops of the rocks, and shall consider him from the hills. This people shall dwell alone, and shall not be reckoned among the nations.
text_la: De summis silicibus videbo eum, et de collibus considerabo illum. Populus solus habitabit, et inter gentes non reputabitur.
text_pt: Porque do cume das penhas o vejo, e dos outeiros o contemplo; eis que este povo habitará só, e entre as nações não será contado.
text_el: ὅτι ἀπὸ κορυφῆς ὀρέων ὄψομαι αὐτὸν καὶ ἀπὸ βουνῶν προσνοήσω αὐτόν ἰδοὺ λαὸς μόνος κατοικήσει καὶ ἐν ἔθνεσιν οὐ συλλογισθήσεται

text_en: Who can count the dust of Jacob , and know the number of the stock of Israel ? Let my soul die the death of the just , and my last end be like to them.
text_la: Quis dinumerare possit pulverem Jacob, et nosse numerum stirpis Israël? Moriatur anima mea morte justorum, et fiant novissima mea horum similia.
text_pt: Quem contará o pó de Jacó e o número da quarta parte de Israel? Que a minha alma morra da morte dos justos, e seja o meu fim como o seu.
text_el: τίς ἐξηκριβάσατο τὸ σπέρμα Ιακωβ καὶ τίς ἐξαριθμήσεται δήμους Ισραηλ ἀποθάνοι ἡ ψυχή μου ἐν ψυχαῖς δικαίων καὶ γένοιτο τὸ σπέρμα μου ὡς τὸ σπέρμα τούτων

text_en: And Balac said to Balaam : What is this that you do? I sent for you to curse my enemies: and you contrariwise bless them.
text_la: Dixitque Balac ad Balaam : Quid est hoc quod agis? ut malediceres inimicis meis vocavi te, et tu e contrario benedicis eis.
text_pt: Então disse Balaque a Balaão: Que me fizeste? Chamei-te para amaldiçoar os meus inimigos, mas eis que inteiramente os abençoaste.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Βαλακ πρὸς Βαλααμ τί πεποίηκάς μοι εἰς κατάρασιν ἐχθρῶν μου κέκληκά σε καὶ ἰδοὺ εὐλόγηκας εὐλογίαν

text_en: He answered him: Can I speak anything else but what the Lord commands?
text_la: Cui ille respondit : Num aliud possum loqui, nisi quod jusserit Dominus?
text_pt: E ele respondeu, e disse: Porventura não terei cuidado de falar o que o Senhor pôs na minha boca?
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Βαλααμ πρὸς Βαλακ οὐχὶ ὅσα ἐὰν ἐμβάλῃ ὁ θεὸς εἰς τὸ στόμα μου τοῦτο φυλάξω λαλῆσαι

text_en: Balac therefore said: Come with me to another place from whence you may see part of Israel , and can not see them all: curse them from thence.
text_la: Dixit ergo Balac : Veni mecum in alterum locum unde partem Israël videas, et totum videre non possis : inde maledicito ei.
text_pt: Então Balaque lhe disse: Rogo-te que venhas comigo a outro lugar, de onde o verás; verás somente a última parte dele, mas a todo ele não verás; e amaldiçoa-mo dali.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτὸν Βαλακ δεῦρο ἔτι μετ' ἐμοῦ εἰς τόπον ἄλλον ἐξ ὧν οὐκ ὄψῃ αὐτὸν ἐκεῖθεν ἀλλ' ἢ μέρος τι αὐτοῦ ὄψῃ πάντας δὲ οὐ μὴ ἴδῃς καὶ κατάρασαί μοι αὐτὸν ἐκεῖθεν

text_en: And when he had brought him to a high place, upon the top of mount Phasga , Balaam built seven altars , and laying on every one a calf and a ram,
text_la: Cumque duxisset eum in locum sublimem, super verticem montis Phasga, ædificavit Balaam septem aras, et impositis supra vitulo atque ariete,
text_pt: Assim o levou consigo ao campo de Zofim, ao cume de Pisga; e edificou sete altares, e ofereceu um novilho e um carneiro sobre cada altar.
text_el: καὶ παρέλαβεν αὐτὸν εἰς ἀγροῦ σκοπιὰν ἐπὶ κορυφὴν λελαξευμένου καὶ ᾠκοδόμησεν ἐκεῖ ἑπτὰ βωμοὺς καὶ ἀνεβίβασεν μόσχον καὶ κριὸν ἐπὶ τὸν βωμόν

text_en: he said to Balac: Stand here by your burnt offering while I go to meet him.
text_la: dixit ad Balac : Sta hic juxta holocaustum tuum, donec ego obvius pergam.
text_pt: Então disse a Balaque: Fica aqui junto do teu holocausto, e eu irei ali ao encontro do Senhor.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Βαλααμ πρὸς Βαλακ παράστηθι ἐπὶ τῆς θυσίας σου ἐγὼ δὲ πορεύσομαι ἐπερωτῆσαι τὸν θεόν

text_en: And when the Lord had met him, and had put the word in his mouth, he said: Return to Balac, and thus shall you say to him.
text_la: Cui cum Dominus occurrisset, posuissetque verbum in ore ejus, ait : Revertere ad Balac, et hæc loqueris ei.
text_pt: E, encontrando-se o Senhor com Balaão, pôs uma palavra na sua boca, e disse: Torna para Balaque, e assim falarás.
text_el: καὶ συνήντησεν ὁ θεὸς τῷ Βαλααμ καὶ ἐνέβαλεν ῥῆμα εἰς τὸ στόμα αὐτοῦ καὶ εἶπεν ἀποστράφητι πρὸς Βαλακ καὶ τάδε λαλήσεις

text_en: Returning he found him standing by his burnt sacrifice , and the princes of the Moabites with him. And Balac said to him: What has the Lord spoken?
text_la: Reversus invenit eum stantem juxta holocaustum suum, et principes Moabitarum cum eo. Ad quem Balac : Quid, inquit, locutus est Dominus?
text_pt: E, vindo a ele, eis que estava junto do holocausto, e os príncipes dos moabitas com ele; disse-lhe pois Balaque: Que coisa falou o Senhor?
text_el: καὶ ἀπεστράφη πρὸς αὐτόν καὶ ὅδε ἐφειστήκει ἐπὶ τῆς ὁλοκαυτώσεως αὐτοῦ καὶ πάντες οἱ ἄρχοντες Μωαβ μετ' αὐτοῦ καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Βαλακ τί ἐλάλησεν κύριος

text_en: But he taking up his parable , said: Stand, O Balac, and give ear: hear, you son of Sephor:
text_la: At ille, assumpta parabola sua, ait : Sta, Balac, et ausculta; audi, fili Sephor :
text_pt: Então proferiu a sua parábola, e disse: Levanta-te, Balaque, e ouve; inclina os teus ouvidos a mim, filho de Zipor.
text_el: καὶ ἀναλαβὼν τὴν παραβολὴν αὐτοῦ εἶπεν ἀνάστηθι Βαλακ καὶ ἄκουε ἐνώτισαι μάρτυς υἱὸς Σεπφωρ

text_en: God is not a man , that he should lie , nor is the son of man , that he should be changed. Hath he said then, and will he not do? Has he spoken, and will he not fulfil?
text_la: non est Deus quasi homo, ut mentiatur, nec ut filius hominis, ut mutetur. Dixit ergo, et non faciet? locutus est, et non implebit?
text_pt: Deus não é homem, para que minta; nem filho do homem, para que se arrependa; porventura diria ele, e não o faria? Ou falaria, e não o confirmaria?
text_el: οὐχ ὡς ἄνθρωπος ὁ θεὸς διαρτηθῆναι οὐδὲ ὡς υἱὸς ἀνθρώπου ἀπειληθῆναι αὐτὸς εἴπας οὐχὶ ποιήσει λαλήσει καὶ οὐχὶ ἐμμενεῖ

text_en: I was brought to bless , the blessing I am not able to hinder.
text_la: Ad benedicendum adductus sum : benedictionem prohibere non valeo.
text_pt: Eis que recebi mandado de abençoar; pois ele tem abençoado, e eu não o posso revogar.
text_el: ἰδοὺ εὐλογεῖν παρείλημμαι εὐλογήσω καὶ οὐ μὴ ἀποστρέψω

text_en: There is no idol in Jacob , neither is there an image god to be seen in Israel . The Lord his God is with him, and the sound of the victory of the king in him.
text_la: Non est idolum in Jacob, nec videtur simulacrum in Israël. Dominus Deus ejus cum eo est, et clangor victoriæ regis in illo.
text_pt: Não viu iniqüidade em Israel, nem contemplou maldade em Jacó; o Senhor seu Deus é com ele, e no meio dele se ouve a aclamação de um rei.
text_el: οὐκ ἔσται μόχθος ἐν Ιακωβ οὐδὲ ὀφθήσεται πόνος ἐν Ισραηλ κύριος ὁ θεὸς αὐτοῦ μετ' αὐτοῦ τὰ ἔνδοξα ἀρχόντων ἐν αὐτῷ

text_en: God has brought him out of Egypt , whose strength is like to the rhinoceros.
text_la: Deus eduxit illum de Ægypto, cujus fortitudo similis est rhinocerotis.
text_pt: Deus os tirou do Egito; as suas forças são como as do boi selvagem.
text_el: θεὸς ὁ ἐξαγαγὼν αὐτοὺς ἐξ Αἰγύπτου ὡς δόξα μονοκέρωτος αὐτῷ

text_en: There is no soothsaying in Jacob , nor divination in Israel . In their times it shall be told to Jacob and to Israel what God has wrought.
text_la: Non est augurium in Jacob, nec divinatio in Israël : temporibus suis dicetur Jacob et Israëli quid operatus sit Deus.
text_pt: Pois contra Jacó não vale encantamento, nem adivinhação contra Israel; neste tempo se dirá de Jacó e de Israel: Que coisas Deus tem realizado!
text_el: οὐ γάρ ἐστιν οἰωνισμὸς ἐν Ιακωβ οὐδὲ μαντεία ἐν Ισραηλ κατὰ καιρὸν ῥηθήσεται Ιακωβ καὶ τῷ Ισραηλ τί ἐπιτελέσει ὁ θεός

text_en: Behold the people shall rise up as a lioness, and shall lift itself up as a lion: it shall not lie down till it devour the prey, and drink the blood of the slain.
text_la: Ecce populus ut leæna consurget, et quasi leo erigetur : non accubabit donec devoret prædam, et occisorum sanguinem bibat.
text_pt: Eis que o povo se levantará como leoa, e se erguerá como leão; não se deitará até que coma a presa, e beba o sangue dos mortos.
text_el: ἰδοὺ λαὸς ὡς σκύμνος ἀναστήσεται καὶ ὡς λέων γαυριωθήσεται οὐ κοιμηθήσεται ἕως φάγῃ θήραν καὶ αἷμα τραυματιῶν πίεται

text_en: And Balac said to Balaam : Neither curse , nor bless him.
text_la: Dixitque Balac ad Balaam : Nec maledicas ei, nec benedicas.
text_pt: Então Balaque disse a Balaão: Nem o amaldiçoarás, nem o abençoarás.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Βαλακ πρὸς Βαλααμ οὔτε κατάραις καταράσῃ μοι αὐτὸν οὔτε εὐλογῶν μὴ εὐλογήσῃς αὐτόν

text_en: And he said: Did I not tell you, that whatsoever God should command me, that I would do?
text_la: Et ille ait : Nonne dixi tibi quod quidquid mihi Deus imperaret, hoc facerem?
text_pt: Porém Balaão respondeu, e disse a Balaque: Não te falei eu, dizendo: Tudo o que o Senhor falar isso farei?
text_el: καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς Βαλααμ εἶπεν τῷ Βαλακ οὐκ ἐλάλησά σοι λέγων τὸ ῥῆμα ὃ ἐὰν λαλήσῃ ὁ θεός τοῦτο ποιήσω

text_en: And Balac said to him: Come and I will bring you to another place; if peradventure it please God that you may curse them from thence.
text_la: Et ait Balac ad eum : Veni, et ducam te ad alium locum : si forte placeat Deo ut inde maledicas eis.
text_pt: Disse mais Balaque a Balaão: Ora vem, e te levarei a outro lugar; porventura bem parecerá aos olhos de Deus que dali mo amaldiçoes.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Βαλακ πρὸς Βαλααμ δεῦρο παραλάβω σε εἰς τόπον ἄλλον εἰ ἀρέσει τῷ θεῷ καὶ καταρᾶσαί μοι αὐτὸν ἐκεῖθεν

text_en: And when he had brought him upon the top of mount Phogor, which looks towards the wilderness ,
text_la: Cumque duxisset eum super verticem montis Phogor, qui respicit solitudinem,
text_pt: Então Balaque levou Balaão consigo ao cume de Peor, que dá para o lado do deserto.
text_el: καὶ παρέλαβεν Βαλακ τὸν Βαλααμ ἐπὶ κορυφὴν τοῦ Φογωρ τὸ παρατεῖνον εἰς τὴν ἔρημον

text_en: Balaam said to him: Build me here seven altars , and prepare as many calves, and the same number of rams.
text_la: dixit ei Balaam : Ædifica mihi hic septem aras, et para totidem vitulos, ejusdemque numeri arietes.
text_pt: Balaão disse a Balaque: Edifica-me aqui sete altares, e prepara-me aqui sete novilhos e sete carneiros.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Βαλααμ πρὸς Βαλακ οἰκοδόμησόν μοι ὧδε ἑπτὰ βωμοὺς καὶ ἑτοίμασόν μοι ὧδε ἑπτὰ μόσχους καὶ ἑπτὰ κριούς

text_en: Balac did as Balaam had said: and he laid on every altar , a calf and a ram.
text_la: Fecit Balac ut Balaam dixerat: imposuitque vitulos et arietes per singulas aras.
text_pt: Balaque, pois, fez como dissera Balaão: e ofereceu um novilho e um carneiro sobre cada altar.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησεν Βαλακ καθάπερ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Βαλααμ καὶ ἀνήνεγκεν μόσχον καὶ κριὸν ἐπὶ τὸν βωμόν

text_en: And when Balaam saw that it pleased the Lord that he should bless Israel , he went not as he had gone before, to seek divination : but setting his face towards the desert ,
text_la: Cumque vidisset Balaam quod placeret Domino ut benediceret Israëli, nequaquam abiit ut ante perrexerat, ut augurium quæreret : sed dirigens contra desertum vultum suum,
text_pt: Vendo Balaão que bem parecia aos olhos do SENHOR que abençoasse a Israel, não se foi esta vez como antes ao encontro dos encantamentos; mas voltou o seu rosto para o deserto.
text_el: καὶ ἰδὼν Βαλααμ ὅτι καλόν ἐστιν ἔναντι κυρίου εὐλογεῖν τὸν Ισραηλ οὐκ ἐπορεύθη κατὰ τὸ εἰωθὸς εἰς συνάντησιν τοῖς οἰωνοῖς καὶ ἀπέστρεψεν τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ εἰς τὴν ἔρημον

text_en: and lifting up his eyes, he saw Israel abiding in their tents by their tribes : and the spirit of God rushing upon him,
text_la: et elevans oculos, vidit Israël in tentoriis commorantem per tribus suas : et irruente in se spiritu Dei,
text_pt: E, levantando Balaão os seus olhos, e vendo a Israel, que estava acampado segundo as suas tribos, veio sobre ele o Espírito de Deus.
text_el: καὶ ἐξάρας Βαλααμ τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς αὐτοῦ καθορᾷ τὸν Ισραηλ ἐστρατοπεδευκότα κατὰ φυλάς καὶ ἐγένετο πνεῦμα θεοῦ ἐν αὐτῷ

text_en: he took up his parable and said: Balaam the son of Beor has said: The man has said, whose eye is stopped up:
text_la: assumpta parabola, ait : Dixit Balaam filius Beor : dixit homo, cujus obturatus est oculus :
text_pt: E proferiu a sua parábola, e disse: Fala, Balaão, filho de Beor, e fala o homem de olhos abertos;
text_el: καὶ ἀναλαβὼν τὴν παραβολὴν αὐτοῦ εἶπεν φησὶν Βαλααμ υἱὸς Βεωρ φησὶν ὁ ἄνθρωπος ὁ ἀληθινῶς ὁρῶν

text_en: The bearer of the words of God has said, he that has beheld the vision of the Almighty , he that falls, and so his eyes are opened:
text_la: dixit auditor sermonum Dei, qui visionem Omnipotentis intuitus est, qui cadit, et sic aperiuntur oculi ejus :
text_pt: Fala aquele que ouviu as palavras de Deus, o que vê a visão do Todo-Poderoso; que cai, e se lhe abrem os olhos:
text_el: φησὶν ἀκούων λόγια θεοῦ ὅστις ὅρασιν θεοῦ εἶδεν ἐν ὕπνῳ ἀποκεκαλυμμένοι οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ αὐτοῦ

text_en: How beautiful are your tabernacles O Jacob , and your tents, O Israel !
text_la: Quam pulchra tabernacula tua, Jacob, et tentoria tua, Israël!
text_pt: Quão formosas são as tuas tendas, ó Jacó, as tuas moradas, ó Israel!
text_el: ὡς καλοί σου οἱ οἶκοι Ιακωβ αἱ σκηναί σου Ισραηλ

text_en: As woody valleys, as watered gardens near the rivers, as tabernacles which the Lord has pitched, as cedars by the waterside.
text_la: ut valles nemorosæ, ut horti juxta fluvios irrigui, ut tabernacula quæ fixit Dominus, quasi cedri prope aquas.
text_pt: Como ribeiros se estendem, como jardins à beira dos rios; como árvores de sândalo o Senhor os plantou, como cedros junto às águas;
text_el: ὡσεὶ νάπαι σκιάζουσαι καὶ ὡσεὶ παράδεισοι ἐπὶ ποταμῶν καὶ ὡσεὶ σκηναί ἃς ἔπηξεν κύριος ὡσεὶ κέδροι παρ' ὕδατα

text_en: Water shall flow out of his bucket, and his seed shall be in many waters. For Agag his king shall be removed, and his kingdom shall be taken away.
text_la: Fluet aqua de situla ejus, et semen illius erit in aquas multas. Tolletur propter Agag, rex ejus, et auferetur regnum illius.
text_pt: De seus baldes manarão águas, e a sua semente estará em muitas águas; e o seu rei se erguerá mais do que Agague, e o seu reino será exaltado.
text_el: ἐξελεύσεται ἄνθρωπος ἐκ τοῦ σπέρματος αὐτοῦ καὶ κυριεύσει ἐθνῶν πολλῶν καὶ ὑψωθήσεται ἢ Γωγ βασιλεία αὐτοῦ καὶ αὐξηθήσεται ἡ βασιλεία αὐτοῦ

text_en: God has brought him out of Egypt , whose strength is like to the rhinoceros. They shall devour the nations that are his enemies, and break their bones, and pierce them with arrows.
text_la: Deus eduxit illum de Ægypto, cujus fortitudo similis est rhinocerotis. Devorabunt gentes hostes illius, ossaque eorum confringent, et perforabunt sagittis.
text_pt: Deus o tirou do Egito; as suas forças são como as do boi selvagem; consumirá as nações, seus inimigos, e quebrará seus ossos, e com as suas setas os atravessará.
text_el: θεὸς ὡδήγησεν αὐτὸν ἐξ Αἰγύπτου ὡς δόξα μονοκέρωτος αὐτῷ ἔδεται ἔθνη ἐχθρῶν αὐτοῦ καὶ τὰ πάχη αὐτῶν ἐκμυελιεῖ καὶ ταῖς βολίσιν αὐτοῦ κατατοξεύσει ἐχθρόν

text_en: Lying down he has slept as a lion, and as a lioness, whom none shall dare to rouse. He that blesses you, shall also himself be blessed : he that curses you shall be reckoned accursed .
text_la: Accubans dormivit ut leo, et quasi leæna, quam suscitare nullus audebit. Qui benedixerit tibi, erit et ipse benedictus : qui maledixerit, in maledictione reputabitur.
text_pt: Encurvou-se, deitou-se como leão, e como leoa; quem o despertará? benditos os que te abençoarem, e malditos os que te amaldiçoarem.
text_el: κατακλιθεὶς ἀνεπαύσατο ὡς λέων καὶ ὡς σκύμνος τίς ἀναστήσει αὐτόν οἱ εὐλογοῦντές σε εὐλόγηνται καὶ οἱ καταρώμενοί σε κεκατήρανται

text_en: And Balac being angry against Balaam , clapped his hands together and said: I called you to curse my enemies, and you on the contrary have blessed them three times.
text_la: Iratusque Balac contra Balaam, complosis manibus ait : Ad maledicendum inimicis meis vocavi te, quibus e contrario tertio benedixisti:
text_pt: Então a ira de Balaque se acendeu contra Balaão, e bateu ele as suas palmas; e Balaque disse a Balaão: Para amaldiçoar os meus inimigos te tenho chamado; porém agora já três vezes os abençoaste inteiramente.
text_el: καὶ ἐθυμώθη Βαλακ ἐπὶ Βαλααμ καὶ συνεκρότησεν ταῖς χερσὶν αὐτοῦ καὶ εἶπεν Βαλακ πρὸς Βαλααμ καταρᾶσθαι τὸν ἐχθρόν μου κέκληκά σε καὶ ἰδοὺ εὐλογῶν εὐλόγησας τρίτον τοῦτο

text_en: Return to your place. I had determined indeed greatly to honour you, but the Lord has deprived you of the honour designed for you.
text_la: revertere ad locum tuum. Decreveram quidem magnifice honorare te, sed Dominus privavit te honore disposito.
text_pt: Agora, pois, foge para o teu lugar; eu tinha dito que te honraria grandemente; mas eis que o Senhor te privou desta honra.
text_el: νῦν οὖν φεῦγε εἰς τὸν τόπον σου εἶπα τιμήσω σε καὶ νῦν ἐστέρησέν σε κύριος τῆς δόξης

text_en: Balaam made answer to Balac: Did I not say to your messengers, whom you sent to me:
text_la: Respondit Balaam ad Balac : Nonne nuntiis tuis, quos misisti ad me, dixi:
text_pt: Então Balaão disse a Balaque: Não falei eu também aos teus mensageiros, que me enviaste, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Βαλααμ πρὸς Βαλακ οὐχὶ καὶ τοῖς ἀγγέλοις σου οὓς ἀπέστειλας πρός με ἐλάλησα λέγων

text_en: If Balac would give me his house full of silver and gold, I cannot go beyond the word of the Lord my God , to utter anything of my own head either good or evil : but whatsoever the Lord shall say, that I will speak?
text_la: Si dederit mihi Balac plenam domum suam argenti et auri, non potero præterire sermonem Domini Dei mei, ut vel boni quid vel mali proferam ex corde meo : sed quidquid Dominus dixerit, hoc loquar?
text_pt: Ainda que Balaque me desse a sua casa cheia de prata e ouro, não poderia ir além da ordem do Senhor, fazendo bem ou mal de meu próprio coração; o que o Senhor falar, isso falarei eu?
text_el: ἐάν μοι δῷ Βαλακ πλήρη τὸν οἶκον αὐτοῦ ἀργυρίου καὶ χρυσίου οὐ δυνήσομαι παραβῆναι τὸ ῥῆμα κυρίου ποιῆσαι αὐτὸ πονηρὸν ἢ καλὸν παρ' ἐμαυτοῦ ὅσα ἐὰν εἴπῃ ὁ θεός ταῦτα ἐρῶ

text_en: But yet going to my people, I will give you counsel, what this people shall do to your people in the latter days.
text_la: verumtamen pergens ad populum meum, dabo consilium, quid populus tuus populo huic faciat extremo tempore.
text_pt: Agora, pois, eis que me vou ao meu povo; vem, avisar-te-ei do que este povo fará ao teu povo nos últimos dias.
text_el: καὶ νῦν ἰδοὺ ἀποτρέχω εἰς τὸν τόπον μου δεῦρο συμβουλεύσω σοι τί ποιήσει ὁ λαὸς οὗτος τὸν λαόν σου ἐπ' ἐσχάτου τῶν ἡμερῶν

text_en: Therefore taking up his parable , again he said: Balaam the son of Beor has said: The man whose eye is stopped up, has said:
text_la: Sumpta igitur parabola, rursum ait : Dixit Balaam filius Beor : dixit homo, cujus obturatus est oculus :
text_pt: Então proferiu a sua parábola, e disse: Fala Balaão, filho de Beor, e fala o homem de olhos abertos;
text_el: καὶ ἀναλαβὼν τὴν παραβολὴν αὐτοῦ εἶπεν φησὶν Βαλααμ υἱὸς Βεωρ φησὶν ὁ ἄνθρωπος ὁ ἀληθινῶς ὁρῶν

text_en: The hearer of the words of God has said, who knows the doctrine of the Highest , and sees the visions of the Almighty , who falling has his eyes opened:
text_la: dixit auditor sermonum Dei, qui novit doctrinam Altissimi, et visiones Omnipotentis videt, qui cadens apertos habet oculos :
text_pt: Fala aquele que ouviu as palavras de Deus, e o que sabe a ciência do Altíssimo; o que viu a visão do Todo-Poderoso, que cai, e se lhe abrem os olhos.
text_el: ἀκούων λόγια θεοῦ ἐπιστάμενος ἐπιστήμην παρὰ ὑψίστου καὶ ὅρασιν θεοῦ ἰδὼν ἐν ὕπνῳ ἀποκεκαλυμμένοι οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ αὐτοῦ

text_en: I shall see him, but not now: I shall behold him, but not near. A star shall rise out of Jacob and a sceptre shall spring up from Israel : and shall strike the chiefs of Moab , and shall waste all the children of Seth.
text_la: Videbo eum, sed non modo : intuebor illum, sed non prope. Orietur stella ex Jacob, et consurget virga de Israël : et percutiet duces Moab, vastabitque omnes filios Seth.
text_pt: Vê-lo-ei, mas não agora, contemplá-lo-ei, mas não de perto; uma estrela procederá de Jacó e um cetro subirá de Israel, que ferirá os termos dos moabitas, e destruirá todos os filhos de Sete.
text_el: δείξω αὐτῷ καὶ οὐχὶ νῦν μακαρίζω καὶ οὐκ ἐγγίζει ἀνατελεῖ ἄστρον ἐξ Ιακωβ καὶ ἀναστήσεται ἄνθρωπος ἐξ Ισραηλ καὶ θραύσει τοὺς ἀρχηγοὺς Μωαβ καὶ προνομεύσει πάντας υἱοὺς Σηθ

text_en: And he shall possess Idumea : the inheritance of Seir shall come to their enemies, but Israel shall do manfully.
text_la: Et erit Idumæa possessio ejus : hæreditas Seir cedet inimicis suis : Israël vero fortiter aget.
text_pt: E Edom será uma possessão, e Seir, seus inimigos, também será uma possessão; pois Israel fará proezas.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται Εδωμ κληρονομία καὶ ἔσται κληρονομία Ησαυ ὁ ἐχθρὸς αὐτοῦ καὶ Ισραηλ ἐποίησεν ἐν ἰσχύι

text_en: Out of Jacob shall he come that shall rule, and shall destroy the remains of the city.
text_la: De Jacob erit qui dominetur, et perdat reliquias civitatis.
text_pt: E dominará um de Jacó, e matará os que restam das cidades.
text_el: καὶ ἐξεγερθήσεται ἐξ Ιακωβ καὶ ἀπολεῖ σῳζόμενον ἐκ πόλεως

text_en: And when he saw Amalec , he took up his parable , and said: Amalec the beginning of nations, whose latter ends shall be destroyed.
text_la: Cumque vidisset Amalec, assumens parabolam, ait : Principium gentium Amalec, cujus extrema perdentur.
text_pt: E vendo os amalequitas, proferiu a sua parábola, e disse: Amaleque é a primeira das nações; porém o seu fim será a destruição.
text_el: καὶ ἰδὼν τὸν Αμαληκ καὶ ἀναλαβὼν τὴν παραβολὴν αὐτοῦ εἶπεν ἀρχὴ ἐθνῶν Αμαληκ καὶ τὸ σπέρμα αὐτῶν ἀπολεῖται

text_en: He saw also the Cinite : and took up his parable , and said: Your habitation indeed is strong: but though you build your nest in a rock,
text_la: Vidit quoque Cinæum : et assumpta parabola, ait : Robustum quidem est habitaculum tuum : sed si in petra posueris nidum tuum,
text_pt: E vendo os quenitas, proferiu a sua parábola, e disse: Firme está a tua habitação, e puseste o teu ninho na penha.
text_el: καὶ ἰδὼν τὸν Καιναῖον καὶ ἀναλαβὼν τὴν παραβολὴν αὐτοῦ εἶπεν ἰσχυρὰ ἡ κατοικία σου καὶ ἐὰν θῇς ἐν πέτρᾳ τὴν νοσσιάν σου

text_en: and you be chosen of the stock of Cin , how long shall you be able to continue? For Assur shall take you captive .
text_la: et fueris electus de stirpe Cin, quamdiu poteris permanere? Assur enim capiet te.
text_pt: Todavia o quenita será consumido, até que Assur te leve por prisioneiro.
text_el: καὶ ἐὰν γένηται τῷ Βεωρ νεοσσιὰ πανουργίας Ἀσσύριοί σε αἰχμαλωτεύσουσιν

text_en: And taking up his parable , again he said: Alas, who shall live when God shall do these things?
text_la: Assumptaque parabola iterum locutus est : Heu! quis victurus est, quando ista faciet Deus?
text_pt: E, proferindo ainda a sua parábola, disse: Ai, quem viverá, quando Deus fizer isto?
text_el: καὶ ἰδὼν τὸν Ωγ καὶ ἀναλαβὼν τὴν παραβολὴν αὐτοῦ εἶπεν ὦ ὦ τίς ζήσεται ὅταν θῇ ταῦτα ὁ θεός

text_en: They shall come in galleys from Italy , they shall overcome the Assyrians , and shall waste the Hebrews , and at the last they themselves also shall perish.
text_la: Venient in trieribus de Italia : superabunt Assyrios, vastabuntque Hebræos, et ad extremum etiam ipsi peribunt.
text_pt: E as naus virão das costas de Quitim e afligirão a Assur; também afligirão a Éber; que também será para destruição.
text_el: καὶ ἐξελεύσεται ἐκ χειρὸς Κιτιαίων καὶ κακώσουσιν Ασσουρ καὶ κακώσουσιν Εβραίους καὶ αὐτοὶ ὁμοθυμαδὸν ἀπολοῦνται

text_en: And Balaam rose, and returned to his place: Balac also returned the way that he came.
text_la: Surrexitque Balaam, et reversus est in locum suum : Balac quoque via, qua venerat, rediit.
text_pt: Então Balaão levantou-se, e se foi, e voltou ao seu lugar, e também Balaque se foi pelo seu caminho.
text_el: καὶ ἀναστὰς Βαλααμ ἀπῆλθεν ἀποστραφεὶς εἰς τὸν τόπον αὐτοῦ καὶ Βαλακ ἀπῆλθεν πρὸς ἑαυτόν

text_en: And Israel at that time abode in Settim , and the people committed fornication with the daughters of Moab ,
text_la: Morabatur autem eo tempore Israël in Settim, et fornicatus est populus cum filiabus Moab,
text_pt: E Israel deteve-se em Sitim e o povo começou a prostituir-se com as filhas dos moabitas.
text_el: καὶ κατέλυσεν Ισραηλ ἐν Σαττιν καὶ ἐβεβηλώθη ὁ λαὸς ἐκπορνεῦσαι εἰς τὰς θυγατέρας Μωαβ

text_en: who called them to their sacrifices . And they ate of them, and adored their gods .
text_la: quæ vocaverunt eos ad sacrificia sua. At ille comederunt et adoraverunt deos earum.
text_pt: Elas convidaram o povo aos sacrifícios dos seus deuses; e o povo comeu, e inclinou-se aos seus deuses.
text_el: καὶ ἐκάλεσαν αὐτοὺς ἐπὶ ταῖς θυσίαις τῶν εἰδώλων αὐτῶν καὶ ἔφαγεν ὁ λαὸς τῶν θυσιῶν αὐτῶν καὶ προσεκύνησαν τοῖς εἰδώλοις αὐτῶν

text_en: And Israel was initiated to Beelphegor : upon which the Lord being angry ,
text_la: Initiatusque est Israël Beelphegor : et iratus Dominus,
text_pt: Juntando-se, pois, Israel a Baal-peor, a ira do Senhor se acendeu contra Israel.
text_el: καὶ ἐτελέσθη Ισραηλ τῷ Βεελφεγωρ καὶ ὠργίσθη θυμῷ κύριος τῷ Ισραηλ

text_en: said to Moses : Take all the princes of the people, and hang them up on gibbets against the sun: that my fury may be turned away from Israel .
text_la: ait ad Moysen : Tolle cunctos principes populi, et suspende eos contra solem in patibulis, ut avertatur furor meus ab Israël.
text_pt: Disse o Senhor a Moisés: Toma todos os cabeças do povo, e enforca-os ao Senhor diante do sol, e o ardor da ira do Senhor se retirará de Israel.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ λαβὲ πάντας τοὺς ἀρχηγοὺς τοῦ λαοῦ καὶ παραδειγμάτισον αὐτοὺς κυρίῳ ἀπέναντι τοῦ ἡλίου καὶ ἀποστραφήσεται ὀργὴ θυμοῦ κυρίου ἀπὸ Ισραηλ

text_en: And Moses said to the judges of Israel : Let every man kill his neighbours, that have been initiated to Beelphegor .
text_la: Dixitque Moyses ad judices Israël : Occidat unusquisque proximos suos, qui initiati sunt Beelphegor.
text_pt: Então Moisés disse aos juízes de Israel: Cada um mate os seus homens que se juntaram a Baal-peor.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Μωυσῆς ταῖς φυλαῖς Ισραηλ ἀποκτείνατε ἕκαστος τὸν οἰκεῖον αὐτοῦ τὸν τετελεσμένον τῷ Βεελφεγωρ

text_en: And behold one of the children of Israel went in before his brethren to a harlot of Madian , in the sight of Moses and of all the children of Israel , who were weeping before the door of the tabernacle .
text_la: Et ecce unus de filiis Israël intravit coram fratribus suis ad scortum Madianitidem, vidente Moyse, et omni turba filiorum Israël, qui flebant ante fores tabernaculi.
text_pt: E eis que veio um homem dos filhos de Israel, e trouxe a seus irmãos uma midianita, à vista de Moisés, e à vista de toda a congregação dos filhos de Israel, chorando eles diante da tenda da congregação.
text_el: καὶ ἰδοὺ ἄνθρωπος τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ ἐλθὼν προσήγαγεν τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ πρὸς τὴν Μαδιανῖτιν ἐναντίον Μωυσῆ καὶ ἔναντι πάσης συναγωγῆς υἱῶν Ισραηλ αὐτοὶ δὲ ἔκλαιον παρὰ τὴν θύραν τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου

text_en: And when Phinees the son of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest saw it, he rose up from the midst of the multitude, and taking a dagger,
text_la: Quod cum vidisset Phinees filius Eleazari filii Aaron sacerdotis, surrexit de medio multitudinis, et arrepto pugione,
text_pt: Vendo isso Finéias, filho de Eleazar, o filho de Arão, sacerdote, se levantou do meio da congregação, e tomou uma lança na sua mão;
text_el: καὶ ἰδὼν Φινεες υἱὸς Ελεαζαρ υἱοῦ Ααρων τοῦ ἱερέως ἐξανέστη ἐκ μέσου τῆς συναγωγῆς καὶ λαβὼν σειρομάστην ἐν τῇ χειρὶ

text_en: went in after the Israelite into the brothel house, and thrust both of them through together, to wit, the man and the woman in the genital parts. And the scourge ceased from the children of Israel .
text_la: ingressus est post virum Israëlitem in lupanar, et perfodit ambos simul, virum scilicet et mulierem in locis genitalibus. Cessavitque plaga a filiis Israël:
text_pt: E foi após o homem israelita até à tenda, e os atravessou a ambos, ao homem israelita e à mulher, pelo ventre; então a praga cessou de sobre os filhos de Israel.
text_el: εἰσῆλθεν ὀπίσω τοῦ ἀνθρώπου τοῦ Ισραηλίτου εἰς τὴν κάμινον καὶ ἀπεκέντησεν ἀμφοτέρους τόν τε ἄνθρωπον τὸν Ισραηλίτην καὶ τὴν γυναῖκα διὰ τῆς μήτρας αὐτῆς καὶ ἐπαύσατο ἡ πληγὴ ἀπὸ υἱῶν Ισραηλ

text_en: And there were slain four and twenty thousand men .
text_la: et occisi sunt viginti quatuor millia hominum.
text_pt: E os que morreram daquela praga foram vinte e quatro mil.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένοντο οἱ τεθνηκότες ἐν τῇ πληγῇ τέσσαρες καὶ εἴκοσι χιλιάδες

text_en: And the Lord said to Moses :
text_la: Dixitque Dominus ad Moysen:
text_pt: Então o Senhor falou a Moisés, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν λέγων

text_en: Phinees the son of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest , has turned away my wrath from the children of Israel : because he was moved with my zeal against them, that I myself might not destroy the children of Israel in my zeal .
text_la: Phinees filius Eleazari filii Aaron sacerdotis avertit iram meam a filiis Israël : quia zelo meo commotus est contra eos, ut non ipse delerem filios Israël in zelo meo.
text_pt: Finéias, filho de Eleazar, o filho de Arão, sacerdote, desviou a minha ira de sobre os filhos de Israel, pois foi zeloso com o meu zelo no meio deles; de modo que, no meu zelo, não consumi os filhos de Israel.
text_el: Φινεες υἱὸς Ελεαζαρ υἱοῦ Ααρων τοῦ ἱερέως κατέπαυσεν τὸν θυμόν μου ἀπὸ υἱῶν Ισραηλ ἐν τῷ ζηλῶσαί μου τὸν ζῆλον ἐν αὐτοῖς καὶ οὐκ ἐξανήλωσα τοὺς υἱοὺς Ισραηλ ἐν τῷ ζήλῳ μου

text_en: Therefore say to him: behold I give him the peace of my covenant,
text_la: Idcirco loquere ad eum : Ecce do ei pacem fœderis mei,
text_pt: Portanto dize: Eis que lhe dou a minha aliança de paz;
text_el: οὕτως εἰπόν ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ δίδωμι αὐτῷ διαθήκην εἰρήνης

text_en: and the covenant of the priesthood for ever shall be both to him and his seed, because he has been zealous for his God , and has made atonement for the wickedness of the children of Israel .
text_la: et erit tam ipsi quam semini ejus pactum sacerdotii sempiternum : quia zelatus est pro Deo suo, et expiavit scelus filiorum Israël.
text_pt: E ele, e a sua descendência depois dele, terá a aliança do sacerdócio perpétuo, porquanto teve zelo pelo seu Deus, e fez expiação pelos filhos de Israel.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται αὐτῷ καὶ τῷ σπέρματι αὐτοῦ μετ' αὐτὸν διαθήκη ἱερατείας αἰωνία ἀνθ' ὧν ἐζήλωσεν τῷ θεῷ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐξιλάσατο περὶ τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ

text_en: And the name of the Israelite , that was slain with the woman of Madian , was Zambri the son of Salu, a prince of the kindred and tribe of Simeon .
text_la: Erat autem nomen viri Israëlitæ, qui occisus est cum Madianitide, Zambri filius Salu, dux de cognatione et tribu Simeonis.
text_pt: E o nome do israelita, que foi morto com a midianita, era Zimri, filho de Salu, príncipe da casa paterna dos simeonitas.
text_el: τὸ δὲ ὄνομα τοῦ ἀνθρώπου τοῦ Ισραηλίτου τοῦ πεπληγότος ὃς ἐπλήγη μετὰ τῆς Μαδιανίτιδος Ζαμβρι υἱὸς Σαλω ἄρχων οἴκου πατριᾶς τῶν Συμεων

text_en: And the Madianite woman , that was slain with him, was called Cozbi the daughter of Sur, a most noble prince among the Madianites .
text_la: Porro mulier Madianitis, quæ pariter interfecta est, vocabatur Cozbi filia Sur principis nobilissimi Madianitarum.
text_pt: E o nome da mulher midianita morta era Cosbi, filha de Zur, cabeça do povo da casa paterna entre os midianitas.
text_el: καὶ ὄνομα τῇ γυναικὶ τῇ Μαδιανίτιδι τῇ πεπληγυίᾳ Χασβι θυγάτηρ Σουρ ἄρχοντος ἔθνους Ομμωθ οἴκου πατριᾶς ἐστιν τῶν Μαδιαν

text_en: And the Lord spoke to Moses , saying:
text_la: Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen, dicens:
text_pt: Falou mais o Senhor a Moisés, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν λέγων λάλησον τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ λέγων

text_en: Let the Madianites find you their enemies, and slay you them:
text_la: Hostes vos sentiant Madianitæ, et percutite eos:
text_pt: Afligireis os midianitas e os ferireis,
text_el: ἐχθραίνετε τοῖς Μαδιηναίοις καὶ πατάξατε αὐτούς

text_en: Because they also have acted like enemies against you, and have guilefully deceived you by the idol Phogor, and Cozbi their sister, a daughter of a prince of Madian , who was slain in the day of the plague for the sacrilege of Phogor.
text_la: quia et ipsi hostiliter egerunt contra vos, et decepere insidiis per idolum Phogor, et Cozbi filiam ducis Madian sororem suam, quæ percussa est in die plagæ pro sacrilegio Phogor.
text_pt: Porque eles vos afligiram a vós com os seus enganos com que vos enganaram no caso de Peor, e no caso de Cosbi, filha do príncipe dos midianitas, irmã deles, que foi morta no dia da praga no caso de Peor.
text_el: ὅτι ἐχθραίνουσιν αὐτοὶ ὑμῖν ἐν δολιότητι ὅσα δολιοῦσιν ὑμᾶς διὰ Φογωρ καὶ διὰ Χασβι θυγατέρα ἄρχοντος Μαδιαν ἀδελφὴν αὐτῶν τὴν πεπληγυῖαν ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῆς πληγῆς διὰ Φογωρ

text_en: After the blood of the guilty was shed, the Lord said to Moses and to Eleazar the son of Aaron , the priest :
text_la: Postquam noxiorum sanguis effusus est, dixit Dominus ad Moysen et Eleazarum filium Aaron sacerdotem:
text_pt: Aconteceu, pois, que, depois daquela praga, falou o SENHOR a Moisés, e a Eleazar, filho de Arão, o sacerdote, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο μετὰ τὴν πληγὴν καὶ ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν καὶ πρὸς Ελεαζαρ τὸν ἱερέα λέγων

text_en: Number the whole sum of the children of Israel from twenty years old and upward, by their houses and kindreds, all that are able to go forth to war .
text_la: Numerate omnem summam filiorum Israël a viginti annis et supra, per domos et cognationes suas, cunctos qui possunt ad bella procedere.
text_pt: Tomai a soma de toda a congregação dos filhos de Israel, da idade de vinte anos para cima, segundo as casas de seus pais; todos os que em Israel podem sair à guerra.
text_el: λαβὲ τὴν ἀρχὴν πάσης συναγωγῆς υἱῶν Ισραηλ ἀπὸ εἰκοσαετοῦς καὶ ἐπάνω κατ' οἴκους πατριῶν αὐτῶν πᾶς ὁ ἐκπορευόμενος παρατάξασθαι ἐν Ισραηλ

text_en: Moses therefore and Eleazar the priest , being in the plains of Moab upon the Jordan over against Jericho , spoke to them that were
text_la: Locuti sunt itaque Moyses et Eleazar sacerdos, in campestribus Moab super Jordanem contra Jericho, ad eos qui erant
text_pt: Falaram-lhes, pois, Moisés e Eleazar, o sacerdote, nas campinas de Moabe, junto ao Jordão na altura de Jericó, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν Μωυσῆς καὶ Ελεαζαρ ὁ ἱερεὺς ἐν Αραβωθ Μωαβ ἐπὶ τοῦ Ιορδάνου κατὰ Ιεριχω λέγων

text_en: from twenty years old and upward, as the Lord had commanded: and this is the number of them:
text_la: a viginti annis et supra, sicut Dominus imperaverat, quorum iste est numerus.
text_pt: Conta o povo da idade de vinte anos para cima, como o Senhor ordenara a Moisés e aos filhos de Israel, que saíram do Egito.
text_el: ἀπὸ εἰκοσαετοῦς καὶ ἐπάνω ὃν τρόπον συνέταξεν κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ οἱ ἐξελθόντες ἐξ Αἰγύπτου

text_en: Ruben the firstborn of Israel . His sons were Henoch, of whom is the family of the Henochites: and Phallu, of whom is the family of the Phalluites:
text_la: Ruben primogenitus Israël : hujus filius, Henoch, a quo familia Henochitarum : et Phallu, a quo familia Phalluitarum:
text_pt: Rúben, o primogênito de Israel; os filhos de Rúben: de Enoque, a família dos enoquitas; de Palu, a família dos paluítas;
text_el: Ρουβην πρωτότοκος Ισραηλ υἱοὶ δὲ Ρουβην Ενωχ καὶ δῆμος τοῦ Ενωχ τῷ Φαλλου δῆμος τοῦ Φαλλουι

text_en: And Hesron, of whom is the family of the Hesronites: and Charmi, of whom is the family of the Charmites.
text_la: et Hesron, a quo familia Hesronitarum : et Charmi, a quo familia Charmitarum.
text_pt: De Hezrom, a família dos hezronitas; de Carmi, a família dos carmitas.
text_el: τῷ Ασρων δῆμος τοῦ Ασρωνι τῷ Χαρμι δῆμος τοῦ Χαρμι

text_en: These are the families of the stock of Ruben : whose number was found to be forty-three thousand seven hundred and thirty.
text_la: Hæ sunt familiæ de stirpe Ruben : quarum numerus inventus est quadraginta tria millia, et septingenti triginta.
text_pt: Estas são as famílias dos rubenitas; e os que foram deles contados foram quarenta e três mil e setecentos e trinta.
text_el: οὗτοι δῆμοι Ρουβην καὶ ἐγένετο ἡ ἐπίσκεψις αὐτῶν τρεῖς καὶ τεσσαράκοντα χιλιάδες καὶ ἑπτακόσιοι καὶ τριάκοντα

text_en: The son of Phallu was Eliab.
text_la: Filius Phallu, Eliab:
text_pt: E os filhos de Palu, Eliabe;
text_el: καὶ υἱοὶ Φαλλου Ελιαβ

text_en: His sons, were Namuel and Dathan and Abiron . These are Dathan and Abiron the princes of the people, that rose against Moses and Aaron in the sedition of Core , when they rebelled against the Lord :
text_la: hujus filii, Namuel et Dathan et Abiron : isti sunt Dathan et Abiron principes populi, qui surrexerunt contra Moysen et Aaron in seditione Core, quando adversus Dominum rebellaverunt:
text_pt: E os filhos de Eliabe, Nemuel, e Datã, e Abirão: estes, Datã e Abirão, foram os do conselho da congregação, que contenderam contra Moisés e contra Arão no grupo de Coré, quando rebelaram contra o Senhor;
text_el: καὶ υἱοὶ Ελιαβ Ναμουηλ καὶ Δαθαν καὶ Αβιρων οὗτοι ἐπίκλητοι τῆς συναγωγῆς οὗτοί εἰσιν οἱ ἐπισυστάντες ἐπὶ Μωυσῆν καὶ Ααρων ἐν τῇ συναγωγῇ Κορε ἐν τῇ ἐπισυστάσει κυρίου

text_en: And the earth opening her mouth swallowed up Core , many others dying, when the fire burned two hundred and fifty men . And there was a great miracle wrought,
text_la: et aperiens terra os suum devoravit Core, morientibus plurimis, quando combussit ignis ducentos quinquaginta viros. Et factum est grande miraculum,
text_pt: E a terra abriu a sua boca, e os tragou com Coré, quando morreu aquele grupo; quando o fogo consumiu duzentos e cinqüenta homens, os quais serviram de advertência.
text_el: καὶ ἀνοίξασα ἡ γῆ τὸ στόμα αὐτῆς κατέπιεν αὐτοὺς καὶ Κορε ἐν τῷ θανάτῳ τῆς συναγωγῆς αὐτοῦ ὅτε κατέφαγεν τὸ πῦρ τοὺς πεντήκοντα καὶ διακοσίους καὶ ἐγενήθησαν ἐν σημείῳ

text_en: that when Core perished, his sons did not perish.
text_la: ut, Core pereunte, filii illius non perirent.
text_pt: Mas os filhos de Coré não morreram.
text_el: οἱ δὲ υἱοὶ Κορε οὐκ ἀπέθανον

text_en: The sons of Simeon by their kindreds: Namuel, of him is the family of the Namuelites: Jamin, of him is the family of the Jaminites: Jachim, of him is the family of the Jachimites:
text_la: Filii Simeon per cognationes suas : Namuel, ab hoc familia Namuelitarum : Jamin, ab hoc familia Jaminitarum : Jachin, ab hoc familia Jachinitarum:
text_pt: Os filhos de Simeão, segundo as suas famílias: de Nemuel, a família dos nemuelitas; de Jamim, a família dos jaminitas; de Jaquim, a família dos jaquinitas;
text_el: καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ Συμεων ὁ δῆμος τῶν υἱῶν Συμεων τῷ Ναμουηλ δῆμος ὁ Ναμουηλι τῷ Ιαμιν δῆμος ὁ Ιαμινι τῷ Ιαχιν δῆμος ὁ Ιαχινι

text_en: Zare, of him is the family of the Zarites: Saul , of him is the family of the Saulites.
text_la: Zare, ab hoc familia Zareitarum : Saul, ab hoc familia Saulitarum.
text_pt: De Zerá, a família dos zeraítas; de Saul, a família dos saulitas.
text_el: τῷ Ζαρα δῆμος ὁ Ζαραϊ τῷ Σαουλ δῆμος ὁ Σαουλι

text_en: These are the families of the stock of Simeon , of which the whole number was twenty-two thousand two hundred.
text_la: Hæ sunt familiæ de stirpe Simeon, quarum omnis numerus fuit viginti duo millia ducenti.
text_pt: Estas são as famílias dos simeonitas, vinte e dois mil e duzentos.
text_el: οὗτοι δῆμοι Συμεων ἐκ τῆς ἐπισκέψεως αὐτῶν δύο καὶ εἴκοσι χιλιάδες καὶ διακόσιοι

text_en: The sons of Gad by their kindreds: Sephon, of him is the family of the Sephonites: Aggi, of him is the family of the Aggites: Suni, of him is the family of the Sunites:
text_la: Filii Gad per cognationes suas : Sephon, ab hoc familia Sephonitarum : Aggi, ab hoc familia Aggitarum : Suni, ab hoc familia Sunitarum:
text_pt: Os filhos de Gade, segundo as suas gerações; de Zefom, a família dos zefonitas; de Hagi, a família dos hagitas; de Suni, a família dos sunitas;
text_el: υἱοὶ δὲ Ιουδα Ηρ καὶ Αυναν καὶ ἀπέθανεν Ηρ καὶ Αυναν ἐν γῇ Χανααν

text_en: Ozni, of him is the family of the Oznites: Her, of him is the family of the Herites:
text_la: Ozni, ab hoc familia Oznitarum : Her, ab hoc familia Heritarum:
text_pt: De Ozni, a família dos oznitas; de Eri, a família dos eritas;
text_el: ἐγένοντο δὲ οἱ υἱοὶ Ιουδα κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν τῷ Σηλων δῆμος ὁ Σηλωνι τῷ Φαρες δῆμος ὁ Φαρες τῷ Ζαρα δῆμος ὁ Ζαραϊ

text_en: Arod, of him is the family of the Arodites: Ariel, of him is the family of the Arielites.
text_la: Arod, ab hoc familia Aroditarum : Ariel, ab hoc familia Arielitarum.
text_pt: De Arode, a família dos aroditas; de Areli, a família dos arelitas.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένοντο υἱοὶ Φαρες τῷ Ασρων δῆμος ὁ Ασρωνι τῷ Ιαμουν δῆμος ὁ Ιαμουνι

text_en: These are the families of Gad , of which the whole number was forty thousand five hundred.
text_la: Istæ sunt familiæ Gad, quarum omnis numerus fuit quadraginta millia quingenti.
text_pt: Estas são as famílias dos filhos de Gade, segundo os que foram deles contados, quarenta mil e quinhentos.
text_el: οὗτοι δῆμοι τῷ Ιουδα κατὰ τὴν ἐπισκοπὴν αὐτῶν ἓξ καὶ ἑβδομήκοντα χιλιάδες καὶ πεντακόσιοι

text_en: The sons of Juda , Her and Onan, who both died in the land of Chanaan .
text_la: Filii Juda, Her et Onan, qui ambo mortui sunt in terra Chanaan.
text_pt: Os filhos de Judá, Er e Onã; mas Er e Onã morreram na terra de Canaã.
text_el: καὶ υἱοὶ Ισσαχαρ κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν τῷ Θωλα δῆμος ὁ Θωλαϊ τῷ Φουα δῆμος ὁ Φουαϊ

text_en: And the sons of Juda by their kindreds were: Sela, of whom is the family of the Selaites: Phares, of whom is the family of the Pharesites: Zare, of whom is the family of the Zarites.
text_la: Fueruntque filii Juda per cognationes suas : Sela, a quo familia Selaitarum : Phares, a quo familia Pharesitarum : Zare, a quo familia Zareitarum.
text_pt: Assim os filhos de Judá foram segundo as suas famílias; de Selá, a família dos selanitas; de Perez, a família dos perezitas; de Zerá, a família dos zeraítas.
text_el: τῷ Ιασουβ δῆμος ὁ Ιασουβι τῷ Σαμαραν δῆμος ὁ Σαμαρανι

text_en: Moreover the sons of Phares were: Hesron, of whom is the family of the Hesronites: and Hamul, of whom is the family of the Hamulites.
text_la: Porro filii Phares : Hesron, a quo familia Hesronitarum : et Hamul, a quo familia Hamulitarum.
text_pt: E os filhos de Perez foram: de Hezrom, a família dos hezronitas; de Hamul, a família dos hamulitas.
text_el: οὗτοι δῆμοι Ισσαχαρ ἐξ ἐπισκέψεως αὐτῶν τέσσαρες καὶ ἑξήκοντα χιλιάδες καὶ τριακόσιοι

text_en: These are the families of Juda , of which the whole number was seventy-six thousand five hundred.
text_la: Istæ sunt familiæ Juda, quarum omnis numerus fuit septuaginta sex millia quingenti.
text_pt: Estas são as famílias de Judá, segundo os que foram deles contados, setenta e seis mil e quinhentos.
text_el: υἱοὶ Ζαβουλων κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν τῷ Σαρεδ δῆμος ὁ Σαρεδι τῷ Αλλων δῆμος ὁ Αλλωνι τῷ Αλληλ δῆμος ὁ Αλληλι

text_en: The sons of Issachar , by their kindreds: Thola of whom is the family of the Tholaites: Phua, of whom is the family of the Phuaites:
text_la: Filii Issachar per cognationes suas : Thola, a quo familia Tholaitarum : Phua, a quo familia Phuaitarum:
text_pt: Os filhos de Issacar, segundo as suas famílias, foram: de Tola, a família dos tolaítas; de Puva, a família dos puvitas;
text_el: οὗτοι δῆμοι Ζαβουλων ἐξ ἐπισκέψεως αὐτῶν ἑξήκοντα χιλιάδες καὶ πεντακόσιοι

text_en: Jasub, of whom is the family of the Jasubites: Semran, of whom is the family of the Semranites.
text_la: Jasub, a quo familia Jasubitarum : Semran, a quo familia Semranitarum.
text_pt: De Jasube, a família dos jasubitas; de Sinrom, a família dos sinronitas.
text_el: υἱοὶ Γαδ κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν τῷ Σαφων δῆμος ὁ Σαφωνι τῷ Αγγι δῆμος ὁ Αγγι τῷ Σουνι δῆμος ὁ Σουνι

text_en: These are the kindreds of Issachar , whose number was sixty-four thousand three hundred.
text_la: Hæ sunt cognationes Issachar, quarum numerus fuit sexaginta quatuor millia trecenti.
text_pt: Estas são as famílias de Issacar, segundo os que foram deles contados, sessenta e quatro mil e trezentos.
text_el: τῷ Αζενι δῆμος ὁ Αζενι τῷ Αδδι δῆμος ὁ Αδδι

text_en: The sons of Zabulon by their kindreds: Sared, of whom is the family of the Saredites: Elon, of whom is the family of the Elonites: Jalel, of whom is the family of the Jalelites.
text_la: Filii Zabulon per cognationes suas : Sared, a quo familia Sareditarum : Elon, a quo familia Elonitarum : Jalel, a quo familia Jalelitarum.
text_pt: Os filhos de Zebulom, segundo as suas famílias, foram: de Serede, a família dos sereditas; de Elom, a família dos elonitas; de Jaleel, a família dos jaleelitas.
text_el: τῷ Αροαδι δῆμος ὁ Αροαδι τῷ Αριηλ δῆμος ὁ Αριηλι

text_en: These are the kindreds of Zabulon , whose number was sixty thousand five hundred.
text_la: Hæ sunt cognationes Zabulon, quarum numerus fuit sexaginta millia quingenti.
text_pt: Estas são as famílias dos zebulonitas, segundo os que foram deles contados, sessenta mil e quinhentos.
text_el: οὗτοι δῆμοι υἱῶν Γαδ ἐξ ἐπισκέψεως αὐτῶν τεσσαράκοντα χιλιάδες καὶ πεντακόσιοι

text_en: The sons of Joseph by their kindred, Manasses and Ephraim.
text_la: Filii Joseph per cognationes suas, Manasse et Ephraim.
text_pt: Os filhos de José segundo as suas famílias, foram Manassés e Efraim.
text_el: υἱοὶ Ασηρ κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν τῷ Ιαμιν δῆμος ὁ Ιαμινι τῷ Ιεσου δῆμος ὁ Ιεσουι τῷ Βαρια δῆμος ὁ Βαριαϊ

text_en: Of Manasses was born Machir, of whom is the family of the Machirites. Machir begot Galaad, of whom is the family of the Galaadites.
text_la: De Manasse ortus est Machir, a quo familia Machiritarum. Machir genuit Galaad, a quo familia Galaaditarum.
text_pt: Os filhos de Manassés foram; de Maquir, a família dos maquiritas; e Maquir gerou a Gileade; de Gileade, a família dos gileaditas.
text_el: τῷ Χοβερ δῆμος ὁ Χοβερι τῷ Μελχιηλ δῆμος ὁ Μελχιηλι

text_en: Galaad had sons: Jezer, of whom is the family of the Jezerites: and Helec, of whom is the family of the Helecites:
text_la: Galaad habuit filios : Jezer, a quo familia Jezeritarum : et Helec, a quo familia Helecitarum:
text_pt: Estes são os filhos de Gileade; de Jezer, a família dos jezeritas; de Heleque, a família dos helequitas;
text_el: καὶ τὸ ὄνομα θυγατρὸς Ασηρ Σαρα

text_en: And Asriel, of whom is the family of the Asrielites: and Sechem, of whom is the family of the Sechemites :
text_la: et Asriel, a quo familia Asrielitarum : et Sechem, a quo familia Sechemitarum:
text_pt: E de Asriel, a família dos asrielitas; e de Siquém, a família dos siquemitas;
text_el: οὗτοι δῆμοι Ασηρ ἐξ ἐπισκέψεως αὐτῶν τρεῖς καὶ πεντήκοντα χιλιάδες καὶ τετρακόσιοι

text_en: And Semida, of whom is the family of the Semidaites: and Hepher, of whom is the family of the Hepherites.
text_la: et Semida, a quo familia Semidaitarum : et Hepher, a quo familia Hepheritarum.
text_pt: E de Semida, a família dos semidaítas; e de Hefer, a família dos heferitas.
text_el: υἱοὶ Ιωσηφ κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν Μανασση καὶ Εφραιμ

text_en: And Hepher was the father of Salphaad, who had no sons, but only daughters, whose names are these: Maala, and Noa, and Hegla, and Melcha, and Thersa.
text_la: Fuit autem Hepher pater Salphaad, qui filios non habebat, sed tantum filias : quarum ista sunt nomina : Maala, et Noa, et Hegla, et Melcha, et Thersa.
text_pt: Porém, Zelofeade, filho de Hefer, não tinha filhos, senão filhas; e os nomes das filhas de Zelofeade foram Maalá, Noa, Hogla, Milca e Tirza.
text_el: υἱοὶ Μανασση τῷ Μαχιρ δῆμος ὁ Μαχιρι καὶ Μαχιρ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Γαλααδ τῷ Γαλααδ δῆμος ὁ Γαλααδι

text_en: These are the families of Manasses , and the number of them fifty-two thousand seven hundred.
text_la: Hæ sunt familiæ Manasse, et numerus earum quinquaginta duo millia septingenti.
text_pt: Estas são as famílias de Manassés; e os que foram deles contados, foram cinqüenta e dois mil e setecentos.
text_el: καὶ οὗτοι υἱοὶ Γαλααδ τῷ Αχιεζερ δῆμος ὁ Αχιεζερι τῷ Χελεγ δῆμος ὁ Χελεγι

text_en: And the sons of Ephraim by their kindreds were these: Suthala, of whom is the family of the Suthalaites: Becher, of whom is the family of the Becherites: Thehen, of whom is the family of the Thehenites.
text_la: Filii autem Ephraim per cognationes suas fuerunt hi : Suthala, a quo familia Suthalaitarum : Becher, a quo familia Becheritarum : Thehen, a quo familia Thehenitarum.
text_pt: Estes são os filhos de Efraim, segundo as suas famílias: de Sutela, a família dos sutelaítas; de Bequer, a família dos bequeritas; de Taã, a família dos taanitas.
text_el: τῷ Εσριηλ δῆμος ὁ Εσριηλι τῷ Συχεμ δῆμος ὁ Συχεμι

text_en: Now the son of Suthala was Heran, of whom is the family of the Heranites.
text_la: Porro filius Suthala fuit Heran, a quo familia Heranitarum.
text_pt: E estes são os filhos de Sutela: de Erã, a família dos eranitas.
text_el: τῷ Συμαερ δῆμος ὁ Συμαερι καὶ τῷ Οφερ δῆμος ὁ Οφερι

text_en: These are the kindreds of the sons of Ephraim: whose number was thirty-two thousand five hundred.
text_la: Hæ sunt cognationes filiorum Ephraim : quarum numerus fuit triginta duo millia quingenti.
text_pt: Estas são as famílias dos filhos de Efraim, segundo os que foram deles contados, trinta e dois mil e quinhentos; estes são os filhos de José, segundo as suas famílias.
text_el: καὶ τῷ Σαλπααδ υἱῷ Οφερ οὐκ ἐγένοντο αὐτῷ υἱοί ἀλλ' ἢ θυγατέρες καὶ ταῦτα τὰ ὀνόματα τῶν θυγατέρων Σαλπααδ Μαλα καὶ Νουα καὶ Εγλα καὶ Μελχα καὶ Θερσα

text_en: These are the sons of Joseph by their families . The sons of Benjamin in their kindreds: Bela, of whom is the family of the Belaites: Asbel, of whom is the family of the Asbelites: Ahiram, of whom is the family of the Ahiramites:
text_la: Isti sunt filii Joseph per familias suas. Filii Benjamin in cognationibus suis : Bela, a quo familia Belaitarum : Asbel, a quo familia Asbelitarum : Ahiram, a quo familia Ahiramitarum:
text_pt: Os filhos de Benjamim, segundo as suas famílias: de Belá, a família dos belaítas; de Asbel, a família dos asbelitas; de Airã, a família dos airamitas;
text_el: οὗτοι δῆμοι Μανασση ἐξ ἐπισκέψεως αὐτῶν δύο καὶ πεντήκοντα χιλιάδες καὶ ἑπτακόσιοι

text_en: Supham, of whom is the family of the Suphamites: Hupham, of whom is the family of the Huphamites.
text_la: Supham, a quo familia Suphamitarum : Hupham, a quo familia Huphamitarum.
text_pt: De Sufã, a família dos sufamitas; de Hufã, a família dos hufamitas.
text_el: καὶ οὗτοι υἱοὶ Εφραιμ τῷ Σουταλα δῆμος ὁ Σουταλαϊ τῷ Ταναχ δῆμος ὁ Ταναχι

text_en: The sons of Bela: Hered, and Noeman. Of Hered, is the family of the Heredites: of Noeman, the family of the Noemanites.
text_la: Filii Bela : Hered, et Noëman. De Hered, familia Hereditarum : de Noëman, familia Noëmanitarum.
text_pt: E os filhos de Belá foram Arde e Naamã; de Arde, a família dos arditas; de Naamã, a família dos naamanitas.
text_el: οὗτοι υἱοὶ Σουταλα τῷ Εδεν δῆμος ὁ Εδενι

text_en: These are the sons of Benjamin by their kindreds, whose number was forty-five thousand six hundred.
text_la: Hi sunt filii Benjamin per cognationes suas : quorum numerus fuit quadraginta quinque millia sexcenti.
text_pt: Estes são os filhos de Benjamim, segundo as suas famílias; e os que foram deles contados, foram quarenta e cinco mil e seiscentos.
text_el: οὗτοι δῆμοι Εφραιμ ἐξ ἐπισκέψεως αὐτῶν δύο καὶ τριάκοντα χιλιάδες καὶ πεντακόσιοι οὗτοι δῆμοι υἱῶν Ιωσηφ κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν

text_en: The sons of Dan by their kindreds: Suham, of whom is the family of the Suhamites: These are the kindreds of Dan by their families .
text_la: Filii Dan per cognationes suas : Suham, a quo familia Suhamitarum. Hæ sunt cognationes Dan per familias suas.
text_pt: Estes são os filhos de Dã, segundo as suas famílias; de Suã, a família dos suamitas. Estas são as famílias de Dã, segundo as suas famílias.
text_el: υἱοὶ Βενιαμιν κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν τῷ Βαλε δῆμος ὁ Βαλεϊ τῷ Ασυβηρ δῆμος ὁ Ασυβηρι τῷ Ιαχιραν δῆμος ὁ Ιαχιρανι

text_en: All were Suhamites, whose number was sixty-four thousand four hundred.
text_la: Omnes fuere Suhamitæ, quorum numerus erat sexaginta quatuor millia quadringenti.
text_pt: Todas as famílias dos suamitas, segundo os que foram deles contados, foram sessenta e quatro mil e quatrocentos.
text_el: τῷ Σωφαν δῆμος ὁ Σωφανι

text_en: The sons of Aser by their kindreds: Jemna, of whom is the family of the Jemnaites: Jessui, of whom is the family of the Jessuites: Brie, of whom is the family of the Brieites.
text_la: Filii Aser per cognationes suas : Jemna, a quo familia Jemnaitarum : Jessui, a quo familia Jessuitarum : Brie, a quo familia Brieitarum.
text_pt: Os filhos de Aser, segundo as suas famílias, foram: de Imna, a família dos imnaítas; de Isvi, a família dos isvitas; de Berias, a família dos beriítas.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένοντο οἱ υἱοὶ Βαλε Αδαρ καὶ Νοεμαν τῷ Αδαρ δῆμος ὁ Αδαρι τῷ Νοεμαν δῆμος ὁ Νοεμανι

text_en: The sons of Brie: Heber, of whom is the family of the Heberites: and Melchiel, of whom is the family of the Melchielites.
text_la: Filii Brie : Heber, a quo familia Heberitarum : et Melchiel, a quo familia Melchielitarum.
text_pt: Dos filhos de Berias, foram; de Héber, a família dos heberitas; de Malquiel, a família dos malquielitas.
text_el: οὗτοι υἱοὶ Βενιαμιν κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν ἐξ ἐπισκέψεως αὐτῶν πέντε καὶ τεσσαράκοντα χιλιάδες καὶ ἑξακόσιοι

text_en: And the name of the daughter of Aser , was Sara.
text_la: Nomen autem filiæ Aser fuit Sara.
text_pt: E o nome da filha de Aser foi Sera.
text_el: καὶ υἱοὶ Δαν κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν τῷ Σαμι δῆμος ὁ Σαμι οὗτοι δῆμοι Δαν κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν

text_en: These are the kindreds of the sons of Aser , and their number fifty-three thousand four hundred.
text_la: Hæ cognationes filiorum Aser, et numerus eorum quinquaginta tria millia quadringenti.
text_pt: Estas são as famílias dos filhos de Aser, segundo os que foram deles contados, cinqüenta e três mil e quatrocentos.
text_el: πάντες οἱ δῆμοι Σαμι κατ' ἐπισκοπὴν αὐτῶν τέσσαρες καὶ ἑξήκοντα χιλιάδες καὶ τετρακόσιοι

text_en: The sons of Nephtali by their kindreds: Jesiel, of whom is the family of the Jesielites: Guni, of whom is the family of the Gunites:
text_la: Filii Nephthali per cognationes suas : Jesiel, a quo familia Jesielitarum : Guni, a quo familia Gunitarum:
text_pt: Os filhos de Naftali, segundo as suas famílias; de Jazeel, a família dos jazeelitas; de Guni, a família dos gunitas;
text_el: υἱοὶ Νεφθαλι κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν τῷ Ασιηλ δῆμος ὁ Ασιηλι τῷ Γαυνι δῆμος ὁ Γαυνι

text_en: Jeser, of whom is the family of the Jeserites: Sellem, of whom is the family of the Sellemites.
text_la: Jeser, a quo familia Jeseritarum : Sellem, a quo familia Sellemitarum.
text_pt: De Jezer, a família dos jezeritas; de Silém, a família dos silemitas.
text_el: τῷ Ιεσερ δῆμος ὁ Ιεσερι τῷ Σελλημ δῆμος ὁ Σελλημι

text_en: These are the kindreds of the sons of Nephtali by their families : whose number was forty-five thousand four hundred.
text_la: Hæ sunt cognationes filiorum Nephthali per familias suas : quorum numerus quadraginta quinque millia quadringenti.
text_pt: Estas são as famílias de Naftali, segundo as suas famílias; e os que foram deles contados, foram quarenta e cinco mil e quatrocentos.
text_el: οὗτοι δῆμοι Νεφθαλι ἐξ ἐπισκέψεως αὐτῶν πέντε καὶ τεσσαράκοντα χιλιάδες καὶ τετρακόσιοι

text_en: This is the sum of the children of Israel , that were reckoned up, six hundred and one thousand seven hundred and thirty.
text_la: Ista est summa filiorum Israël, qui recensiti sunt, sexcenta millia, et mille septingenti triginta.
text_pt: Estes são os que foram contados dos filhos de Israel, seiscentos e um mil e setecentos e trinta.
text_el: αὕτη ἡ ἐπίσκεψις υἱῶν Ισραηλ ἑξακόσιαι χιλιάδες καὶ χίλιοι καὶ ἑπτακόσιοι καὶ τριάκοντα

text_en: And the Lord spoke to Moses , saying:
text_la: Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen, dicens:
text_pt: E falou o Senhor a Moisés, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν λέγων

text_en: To these shall the land be divided for their possessions according to the number of names .
text_la: Istis dividetur terra juxta numerum vocabulorum in possessiones suas.
text_pt: A estes se repartirá a terra em herança, segundo o número dos nomes.
text_el: τούτοις μερισθήσεται ἡ γῆ κληρονομεῖν ἐξ ἀριθμοῦ ὀνομάτων

text_en: To the greater number you shall give a greater portion, and to the fewer a less: to every one, as they have now been reckoned up, shall a possession be delivered:
text_la: Pluribus majorem partem dabis, et paucioribus minorem : singulis, sicut nunc recensiti sunt, tradetur possessio:
text_pt: Aos muitos aumentarás a sua herança, e aos poucos diminuirás a sua herança; a cada um se dará a sua herança, segundo os que foram deles contados.
text_el: τοῖς πλείοσιν πλεονάσεις τὴν κληρονομίαν καὶ τοῖς ἐλάττοσιν ἐλαττώσεις τὴν κληρονομίαν αὐτῶν ἑκάστῳ καθὼς ἐπεσκέπησαν δοθήσεται ἡ κληρονομία αὐτῶν

text_en: Yet so that by lot the land be divided to the tribe and families .
text_la: ita dumtaxat ut sors terram tribubus dividat et familiis.
text_pt: Todavia a terra se repartirá por sortes; segundo os nomes das tribos de seus pais a herdarão.
text_el: διὰ κλήρων μερισθήσεται ἡ γῆ τοῖς ὀνόμασιν κατὰ φυλὰς πατριῶν αὐτῶν κληρονομήσουσιν

text_en: Whatsoever shall fall by lot, that shall be taken by the more, or the fewer.
text_la: Quidquid sorte contigerit, hoc vel plures accipiant, vel pauciores.
text_pt: Segundo sair a sorte, se repartirá a herança deles entre as tribos de muitos e as de poucos.
text_el: ἐκ τοῦ κλήρου μεριεῖς τὴν κληρονομίαν αὐτῶν ἀνὰ μέσον πολλῶν καὶ ὀλίγων

text_en: This also is the number of the sons of Levi by their families : Gerson, of whom is the family of the Gersonites: Caath, of whom is the family of the Caathites: Merari, of whom is the family of the Merarites.
text_la: Hic quoque est numerus filiorum Levi per familias suas : Gerson, a quo familia Gersonitarum : Caath, a quo familia Caathitarum : Merari, a quo familia Meraritarum.
text_pt: E estes são os que foram contados dos levitas, segundo as suas famílias: de Gérson, a família dos gersonitas; de Coate, a família dos coatitas; de Merari, a família dos meraritas.
text_el: καὶ υἱοὶ Λευι κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν τῷ Γεδσων δῆμος ὁ Γεδσωνι τῷ Κααθ δῆμος ὁ Κααθι τῷ Μεραρι δῆμος ὁ Μεραρι

text_en: These are the families of Levi : The family of Lobni, the family of Hebroni, the family of Core . Now Caath begot Amram:
text_la: Hæ sunt familiæ Levi : familia Lobni, familia Hebroni, familia Moholi, familia Musi, familia Core. At vero Caath genuit Amram:
text_pt: Estas são as famílias de Levi: a família dos libnitas, a família dos hebronitas, a família dos malitas, a família dos musitas, a família dos coreítas. E Coate gerou a Anrão.
text_el: οὗτοι δῆμοι υἱῶν Λευι δῆμος ὁ Λοβενι δῆμος ὁ Χεβρωνι δῆμος ὁ Κορε καὶ δῆμος ὁ Μουσι καὶ Κααθ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Αμραμ

text_en: Who had to wife Jochabed the daughter of Levi , who was born to him in Egypt . She bore to her husband Amram sons, Aaron and Moses , and Mary their sister.
text_la: qui habuit uxorem Jochabed filiam Levi, quæ nata est ei in Ægypto. Hæc genuit Amram viro suo filios, Aaron, et Moysen, et Mariam sororem eorum.
text_pt: E o nome da mulher de Anrão era Joquebede, filha de Levi, a qual nasceu a Levi no Egito; e de Anrão ela teve Arão, e Moisés, e Miriã, irmã deles.
text_el: καὶ τὸ ὄνομα τῆς γυναικὸς αὐτοῦ Ιωχαβεδ θυγάτηρ Λευι ἣ ἔτεκεν τούτους τῷ Λευι ἐν Αἰγύπτῳ καὶ ἔτεκεν τῷ Αμραμ τὸν Ααρων καὶ Μωυσῆν καὶ Μαριαμ τὴν ἀδελφὴν αὐτῶν

text_en: Of Aaron were born Nadab and Abiu, and Eleazar and Ithamar:
text_la: De Aaron orti sunt Nadab et Abiu, et Eleazar et Ithamar:
text_pt: E a Arão nasceram Nadabe, Abiú, Eleazar, e Itamar.
text_el: καὶ ἐγεννήθησαν τῷ Ααρων ὅ τε Ναδαβ καὶ Αβιουδ καὶ Ελεαζαρ καὶ Ιθαμαρ

text_en: Of whom Nadab and Abiu died, when they had offered the strange fire before the Lord .
text_la: quorum Nadab et Abiu mortui sunt, cum obtulissent ignem alienum coram Domino.
text_pt: Porém Nadabe e Abiú morreram quando trouxeram fogo estranho perante o Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέθανεν Ναδαβ καὶ Αβιουδ ἐν τῷ προσφέρειν αὐτοὺς πῦρ ἀλλότριον ἔναντι κυρίου ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ Σινα

text_en: And all that were numbered, were twenty-three thousand males from one month old and upward: for they were not reckoned up among the children of Israel , neither was a possession given to them with the rest.
text_la: Fueruntque omnes qui numerati sunt, viginti tria millia generis masculini ab uno mense et supra : quia non sunt recensiti inter filios Israël, nec eis cum ceteris data possessio est.
text_pt: E os que deles foram contados eram vinte e três mil, todo o homem da idade de um mês para cima; porque estes não foram contados entre os filhos de Israel, porquanto não lhes foi dada herança entre os filhos de Israel.
text_el: καὶ ἐγενήθησαν ἐξ ἐπισκέψεως αὐτῶν τρεῖς καὶ εἴκοσι χιλιάδες πᾶν ἀρσενικὸν ἀπὸ μηνιαίου καὶ ἐπάνω οὐ γὰρ συνεπεσκέπησαν ἐν μέσῳ υἱῶν Ισραηλ ὅτι οὐ δίδοται αὐτοῖς κλῆρος ἐν μέσῳ υἱῶν Ισραηλ

text_en: This is the number of the children of Israel , that were enrolled by Moses and Eleazar the priest , in the plains of Moab upon the Jordan , over against Jericho .
text_la: Hic est numerus filiorum Israël, qui descripti sunt a Moyse et Eleazaro sacerdote, in campestribus Moab supra Jordanem contra Jericho:
text_pt: Estes são os que foram contados por Moisés e Eleazar, o sacerdote, que contaram os filhos de Israel nas campinas de Moabe, junto ao Jordão na direção de Jericó.
text_el: καὶ αὕτη ἡ ἐπίσκεψις Μωυσῆ καὶ Ελεαζαρ τοῦ ἱερέως οἳ ἐπεσκέψαντο τοὺς υἱοὺς Ισραηλ ἐν Αραβωθ Μωαβ ἐπὶ τοῦ Ιορδάνου κατὰ Ιεριχω

text_en: Among whom there was not one of them that were numbered before by Moses and Aaron in the desert of Sinai .
text_la: inter quos, nullus fuit eorum qui ante numerati sunt a Moyse et Aaron in deserto Sinai:
text_pt: E entre estes nenhum houve dos que foram contados por Moisés e Arão, o sacerdote, quando contaram aos filhos de Israel no deserto de Sinai.
text_el: καὶ ἐν τούτοις οὐκ ἦν ἄνθρωπος τῶν ἐπεσκεμμένων ὑπὸ Μωυσῆ καὶ Ααρων οὓς ἐπεσκέψαντο τοὺς υἱοὺς Ισραηλ ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ Σινα

text_en: For the Lord had foretold that they should die in the wilderness . And none remained of them, but Caleb the son of Jephone , and Joshua the son of Nun .
text_la: prædixerat enim Dominus quod omnes morerentur in solitudine. Nullusque remansit ex eis, nisi Caleb filius Jephone, et Josue filius Nun.
text_pt: Porque o Senhor dissera deles que certamente morreriam no deserto; e nenhum deles ficou senão Calebe, filho de Jefoné, e Josué, filho de Num.
text_el: ὅτι εἶπεν κύριος αὐτοῖς θανάτῳ ἀποθανοῦνται ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ καὶ οὐ κατελείφθη ἐξ αὐτῶν οὐδὲ εἷς πλὴν Χαλεβ υἱὸς Ιεφοννη καὶ Ἰησοῦς ὁ τοῦ Ναυη

text_en: Then came the daughters of Salphaad, the son of Hepher, the son of Galaad, the son of Machir, the son of Manasses , who was the son of Joseph : and their names are Maala, and Noa, and Hegla, and Melcha, and Thersa.
text_la: Accesserunt autem filiæ Salphaad, filii Hepher, filii Galaad, filii Machir, filii Manasse, qui fuit filius Joseph : quarum sunt nomina, Maala, et Noa, et Hegla, et Melcha, et Thersa.
text_pt: E chegaram as filhas de Zelofeade, filho de Hefer, filho de Gileade, filho de Maquir, filho de Manassés, entre as famílias de Manassés, filho de José; e estes são os nomes delas; Maalá, Noa, Hogla, Milca, e Tirza;
text_el: καὶ προσελθοῦσαι αἱ θυγατέρες Σαλπααδ υἱοῦ Οφερ υἱοῦ Γαλααδ υἱοῦ Μαχιρ τοῦ δήμου Μανασση τῶν υἱῶν Ιωσηφ καὶ ταῦτα τὰ ὀνόματα αὐτῶν Μαλα καὶ Νουα καὶ Εγλα καὶ Μελχα καὶ Θερσα

text_en: And they stood before Moses and Eleazar the priest , and all the princes of the people at the door of the tabernacle of the covenant , and said:
text_la: Steteruntque coram Moyse et Eleazaro sacerdote et cunctis principibus populi ad ostium tabernaculi fœderis, atque dixerunt:
text_pt: E apresentaram-se diante de Moisés, e diante de Eleazar, o sacerdote, e diante dos príncipes e de toda a congregação, à porta da tenda da congregação, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ στᾶσαι ἔναντι Μωυσῆ καὶ ἔναντι Ελεαζαρ τοῦ ἱερέως καὶ ἔναντι τῶν ἀρχόντων καὶ ἔναντι πάσης συναγωγῆς ἐπὶ τῆς θύρας τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου λέγουσιν

text_en: Our father died in the desert , and was not in the sedition, that was raised against the Lord under Core , but he died in his own sin : and he had no male children. Why is his name taken away out of his family , because he had no son? Give us a possession among the kinsmen of our father.
text_la: Pater noster mortuus est in deserto, nec fuit in seditione, quæ concitata est contra Dominum sub Core, sed in peccato suo mortuus est : hic non habuit mares filios. Cur tollitur nomen illius de familia sua, quia non habuit filium? date nobis possessionem inter cognatos patris nostri.
text_pt: Nosso pai morreu no deserto, e não estava entre os que se congregaram contra o Senhor no grupo de Coré; mas morreu no seu próprio pecado, e não teve filhos.
text_el: ὁ πατὴρ ἡμῶν ἀπέθανεν ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ καὶ αὐτὸς οὐκ ἦν ἐν μέσῳ τῆς συναγωγῆς τῆς ἐπισυστάσης ἔναντι κυρίου ἐν τῇ συναγωγῇ Κορε ὅτι διὰ ἁμαρτίαν αὐτοῦ ἀπέθανεν καὶ υἱοὶ οὐκ ἐγένοντο αὐτῷ

text_en: And Moses referred their cause to the judgment of the Lord .
text_la: Retulitque Moyses causam earum ad judicium Domini.
text_pt: Por que se tiraria o nome de nosso pai do meio da sua família, porquanto não teve filhos? Dá-nos possessão entre os irmãos de nosso pai.
text_el: μὴ ἐξαλειφθήτω τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ πατρὸς ἡμῶν ἐκ μέσου τοῦ δήμου αὐτοῦ ὅτι οὐκ ἔστιν αὐτῷ υἱός δότε ἡμῖν κατάσχεσιν ἐν μέσῳ ἀδελφῶν πατρὸς ἡμῶν

text_en: And the Lord said to him:
text_la: Qui dixit ad eum:
text_pt: E Moisés levou a causa delas perante o Senhor.
text_el: καὶ προσήγαγεν Μωυσῆς τὴν κρίσιν αὐτῶν ἔναντι κυρίου

text_en: The daughters of Salphaad demand a just thing: Give them a possession among their father's kindred, and let them succeed him in his inheritance.
text_la: Justam rem postulant filiæ Salphaad : da eis possessionem inter cognatos patris sui, et ei in hæreditatem succedant.
text_pt: E falou o Senhor a Moisés, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν λέγων

text_en: And to the children of Israel you shall speak these things:
text_la: Ad filios autem Israël loqueris hæc:
text_pt: As filhas de Zelofeade falam o que é justo; certamente lhes darás possessão de herança entre os irmãos de seu pai; e a herança de seu pai farás passar a elas.
text_el: ὀρθῶς θυγατέρες Σαλπααδ λελαλήκασιν δόμα δώσεις αὐταῖς κατάσχεσιν κληρονομίας ἐν μέσῳ ἀδελφῶν πατρὸς αὐτῶν καὶ περιθήσεις τὸν κλῆρον τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτῶν αὐταῖς

text_en: When a man dies without a son, his inheritance shall pass to his daughter.
text_la: Homo cum mortuus fuerit absque filio, ad filiam ejus transibit hæreditas.
text_pt: E falarás aos filhos de Israel, dizendo: Quando alguém morrer e não tiver filho, então fareis passar a sua herança à sua filha.
text_el: καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ λαλήσεις λέγων ἄνθρωπος ἐὰν ἀποθάνῃ καὶ υἱὸς μὴ ᾖ αὐτῷ περιθήσετε τὴν κληρονομίαν αὐτοῦ τῇ θυγατρὶ αὐτοῦ

text_en: If he have no daughter, his brethren shall succeed him.
text_la: Si filiam non habuerit, habebit successores fratres suos.
text_pt: E, se não tiver filha, então a sua herança dareis a seus irmãos.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ μὴ ᾖ θυγάτηρ αὐτῷ δώσετε τὴν κληρονομίαν τῷ ἀδελφῷ αὐτοῦ

text_en: And if he have no brethren, you shall give the inheritance to his father's brethren.
text_la: Quod si et fratres non fuerint, dabitis hæreditatem fratribus patris ejus.
text_pt: Porém, se não tiver irmãos, então dareis a sua herança aos irmãos de seu pai.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ μὴ ὦσιν αὐτῷ ἀδελφοί δώσετε τὴν κληρονομίαν τῷ ἀδελφῷ τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ

text_en: But if he have no uncles by the father, the inheritance shall be given to them that are the next akin. And this shall be to the children of Israel sacred by a perpetual law , as the Lord has commanded Moses .
text_la: Sin autem nec patruos habuerit, dabitur hæreditas his qui ei proximi sunt. Eritque hoc filiis Israël sanctum lege perpetua, sicut præcepit Dominus Moysi.
text_pt: Se também seu pai não tiver irmãos, então dareis a sua herança a seu parente, àquele que lhe for o mais chegado da sua família, para que a possua; isto aos filhos de Israel será por estatuto de direito, como o Senhor ordenou a Moisés.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ μὴ ὦσιν ἀδελφοὶ τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ δώσετε τὴν κληρονομίαν τῷ οἰκείῳ τῷ ἔγγιστα αὐτοῦ ἐκ τῆς φυλῆς αὐτοῦ κληρονομήσει τὰ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἔσται τοῦτο τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ δικαίωμα κρίσεως καθὰ συνέταξεν κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ

text_en: The Lord also said to Moses : Go up into this mountain Abarim , and view from thence the land which I will give to the children of Israel .
text_la: Dixit quoque Dominus ad Moysen : Ascende in montem istum Abarim, et contemplare inde terram, quam daturus sum filiis Israël.
text_pt: Depois disse o Senhor a Moisés: Sobe a este monte de Abarim, e vê a terra que tenho dado aos filhos de Israel.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν ἀνάβηθι εἰς τὸ ὄρος τὸ ἐν τῷ πέραν τοῦτο ὄρος Ναβαυ καὶ ἰδὲ τὴν γῆν Χανααν ἣν ἐγὼ δίδωμι τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ ἐν κατασχέσει

text_en: And when you shall have seen it, you also shall go to your people, as your brother Aaron has gone:
text_la: Cumque videris eam, ibis et tu ad populum tuum, sicut ivit frater tuus Aaron:
text_pt: E, tendo-a visto, então serás recolhido ao teu povo, assim como foi recolhido teu irmão Arão;
text_el: καὶ ὄψει αὐτὴν καὶ προστεθήσῃ πρὸς τὸν λαόν σου καὶ σύ καθὰ προσετέθη Ααρων ὁ ἀδελφός σου ἐν Ωρ τῷ ὄρει

text_en: Because you offended me in the desert of Sin in the contradiction of the multitude, neither would you sanctify me before them at the waters. These are the waters of contradiction in Cades of the desert of Sin.
text_la: quia offendistis me in deserto Sin in contradictione multitudinis, nec sanctificare me voluistis coram ea super aquas. Hæ sunt aquæ contradictionis in Cades deserti Sin.
text_pt: Porquanto, no deserto de Zim, na contenda da congregação, fostes rebeldes ao meu mandado de me santificar nas águas diante dos seus olhos (estas são as águas de Meribá de Cades, no deserto de Zim).
text_el: διότι παρέβητε τὸ ῥῆμά μου ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ Σιν ἐν τῷ ἀντιπίπτειν τὴν συναγωγὴν ἁγιάσαι με οὐχ ἡγιάσατέ με ἐπὶ τῷ ὕδατι ἔναντι αὐτῶν τοῦτό ἐστιν ὕδωρ ἀντιλογίας Καδης ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ Σιν

text_en: And Moses answered him:
text_la: Cui respondit Moyses:
text_pt: Então falou Moisés ao Senhor, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Μωυσῆς πρὸς κύριον

text_en: May the Lord the God of the spirits of all flesh provide a man , that may be over this multitude:
text_la: Provideat Dominus Deus spirituum omnis carnis hominem, qui sit super multitudinem hanc:
text_pt: O Senhor, Deus dos espíritos de toda a carne, ponha um homem sobre esta congregação,
text_el: ἐπισκεψάσθω κύριος ὁ θεὸς τῶν πνευμάτων καὶ πάσης σαρκὸς ἄνθρωπον ἐπὶ τῆς συναγωγῆς ταύτης

text_en: And may go out and in before them, and may lead them out, or bring them in: lest the people of the Lord be as sheep without a shepherd.
text_la: et possit exire et intrare ante eos, et educere eos vel introducere : ne sit populus Domini sicut oves absque pastore.
text_pt: Que saia diante deles, e que entre diante deles, e que os faça sair, e que os faça entrar; para que a congregação do Senhor não seja como ovelhas que não têm pastor.
text_el: ὅστις ἐξελεύσεται πρὸ προσώπου αὐτῶν καὶ ὅστις εἰσελεύσεται πρὸ προσώπου αὐτῶν καὶ ὅστις ἐξάξει αὐτοὺς καὶ ὅστις εἰσάξει αὐτούς καὶ οὐκ ἔσται ἡ συναγωγὴ κυρίου ὡσεὶ πρόβατα οἷς οὐκ ἔστιν ποιμήν

text_en: And the Lord said to him: take Joshua the son of Nun , a man in whom is the Spirit , and put your hand upon him.
text_la: Dixitque Dominus ad eum : Tolle Josue filium Nun, virum in quo est spiritus, et pone manum tuam super eum.
text_pt: Então disse o Senhor a Moisés: Toma a Josué, filho de Num, homem em quem há o Espírito, e impõe a tua mão sobre ele.
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν λέγων λαβὲ πρὸς σεαυτὸν τὸν Ἰησοῦν υἱὸν Ναυη ἄνθρωπον ὃς ἔχει πνεῦμα ἐν ἑαυτῷ καὶ ἐπιθήσεις τὰς χεῖράς σου ἐπ' αὐτὸν

text_en: And he shall stand before Eleazar the priest and all the multitude:
text_la: Qui stabit coram Eleazaro sacerdote et omni multitudine:
text_pt: E apresenta-o perante Eleazar, o sacerdote, e perante toda a congregação, e dá-lhe as tuas ordens na presença deles.
text_el: καὶ στήσεις αὐτὸν ἔναντι Ελεαζαρ τοῦ ἱερέως καὶ ἐντελῇ αὐτῷ ἔναντι πάσης συναγωγῆς καὶ ἐντελῇ περὶ αὐτοῦ ἐναντίον αὐτῶν

text_en: And you shall give him precepts in the sight of all, and part of your glory , that all the congregation of the children of Israel may hear him.
text_la: et dabis ei præcepta cunctis videntibus, et partem gloriæ tuæ, ut audiat eum omnis synagoga filiorum Israël.
text_pt: E põe sobre ele da tua glória, para que lhe obedeça toda a congregação dos filhos de Israel.
text_el: καὶ δώσεις τῆς δόξης σου ἐπ' αὐτόν ὅπως ἂν εἰσακούσωσιν αὐτοῦ οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ

text_en: If anything be to be done, Eleazar the priest shall consult the Lord for him. He and all the children of Israel with him, and the rest of the multitude shall go out and go in at his word.
text_la: Pro hoc, si quid agendum erit, Eleazar sacerdos consulet Dominum. Ad verbum ejus egredietur et ingredietur ipse, et omnes filii Israël cum eo, et cetera multitudo.
text_pt: E apresentar-se-á perante Eleazar, o sacerdote, o qual por ele consultará, segundo o juízo de Urim, perante o Senhor; conforme a sua palavra sairão, e conforme a sua palavra entrarão, ele e todos os filhos de Israel com ele, e toda a congregação.
text_el: καὶ ἔναντι Ελεαζαρ τοῦ ἱερέως στήσεται καὶ ἐπερωτήσουσιν αὐτὸν τὴν κρίσιν τῶν δήλων ἔναντι κυρίου ἐπὶ τῷ στόματι αὐτοῦ ἐξελεύσονται καὶ ἐπὶ τῷ στόματι αὐτοῦ εἰσελεύσονται αὐτὸς καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ ὁμοθυμαδὸν καὶ πᾶσα ἡ συναγωγή

text_en: Moses did as the Lord had commanded. And, when he had taken Joshua , he set him before Eleazar the priest , and all the assembly of the people,
text_la: Fecit Moyses ut præceperat Dominus : cumque tulisset Josue, statuit eum coram Eleazaro sacerdote et omni frequentia populi.
text_pt: E fez Moisés como o Senhor lhe ordenara; porque tomou a Josué, e apresentou-o perante Eleazar, o sacerdote, e perante toda a congregação;
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησεν Μωυσῆς καθὰ ἐνετείλατο αὐτῷ κύριος καὶ λαβὼν τὸν Ἰησοῦν ἔστησεν αὐτὸν ἐναντίον Ελεαζαρ τοῦ ἱερέως καὶ ἔναντι πάσης συναγωγῆς

text_en: and laying his hands on his head, he repeated all things that the Lord had commanded.
text_la: Et impositis capiti ejus manibus, cuncta replicavit quæ mandaverat Dominus.
text_pt: E sobre ele impôs as suas mãos, e lhe deu ordens, como o Senhor falara por intermédio de Moisés.
text_el: καὶ ἐπέθηκεν τὰς χεῖρας αὐτοῦ ἐπ' αὐτὸν καὶ συνέστησεν αὐτόν καθάπερ συνέταξεν κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ

text_en: The Lord also said to Moses :
text_la: Dixit quoque Dominus ad Moysen:
text_pt: Falou mais o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν λέγων

text_en: Command the children of Israel , and you shall say to them: Offer my oblation and my bread, and burnt sacrifice of most sweet odour, in their due seasons.
text_la: Præcipe filiis Israël, et dices ad eos : Oblationem meam et panes, et incensum odoris suavissimi offerte per tempora sua.
text_pt: Dá ordem aos filhos de Israel, e dize-lhes: Da minha oferta, do meu alimento para as minhas ofertas queimadas, do meu cheiro suave, tereis cuidado, para me oferecê-las ao seu tempo determinado.
text_el: ἔντειλαι τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ καὶ ἐρεῖς πρὸς αὐτοὺς λέγων τὰ δῶρά μου δόματά μου καρπώματά μου εἰς ὀσμὴν εὐωδίας διατηρήσετε προσφέρειν ἐμοὶ ἐν ταῖς ἑορταῖς μου

text_en: These are the sacrifices which you shall offer: Two lambs of a year old without blemish every day for the perpetual holocaust :
text_la: Hæc sunt sacrificia quæ offerre debetis : agnos anniculos immaculatos duos quotidie in holocaustum sempiternum:
text_pt: E dir-lhes-ás: Esta é a oferta queimada que oferecereis ao Senhor: dois cordeiros de um ano, sem defeito, cada dia, em contínuo holocausto;
text_el: καὶ ἐρεῖς πρὸς αὐτούς ταῦτα τὰ καρπώματα ὅσα προσάξετε κυρίῳ ἀμνοὺς ἐνιαυσίους ἀμώμους δύο τὴν ἡμέραν εἰς ὁλοκαύτωσιν ἐνδελεχῶς

text_en: One you shall offer in the mornings, and the other in the evening:
text_la: unum offeretis mane, et alterum ad vesperum:
text_pt: Um cordeiro sacrificarás pela manhã, e o outro cordeiro sacrificarás à tarde;
text_el: τὸν ἀμνὸν τὸν ἕνα ποιήσεις τὸ πρωὶ καὶ τὸν ἀμνὸν τὸν δεύτερον ποιήσεις τὸ πρὸς ἑσπέραν

text_en: And the tenth part of an ephi of flour, which shall be tempered with the, purest oil, of the measure of the fourth part of a hin.
text_la: decimam partem ephi similæ, quæ conspersa sit oleo purissimo, et habeat quartam partem hin.
text_pt: E a décima parte de um efa de flor de farinha em oferta de alimentos, misturada com a quarta parte de um him de azeite batido.
text_el: καὶ ποιήσεις τὸ δέκατον τοῦ οιφι σεμίδαλιν εἰς θυσίαν ἀναπεποιημένην ἐν ἐλαίῳ ἐν τετάρτῳ τοῦ ιν

text_en: It is the continual holocaust which you offered in mount Sinai for a most sweet odour of a sacrifice by fire to the Lord .
text_la: Holocaustum juge est quod obtulistis in monte Sinai in odorem suavissimum incensi Domini.
text_pt: Este é o holocausto contínuo, instituído no monte Sinai, em cheiro suave, oferta queimada ao Senhor.
text_el: ὁλοκαύτωμα ἐνδελεχισμοῦ ἡ γενομένη ἐν τῷ ὄρει Σινα εἰς ὀσμὴν εὐωδίας κυρίῳ

text_en: And for a libation you shall offer of wine the fourth part of a hin for every lamb in the sanctuary of the Lord .
