text_la: Et libabitis vini quartam partem hin per agnos singulos in sanctuario Domini.
text_pt: E a sua libação será a quarta parte de um him para um cordeiro; no santuário, oferecerás a libação de bebida forte ao Senhor.
text_el: καὶ σπονδὴν αὐτοῦ τὸ τέταρτον τοῦ ιν τῷ ἀμνῷ τῷ ἑνί ἐν τῷ ἁγίῳ σπείσεις σπονδὴν σικερα κυρίῳ

text_en: And you shall offer the other lamb in like manner in the evening according to all the rites of the morning sacrifice , and of the libations thereof, an oblation of most sweet odour to the Lord .
text_la: Alterumque agnum similiter offeretis ad vesperam juxta omnem ritum sacrificii matutini, et libamentorum ejus, oblationem suavissimi odoris Domino.
text_pt: E o outro cordeiro sacrificarás à tarde, como a oferta de alimentos da manhã, e como a sua libação o oferecerás em oferta queimada de cheiro suave ao Senhor.
text_el: καὶ τὸν ἀμνὸν τὸν δεύτερον ποιήσεις τὸ πρὸς ἑσπέραν κατὰ τὴν θυσίαν αὐτοῦ καὶ κατὰ τὴν σπονδὴν αὐτοῦ ποιήσετε εἰς ὀσμὴν εὐωδίας κυρίῳ

text_en: And on the sabbath day you shall offer two lambs of a year old without blemish, and two tenths of flour tempered with oil in sacrifice , and the libations,
text_la: Die autem sabbati offeretis duos agnos anniculos immaculatos, et duas decimas similæ oleo conspersæ in sacrificio, et liba:
text_pt: Porém, no dia de sábado, oferecerás dois cordeiros de um ano, sem defeito, e duas décimas de flor de farinha, misturada com azeite, em oferta de alimentos, com a sua libação.
text_el: καὶ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῶν σαββάτων προσάξετε δύο ἀμνοὺς ἐνιαυσίους ἀμώμους καὶ δύο δέκατα σεμιδάλεως ἀναπεποιημένης ἐν ἐλαίῳ εἰς θυσίαν καὶ σπονδὴν

text_en: which regularly are poured out every sabbath for the perpetual holocaust .
text_la: quæ rite funduntur per singula sabbata in holocaustum sempiternum.
text_pt: Holocausto é de cada sábado, além do holocausto contínuo, e a sua libação.
text_el: ὁλοκαύτωμα σαββάτων ἐν τοῖς σαββάτοις ἐπὶ τῆς ὁλοκαυτώσεως τῆς διὰ παντὸς καὶ τὴν σπονδὴν αὐτοῦ

text_en: And on the first day of the month you shall offer a holocaust to the Lord , two calves of the herd, one ram, and seven lambs of a year old, without blemish,
text_la: In calendis autem offeretis holocaustum Domino, vitulos de armento duos, arietem unum, agnos anniculos septem immaculatos,
text_pt: E nos princípios dos vossos meses oferecereis, em holocausto ao Senhor, dois novilhos e um carneiro, sete cordeiros de um ano, sem defeito;
text_el: καὶ ἐν ταῖς νεομηνίαις προσάξετε ὁλοκαυτώματα τῷ κυρίῳ μόσχους ἐκ βοῶν δύο καὶ κριὸν ἕνα ἀμνοὺς ἐνιαυσίους ἑπτὰ ἀμώμους

text_en: and three tenths of flour tempered with oil in sacrifice for every calf: and two tenths of flour tempered with oil for every ram:
text_la: et tres decimas similæ oleo conspersæ in sacrificio per singulos vitulos : et duas decimas similæ oleo conspersæ per singulos arietes:
text_pt: E três décimas de flor de farinha misturada com azeite, em oferta de alimentos, para um novilho; e duas décimas de flor de farinha misturada com azeite, em oferta de alimentos, para um carneiro.
text_el: τρία δέκατα σεμιδάλεως ἀναπεποιημένης ἐν ἐλαίῳ τῷ μόσχῳ τῷ ἑνὶ καὶ δύο δέκατα σεμιδάλεως ἀναπεποιημένης ἐν ἐλαίῳ τῷ κριῷ τῷ ἑνί

text_en: And the tenth of a tenth of flour tempered with oil in sacrifice for every lamb. It is a holocaust of most sweet odour and an offering by fire to the Lord .
text_la: et decimam decimæ similæ ex oleo in sacrificio per agnos singulos : holocaustum suavissimi odoris atque incensi est Domino.
text_pt: E uma décima de flor de farinha misturada com azeite em oferta de alimentos, para um cordeiro; holocausto é de cheiro suave, oferta queimada ao Senhor.
text_el: δέκατον σεμιδάλεως ἀναπεποιημένης ἐν ἐλαίῳ τῷ ἀμνῷ τῷ ἑνί θυσίαν ὀσμὴν εὐωδίας κάρπωμα κυρίῳ

text_en: And these shall be the libations of wine that are to be poured out for every victim: Half a hin for every calf, a third for a ram, and a fourth for a lamb. This shall be the holocaust for every month, as they succeed one another in the course of the year.
text_la: Libamenta autem vini, quæ per singulas fundenda sunt victimas, ista erunt : media pars hin per singulos vitulos, tertia per arietem, quarta per agnum. Hoc erit holocaustum per omnes menses, qui sibi anno vertente succedunt.
text_pt: E as suas libações serão a metade de um him de vinho para um novilho, e a terça parte de um him para um carneiro, e a quarta parte de um him para um cordeiro; este é o holocausto da lua nova de cada mês, segundo os meses do ano.
text_el: ἡ σπονδὴ αὐτῶν τὸ ἥμισυ τοῦ ιν ἔσται τῷ μόσχῳ τῷ ἑνί καὶ τὸ τρίτον τοῦ ιν ἔσται τῷ κριῷ τῷ ἑνί καὶ τὸ τέταρτον τοῦ ιν ἔσται τῷ ἀμνῷ τῷ ἑνὶ οἴνου τοῦτο ὁλοκαύτωμα μῆνα ἐκ μηνὸς εἰς τοὺς μῆνας τοῦ ἐνιαυτοῦ

text_en: A buck goat also shall be offered to the Lord for a sin offering over and above the perpetual holocaust with its libations.
text_la: Hircus quoque offeretur Domino pro peccatis in holocaustum sempiternum cum libamentis suis.
text_pt: Também um bode para expiação do pecado ao Senhor, além do holocausto contínuo, com a sua libação se oferecerá.
text_el: καὶ χίμαρον ἐξ αἰγῶν ἕνα περὶ ἁμαρτίας κυρίῳ ἐπὶ τῆς ὁλοκαυτώσεως τῆς διὰ παντὸς ποιηθήσεται καὶ ἡ σπονδὴ αὐτοῦ

text_en: And in the first month, on the four tenth day of the month, shall be the phase of the Lord ,
text_la: Mense autem primo, quartadecima die mensis, Phase Domini erit,
text_pt: Porém no mês primeiro, aos catorze dias do mês, é a páscoa do Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἐν τῷ μηνὶ τῷ πρώτῳ τεσσαρεσκαιδεκάτῃ ἡμέρᾳ τοῦ μηνὸς πασχα κυρίῳ

text_en: and on the fifteenth day the solemn feast : seven days shall they eat unleavened bread .
text_la: et quintadecima die solemnitas : septem diebus vescentur azymis.
text_pt: E aos quinze dias do mesmo mês haverá festa; sete dias se comerão pães ázimos.
text_el: καὶ τῇ πεντεκαιδεκάτῃ ἡμέρᾳ τοῦ μηνὸς τούτου ἑορτή ἑπτὰ ἡμέρας ἄζυμα ἔδεσθε

text_en: And the first day of them shall be venerable and holy : you shall not do any servile work therein.
text_la: Quarum dies prima venerabilis et sancta erit : omne opus servile non facietis in ea.
text_pt: No primeiro dia haverá santa convocação; nenhum trabalho servil fareis;
text_el: καὶ ἡ ἡμέρα ἡ πρώτη ἐπίκλητος ἁγία ἔσται ὑμῖν πᾶν ἔργον λατρευτὸν οὐ ποιήσετε

text_en: And you shall offer a burnt sacrifice a holocaust to the Lord , two calves of the herd, one ram, seven lambs of a year old, without blemish:
text_la: Offeretisque incensum holocaustum Domino, vitulos de armento duos, arietem unum, agnos anniculos immaculatos septem:
text_pt: Mas oferecereis oferta queimada em holocausto ao Senhor, dois novilhos e um carneiro, e sete cordeiros de um ano; eles serão sem defeito.
text_el: καὶ προσάξετε ὁλοκαυτώματα καρπώματα κυρίῳ μόσχους ἐκ βοῶν δύο κριὸν ἕνα ἑπτὰ ἀμνοὺς ἐνιαυσίους ἄμωμοι ἔσονται ὑμῖν

text_en: And for the sacrifice of every one three tenths of flour which shall be tempered with oil to every calf, and two tenths to every ram,
text_la: et sacrificia singulorum ex simila quæ conspersa sit oleo, tres decimas per singulos vitulos, et duas decimas per arietem,
text_pt: E a sua oferta de alimentos será de flor de farinha misturada com azeite; oferecereis três décimas para um novilho, e duas décimas para um carneiro.
text_el: καὶ ἡ θυσία αὐτῶν σεμίδαλις ἀναπεποιημένη ἐν ἐλαίῳ τρία δέκατα τῷ μόσχῳ τῷ ἑνὶ καὶ δύο δέκατα τῷ κριῷ τῷ ἑνί

text_en: and the tenth of a tenth, to every lamb, that is to say, to all the seven lambs:
text_la: et decimam decimæ per agnos singulos, id est, per septem agnos.
text_pt: Para cada um dos sete cordeiros oferecereis uma décima;
text_el: δέκατον δέκατον ποιήσεις τῷ ἀμνῷ τῷ ἑνὶ τοῖς ἑπτὰ ἀμνοῖς

text_en: And one buck goat for sin , to make atonement for you,
text_la: Et hircum pro peccato unum, ut expietur pro vobis,
text_pt: E um bode para expiação do pecado, para fazer expiação por vós.
text_el: καὶ χίμαρον ἐξ αἰγῶν ἕνα περὶ ἁμαρτίας ἐξιλάσασθαι περὶ ὑμῶν

text_en: besides the morning holocaust which you shall always offer.
text_la: præter holocaustum matutinum, quod semper offeretis.
text_pt: Estas coisas oferecereis, além do holocausto da manhã, que é o holocausto contínuo.
text_el: πλὴν τῆς ὁλοκαυτώσεως τῆς διὰ παντὸς τῆς πρωινῆς ὅ ἐστιν ὁλοκαύτωμα ἐνδελεχισμοῦ

text_en: So shall you do every day of the seven days for the food of the fire, and for a most sweet odour to the Lord , which shall rise from the holocaust , and from the libations of each.
text_la: Ita facietis per singulos dies septem dierum in fomitem ignis, et in odorem suavissimum Domino, qui surget de holocausto, et de libationibus singulorum.
text_pt: Segundo este modo, cada dia oferecereis, por sete dias, o alimento da oferta queimada em cheiro suave ao Senhor; além do holocausto contínuo se oferecerá isto com a sua libação.
text_el: ταῦτα κατὰ ταῦτα ποιήσετε τὴν ἡμέραν εἰς τὰς ἑπτὰ ἡμέρας δῶρον κάρπωμα εἰς ὀσμὴν εὐωδίας κυρίῳ ἐπὶ τοῦ ὁλοκαυτώματος τοῦ διὰ παντὸς ποιήσεις τὴν σπονδὴν αὐτοῦ

text_en: The seventh day also shall be most solemn and holy unto you, you shall do no servile work therein.
text_la: Dies quoque septimus celeberrimus et sanctus erit vobis : omne opus servile non facietis in eo.
text_pt: E no sétimo dia tereis santa convocação; nenhum trabalho servil fareis.
text_el: καὶ ἡ ἡμέρα ἡ ἑβδόμη κλητὴ ἁγία ἔσται ὑμῖν πᾶν ἔργον λατρευτὸν οὐ ποιήσετε ἐν αὐτῇ

text_en: The day also of firstfruits , when after the weeks are accomplished, you shall offer new fruits to the Lord , shall be venerable and holy : you shall do no servile work therein.
text_la: Dies etiam primitivorum, quando offeretis novas fruges Domino, expletis hebdomadibus, venerabilis et sancta erit : omne opus servile non facietis in ea.
text_pt: Semelhantemente, tereis santa convocação no dia das primícias, quando oferecerdes oferta nova de alimentos ao Senhor, segundo as vossas semanas; nenhum trabalho servil fareis.
text_el: καὶ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῶν νέων ὅταν προσφέρητε θυσίαν νέαν κυρίῳ τῶν ἑβδομάδων ἐπίκλητος ἁγία ἔσται ὑμῖν πᾶν ἔργον λατρευτὸν οὐ ποιήσετε

text_en: And you shall offer a holocaust for a most sweet odour to the Lord , two calves of the herd, one ram, and seven lambs of a year old, without blemish:
text_la: Offeretisque holocaustum in odorem suavissimum Domino, vitulos de armento duos, arietem unum, et agnos anniculos immaculatos septem:
text_pt: Então oferecereis ao Senhor por holocausto, em cheiro suave, dois novilhos, um carneiro e sete cordeiros de um ano;
text_el: καὶ προσάξετε ὁλοκαυτώματα εἰς ὀσμὴν εὐωδίας κυρίῳ μόσχους ἐκ βοῶν δύο κριὸν ἕνα ἑπτὰ ἀμνοὺς ἐνιαυσίους ἀμώμους

text_en: And in the sacrifices of them three tenths of flour tempered with oil to every calf, two to every ram,
text_la: atque in sacrificiis eorum, similæ oleo conspersæ tres decimas per singulos vitulos, per arietes duas,
text_pt: E a sua oferta de alimentos de flor de farinha misturada com azeite: três décimas para um novilho, duas décimas para um carneiro;
text_el: ἡ θυσία αὐτῶν σεμίδαλις ἀναπεποιημένη ἐν ἐλαίῳ τρία δέκατα τῷ μόσχῳ τῷ ἑνὶ καὶ δύο δέκατα τῷ κριῷ τῷ ἑνί

text_en: the tenth of a tenth to every lamb, which in all are seven lambs: a buck goat also,
text_la: per agnos decimam decimæ, qui simul sunt agni septem. Hircum quoque,
text_pt: E uma décima, para cada um dos sete cordeiros;
text_el: δέκατον δέκατον τῷ ἀμνῷ τῷ ἑνὶ τοῖς ἑπτὰ ἀμνοῖς

text_en: which is slain for expiation: besides the perpetual holocaust and the libations thereof.
text_la: qui mactatur pro expiatione : præter holocaustum sempiternum et liba ejus.
text_pt: Um bode para fazer expiação por vós.
text_el: καὶ χίμαρον ἐξ αἰγῶν ἕνα περὶ ἁμαρτίας ἐξιλάσασθαι περὶ ὑμῶν

text_en: You shall offer them all without blemish with their libations.
text_la: Immaculata offeretis omnia cum libationibus suis.
text_pt: Além do holocausto contínuo, e a sua oferta de alimentos, os oferecereis (ser-vos-ão eles sem defeito) com as suas libações.
text_el: πλὴν τοῦ ὁλοκαυτώματος τοῦ διὰ παντός καὶ τὴν θυσίαν αὐτῶν ποιήσετέ μοι ἄμωμοι ἔσονται ὑμῖν καὶ τὰς σπονδὰς αὐτῶν

text_en: The first day also of the seventh month shall be venerable and holy unto you; you shall do no servile work therein, because it is the day of the sounding and of trumpets.
text_la: Mensis etiam septimi prima dies venerabilis et sancta erit vobis. Omne opus servile non facietis in ea, quia dies clangoris est et tubarum.
text_pt: Semelhantemente, tereis santa convocação no sétimo mês, no primeiro dia do mês; nenhum trabalho servil fareis; será para vós dia de sonido de trombetas.
text_el: καὶ τῷ μηνὶ τῷ ἑβδόμῳ μιᾷ τοῦ μηνὸς ἐπίκλητος ἁγία ἔσται ὑμῖν πᾶν ἔργον λατρευτὸν οὐ ποιήσετε ἡμέρα σημασίας ἔσται ὑμῖν

text_en: And you shall offer a holocaust for a most sweet odour to the Lord , one calf of the herd, one ram and seven lambs of a year old, without blemish.
text_la: Offeretisque holocaustum in odorem suavissimum Domino, vitulum de armento unum, arietem unum, et agnos anniculos immaculatos septem:
text_pt: Então por holocausto, em cheiro suave ao Senhor, oferecereis um novilho, um carneiro e sete cordeiros de um ano, sem defeito.
text_el: καὶ ποιήσετε ὁλοκαυτώματα εἰς ὀσμὴν εὐωδίας κυρίῳ μόσχον ἕνα ἐκ βοῶν κριὸν ἕνα ἀμνοὺς ἐνιαυσίους ἑπτὰ ἀμώμους

text_en: And for their sacrifices , three tenths of flour tempered with oil to every calf, two tenths to a ram,
text_la: et in sacrificiis eorum, similæ oleo conspersæ tres decimas per singulos vitulos, duas decimas per arietem,
text_pt: E pela sua oferta de alimentos de flor de farinha misturada com azeite, três décimas para o novilho, e duas décimas para o carneiro,
text_el: ἡ θυσία αὐτῶν σεμίδαλις ἀναπεποιημένη ἐν ἐλαίῳ τρία δέκατα τῷ μόσχῳ τῷ ἑνὶ καὶ δύο δέκατα τῷ κριῷ τῷ ἑνί

text_en: one tenth to a lamb, which in all are seven lambs:
text_la: unam decimam per agnum, qui simul sunt agni septem:
text_pt: E uma décima para cada um dos sete cordeiros.
text_el: δέκατον δέκατον τῷ ἀμνῷ τῷ ἑνὶ τοῖς ἑπτὰ ἀμνοῖς

text_en: And a buck goat for sin , which is offered for the expiation of the people,
text_la: et hircum pro peccato, qui offertur in expiationem populi,
text_pt: E um bode para expiação do pecado, para fazer expiação por vós;
text_el: καὶ χίμαρον ἐξ αἰγῶν ἕνα περὶ ἁμαρτίας ἐξιλάσασθαι περὶ ὑμῶν

text_en: besides the holocaust of the first day of the month with the sacrifices thereof, and the perpetual holocaust with the accustomed libations. With the same ceremonies you shall offer a burnt sacrifice for a most sweet odour to the Lord .
text_la: præter holocaustum calendarum cum sacrificiis suis, et holocaustum sempiternum cum libationibus solitis : eisdem cæremoniis offeretis in odorem suavissimum incensum Domino.
text_pt: Além do holocausto do mês, e a sua oferta de alimentos, e o holocausto contínuo, e a sua oferta de alimentos, com as suas libações, segundo o seu estatuto, em cheiro suave, oferta queimada ao Senhor.
text_el: πλὴν τῶν ὁλοκαυτωμάτων τῆς νουμηνίας καὶ αἱ θυσίαι αὐτῶν καὶ αἱ σπονδαὶ αὐτῶν καὶ τὸ ὁλοκαύτωμα τὸ διὰ παντὸς καὶ αἱ θυσίαι αὐτῶν καὶ αἱ σπονδαὶ αὐτῶν κατὰ τὴν σύγκρισιν αὐτῶν εἰς ὀσμὴν εὐωδίας κυρίῳ

text_en: The tenth day also of this seventh month shall be holy and venerable unto you, and you shall afflict your souls ; you shall do no servile work therein.
text_la: Decima quoque dies mensis hujus septimi erit vobis sancta atque venerabilis, et affligetis animas vestras : omne opus servile non facietis in ea.
text_pt: E no dia dez deste sétimo mês tereis santa convocação, e afligireis as vossas almas; nenhum trabalho fareis.
text_el: καὶ τῇ δεκάτῃ τοῦ μηνὸς τούτου ἐπίκλητος ἁγία ἔσται ὑμῖν καὶ κακώσετε τὰς ψυχὰς ὑμῶν καὶ πᾶν ἔργον οὐ ποιήσετε

text_en: And you shall offer a holocaust to the Lord for a most sweet odour, one calf of the herd, one ram, and seven lambs of a year old, without blemish:
text_la: Offeretisque holocaustum Domino in odorem suavissimum, vitulum de armento unum, arietem unum, agnos anniculos immaculatos septem:
text_pt: Mas por holocausto, em cheiro suave ao Senhor, oferecereis um novilho, um carneiro e sete cordeiros de um ano; eles serão sem defeito.
text_el: καὶ προσοίσετε ὁλοκαυτώματα εἰς ὀσμὴν εὐωδίας καρπώματα κυρίῳ μόσχον ἕνα ἐκ βοῶν κριὸν ἕνα ἀμνοὺς ἐνιαυσίους ἑπτά ἄμωμοι ἔσονται ὑμῖν

text_en: And for their sacrifices , three tenths of flour tempered with oil to every calf, two tenths to a ram,
text_la: et in sacrificiis eorum similæ oleo conspersæ tres decimas per singulos vitulos, duas decimas per arietem,
text_pt: E, pela sua oferta de alimentos de flor de farinha misturada com azeite, três décimas para o novilho, duas décimas para o carneiro,
text_el: ἡ θυσία αὐτῶν σεμίδαλις ἀναπεποιημένη ἐν ἐλαίῳ τρία δέκατα τῷ μόσχῳ τῷ ἑνὶ καὶ δύο δέκατα τῷ κριῷ τῷ ἑνί

text_en: the tenth of a tenth to every lamb, which are in all seven lambs:
text_la: decimam decimæ per agnos singulos, qui sunt simul agni septem:
text_pt: E uma décima para cada um dos sete cordeiros;
text_el: δέκατον δέκατον τῷ ἀμνῷ τῷ ἑνὶ εἰς τοὺς ἑπτὰ ἀμνούς

text_en: And a buck goat for sin , besides the things that are wont to be offered for sin , for expiation, and for the perpetual holocaust with their sacrifice and libations.
text_la: et hircum pro peccato, absque his quæ offerri pro delicto solent in expiationem, et holocaustum sempiternum, cum sacrificio et libaminibus eorum.
text_pt: Um bode para expiação do pecado, além da expiação do pecado pelas propiciações, e do holocausto contínuo, e da sua oferta de alimentos com as suas libações.
text_el: καὶ χίμαρον ἐξ αἰγῶν ἕνα περὶ ἁμαρτίας ἐξιλάσασθαι περὶ ὑμῶν πλὴν τὸ περὶ τῆς ἁμαρτίας τῆς ἐξιλάσεως καὶ ἡ ὁλοκαύτωσις ἡ διὰ παντός ἡ θυσία αὐτῆς καὶ ἡ σπονδὴ αὐτῆς κατὰ τὴν σύγκρισιν εἰς ὀσμὴν εὐωδίας κάρπωμα κυρίῳ

text_en: And on the fifteenth day of the seventh month, which shall be unto you holy and venerable, you shall do no servile work, but shall celebrate a solemnity to the Lord seven days.
text_la: Quintadecima vero die mensis septimi, quæ vobis sancta erit atque venerabilis, omne opus servile non facietis in ea, sed celebrabitis solemnitatem Domino septem diebus.
text_pt: Semelhantemente, aos quinze dias deste sétimo mês tereis santa convocação; nenhum trabalho servil fareis; mas sete dias celebrareis festa ao Senhor.
text_el: καὶ τῇ πεντεκαιδεκάτῃ ἡμέρᾳ τοῦ μηνὸς τοῦ ἑβδόμου τούτου ἐπίκλητος ἁγία ἔσται ὑμῖν πᾶν ἔργον λατρευτὸν οὐ ποιήσετε καὶ ἑορτάσετε αὐτὴν ἑορτὴν κυρίῳ ἑπτὰ ἡμέρας

text_en: And you shall offer a holocaust for a most sweet odour to the Lord , thirteen calves of the herd, two rams, and fourteen lambs of a year old, without blemish:
text_la: Offeretisque holocaustum in odorem suavissimum Domino, vitulos de armento tredecim, arietes duos, agnos anniculos immaculatos quatuordecim:
text_pt: E, por holocausto em oferta queimada, de cheiro suave ao Senhor, oferecereis treze novilhos, dois carneiros e catorze cordeiros de um ano; todos eles sem defeito.
text_el: καὶ προσάξετε ὁλοκαυτώματα καρπώματα εἰς ὀσμὴν εὐωδίας κυρίῳ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ πρώτῃ μόσχους ἐκ βοῶν τρεῖς καὶ δέκα κριοὺς δύο ἀμνοὺς ἐνιαυσίους δέκα τέσσαρας ἄμωμοι ἔσονται

text_en: And for their libations three tenths of flour tempered with oil to every calf, being in all thirteen calves: and two tenths to each ram, being two rams,
text_la: et in libamentis eorum, similæ oleo conspersæ tres decimas per vitulos singulos, qui sunt simul vituli tredecim, et duas decimas arieti uno, id est, simul arietibus duobus,
text_pt: E, pela sua oferta de alimentos de flor de farinha misturada com azeite, três décimas para cada um dos treze novilhos, duas décimas para cada carneiro, entre os dois carneiros;
text_el: αἱ θυσίαι αὐτῶν σεμίδαλις ἀναπεποιημένη ἐν ἐλαίῳ τρία δέκατα τῷ μόσχῳ τῷ ἑνὶ τοῖς τρισκαίδεκα μόσχοις καὶ δύο δέκατα τῷ κριῷ τῷ ἑνὶ ἐπὶ τοὺς δύο κριούς

text_en: and the tenth of a tenth to every lamb, being in all fourteen lambs:
text_la: et decimam decimæ agnis singulis, qui sunt simul agni quatuordecim:
text_pt: E uma décima para cada um dos catorze cordeiros;
text_el: δέκατον δέκατον τῷ ἀμνῷ τῷ ἑνὶ ἐπὶ τοὺς τέσσαρας καὶ δέκα ἀμνούς

text_en: And a buck goat for sin , besides the perpetual holocaust , and the sacrifice and the libation thereof.
text_la: et hircum pro peccato, absque holocausto sempiterno, et sacrificio, et libamine ejus.
text_pt: E um bode para expiação do pecado, além do holocausto contínuo, a sua oferta de alimentos e a sua libação;
text_el: καὶ χίμαρον ἐξ αἰγῶν ἕνα περὶ ἁμαρτίας πλὴν τῆς ὁλοκαυτώσεως τῆς διὰ παντός αἱ θυσίαι αὐτῶν καὶ αἱ σπονδαὶ αὐτῶν

text_en: On the second day you shall offer twelve calves of the herd, two rams and fourteen lambs of a year old, without blemish:
text_la: In die altero offeretis vitulos de armento duodecim, arietes duos, agnos anniculos immaculatos quatuordecim:
text_pt: Depois, no segundo dia, doze novilhos, dois carneiros, catorze cordeiros de um ano, sem defeito;
text_el: καὶ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ δευτέρᾳ μόσχους δώδεκα κριοὺς δύο ἀμνοὺς ἐνιαυσίους τέσσαρας καὶ δέκα ἀμώμους

text_en: And the sacrifices and the libations for every one, for the calves and for the rams and for the lambs you shall duly celebrate:
text_la: sacrificiaque et libamina singulorum, per vitulos, et arietes, et agnos rite celebrabitis:
text_pt: E a sua oferta de alimentos e as suas libações para os novilhos, para os carneiros e para os cordeiros, conforme o seu número, segundo o estatuto;
text_el: ἡ θυσία αὐτῶν καὶ ἡ σπονδὴ αὐτῶν τοῖς μόσχοις καὶ τοῖς κριοῖς καὶ τοῖς ἀμνοῖς κατὰ ἀριθμὸν αὐτῶν κατὰ τὴν σύγκρισιν αὐτῶν

text_en: And a buck goat for a sin offering besides the perpetual holocaust , and the sacrifice and the libation thereof.
text_la: et hircum pro peccato, absque holocausto sempiterno, sacrificioque et libamine ejus.
text_pt: E um bode para expiação do pecado, além do holocausto contínuo, da sua oferta de alimentos e das suas libações.
text_el: καὶ χίμαρον ἐξ αἰγῶν ἕνα περὶ ἁμαρτίας πλὴν τῆς ὁλοκαυτώσεως τῆς διὰ παντός αἱ θυσίαι αὐτῶν καὶ αἱ σπονδαὶ αὐτῶν

text_en: The third day you shall offer eleven calves, two rams, and fourteen lambs of a year old, without blemish:
text_la: Die tertio offeretis vitulos undecim, arietes duos, agnos anniculos immaculatos quatuordecim:
text_pt: E, no terceiro dia, onze novilhos, dois carneiros, catorze cordeiros de um ano, sem defeito;
text_el: τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ τρίτῃ μόσχους ἕνδεκα κριοὺς δύο ἀμνοὺς ἐνιαυσίους τέσσαρας καὶ δέκα ἀμώμους

text_en: And the sacrifices and the libations of every one for the calves and for the rams and for the lambs you shall offer according to the rite :
text_la: sacrificiaque et libamina singulorum, per vitulos, et arietes, et agnos rite celebrabitis:
text_pt: E as suas ofertas de alimentos, e as suas libações para os novilhos, para os carneiros e para os cordeiros, conforme o seu número, segundo o estatuto;
text_el: ἡ θυσία αὐτῶν καὶ ἡ σπονδὴ αὐτῶν τοῖς μόσχοις καὶ τοῖς κριοῖς καὶ τοῖς ἀμνοῖς κατὰ ἀριθμὸν αὐτῶν κατὰ τὴν σύγκρισιν αὐτῶν

text_en: And a buck goat for sin , besides the perpetual holocaust , and the sacrifice , and the libation thereof.
text_la: et hircum pro peccato, absque holocausto sempiterno, sacrificioque et libamine ejus.
text_pt: E um bode para expiação do pecado, além do holocausto contínuo, e da sua oferta de alimentos e da sua libação.
text_el: καὶ χίμαρον ἐξ αἰγῶν ἕνα περὶ ἁμαρτίας πλὴν τῆς ὁλοκαυτώσεως τῆς διὰ παντός αἱ θυσίαι αὐτῶν καὶ αἱ σπονδαὶ αὐτῶν

text_en: The fourth day you shall offer ten calves, two rams, and fourteen lambs of a year old, without blemish:
text_la: Die quarto offeretis vitulos decem, arietes duos, agnos anniculos immaculatos quatuordecim:
text_pt: E, no quarto dia, dez novilhos, dois carneiros, catorze cordeiros de um ano, sem defeito;
text_el: τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ τετάρτῃ μόσχους δέκα κριοὺς δύο ἀμνοὺς ἐνιαυσίους τέσσαρας καὶ δέκα ἀμώμους

text_en: And the sacrifices and the libations of every one for the calves and for the rams and for the lambs you shall celebrate in right manner:
text_la: sacrificiaque et libamina singulorum, per vitulos, et arietes, et agnos rite celebrabitis:
text_pt: A sua oferta de alimentos, e as suas libações para os novilhos, para os carneiros, e para os cordeiros, conforme o seu número, segundo o estatuto;
text_el: αἱ θυσίαι αὐτῶν καὶ αἱ σπονδαὶ αὐτῶν τοῖς μόσχοις καὶ τοῖς κριοῖς καὶ τοῖς ἀμνοῖς κατὰ ἀριθμὸν αὐτῶν κατὰ τὴν σύγκρισιν αὐτῶν

text_en: And a buck goat for sin , besides the perpetual holocaust , and the sacrifice and the libation thereof.
text_la: et hircum pro peccato, absque holocausto sempiterno, sacrificioque ejus et libamine.
text_pt: E um bode para expiação do pecado, além do holocausto contínuo, da sua oferta de alimentos e da sua libação.
text_el: καὶ χίμαρον ἐξ αἰγῶν ἕνα περὶ ἁμαρτίας πλὴν τῆς ὁλοκαυτώσεως τῆς διὰ παντός αἱ θυσίαι αὐτῶν καὶ αἱ σπονδαὶ αὐτῶν

text_en: The fifth day you shall offer nine calves, two rams, and fourteen lambs of a year old, without blemish:
text_la: Die quinto offeretis vitulos novem, arietes duos, agnos anniculos immaculatos quatuordecim:
text_pt: E, no quinto dia, nove novilhos, dois carneiros e catorze cordeiros de um ano, sem defeito.
text_el: τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ πέμπτῃ μόσχους ἐννέα κριοὺς δύο ἀμνοὺς ἐνιαυσίους τέσσαρας καὶ δέκα ἀμώμους

text_en: And the sacrifices and the libations of every one for the calves and for the rams and for the lambs you shall celebrate according to the rite :
text_la: sacrificiaque et libamina singulorum, per vitulos, et arietes, et agnos rite celebrabitis:
text_pt: E a sua oferta de alimentos, e as suas libações para os novilhos, para os carneiros e para os cordeiros, conforme o seu número, segundo o estatuto;
text_el: αἱ θυσίαι αὐτῶν καὶ αἱ σπονδαὶ αὐτῶν τοῖς μόσχοις καὶ τοῖς κριοῖς καὶ τοῖς ἀμνοῖς κατὰ ἀριθμὸν αὐτῶν κατὰ τὴν σύγκρισιν αὐτῶν

text_en: And a buck goat for sin , besides the perpetual holocaust , and the sacrifice and the libation thereof.
text_la: et hircum pro peccato, absque holocausto sempiterno, sacrificioque ejus et libamine.
text_pt: E um bode para expiação do pecado além do holocausto contínuo, e da sua oferta de alimentos e da sua libação.
text_el: καὶ χίμαρον ἐξ αἰγῶν ἕνα περὶ ἁμαρτίας πλὴν τῆς ὁλοκαυτώσεως τῆς διὰ παντός αἱ θυσίαι αὐτῶν καὶ αἱ σπονδαὶ αὐτῶν

text_en: The sixth day you shall offer eight calves, two rams, and fourteen lambs of a year old, without blemish:
text_la: Die sexto offeretis vitulos octo, arietes duos, agnos anniculos immaculatos quatuordecim:
text_pt: E, no sexto dia, oito novilhos, dois carneiros, catorze cordeiros de um ano, sem defeito;
text_el: τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ ἕκτῃ μόσχους ὀκτώ κριοὺς δύο ἀμνοὺς ἐνιαυσίους δέκα τέσσαρας ἀμώμους

text_en: And the sacrifices and the libations of every one for the calves and for the rams and for the lambs you shall celebrate according to the rite :
text_la: sacrificiaque et libamina singulorum, per vitulos, et arietes, et agnos rite celebrabitis:
text_pt: E a sua oferta de alimentos, e as suas libações para os bezerros, para os carneiros e para os cordeiros, conforme o seu número, segundo o estatuto;
text_el: αἱ θυσίαι αὐτῶν καὶ αἱ σπονδαὶ αὐτῶν τοῖς μόσχοις καὶ τοῖς κριοῖς καὶ τοῖς ἀμνοῖς κατὰ ἀριθμὸν αὐτῶν κατὰ τὴν σύγκρισιν αὐτῶν

text_en: And a buck goat for sin , besides the perpetual holocaust , and the sacrifice and the libation thereof.
text_la: et hircum pro peccato, absque holocausto sempiterno, sacrificioque ejus et libamine.
text_pt: E um bode para expiação do pecado, além do holocausto contínuo, da sua oferta de alimentos e da sua libação.
text_el: καὶ χίμαρον ἐξ αἰγῶν ἕνα περὶ ἁμαρτίας πλὴν τῆς ὁλοκαυτώσεως τῆς διὰ παντός αἱ θυσίαι αὐτῶν καὶ αἱ σπονδαὶ αὐτῶν

text_en: The seventh day you shall offer seven calves and two rams, and fourteen lambs of a year old, without blemish:
text_la: Die septimo offeretis vitulos septem, et arietes duos, agnos anniculos immaculatos quatuordecim:
text_pt: E, no sétimo dia, sete novilhos, dois carneiros, catorze cordeiros de um ano, sem defeito.
text_el: τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ ἑβδόμῃ μόσχους ἑπτά κριοὺς δύο ἀμνοὺς ἐνιαυσίους τέσσαρας καὶ δέκα ἀμώμους

text_en: And the sacrifices and the libations of every one for the calves and for the rams and for the lambs you shall celebrate according to the rite :
text_la: sacrificiaque et libamina singulorum, per vitulos, et arietes, et agnos rite celebrabitis:
text_pt: E a sua oferta de alimentos, e as suas libações para os novilhos, para os carneiros e para os cordeiros, conforme o seu número, segundo o seu estatuto,
text_el: αἱ θυσίαι αὐτῶν καὶ αἱ σπονδαὶ αὐτῶν τοῖς μόσχοις καὶ τοῖς κριοῖς καὶ τοῖς ἀμνοῖς κατὰ ἀριθμὸν αὐτῶν κατὰ τὴν σύγκρισιν αὐτῶν

text_en: And a buck goat for sin , besides the perpetual holocaust , and the sacrifice and the libation thereof.
text_la: et hircum pro peccato, absque holocausto sempiterno, sacrificioque ejus et libamine.
text_pt: E um bode para expiação do pecado, além do holocausto contínuo, da sua oferta de alimentos e da sua libação.
text_el: καὶ χίμαρον ἐξ αἰγῶν ἕνα περὶ ἁμαρτίας πλὴν τῆς ὁλοκαυτώσεως τῆς διὰ παντός αἱ θυσίαι αὐτῶν καὶ αἱ σπονδαὶ αὐτῶν

text_en: On the eighth day, which is most solemn , you shall do no servile work:
text_la: Die octavo, qui est celeberrimus, omne opus servile non facietis,
text_pt: No oitavo dia tereis dia de solenidade; nenhum trabalho servil fareis;
text_el: καὶ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ ὀγδόῃ ἐξόδιον ἔσται ὑμῖν πᾶν ἔργον λατρευτὸν οὐ ποιήσετε ἐν αὐτῇ

text_en: But you shall offer a holocaust for a most sweet odour to the Lord , one calf, one ram, and seven lambs of a year old, without blemish:
text_la: offerentes holocaustum in odorem suavissimum Domino, vitulum unum, arietem unum, agnos anniculos immaculatos septem:
text_pt: E por holocausto em oferta queimada de cheiro suave ao Senhor oferecereis um novilho, um carneiro, sete cordeiros de um ano, sem defeito;
text_el: καὶ προσάξετε ὁλοκαυτώματα εἰς ὀσμὴν εὐωδίας καρπώματα κυρίῳ μόσχον ἕνα κριὸν ἕνα ἀμνοὺς ἐνιαυσίους ἑπτὰ ἀμώμους

text_en: And the sacrifices and the libations of every one for the calves and for the rams and for the lambs you shall celebrate according to the rite :
text_la: sacrificiaque et libamina singulorum, per vitulos, et arietes, et agnos rite celebrabitis:
text_pt: A sua oferta de alimentos e as suas libações para o novilho, para o carneiro e para os cordeiros, conforme o seu número, segundo o estatuto.
text_el: αἱ θυσίαι αὐτῶν καὶ αἱ σπονδαὶ αὐτῶν τῷ μόσχῳ καὶ τῷ κριῷ καὶ τοῖς ἀμνοῖς κατὰ ἀριθμὸν αὐτῶν κατὰ τὴν σύγκρισιν αὐτῶν

text_en: And a buck goat for sin , besides the perpetual holocaust , and the sacrifice and the libation thereof.
text_la: et hircum pro peccato, absque holocausto sempiterno, sacrificioque ejus et libamine.
text_pt: E um bode para expiação do pecado, além do holocausto contínuo, e da sua oferta de alimentos e da sua libação.
text_el: καὶ χίμαρον ἐξ αἰγῶν ἕνα περὶ ἁμαρτίας πλὴν τῆς ὁλοκαυτώσεως τῆς διὰ παντός αἱ θυσίαι αὐτῶν καὶ αἱ σπονδαὶ αὐτῶν

text_en: These things shall you offer to the Lord in your solemnities : besides your vows and voluntary oblations for holocaust , for sacrifice , for libation, and for victims of peace offerings .
text_la: Hæc offeretis Domino in solemnitatibus vestris : præter vota et oblationes spontaneas in holocausto, in sacrificio, in libamine, et in hostiis pacificis.
text_pt: Estas coisas fareis ao Senhor nas vossas solenidades além dos vossos votos, e das vossas ofertas voluntárias, com os vossos holocaustos, e com as vossas ofertas de alimentos, e com as vossas libações, e com as vossas ofertas pacíficas.
text_el: ταῦτα ποιήσετε κυρίῳ ἐν ταῖς ἑορταῖς ὑμῶν πλὴν τῶν εὐχῶν ὑμῶν καὶ τὰ ἑκούσια ὑμῶν καὶ τὰ ὁλοκαυτώματα ὑμῶν καὶ τὰς θυσίας ὑμῶν καὶ τὰς σπονδὰς ὑμῶν καὶ τὰ σωτήρια ὑμῶν

text_en: And Moses told the children of Israel all that the Lord had commanded him:
text_la: Narravitque Moyses filiis Israël omnia quæ ei Dominus imperarat.
text_pt: E falou Moisés aos cabeças das tribos dos filhos de Israel, dizendo: Esta é a palavra que o SENHOR tem ordenado.
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν Μωυσῆς τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ κατὰ πάντα ὅσα ἐνετείλατο κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ

text_en: And he said to the princes of the tribes of the children of Israel : This is the word that the Lord has commanded:
text_la: Et locutus est ad principes tribuum filiorum Israël : Iste est sermo quem præcepit Dominus:
text_pt: Quando um homem fizer voto ao Senhor, ou fizer juramento, ligando a sua alma com obrigação, não violará a sua palavra: segundo tudo o que saiu da sua boca, fará.
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν Μωυσῆς πρὸς τοὺς ἄρχοντας τῶν φυλῶν Ισραηλ λέγων τοῦτο τὸ ῥῆμα ὃ συνέταξεν κύριος

text_en: If any man make a vow to the Lord , or bind himself by an oath : he shall not make his word void but shall fulfil all that he promised.
text_la: Si quis virorum votum Domino voverit, aut se constrinxerit juramento : non faciet irritum verbum suum, sed omne quod promisit, implebit.
text_pt: Também quando uma mulher, na sua mocidade, estando ainda na casa de seu pai, fizer voto ao Senhor, e com obrigação se ligar,
text_el: ἄνθρωπος ἄνθρωπος ὃς ἂν εὔξηται εὐχὴν κυρίῳ ἢ ὀμόσῃ ὅρκον ἢ ὁρίσηται ὁρισμῷ περὶ τῆς ψυχῆς αὐτοῦ οὐ βεβηλώσει τὸ ῥῆμα αὐτοῦ πάντα ὅσα ἐὰν ἐξέλθῃ ἐκ τοῦ στόματος αὐτοῦ ποιήσει

text_en: If a woman vow anything, and bind herself by an oath , being in her father's house, and but yet a girl in age: if her father knew the vow that she has promised, and the oath wherewith she has bound her soul , and held his peace, she shall be bound by the vow :
text_la: Mulier si quippiam voverit, et se constrinxerit juramento, quæ est in domo patris sui, et in ætate adhuc puellari : si cognoverit pater votum quod pollicita est, et juramentum quo obligavit animam suam, et tacuerit, voti rea erit:
text_pt: E seu pai ouvir o seu voto e a sua obrigação, com que ligou a sua alma; e seu pai se calar para com ela, todos os seus votos serão válidos; e toda a obrigação com que ligou a sua alma, será válida.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ γυνὴ εὔξηται εὐχὴν κυρίῳ ἢ ὁρίσηται ὁρισμὸν ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτῆς ἐν τῇ νεότητι αὐτῆς

text_en: Whatsoever she promised and swore , she shall fulfil in deed.
text_la: quidquid pollicita est, et juravit, opere complebit.
text_pt: Mas se seu pai lhe tolher no dia que tal ouvir, todos os seus votos e as suas obrigações com que tiver ligado a sua alma, não serão válidos; mas o Senhor lhe perdoará, porquanto seu pai lhos tolheu.
text_el: καὶ ἀκούσῃ ὁ πατὴρ αὐτῆς τὰς εὐχὰς αὐτῆς καὶ τοὺς ὁρισμοὺς αὐτῆς οὓς ὡρίσατο κατὰ τῆς ψυχῆς αὐτῆς καὶ παρασιωπήσῃ αὐτῆς ὁ πατήρ καὶ στήσονται πᾶσαι αἱ εὐχαὶ αὐτῆς καὶ πάντες οἱ ὁρισμοί οὓς ὡρίσατο κατὰ τῆς ψυχῆς αὐτῆς μενοῦσιν αὐτῇ

text_en: But if her father, immediately as soon as he heard it, gainsaid it, both her vows and her oaths shall be void, neither shall she be bound to what she promised, because her father has gainsaid it.
text_la: Sin autem statim ut audierit, contradixerit pater : et vota et juramenta ejus irrita erunt, nec obnoxia tenebitur sponsioni, eo quod contradixerit pater.
text_pt: E se ela for casada, e for obrigada a alguns votos, ou à pronunciação dos seus lábios, com que tiver ligado a sua alma;
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ ἀνανεύων ἀνανεύσῃ ὁ πατὴρ αὐτῆς ᾗ ἂν ἡμέρᾳ ἀκούσῃ πάσας τὰς εὐχὰς αὐτῆς καὶ τοὺς ὁρισμούς οὓς ὡρίσατο κατὰ τῆς ψυχῆς αὐτῆς οὐ στήσονται καὶ κύριος καθαριεῖ αὐτήν ὅτι ἀνένευσεν ὁ πατὴρ αὐτῆς

text_en: If she have a husband, and shall vow anything, and the word once going out of her mouth shall bind her soul by an oath ,
text_la: Si maritum habuerit, et voverit aliquid, et semel de ore ejus verbum egrediens animam ejus obligaverit juramento:
text_pt: E seu marido o ouvir, e se calar para com ela no dia em que o ouvir, os seus votos serão válidos; e as suas obrigações com que ligou a sua alma, serão válidas.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ γενομένη γένηται ἀνδρὶ καὶ αἱ εὐχαὶ αὐτῆς ἐπ' αὐτῇ κατὰ τὴν διαστολὴν τῶν χειλέων αὐτῆς οὓς ὡρίσατο κατὰ τῆς ψυχῆς αὐτῆς

text_en: the day that her husband shall hear it, and not gainsay it, she shall be bound to the vow , and shall give whatsoever she promised.
text_la: quo die audierit vir, et non contradixerit, voti rea erit, reddetque quodcumque promiserat.
text_pt: Mas se seu marido lhe tolher no dia em que o ouvir, e anular o seu voto a que estava obrigada, como também a pronunciação dos seus lábios, com que ligou a sua alma; o Senhor lhe perdoará.
text_el: καὶ ἀκούσῃ ὁ ἀνὴρ αὐτῆς καὶ παρασιωπήσῃ αὐτῇ ᾗ ἂν ἡμέρᾳ ἀκούσῃ καὶ οὕτως στήσονται πᾶσαι αἱ εὐχαὶ αὐτῆς καὶ οἱ ὁρισμοὶ αὐτῆς οὓς ὡρίσατο κατὰ τῆς ψυχῆς αὐτῆς στήσονται

text_en: But if as soon as he hears he gainsay it, and make her promises and the words wherewith she had bound her soul of no effect: the Lord will forgive her.
text_la: Sin autem audiens statim contradixerit, et irritas fecerit pollicitationes ejus, verbaque quibus obstrinxerat animam suam, propitius erit ei Dominus.
text_pt: No tocante ao voto da viúva, ou da repudiada, tudo com que ligar a sua alma, sobre ela será válido.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ ἀνανεύων ἀνανεύσῃ ὁ ἀνὴρ αὐτῆς ᾗ ἂν ἡμέρᾳ ἀκούσῃ πᾶσαι αἱ εὐχαὶ αὐτῆς καὶ οἱ ὁρισμοὶ αὐτῆς οὓς ὡρίσατο κατὰ τῆς ψυχῆς αὐτῆς οὐ μενοῦσιν ὅτι ὁ ἀνὴρ ἀνένευσεν ἀπ' αὐτῆς καὶ κύριος καθαριεῖ αὐτήν

text_en: The widow , and she that is divorced , shall fulfil whatsoever they vow .
text_la: Vidua et repudiata quidquid voverint, reddent.
text_pt: Porém se fez voto na casa de seu marido, ou ligou a sua alma com obrigação de juramento;
text_el: καὶ εὐχὴ χήρας καὶ ἐκβεβλημένης ὅσα ἂν εὔξηται κατὰ τῆς ψυχῆς αὐτῆς μενοῦσιν αὐτῇ

text_en: If the wife in the house of her husband, has bound herself by vow and by oath ,
text_la: Uxor in domo viri cum se voto constrinxerit et juramento,
text_pt: E seu marido o ouviu, e se calou para com ela, e não lho tolheu, todos os seus votos serão válidos, e toda a obrigação, com que ligou a sua alma, será válida.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ τοῦ ἀνδρὸς αὐτῆς ἡ εὐχὴ αὐτῆς ἢ ὁ ὁρισμὸς κατὰ τῆς ψυχῆς αὐτῆς μεθ' ὅρκου

text_en: if her husband hear, and hold his peace, and does not disallow the promise, she shall accomplish whatsoever she had promised.
text_la: si audierit vir, et tacuerit, nec contradixerit sponsioni, reddet quodcumque promiserat.
text_pt: Porém se seu marido lhos anulou no dia em que os ouviu; tudo quanto saiu dos seus lábios, quer dos seus votos, quer da obrigação da sua alma, não será válido; seu marido lhos anulou, e o Senhor lhe perdoará.
text_el: καὶ ἀκούσῃ ὁ ἀνὴρ αὐτῆς καὶ παρασιωπήσῃ αὐτῇ καὶ μὴ ἀνανεύσῃ αὐτῇ καὶ στήσονται πᾶσαι αἱ εὐχαὶ αὐτῆς καὶ πάντες οἱ ὁρισμοὶ αὐτῆς οὓς ὡρίσατο κατὰ τῆς ψυχῆς αὐτῆς στήσονται κατ' αὐτῆς

text_en: But if forthwith he gainsay it, she shall not be bound by the promise: because her husband gainsaid it, and the Lord will be merciful to her.
text_la: Sin autem extemplo contradixerit, non tenebitur promissionis rea : quia maritus contradixit, et Dominus ei propitius erit.
text_pt: Todo o voto, e todo o juramento de obrigação, para humilhar a alma, seu marido o confirmará, ou anulará.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ περιελὼν περιέλῃ ὁ ἀνὴρ αὐτῆς ᾗ ἂν ἡμέρᾳ ἀκούσῃ πάντα ὅσα ἐὰν ἐξέλθῃ ἐκ τῶν χειλέων αὐτῆς κατὰ τὰς εὐχὰς αὐτῆς καὶ κατὰ τοὺς ὁρισμοὺς τοὺς κατὰ τῆς ψυχῆς αὐτῆς οὐ μενεῖ αὐτῇ ὁ ἀνὴρ αὐτῆς περιεῖλεν καὶ κύριος καθαρίσει αὐτήν

text_en: If she vow and bind herself by oath , to afflict her soul by fasting , or abstinence from other things, it shall depend on the will of her husband, whether she shall do it, or not do it.
text_la: Si voverit, et juramento se constrinxerit, ut per jejunium, vel ceterarum rerum abstinentiam affligat animam suam, in arbitrio viri erit ut faciat, sive non faciat.
text_pt: Porém se seu marido, de dia em dia, se calar inteiramente para com ela, então confirma todos os seus votos e todas as suas obrigações, que estiverem sobre ela; confirmado lhos tem, porquanto se calou para com ela no dia em que o ouviu.
text_el: πᾶσα εὐχὴ καὶ πᾶς ὅρκος δεσμοῦ κακῶσαι ψυχήν ὁ ἀνὴρ αὐτῆς στήσει αὐτῇ καὶ ὁ ἀνὴρ αὐτῆς περιελεῖ

text_en: But if the husband hearing it hold his peace, and defer the declaring his mind till another day: whatsoever she had vowed and promised, she shall fulfil: because immediately as he heard it, he held his peace.
text_la: Quod si audiens vir tacuerit, et in alteram diem distulerit sententiam, quidquid voverat atque promiserat, reddet : quia statim ut audivit, tacuit.
text_pt: Porém se de todo lhos anular depois que o ouviu, então ele levará a iniqüidade dela.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ σιωπῶν παρασιωπήσῃ αὐτῇ ἡμέραν ἐξ ἡμέρας καὶ στήσει αὐτῇ πάσας τὰς εὐχὰς αὐτῆς καὶ τοὺς ὁρισμοὺς τοὺς ἐπ' αὐτῆς στήσει αὐτῇ ὅτι ἐσιώπησεν αὐτῇ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ᾗ ἤκουσεν

text_en: But if he gainsay it after that he knew it, he shall bear her iniquity .
text_la: Sin autem contradixerit postquam rescivit, portabit ipse iniquitatem ejus.
text_pt: Estes são os estatutos que o Senhor ordenou a Moisés entre o marido e sua mulher; entre o pai e sua filha, na sua mocidade, em casa de seu pai.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ περιελὼν περιέλῃ αὐτῆς μετὰ τὴν ἡμέραν ἣν ἤκουσεν καὶ λήμψεται τὴν ἁμαρτίαν αὐτοῦ

text_en: These are the laws which the Lord appointed to Moses between the husband and the wife, between the father and the daughter that is as yet but a girl in age, or that abides in her father's house.
text_la: Istæ sunt leges, quas constituit Dominus Moysi inter virum et uxorem, inter patrem et filiam, quæ in puellari adhuc ætate est, vel quæ manet in parentis domo.
text_el: ταῦτα τὰ δικαιώματα ὅσα ἐνετείλατο κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ ἀνὰ μέσον ἀνδρὸς καὶ γυναικὸς αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον πατρὸς καὶ θυγατρὸς ἐν νεότητι ἐν οἴκῳ πατρός

text_en: And the Lord spoke to Moses , saying:
text_la: Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen, dicens:
text_pt: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν λέγων

text_en: Revenge first the children of Israel on the Madianites , and so you shall be gathered to your people.
text_la: Ulciscere prius filios Israël de Madianitis, et sic colligeris ad populum tuum.
text_pt: Vinga os filhos de Israel dos midianitas; depois recolhido serás ao teu povo.
text_el: ἐκδίκει τὴν ἐκδίκησιν υἱῶν Ισραηλ ἐκ τῶν Μαδιανιτῶν καὶ ἔσχατον προστεθήσῃ πρὸς τὸν λαόν σου

text_en: And Moses forthwith said: Arm of you men to fight, who may take the revenge of the Lord on the Madianites .
text_la: Statimque Moyses : Armate, inquit, ex vobis viros ad pugnam, qui possint ultionem Domini expetere de Madianitis.
text_pt: Falou, pois, Moisés ao povo, dizendo: Armem-se alguns de vós para a guerra, e saiam contra os midianitas, para fazerem a vingança do Senhor contra eles.
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν Μωυσῆς πρὸς τὸν λαὸν λέγων ἐξοπλίσατε ἐξ ὑμῶν ἄνδρας παρατάξασθαι ἔναντι κυρίου ἐπὶ Μαδιαν ἀποδοῦναι ἐκδίκησιν παρὰ τοῦ κυρίου τῇ Μαδιαν

text_en: Let a thousand men be chosen out of every tribe of Israel to be sent to the war .
text_la: Mille viri de singulis tribubus eligantur ex Israël qui mittantur ad bellum.
text_pt: Mil de cada tribo, entre todas as tribos de Israel, enviareis à guerra.
text_el: χιλίους ἐκ φυλῆς χιλίους ἐκ φυλῆς ἐκ πασῶν φυλῶν Ισραηλ ἀποστείλατε παρατάξασθαι

text_en: And they gave a thousand of every tribe , that is to say, twelve thousand men well appointed for battle.
text_la: Dederuntque millenos de singulis tribubus, id est, duodecim millia expeditorum ad pugnam:
text_pt: Assim foram dados, dos milhares de Israel, mil de cada tribo; doze mil armados para a peleja.
text_el: καὶ ἐξηρίθμησαν ἐκ τῶν χιλιάδων Ισραηλ χιλίους ἐκ φυλῆς δώδεκα χιλιάδες ἐνωπλισμένοι εἰς παράταξιν

text_en: And Moses sent them with Phinees the son of Eleazar the priest , and he delivered to him the holy vessels, and the trumpets to sound.
text_la: quos misit Moyses cum Phinees filio Eleazari sacerdotis, vasa quoque sancta, et tubas ad clangendum tradidit ei.
text_pt: E Moisés os mandou à guerra, mil de cada tribo, e com eles Finéias, filho de Eleazar, o sacerdote, com os vasos do santuário, e com as trombetas do alarido na sua mão.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν αὐτοὺς Μωυσῆς χιλίους ἐκ φυλῆς χιλίους ἐκ φυλῆς σὺν δυνάμει αὐτῶν καὶ Φινεες υἱὸν Ελεαζαρ υἱοῦ Ααρων τοῦ ἱερέως καὶ τὰ σκεύη τὰ ἅγια καὶ αἱ σάλπιγγες τῶν σημασιῶν ἐν ταῖς χερσὶν αὐτῶν

text_en: And when they had fought against the Madianites and had overcome them, they slew all the men .
text_la: Cumque pugnassent contra Madianitas atque vicissent, omnes mares occiderunt,
text_pt: E pelejaram contra os midianitas, como o Senhor ordenara a Moisés; e mataram a todos os homens.
text_el: καὶ παρετάξαντο ἐπὶ Μαδιαν καθὰ ἐνετείλατο κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ καὶ ἀπέκτειναν πᾶν ἀρσενικόν

text_en: And their kings Evi, and Recem, and Sur, and Hur, and Rebe, five princes of the nation: Balaam also the son of Beor they killed with the sword.
text_la: et reges eorum, Evi, et Recem, et Sur, et Hur, et Rebe, quinque principes gentis : Balaam quoque filium Beor interfecerunt gladio.
text_pt: Mataram também, além dos que já haviam sido mortos, os reis dos midianitas: a Evi, e a Requém, e a Zur, e a Hur, e a Reba, cinco reis dos midianitas; também a Balaão, filho de Beor, mataram à espada.
text_el: καὶ τοὺς βασιλεῖς Μαδιαν ἀπέκτειναν ἅμα τοῖς τραυματίαις αὐτῶν καὶ τὸν Ευιν καὶ τὸν Σουρ καὶ τὸν Ροκομ καὶ τὸν Ουρ καὶ τὸν Ροβοκ πέντε βασιλεῖς Μαδιαν καὶ τὸν Βαλααμ υἱὸν Βεωρ ἀπέκτειναν ἐν ῥομφαίᾳ σὺν τοῖς τραυματίαις αὐτῶν

text_en: And they took their women , and their children captives , and all their cattle, and all their goods : and all their possessions they plundered:
text_la: Ceperuntque mulieres eorum, et parvulos, omniaque pecora, et cunctam supellectilem : quidquid habere potuerant depopulati sunt:
text_pt: Porém, os filhos de Israel levaram presas as mulheres dos midianitas e as suas crianças; também levaram todos os seus animais e todo o seu gado, e todos os seus bens.
text_el: καὶ ἐπρονόμευσαν τὰς γυναῖκας Μαδιαν καὶ τὴν ἀποσκευὴν αὐτῶν καὶ τὰ κτήνη αὐτῶν καὶ πάντα τὰ ἔγκτητα αὐτῶν καὶ τὴν δύναμιν αὐτῶν ἐπρονόμευσαν

text_en: And all their cities, and their villages , and castles , they burned.
text_la: tam urbes quam viculos et castella flamma consumpsit.
text_pt: E queimaram a fogo todas as suas cidades com todas as suas habitações e todos os seus acampamentos.
text_el: καὶ πάσας τὰς πόλεις αὐτῶν τὰς ἐν ταῖς οἰκίαις αὐτῶν καὶ τὰς ἐπαύλεις αὐτῶν ἐνέπρησαν ἐν πυρί

text_en: And they carried away the booty, and all that they had taken both of men and of beasts.
text_la: Et tulerunt prædam, et universa quæ ceperant tam ex hominibus quam ex jumentis,
text_pt: E tomaram todo o despojo e toda a presa de homens e de animais.
text_el: καὶ ἔλαβον πᾶσαν τὴν προνομὴν καὶ πάντα τὰ σκῦλα αὐτῶν ἀπὸ ἀνθρώπου ἕως κτήνους

text_en: And they brought them to Moses , and Eleazar the priest , and to all the multitude of the children of Israel . But the rest of the things for use they carried to the camp on the plains of Moab , beside the Jordan over against Jericho .
text_la: et adduxerunt ad Moysen, et Eleazarum sacerdotem, et ad omnem multitudinem filiorum Israël : reliqua autem utensilia portaverunt ad castra in campestribus Moab juxta Jordanem contra Jericho.
text_pt: E trouxeram a Moisés e a Eleazar, o sacerdote, e à congregação dos filhos de Israel, os cativos, e a presa, e o despojo, para o arraial, nas campinas de Moabe, que estão junto ao Jordão, na altura de Jericó.
text_el: καὶ ἤγαγον πρὸς Μωυσῆν καὶ πρὸς Ελεαζαρ τὸν ἱερέα καὶ πρὸς πάντας υἱοὺς Ισραηλ τὴν αἰχμαλωσίαν καὶ τὰ σκῦλα καὶ τὴν προνομὴν εἰς τὴν παρεμβολὴν εἰς Αραβωθ Μωαβ ἥ ἐστιν ἐπὶ τοῦ Ιορδάνου κατὰ Ιεριχω

text_en: And Moses and Eleazar the priest and all the princes of the synagogue went forth to meet them without the camp.
text_la: Egressi sunt autem Moyses et Eleazar sacerdos, et omnes principes synagogæ, in occursum eorum extra castra.
text_pt: Porém Moisés e Eleazar, o sacerdote, e todos os príncipes da congregação, saíram a recebê-los fora do arraial.
text_el: καὶ ἐξῆλθεν Μωυσῆς καὶ Ελεαζαρ ὁ ἱερεὺς καὶ πάντες οἱ ἄρχοντες τῆς συναγωγῆς εἰς συνάντησιν αὐτοῖς ἔξω τῆς παρεμβολῆς

text_en: And Moses being angry with the chief officers of the army, the tribunes, and the centurions that had come from the battle,
text_la: Iratusque Moyses principibus exercitus, tribunis, et centurionibus qui venerant de bello,
text_pt: E indignou-se Moisés grandemente contra os oficiais do exército, capitães dos milhares e capitães das centenas, que vinham do serviço da guerra.
text_el: καὶ ὠργίσθη Μωυσῆς ἐπὶ τοῖς ἐπισκόποις τῆς δυνάμεως χιλιάρχοις καὶ ἑκατοντάρχοις τοῖς ἐρχομένοις ἐκ τῆς παρατάξεως τοῦ πολέμου

text_en: said: Why have you saved the women ?
text_la: ait : Cur feminas reservastis?
text_pt: E Moisés disse-lhes: Deixastes viver todas as mulheres?
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Μωυσῆς ἵνα τί ἐζωγρήσατε πᾶν θῆλυ

text_en: Are not these they, that deceived the children of Israel by the counsel of Balaam , and made you transgress against the Lord by the sin of Phogor, for which also the people was punished?
text_la: nonne istæ sunt, quæ deceperunt filios Israël ad suggestionem Balaam, et prævaricari vos fecerunt in Domino super peccato Phogor, unde et percussus est populus?
text_pt: Eis que estas foram as que, por conselho de Balaão, deram ocasião aos filhos de Israel de transgredir contra o Senhor no caso de Peor; por isso houve aquela praga entre a congregação do Senhor.
text_el: αὗται γὰρ ἦσαν τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ κατὰ τὸ ῥῆμα Βαλααμ τοῦ ἀποστῆσαι καὶ ὑπεριδεῖν τὸ ῥῆμα κυρίου ἕνεκεν Φογωρ καὶ ἐγένετο ἡ πληγὴ ἐν τῇ συναγωγῇ κυρίου

text_en: Therefore kill all that are of the male sex, even of the children: and put to death the women , that have carnally known men .
text_la: ergo cunctos interficite quidquid est generis masculinis, etiam in parvulis : et mulieres, quæ noverunt viros in coitu, jugulate:
text_pt: Agora, pois, matai todo o homem entre as crianças, e matai toda a mulher que conheceu algum homem, deitando-se com ele.
text_el: καὶ νῦν ἀποκτείνατε πᾶν ἀρσενικὸν ἐν πάσῃ τῇ ἀπαρτίᾳ καὶ πᾶσαν γυναῖκα ἥτις ἔγνωκεν κοίτην ἄρσενος ἀποκτείνατε

text_en: But the girls, and all the women that are virgins save for yourselves:
text_la: puellas autem et omnes feminas virgines reservate vobis:
text_pt: Porém, todas as meninas que não conheceram algum homem, deitando-se com ele, deixai-as viver para vós.
text_el: πᾶσαν τὴν ἀπαρτίαν τῶν γυναικῶν ἥτις οὐκ οἶδεν κοίτην ἄρσενος ζωγρήσατε αὐτάς

text_en: And stay without the camp seven days. He that has killed a man , or touched one that is killed, shall be purified the third day and the seventh day.
text_la: et manete extra castra septem diebus. Qui occiderit hominem, vel occisum tetigerit, lustrabitur die tertio et septimo.
text_pt: E alojai-vos sete dias fora do arraial; qualquer que tiver matado alguma pessoa, e qualquer que tiver tocado algum morto, ao terceiro dia, e ao sétimo dia vos purificareis, a vós e a vossos cativos.
text_el: καὶ ὑμεῖς παρεμβάλετε ἔξω τῆς παρεμβολῆς ἑπτὰ ἡμέρας πᾶς ὁ ἀνελὼν καὶ ὁ ἁπτόμενος τοῦ τετρωμένου ἁγνισθήσεται τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ τρίτῃ καὶ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ ἑβδόμῃ ὑμεῖς καὶ ἡ αἰχμαλωσία ὑμῶν

text_en: And of all the spoil, every garment, or vessel, or anything made for use, of the skins, or hair of goats, or of wood, shall be purified.
text_la: Et de omni præda, sive vestimentum fuerit, sive vas, et aliquid in utensilia præparatum, de caprarum pellibus, et pilis, et ligno, expiabitur.
text_pt: Também purificareis toda a roupa, e toda a obra de peles, e toda a obra de pêlos de cabras, e todo o utensílio de madeira.
text_el: καὶ πᾶν περίβλημα καὶ πᾶν σκεῦος δερμάτινον καὶ πᾶσαν ἐργασίαν ἐξ αἰγείας καὶ πᾶν σκεῦος ξύλινον ἀφαγνιεῖτε

text_en: Eleazar also the priest spoke to the men of the army, that had fought, in this manner: This is the ordinance of the law , which the Lord has commanded Moses :
text_la: Eleazar quoque sacerdos ad viros exercitus, qui pugnaverunt, sic locutus est : Hoc est præceptum legis, quod mandavit Dominus Moysi:
text_pt: E disse Eleazar, o sacerdote, aos homens da guerra, que foram à peleja: Este é o estatuto da lei que o Senhor ordenou a Moisés.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ελεαζαρ ὁ ἱερεὺς πρὸς τοὺς ἄνδρας τῆς δυνάμεως τοὺς ἐρχομένους ἐκ τῆς παρατάξεως τοῦ πολέμου τοῦτο τὸ δικαίωμα τοῦ νόμου ὃ συνέταξεν κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ

text_en: Gold, and silver, and brass, and iron, and lead, and tin,
text_la: aurum, et argentum, et æs, et ferrum, et plumbum, et stannum,
text_pt: Contudo o ouro, e a prata, o cobre, o ferro, o estanho, e o chumbo,
text_el: πλὴν τοῦ χρυσίου καὶ τοῦ ἀργυρίου καὶ χαλκοῦ καὶ σιδήρου καὶ μολίβου καὶ κασσιτέρου

text_en: and all that may pass through the fire, shall be purified by fire, but whatsoever cannot abide the fire, shall be sanctified with the water of expiation:
text_la: et omne, quod potest transire per flammas, igne purgabitur : quidquid autem ignem non potest sustinere, aqua expiationis sanctificabitur:
text_pt: Toda a coisa que pode resistir ao fogo, fareis passar pelo fogo, para que fique limpa, todavia se purificará com a água da purificação; mas tudo que não pode resistir ao fogo, fareis passar pela água.
text_el: πᾶν πρᾶγμα ὃ διελεύσεται ἐν πυρί καὶ καθαρισθήσεται ἀλλ' ἢ τῷ ὕδατι τοῦ ἁγνισμοῦ ἁγνισθήσεται καὶ πάντα ὅσα ἐὰν μὴ διαπορεύηται διὰ πυρός διελεύσεται δι' ὕδατος

text_en: And you shall wash your garments the seventh day, and being purified, you shall afterwards enter into the camp.
text_la: et lavabitis vestimenta vestra die septimo, et purificati postea castra intrabitis.
text_pt: Também lavareis as vossas roupas ao sétimo dia, para que fiqueis limpos; e depois entrareis no arraial.
text_el: καὶ πλυνεῖσθε τὰ ἱμάτια τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ ἑβδόμῃ καὶ καθαρισθήσεσθε καὶ μετὰ ταῦτα εἰσελεύσεσθε εἰς τὴν παρεμβολήν

text_en: And the Lord said to Moses :
text_la: Dixit quoque Dominus ad Moysen:
text_pt: Falou mais o Senhor a Moisés, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν λέγων

text_en: Take the sum of the things that were taken both of man and beast, you and Eleazar the priest and the princes of the multitude:
text_la: Tollite summam eorum quæ capta sunt, ab homine usque ad pecus, tu et Eleazar sacerdos et principes vulgi:
text_pt: Faze a soma da presa que foi tomada, de homens e de animais, tu e Eleazar, o sacerdote, e os cabeças das casas dos pais da congregação,
text_el: λαβὲ τὸ κεφάλαιον τῶν σκύλων τῆς αἰχμαλωσίας ἀπὸ ἀνθρώπου ἕως κτήνους σὺ καὶ Ελεαζαρ ὁ ἱερεὺς καὶ οἱ ἄρχοντες τῶν πατριῶν τῆς συναγωγῆς

text_en: And you shall divide the spoil equally, between them that fought and went out to the war , and between the rest of the multitude.
text_la: dividesque ex æquo prædam inter eos qui pugnaverunt egressique sunt ad bellum, et inter omnem reliquam multitudinem.
text_pt: E divide a presa em duas metades, entre os que se armaram para a peleja, e saíram à guerra, e toda a congregação.
text_el: καὶ διελεῖτε τὰ σκῦλα ἀνὰ μέσον τῶν πολεμιστῶν τῶν ἐκπορευομένων εἰς τὴν παράταξιν καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον πάσης συναγωγῆς

text_en: And you shall separate a portion to the Lord from them that fought and were in the battle, one soul of five hundred as well of persons as of oxen and asses and sheep.
text_la: Et separabis partem Domino ab his qui pugnaverunt et fuerunt in bello, unam animam de quingentis, tam ex hominibus quam ex bobus et asinis et ovibus,
text_pt: Então para o Senhor tomarás o tributo dos homens de guerra, que saíram a esta peleja, de cada quinhentos uma alma, dos homens, e dos bois, e dos jumentos e das ovelhas.
text_el: καὶ ἀφελεῖτε τέλος κυρίῳ παρὰ τῶν ἀνθρώπων τῶν πολεμιστῶν τῶν ἐκπεπορευμένων εἰς τὴν παράταξιν μίαν ψυχὴν ἀπὸ πεντακοσίων ἀπὸ τῶν ἀνθρώπων καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν κτηνῶν καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν βοῶν καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν προβάτων καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν αἰγῶν

text_en: And you shall give it to Eleazar the priest , because they are the firstfruits of the Lord .
text_la: et dabis eam Eleazaro sacerdoti, quia primitiæ Domini sunt.
text_pt: Da sua metade o tomareis, e o dareis ao sacerdote Eleazar, para a oferta alçada do Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἀπὸ τοῦ ἡμίσους αὐτῶν λήμψεσθε καὶ δώσεις Ελεαζαρ τῷ ἱερεῖ τὰς ἀπαρχὰς κυρίου

text_en: Out of the moiety also of the children of Israel you shall take the fiftieth head of persons, and of oxen, and asses, and sheep, and of all beasts, and you shall give them to the Levites that watch in the charge of the tabernacle of the Lord .
text_la: Ex media quoque parte filiorum Israël accipies quinquagesimum caput hominum, et boum, et asinorum, et ovium, cunctorum animantium, et dabis ea Levitis, qui excubant in custodiis tabernaculi Domini.
text_pt: Mas, da metade dos filhos de Israel, tomarás um de cada cinqüenta, um dos homens, dos bois, dos jumentos, e das ovelhas, e de todos os animais; e os darás aos levitas que têm cuidado da guarda do tabernáculo do Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἀπὸ τοῦ ἡμίσους τοῦ τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ λήμψῃ ἕνα ἀπὸ τῶν πεντήκοντα ἀπὸ τῶν ἀνθρώπων καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν βοῶν καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν προβάτων καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν ὄνων καὶ ἀπὸ πάντων τῶν κτηνῶν καὶ δώσεις αὐτὰ τοῖς Λευίταις τοῖς φυλάσσουσιν τὰς φυλακὰς ἐν τῇ σκηνῇ κυρίου

text_en: And Moses and Eleazar did as the Lord had commanded.
text_la: Feceruntque Moyses et Eleazar sicut præceperat Dominus.
text_pt: E fizeram Moisés e Eleazar, o sacerdote, como o Senhor ordenara a Moisés.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησεν Μωυσῆς καὶ Ελεαζαρ ὁ ἱερεὺς καθὰ συνέταξεν κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ

text_en: And the spoil which the army had taken, was six hundred seventy-five thousand sheep,
text_la: Fuit autem præda, quam exercitus ceperat, ovium sexcenta septuaginta quinque millia,
text_pt: Foi a presa, restante do despojo que tomaram os homens de guerra, seiscentas e setenta e cinco mil ovelhas;
text_el: καὶ ἐγενήθη τὸ πλεόνασμα τῆς προνομῆς ὃ ἐπρονόμευσαν οἱ ἄνδρες οἱ πολεμισταί ἀπὸ τῶν προβάτων ἑξακόσιαι χιλιάδες καὶ ἑβδομήκοντα καὶ πέντε χιλιάδες

text_en: seventy-two thousand oxen,
text_la: boum septuaginta duo millia,
text_pt: E setenta e dois mil bois;
text_el: καὶ βόες δύο καὶ ἑβδομήκοντα χιλιάδες

text_en: sixty-one thousand asses:
text_la: asinorum sexaginta millia et mille:
text_pt: E sessenta e um mil jumentos;
text_el: καὶ ὄνοι μία καὶ ἑξήκοντα χιλιάδες

text_en: And thirty-two thousand persons of the female sex , that had not known men .
text_la: animæ hominum sexus feminei, quæ non cognoverant viros, triginta duo millia.
text_pt: E, das mulheres que não conheceram homem algum, deitando-se com ele, todas as almas foram trinta e duas mil.
text_el: καὶ ψυχαὶ ἀνθρώπων ἀπὸ τῶν γυναικῶν αἳ οὐκ ἔγνωσαν κοίτην ἀνδρός πᾶσαι ψυχαὶ δύο καὶ τριάκοντα χιλιάδες

text_en: And one half was given to them that had been in the battle, to wit, three hundred thirty-seven thousand five hundred sheep:
text_la: Dataque est media pars his qui in prælio fuerant, ovium trecenta triginta septem millia quingentæ:
text_pt: E a metade, que era a porção dos que saíram à guerra, foi em número de trezentas e trinta e sete mil e quinhentas ovelhas.
text_el: καὶ ἐγενήθη τὸ ἡμίσευμα ἡ μερὶς τῶν ἐκπεπορευμένων εἰς τὸν πόλεμον ἐκ τοῦ ἀριθμοῦ τῶν προβάτων τριακόσιαι καὶ τριάκοντα χιλιάδες καὶ ἑπτακισχίλια καὶ πεντακόσια

text_en: Out of which, for the portion of the Lord , were reckoned six hundred seventy five sheep.
text_la: e quibus in partem Domini supputatæ sunt oves sexcentæ septuaginta quinque:
text_pt: E das ovelhas, o tributo para o Senhor foi de seiscentas e setenta e cinco.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο τὸ τέλος κυρίῳ ἀπὸ τῶν προβάτων ἑξακόσια ἑβδομήκοντα πέντε

text_en: And out of the thirty-six thousand oxen, seventy-two oxen:
text_la: et de bobus triginta sex millibus, boves septuaginta et duo:
text_pt: E foram os bois trinta e seis mil; e o seu tributo para o Senhor setenta e dois.
text_el: καὶ βόες ἓξ καὶ τριάκοντα χιλιάδες καὶ τὸ τέλος κυρίῳ δύο καὶ ἑβδομήκοντα

text_en: Out of the thirty thousand five hundred asses, sixty-one asses:
text_la: de asinis triginta millibus quingentis, asini sexaginta unus:
text_pt: E foram os jumentos trinta mil e quinhentos; e o seu tributo para o Senhor sessenta e um.
text_el: καὶ ὄνοι τριάκοντα χιλιάδες καὶ πεντακόσιοι καὶ τὸ τέλος κυρίῳ εἷς καὶ ἑξήκοντα

text_en: Out of the sixteen thousand persons, there fell to the portion of the Lord , thirty-two souls .
text_la: de animabus hominum sedecim millibus, cesserunt in partem Domini triginta duæ animæ.
text_pt: E houve de pessoas dezesseis mil; e o seu tributo para o Senhor trinta e duas pessoas.
text_el: καὶ ψυχαὶ ἀνθρώπων ἑκκαίδεκα χιλιάδες καὶ τὸ τέλος αὐτῶν κυρίῳ δύο καὶ τριάκοντα ψυχαί

text_en: And Moses delivered the number of the firstfruits of the Lord to Eleazar the priest , as had been commanded him,
text_la: Tradiditque Moyses numerum primitiarum Domini Eleazaro sacerdoti, sicut fuerat ei imperatum,
text_pt: E deu Moisés a Eleazar, o sacerdote, o tributo da oferta alçada do Senhor, como o Senhor ordenara a Moisés.
text_el: καὶ ἔδωκεν Μωυσῆς τὸ τέλος κυρίῳ τὸ ἀφαίρεμα τοῦ θεοῦ Ελεαζαρ τῷ ἱερεῖ καθὰ συνέταξεν κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ

text_en: out of the half of the children of Israel , which he had separated for them that had been in the battle.
text_la: ex media parte filiorum Israël, quam separaverat his qui in prælio fuerant.
text_pt: E da metade dos filhos de Israel que Moisés separara da dos homens que pelejaram,
text_el: ἀπὸ τοῦ ἡμισεύματος τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ οὓς διεῖλεν Μωυσῆς ἀπὸ τῶν ἀνδρῶν τῶν πολεμιστῶν

text_en: But out of the half that fell to the rest of the multitude, that is to say, out of the three hundred thirty-seven thousand five hundred sheep,
text_la: De media vero parte, quæ contigerat reliquæ multitudini, id est, de ovibus trecentis triginta septem millibus quingentis,
text_pt: (A metade para a congregação foi, das ovelhas, trezentas e trinta e sete mil e quinhentas;
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο τὸ ἡμίσευμα τὸ τῆς συναγωγῆς ἀπὸ τῶν προβάτων τριακόσιαι χιλιάδες καὶ τριάκοντα χιλιάδες καὶ ἑπτακισχίλια καὶ πεντακόσια

text_en: and out of the thirty-six thousand oxen,
text_la: et de bobus triginta sex millibus,
text_pt: E dos bois trinta e seis mil;
text_el: καὶ βόες ἓξ καὶ τριάκοντα χιλιάδες

text_en: and out of the thirty thousand five hundred asses,
text_la: et de asinis triginta millibus quingentis,
text_pt: E dos jumentos trinta mil e quinhentos;
text_el: ὄνοι τριάκοντα χιλιάδες καὶ πεντακόσιοι

text_en: and out of the sixteen thousand persons ,
text_la: et de hominibus sedecim millibus,
text_pt: E das pessoas, dezesseis mil).
text_el: καὶ ψυχαὶ ἀνθρώπων ἓξ καὶ δέκα χιλιάδες

text_en: Moses took the fiftieth head , and gave it to the Levites that watched in the tabernacle of the Lord , as the Lord had commanded.
text_la: tulit Moyses quinquagesimum caput, et dedit Levitis, qui excubabant in tabernaculo Domini, sicut præceperat Dominus.
text_pt: Desta metade dos filhos de Israel, Moisés tomou um de cada cinqüenta, de homens e de animais, e os deu aos levitas, que tinham cuidado da guarda do tabernáculo do Senhor, como o Senhor ordenara a Moisés.
text_el: καὶ ἔλαβεν Μωυσῆς ἀπὸ τοῦ ἡμισεύματος τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ τὸ ἓν ἀπὸ τῶν πεντήκοντα ἀπὸ τῶν ἀνθρώπων καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν κτηνῶν καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτὰ τοῖς Λευίταις τοῖς φυλάσσουσιν τὰς φυλακὰς τῆς σκηνῆς κυρίου ὃν τρόπον συνέταξεν κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ

text_en: And when the commanders of the army, and the tribunes and centurions had come to Moses , they said:
text_la: Cumque accessissent principes exercitus ad Moysen, et tribuni, centurionesque, dixerunt:
text_pt: Então chegaram-se a Moisés os oficiais que estavam sobre os milhares do exército, os chefes de mil e os chefes de cem;
text_el: καὶ προσῆλθον πρὸς Μωυσῆν πάντες οἱ καθεσταμένοι εἰς τὰς χιλιαρχίας τῆς δυνάμεως χιλίαρχοι καὶ ἑκατόνταρχοι

text_en: We your servants have reckoned up the number of the fighting men , whom we had under our hand, and not so much as one was wanting.
text_la: Nos servi tui recensuimus numerum pugnatorum, quos habuimus sub manu nostra : et ne unus quidem defuit.
text_pt: E disseram a Moisés: Teus servos tomaram a soma dos homens de guerra que estiveram sob as nossas ordens; e não falta nenhum de nós.
text_el: καὶ εἶπαν πρὸς Μωυσῆν οἱ παῖδές σου εἰλήφασιν τὸ κεφάλαιον τῶν ἀνδρῶν τῶν πολεμιστῶν τῶν παρ' ἡμῶν καὶ οὐ διαπεφώνηκεν ἀπ' αὐτῶν οὐδὲ εἷς

text_en: Therefore we offer as gifts to the Lord what gold every one of us could find in the booty, in garters and tablets, rings and bracelets, and chains, that you may pray to the Lord for us.
text_la: Ob hanc causam offerimus in donariis Domini singuli quod in præda auri potuimus invenire, periscelides et armillas, annulos et dextralia, ac murænulas, ut depreceris pro nobis Dominum.
text_pt: Por isso trouxemos uma oferta ao Senhor, cada um o que achou, objetos de ouro, cadeias, ou manilhas, anéis, arrecadas, e colares, para fazer expiação pelas nossas almas perante o Senhor.
text_el: καὶ προσενηνόχαμεν τὸ δῶρον κυρίῳ ἀνὴρ ὃ εὗρεν σκεῦος χρυσοῦν χλιδῶνα καὶ ψέλιον καὶ δακτύλιον καὶ περιδέξιον καὶ ἐμπλόκιον ἐξιλάσασθαι περὶ ἡμῶν ἔναντι κυρίου

text_en: And Moses and Eleazar the priest received all the gold in divers kinds,
text_la: Susceperuntque Moyses et Eleazar sacerdos omne aurum in diversis speciebus,
text_pt: Assim Moisés e Eleazar, o sacerdote, receberam deles o ouro, sendo todos os objetos bem trabalhados.
text_el: καὶ ἔλαβεν Μωυσῆς καὶ Ελεαζαρ ὁ ἱερεὺς τὸ χρυσίον παρ' αὐτῶν πᾶν σκεῦος εἰργασμένον

text_en: in weight sixteen thousand seven hundred and fifty sicles, from the tribunes and from the centurions .
text_la: pondo sedecim millia septingentos quinquaginta siclos, a tribunis et centurionibus.
text_pt: E foi todo o ouro da oferta alçada, que ofereceram ao Senhor, dezesseis mil e setecentos e cinqüenta siclos, dos chefes de mil e dos chefes de cem
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο πᾶν τὸ χρυσίον τὸ ἀφαίρεμα ὃ ἀφεῖλον κυρίῳ ἓξ καὶ δέκα χιλιάδες καὶ ἑπτακόσιοι καὶ πεντήκοντα σίκλοι παρὰ τῶν χιλιάρχων καὶ παρὰ τῶν ἑκατοντάρχων

text_en: For that which every one had taken in the booty was his own.
text_la: Unusquisque enim quod in præda rapuerat, suum erat.
text_pt: (Pois cada um dos homens de guerra, tinha tomado presa para si).
text_el: καὶ οἱ ἄνδρες οἱ πολεμισταὶ ἐπρονόμευσαν ἕκαστος ἑαυτῷ

text_en: And that which was received they brought into the tabernacle of the testimony , for a memorial of the children of Israel before the Lord .
text_la: Et susceptum intulerunt in tabernaculum testimonii, in monimentum filiorum Israël coram Domino.
text_pt: Receberam, pois, Moisés e Eleazar, o sacerdote, o ouro dos chefes de mil e dos chefes de cem, e o levaram à tenda da congregação, por memorial para os filhos de Israel perante o Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἔλαβεν Μωυσῆς καὶ Ελεαζαρ ὁ ἱερεὺς τὸ χρυσίον παρὰ τῶν χιλιάρχων καὶ παρὰ τῶν ἑκατοντάρχων καὶ εἰσήνεγκεν αὐτὰ εἰς τὴν σκηνὴν τοῦ μαρτυρίου μνημόσυνον τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ ἔναντι κυρίου

text_en: And the sons of Ruben and Gad had many flocks of cattle, and their substance in beasts was infinite. And when they saw the lands of Jazer and Galaad fit for feeding cattle,
text_la: Filii autem Ruben et Gad habebant pecora multa, et erat illis in jumentis infinita substantia. Cumque vidissent Jazer et Galaad aptas animalibus alendis terras,
text_pt: E os filhos de Rúben e os filhos de Gade tinham gado em grande quantidade; e viram a terra de Jazer, e a terra de Gileade, e eis que o lugar era lugar de gado.
text_el: καὶ κτήνη πλῆθος ἦν τοῖς υἱοῖς Ρουβην καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς Γαδ πλῆθος σφόδρα καὶ εἶδον τὴν χώραν Ιαζηρ καὶ τὴν χώραν Γαλααδ καὶ ἦν ὁ τόπος τόπος κτήνεσιν

text_en: they came to Moses and Eleazar the priest , and the princes of the multitude, and said:
text_la: venerunt ad Moysen, et ad Elezarum sacerdotem, et principes multitudinis, atque dixerunt:
text_pt: Vieram, pois, os filhos de Gade, e os filhos de Rúben e falaram a Moisés e a Eleazar, o sacerdote, e aos chefes da congregação, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ προσελθόντες οἱ υἱοὶ Ρουβην καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ Γαδ εἶπαν πρὸς Μωυσῆν καὶ πρὸς Ελεαζαρ τὸν ἱερέα καὶ πρὸς τοὺς ἄρχοντας τῆς συναγωγῆς λέγοντες

text_en: Ataroth, and Dibon , and Jazer, and Nemra, Hesebon , and Eleale, and Saban, and Nebo , and Beon,
text_la: Ataroth, et Dibon, et Jazer, et Nemra, Hesebon, et Eleale, et Saban, et Nebo, et Beon,
text_pt: Atarote, e Dibom, e Jazer, e Ninra, e Hesbom, e Eleale, e Sebã, e Nebo, e Beom,
text_el: Αταρωθ καὶ Δαιβων καὶ Ιαζηρ καὶ Ναμβρα καὶ Εσεβων καὶ Ελεαλη καὶ Σεβαμα καὶ Ναβαυ καὶ Βαιαν

text_en: the land, which the Lord has conquered in the sight of the children of Israel , is a very fertile soil for the feeding of beasts: and we your servants have very much cattle:
text_la: terra, quam percussit Dominus in conspectu filiorum Israël, regio uberrima est ad pastum animalium : et nos servi tui habemus jumenta plurima,
text_pt: A terra que o Senhor feriu diante da congregação de Israel, é terra para gado, e os teus servos têm gado.
text_el: τὴν γῆν ἣν παρέδωκεν κύριος ἐνώπιον τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ γῆ κτηνοτρόφος ἐστίν καὶ τοῖς παισίν σου κτήνη ὑπάρχει

text_en: And we pray you, if we have found favour in your sight, that you give it to us your servants in possession, and make us not pass over the Jordan .
text_la: precamurque si invenimus gratiam coram te, ut des nobis famulis tuis eam in possessionem, nec facias nos transire Jordanem.
text_pt: Disseram mais: Se achamos graça aos teus olhos, dê-se esta terra aos teus servos em possessão; e não nos faças passar o Jordão.
text_el: καὶ ἔλεγον εἰ εὕρομεν χάριν ἐνώπιόν σου δοθήτω ἡ γῆ αὕτη τοῖς οἰκέταις σου ἐν κατασχέσει καὶ μὴ διαβιβάσῃς ἡμᾶς τὸν Ιορδάνην

text_en: And Moses answered them: What, shall your brethren go to fight, and will you sit here?
text_la: Quibus respondit Moyses : Numquid fratres vestri ibunt ad pugnam, et vos hic sedebitis?
text_pt: Porém Moisés disse aos filhos de Gade e aos filhos de Rúben: Irão vossos irmãos à peleja, e ficareis vós aqui?
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Μωυσῆς τοῖς υἱοῖς Γαδ καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς Ρουβην οἱ ἀδελφοὶ ὑμῶν πορεύονται εἰς πόλεμον καὶ ὑμεῖς καθήσεσθε αὐτοῦ

text_en: Why do you overturn the minds of the children of Israel , that they may not dare to pass into the place which the Lord has given them?
text_la: cur subvertitis mentes filiorum Israël, ne transire audeant in locum, quem eis daturus est Dominus?
text_pt: Por que, pois, desencorajais o coração dos filhos de Israel, para que não passem à terra que o Senhor lhes tem dado?
text_el: καὶ ἵνα τί διαστρέφετε τὰς διανοίας τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ μὴ διαβῆναι εἰς τὴν γῆν ἣν κύριος δίδωσιν αὐτοῖς

text_en: Was it not thus your fathers did, when I sent from Cadesbarne to view the land?
text_la: Nonne ita egerunt patres vestri, quando misi de Cadesbarne ad explorandam terram?
text_pt: Assim fizeram vossos pais, quando os mandei de Cades-Barnéia, a ver esta terra.
text_el: οὐχ οὕτως ἐποίησαν οἱ πατέρες ὑμῶν ὅτε ἀπέστειλα αὐτοὺς ἐκ Καδης Βαρνη κατανοῆσαι τὴν γῆν

text_en: And when they had come as far as the valley of the cluster, having viewed all the country, they overturned the hearts of the children of Israel , that they should not enter into the coasts, which the Lord gave them.
text_la: cumque venissent usque ad Vallem botri, lustrata omni regione, subverterunt cor filiorum Israël, ut non intrarent fines, quos eis Dominus dedit.
text_pt: Chegando eles até ao vale de Escol, e vendo esta terra, desencorajaram o coração dos filhos de Israel, para que não entrassem na terra que o Senhor lhes tinha dado.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέβησαν Φάραγγα βότρυος καὶ κατενόησαν τὴν γῆν καὶ ἀπέστησαν τὴν καρδίαν τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ ὅπως μὴ εἰσέλθωσιν εἰς τὴν γῆν ἣν ἔδωκεν κύριος αὐτοῖς

text_en: And he swore in his anger , saying:
text_la: Qui iratus juravit, dicens:
text_pt: Então a ira do Senhor se acendeu naquele mesmo dia, e jurou dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ὠργίσθη θυμῷ κύριος ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ καὶ ὤμοσεν λέγων

text_en: If these men , that came up out of Egypt , from twenty years old and upward, shall see the land, which I promised with an oath to Abraham , Isaac , and Jacob : because they would not follow me,
text_la: Si videbunt homines isti, qui ascenderunt ex Ægypto a viginti annis et supra, terram, quam sub juramento pollicitus sum Abraham, Isaac, et Jacob : et noluerunt sequi me,
text_pt: Que os homens, que subiram do Egito, de vinte anos para cima, não verão a terra que jurei a Abraão, a Isaque, e a Jacó! porquanto não perseveraram em seguir-me;
text_el: εἰ ὄψονται οἱ ἄνθρωποι οὗτοι οἱ ἀναβάντες ἐξ Αἰγύπτου ἀπὸ εἰκοσαετοῦς καὶ ἐπάνω οἱ ἐπιστάμενοι τὸ κακὸν καὶ τὸ ἀγαθὸν τὴν γῆν ἣν ὤμοσα τῷ Αβρααμ καὶ Ισαακ καὶ Ιακωβ οὐ γὰρ συνεπηκολούθησαν ὀπίσω μου

text_en: except Caleb the son of Jephone the Cenezite , and Joshua the son of Nun : these have fulfilled my will .
text_la: præter Caleb filium Jephone Cenezæum, et Josue filium Nun : isti impleverunt voluntatem meam.
text_pt: Exceto Calebe, filho de Jefoné o quenezeu, e Josué, filho de Num, porquanto perseveraram em seguir ao Senhor.
text_el: πλὴν Χαλεβ υἱὸς Ιεφοννη ὁ διακεχωρισμένος καὶ Ἰησοῦς ὁ τοῦ Ναυη ὅτι συνεπηκολούθησεν ὀπίσω κυρίου

text_en: And the Lord being angry against Israel , led them about through the desert forty years, until the whole generation , that had done evil in his sight, was consumed.
text_la: Iratusque Dominus adversum Israël, circumduxit eum per desertum quadraginta annis, donec consumeretur universa generatio, quæ fecerat malum in conspectu ejus.
text_pt: Assim se acendeu a ira do Senhor contra Israel, e fê-los andar errantes pelo deserto quarenta anos até que se consumiu toda aquela geração, que fizera mal aos olhos do Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ὠργίσθη θυμῷ κύριος ἐπὶ τὸν Ισραηλ καὶ κατερρόμβευσεν αὐτοὺς ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ τεσσαράκοντα ἔτη ἕως ἐξανηλώθη πᾶσα ἡ γενεὰ οἱ ποιοῦντες τὰ πονηρὰ ἔναντι κυρίου

text_en: And behold, said he, you are risen up instead of your fathers, the increase and offspring of sinful men , to augment the fury of the Lord against Israel .
text_la: Et ecce, inquit, vos surrexistis pro patribus vestris, incrementa et alumni hominum peccatorum, ut augeretis furorem Domini contra Israël.
text_pt: E eis que vós, uma geração de homens pecadores, vos levantastes em lugar de vossos pais, para ainda mais acrescentar o furor da ira do Senhor contra Israel.
text_el: ἰδοὺ ἀνέστητε ἀντὶ τῶν πατέρων ὑμῶν σύστρεμμα ἀνθρώπων ἁμαρτωλῶν προσθεῖναι ἔτι ἐπὶ τὸν θυμὸν τῆς ὀργῆς κυρίου ἐπὶ Ισραηλ

text_en: For if you will not follow him, he will leave the people in the wilderness , and you shall be the cause of the destruction of all.
text_la: Quod si nolueritis sequi eum, in solitudine populum derelinquet, et vos causa eritis necis omnium.
text_pt: Se vós vos virardes de segui-lo, também ele os deixará de novo no deserto, e destruireis a todo este povo.
text_el: ὅτι ἀποστραφήσεσθε ἀπ' αὐτοῦ προσθεῖναι ἔτι καταλιπεῖν αὐτὸν ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ καὶ ἀνομήσετε εἰς ὅλην τὴν συναγωγὴν ταύτην

text_en: But they coming near, said: We will make sheepfolds, and stalls for our cattle, and strong cities for our children:
text_la: At illi prope accedentes, dixerunt : Caulas ovium fabricabimus, et stabula jumentorum, parvulis quoque nostris urbes munitas:
text_pt: Então chegaram-se a ele, e disseram: Edificaremos currais aqui para o nosso gado, e cidades para as nossas crianças;
text_el: καὶ προσῆλθον αὐτῷ καὶ ἔλεγον ἐπαύλεις προβάτων οἰκοδομήσωμεν ὧδε τοῖς κτήνεσιν ἡμῶν καὶ πόλεις ταῖς ἀποσκευαῖς ἡμῶν

text_en: And we ourselves will go armed and ready for battle before the children of Israel , until we bring them in unto their places. Our little ones, and all we have, shall be in walled cities, for fear of the ambushes of the inhabitants.
text_la: nos autem ipsi armati et accincti pergemus ad prælium ante filios Israël, donec introducamus eos ad loca sua. Parvuli nostri, et quidquid habere possumus, erunt in urbibus muratis, propter habitatorum insidias.
text_pt: Porém nós nos armaremos, apressando-nos adiante dos de Israel, até que os levemos ao seu lugar; e ficarão as nossas crianças nas cidades fortes por causa dos moradores da terra.
text_el: καὶ ἡμεῖς ἐνοπλισάμενοι προφυλακὴ πρότεροι τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ ἕως ἂν ἀγάγωμεν αὐτοὺς εἰς τὸν ἑαυτῶν τόπον καὶ κατοικήσει ἡ ἀποσκευὴ ἡμῶν ἐν πόλεσιν τετειχισμέναις διὰ τοὺς κατοικοῦντας τὴν γῆν

text_en: We will not return into our houses until the children of Israel possess their inheritance:
text_la: Non revertemur in domos nostras, usque dum possideant filii Israël hæreditatem suam:
text_pt: Não voltaremos para nossas casas, até que os filhos de Israel estejam de posse, cada um, da sua herança.
text_el: οὐ μὴ ἀποστραφῶμεν εἰς τὰς οἰκίας ἡμῶν ἕως ἂν καταμερισθῶσιν οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ ἕκαστος εἰς τὴν κληρονομίαν αὐτοῦ

text_en: Neither will we seek anything beyond the Jordan , because we have already our possession on the east side thereof,
text_la: nec quidquam quæremus trans Jordanem, quia jam habemus nostram possessionem in orientali ejus plaga.
text_pt: Porque não herdaremos com eles além do Jordão, nem mais adiante; porquanto nós já temos a nossa herança aquém do Jordão, ao oriente.
text_el: καὶ οὐκέτι κληρονομήσωμεν ἐν αὐτοῖς ἀπὸ τοῦ πέραν τοῦ Ιορδάνου καὶ ἐπέκεινα ὅτι ἀπέχομεν τοὺς κλήρους ἡμῶν ἐν τῷ πέραν τοῦ Ιορδάνου ἐν ἀνατολαῖς

text_en: and Moses said to them: If you do what you promise, go on well appointed for war before the Lord :
text_la: Quibus Moyses ait : Si facitis quod promittitis, expediti pergite coram Domino ad pugnam:
text_pt: Então Moisés lhes disse: Se isto fizerdes assim, se vos armardes à guerra perante o Senhor;
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτοὺς Μωυσῆς ἐὰν ποιήσητε κατὰ τὸ ῥῆμα τοῦτο ἐὰν ἐξοπλίσησθε ἔναντι κυρίου εἰς πόλεμον

text_en: And let every fighting man pass over the Jordan , until the Lord overthrow his enemies:
text_la: et omnis vir bellator armatus Jordanem transeat, donec subvertat Dominus inimicos suos,
text_pt: E cada um de vós, armado, passar o Jordão perante o Senhor, até que haja lançado fora os seus inimigos de diante dele,
text_el: καὶ παρελεύσεται ὑμῶν πᾶς ὁπλίτης τὸν Ιορδάνην ἔναντι κυρίου ἕως ἂν ἐκτριβῇ ὁ ἐχθρὸς αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ προσώπου αὐτοῦ

text_en: And all the land be brought under him, then shall you be blameless before the Lord and before Israel , and you shall obtain the countries that you desire, before the Lord .
text_la: et subjiciatur ei omnis terra : tunc eritis inculpabiles apud Dominum et apud Israël, et obtinebitis regiones, quas vultis, coram Domino.
text_pt: E a terra esteja subjugada perante o Senhor; então voltareis e sereis inculpáveis perante o Senhor e perante Israel; e esta terra vos será por possessão perante o Senhor;
text_el: καὶ κατακυριευθῇ ἡ γῆ ἔναντι κυρίου καὶ μετὰ ταῦτα ἀποστραφήσεσθε καὶ ἔσεσθε ἀθῷοι ἔναντι κυρίου καὶ ἀπὸ Ισραηλ καὶ ἔσται ἡ γῆ αὕτη ὑμῖν ἐν κατασχέσει ἔναντι κυρίου

text_en: But if you do not what you say, no man can doubt but you sin against God : and know that your sin shall overtake you.
text_la: Sin autem quod dicitis, non feceritis, nulli dubium est quin peccetis in Deum : et scitote quoniam peccatum vestrum apprehendet vos.
text_pt: E se não fizerdes assim, eis que pecastes contra o Senhor; e sabei que o vosso pecado vos há de achar.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ μὴ ποιήσητε οὕτως ἁμαρτήσεσθε ἔναντι κυρίου καὶ γνώσεσθε τὴν ἁμαρτίαν ὑμῶν ὅταν ὑμᾶς καταλάβῃ τὰ κακά

text_en: Build therefore cities for your children, and folds and stalls for your sheep and beasts, and accomplish what you have promised.
text_la: Ædificate ergo urbes parvulis vestris, et caulas, et stabula ovibus ac jumentis : et quod polliciti estis, implete.
text_pt: Edificai cidades para as vossas crianças, e currais para as vossas ovelhas; e fazei o que saiu da vossa boca.
text_el: καὶ οἰκοδομήσετε ὑμῖν αὐτοῖς πόλεις τῇ ἀποσκευῇ ὑμῶν καὶ ἐπαύλεις τοῖς κτήνεσιν ὑμῶν καὶ τὸ ἐκπορευόμενον ἐκ τοῦ στόματος ὑμῶν ποιήσετε

text_en: And the children of Gad and Ruben said to Moses : We are your servants, we will do what my lord commands.
text_la: Dixeruntque filii Gad et Ruben ad Moysen : Servi tui sumus : faciemus quod jubet dominus noster.
text_pt: Então falaram os filhos de Gade, e os filhos de Rúben a Moisés, dizendo: Como ordena meu senhor, assim farão teus servos.
text_el: καὶ εἶπαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ρουβην καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ Γαδ πρὸς Μωυσῆν λέγοντες οἱ παῖδές σου ποιήσουσιν καθὰ ὁ κύριος ἡμῶν ἐντέλλεται

text_en: We will leave our children, and our wives and sheep and cattle, in the cities of Galaad:
text_la: Parvulos nostros, et mulieres, et pecora, ac jumenta relinquemus in urbibus Galaad:
text_pt: As nossas crianças, as nossas mulheres, o nosso gado, e todos os nossos animais estarão aí nas cidades de Gileade.
text_el: ἡ ἀποσκευὴ ἡμῶν καὶ αἱ γυναῖκες ἡμῶν καὶ πάντα τὰ κτήνη ἡμῶν ἔσονται ἐν ταῖς πόλεσιν Γαλααδ

text_en: And we your servants all well appointed will march on to the war , as you, my lord, speak.
