text_la: nos autem famuli tui omnes expediti pergemus ad bellum, sicut tu, domine, loqueris.
text_pt: Mas os teus servos passarão, cada um armado para a guerra, a pelejar perante o SENHOR, como tem falado o meu senhor.
text_el: οἱ δὲ παῖδές σου παρελεύσονται πάντες ἐνωπλισμένοι καὶ ἐκτεταγμένοι ἔναντι κυρίου εἰς τὸν πόλεμον ὃν τρόπον ὁ κύριος λέγει

text_en: Moses therefore commanded Eleazar the priest , and Joshua the son of Nun , and the princes of the families of all the tribes of Israel , and said to them:
text_la: Præcepit ergo Moyses Eleazaro sacerdoti, et Josue filio Nun, et principibus familiarum per tribus Israël, et dixit ad eos:
text_pt: Então Moisés deu ordem acerca deles a Eleazar, o sacerdote, e a Josué filho de Num, e aos cabeças das casas dos pais das tribos dos filhos de Israel.
text_el: καὶ συνέστησεν αὐτοῖς Μωυσῆς Ελεαζαρ τὸν ἱερέα καὶ Ἰησοῦν υἱὸν Ναυη καὶ τοὺς ἄρχοντας πατριῶν τῶν φυλῶν Ισραηλ

text_en: If the children of Gad , and the children of Ruben pass with you over the Jordan , all armed for war before the Lord , and the land be made subject to you: give them Galaad in possession.
text_la: Si transierint filii Gad et filii Ruben vobiscum Jordanem omnes armati ad bellum coram Domino, et vobis fuerit terra subjecta, date eis Galaad in possessionem.
text_pt: E disse-lhes Moisés: Se os filhos de Gade e os filhos de Rúben passarem convosco o Jordão, armado cada um para a guerra, perante o Senhor, e a terra estiver subjugada diante de vós, em possessão lhes dareis a terra de Gileade.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτοὺς Μωυσῆς ἐὰν διαβῶσιν οἱ υἱοὶ Ρουβην καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ Γαδ μεθ' ὑμῶν τὸν Ιορδάνην πᾶς ἐνωπλισμένος εἰς πόλεμον ἔναντι κυρίου καὶ κατακυριεύσητε τῆς γῆς ἀπέναντι ὑμῶν καὶ δώσετε αὐτοῖς τὴν γῆν Γαλααδ ἐν κατασχέσει

text_en: But if they will not pass armed with you into the land of Chanaan , let them receive places to dwell in among you.
text_la: Sin autem noluerint transire armati vobiscum in terram Chanaan, inter vos habitandi accipiant loca.
text_pt: Porém, se não passarem armados convosco, terão possessões entre vós, na terra de Canaã.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ μὴ διαβῶσιν ἐνωπλισμένοι μεθ' ὑμῶν εἰς τὸν πόλεμον ἔναντι κυρίου καὶ διαβιβάσετε τὴν ἀποσκευὴν αὐτῶν καὶ τὰς γυναῖκας αὐτῶν καὶ τὰ κτήνη αὐτῶν πρότερα ὑμῶν εἰς γῆν Χανααν καὶ συγκατακληρονομηθήσονται ἐν ὑμῖν ἐν τῇ γῇ Χανααν

text_en: And the children of Gad , and the children of Ruben answered: As the Lord has spoken to his servants, so will we do:
text_la: Responderuntque filii Gad et filii Ruben : Sicut locutus est Dominus servis suis, ita faciemus:
text_pt: E responderam os filhos de Gade e os filhos de Rúben, dizendo: O que o Senhor falou a teus servos, isso faremos.
text_el: καὶ ἀπεκρίθησαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ρουβην καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ Γαδ λέγοντες ὅσα ὁ κύριος λέγει τοῖς θεράπουσιν αὐτοῦ οὕτως ποιήσομεν

text_en: We will go armed before the Lord into the land of Chanaan , and we confess that we have already received our possession beyond the Jordan .
text_la: ipsi armati pergemus coram Domino in terram Chanaan, et possessionem jam suscepisse nos confitemur trans Jordanem.
text_pt: Nós passaremos, armados, perante o Senhor, à terra de Canaã, e teremos a possessão de nossa herança aquém do Jordão.
text_el: ἡμεῖς διαβησόμεθα ἐνωπλισμένοι ἔναντι κυρίου εἰς γῆν Χανααν καὶ δώσετε τὴν κατάσχεσιν ἡμῖν ἐν τῷ πέραν τοῦ Ιορδάνου

text_en: Moses therefore gave to the children of Gad and of Ruben , and to the half tribe of Manasses the son of Joseph , the kingdom of Sehon king of the Amorrhites , and the kingdom of Og king of Basan, and their land and the cities thereof round about.
text_la: Dedit itaque Moyses filiis Gad et Ruben, et dimidiæ tribui Manasse filii Joseph, regnum Sehon regis Amorrhæi, et regnum Og regis Basan, et terram eorum cum urbibus suis per circuitum.
text_pt: Assim deu-lhes Moisés, aos filhos de Gade, e aos filhos de Rúben, e à meia tribo de Manassés, filho de José, o reino de Siom, rei dos amorreus, e o reino de Ogue, rei de Basã; a terra com as suas cidades nos seus termos, e as cidades ao seu redor.
text_el: καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς Μωυσῆς τοῖς υἱοῖς Γαδ καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς Ρουβην καὶ τῷ ἡμίσει φυλῆς Μανασση υἱῶν Ιωσηφ τὴν βασιλείαν Σηων βασιλέως Αμορραίων καὶ τὴν βασιλείαν Ωγ βασιλέως τῆς Βασαν τὴν γῆν καὶ τὰς πόλεις σὺν τοῖς ὁρίοις αὐτῆς πόλεις τῆς γῆς κύκλῳ

text_en: And the sons of Gad built Dibon , and Ataroth, and Aroer,
text_la: Igitur exstruxerunt filii Gad, Dibon, et Ataroth, et Aroër,
text_pt: E os filhos de Gade edificaram a Dibom, e Atarote, e Aroer;
text_el: καὶ ᾠκοδόμησαν οἱ υἱοὶ Γαδ τὴν Δαιβων καὶ τὴν Αταρωθ καὶ τὴν Αροηρ

text_en: and Etroth, and Sophan, and Jazer, and Jegbaa,
text_la: et Etroth, et Sophan, et Jazer, et Jegbaa,
text_pt: E Atarote-Sofã, e Jazer, e Jogbeá;
text_el: καὶ τὴν Σωφαρ καὶ τὴν Ιαζηρ καὶ ὕψωσαν αὐτὰς

text_en: and Bethnemra, and Betharan , fenced cities, and folds for their cattle.
text_la: et Bethnemra, et Betharan, urbes munitas, et caulas pecoribus suis.
text_pt: E Bete-Nimra, e Bete-Harã, cidades fortes; e currais de ovelhas.
text_el: καὶ τὴν Ναμβραν καὶ τὴν Βαιθαραν πόλεις ὀχυρὰς καὶ ἐπαύλεις προβάτων

text_en: But the children of Ruben built Hesebon , and Eleale, and Cariathaim,
text_la: Filii vero Ruben ædificaverunt Hesebon, et Eleale, et Cariathaim,
text_pt: E os filhos de Rúben edificaram a Hesbom, e Eleale, e Quiriataim;
text_el: καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ Ρουβην ᾠκοδόμησαν τὴν Εσεβων καὶ Ελεαλη καὶ Καριαθαιμ

text_en: and Nabo , and Baalmeon (their names being changed) and Sabama: giving names to the cities which they had built.
text_la: et Nabo, et Baalmeon versis nominibus, Sabama quoque : imponentes vocabula urbibus, quas exstruxerunt.
text_pt: E Nebo, e Baal-Meom, mudando-lhes o nome, e Sibma; e os nomes das cidades que edificaram chamaram por outros nomes.
text_el: καὶ τὴν Βεελμεων περικεκυκλωμένας καὶ τὴν Σεβαμα καὶ ἐπωνόμασαν κατὰ τὰ ὀνόματα αὐτῶν τὰ ὀνόματα τῶν πόλεων ἃς ᾠκοδόμησαν

text_en: Moreover the children of Machir, the son of Manasses , went into Galaad, and wasted it, cutting off the Amorrhites , the inhabitants thereof.
text_la: Porro filii Machir filii Manasse, perrexerunt in Galaad, et vastaverunt eam interfecto Amorrhæo habitatore ejus.
text_pt: E os filhos de Maquir, filho de Manassés, foram-se para Gileade, e a tomaram; e daquela possessão expulsaram os amorreus que estavam nela.
text_el: καὶ ἐπορεύθη υἱὸς Μαχιρ υἱοῦ Μανασση εἰς Γαλααδ καὶ ἔλαβεν αὐτὴν καὶ ἀπώλεσεν τὸν Αμορραῖον τὸν κατοικοῦντα ἐν αὐτῇ

text_en: And Moses gave the land of Galaad to Machir the son of Manasses , and he dwelt in it.
text_la: Dedit ergo Moyses terram Galaad Machir filio Manasse, qui habitavit in ea.
text_pt: Assim Moisés deu Gileade a Maquir, filho de Manassés, o qual habitou nela.
text_el: καὶ ἔδωκεν Μωυσῆς τὴν Γαλααδ τῷ Μαχιρ υἱῷ Μανασση καὶ κατῴκησεν ἐκεῖ

text_en: And Jair the son of Manasses went, and took the villages thereof, and he called them Havoth Jair, that is to say, the villages of Jair.
text_la: Jair autem filius Manasse abiit, et occupavit vicos ejus, quos appellavit Havoth Jair, id est, Villas Jair.
text_pt: E foi Jair, filho de Manassés, e tomou as suas aldeias; e chamou-as Havote-Jair.
text_el: καὶ Ιαϊρ ὁ τοῦ Μανασση ἐπορεύθη καὶ ἔλαβεν τὰς ἐπαύλεις αὐτῶν καὶ ἐπωνόμασεν αὐτὰς ἐπαύλεις Ιαϊρ

text_en: Nobe also went, and took Canath with the villages thereof: and he called it by his own name , Nobe.
text_la: Nobe quoque perrexit, et apprehendit Chanath cum viculis suis : vocavitque eam ex nomine suo Nobe.
text_pt: E foi Nobá, e tomou a Quenate com as suas aldeias; e chamou-a Nobá, segundo o seu próprio nome.
text_el: καὶ Ναβαυ ἐπορεύθη καὶ ἔλαβεν τὴν Κανααθ καὶ τὰς κώμας αὐτῆς καὶ ἐπωνόμασεν αὐτὰς Ναβωθ ἐκ τοῦ ὀνόματος αὐτοῦ

text_en: These are the mansions of the children of Israel , who went out of Egypt by their troops under the conduct of Moses and Aaron ,
text_la: Hæ sunt mansiones filiorum Israël, qui egressi sunt de Ægypto per turmas suas in manu Moysi et Aaron,
text_pt: Estas são as jornadas dos filhos de Israel, que saíram da terra do Egito, segundo os seus exércitos, sob a direção de Moisés e Arão.
text_el: καὶ οὗτοι σταθμοὶ τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ ὡς ἐξῆλθον ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου σὺν δυνάμει αὐτῶν ἐν χειρὶ Μωυσῆ καὶ Ααρων

text_en: which Moses wrote down according to the places of their encamping, which they changed by the commandment of the Lord .
text_la: quas descripsit Moyses juxta castrorum loca, quæ Domini jussione mutabant.
text_pt: E escreveu Moisés as suas saídas, segundo as suas jornadas, conforme ao mandado do Senhor; e estas são as suas jornadas, segundo as suas saídas.
text_el: καὶ ἔγραψεν Μωυσῆς τὰς ἀπάρσεις αὐτῶν καὶ τοὺς σταθμοὺς αὐτῶν διὰ ῥήματος κυρίου καὶ οὗτοι σταθμοὶ τῆς πορείας αὐτῶν

text_en: Now the children of Israel departed from Ramesses the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month, the day after the phase , with a mighty hand, in the sight of all the Egyptians ,
text_la: Profecti igitur de Ramesse mense primo, quintadecima die mensis primi, altera die Phase, filii Israël in manu excelsa, videntibus cunctis Ægyptiis,
text_pt: Partiram, pois, de Ramessés no primeiro mês, no dia quinze do primeiro mês; no dia seguinte da páscoa saíram os filhos de Israel por alta mão, aos olhos de todos os egípcios,
text_el: ἀπῆραν ἐκ Ραμεσση τῷ μηνὶ τῷ πρώτῳ τῇ πεντεκαιδεκάτῃ ἡμέρᾳ τοῦ μηνὸς τοῦ πρώτου τῇ ἐπαύριον τοῦ πασχα ἐξῆλθον οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ ἐν χειρὶ ὑψηλῇ ἐναντίον πάντων τῶν Αἰγυπτίων

text_en: who were burying their firstborn , whom the Lord had slain (upon their gods also he had executed vengeance),
text_la: et sepelientibus primogenitos, quos percusserat Dominus (nam et in diis eorum exercuerat ultionem),
text_pt: Enquanto os egípcios enterravam os que o Senhor tinha ferido entre eles, a todo o primogênito, e havendo o Senhor executado juízos também contra os seus deuses.
text_el: καὶ οἱ Αἰγύπτιοι ἔθαπτον ἐξ αὑτῶν τοὺς τεθνηκότας πάντας οὓς ἐπάταξεν κύριος πᾶν πρωτότοκον ἐν γῇ Αἰγύπτῳ καὶ ἐν τοῖς θεοῖς αὐτῶν ἐποίησεν τὴν ἐκδίκησιν κύριος

text_en: and they camped in Soccoth.
text_la: castrametati sunt in Soccoth.
text_pt: Partiram, pois, os filhos de Israel de Ramessés, e acamparam-se em Sucote.
text_el: καὶ ἀπάραντες οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ ἐκ Ραμεσση παρενέβαλον εἰς Σοκχωθ

text_en: And from Soccoth they came into Etham, which is in the uttermost borders of the wilderness .
text_la: Et de Soccoth venerunt in Etham, quæ est in extremis finibus solitudinis.
text_pt: E partiram de Sucote, e acamparam-se em Etã, que está no fim do deserto.
text_el: καὶ ἀπῆραν ἐκ Σοκχωθ καὶ παρενέβαλον εἰς Βουθαν ὅ ἐστιν μέρος τι τῆς ἐρήμου

text_en: Departing from thence they came over against Phihahiroth, which looks towards Beelsephon, and they camped before Magdalum.
text_la: Inde egressi venerunt contra Phihahiroth, quæ respicit Beelsephon, et castrametati sunt ante Magdalum.
text_pt: E partiram de Etã, e voltaram a Pi-Hairote, que está defronte de Baal-Zefom, e acamparam-se diante de Migdol.
text_el: καὶ ἀπῆραν ἐκ Βουθαν καὶ παρενέβαλον ἐπὶ στόμα Εϊρωθ ὅ ἐστιν ἀπέναντι Βεελσεπφων καὶ παρενέβαλον ἀπέναντι Μαγδώλου

text_en: And departing from Phihahiroth, they passed through the midst of the sea into the wilderness : and having marched three days through the desert of Etham, they camped in Mara.
text_la: Profectique de Phihahiroth, transierunt per medium mare in solitudinem : et ambulantes tribus diebus per desertum Etham, castrametati sunt in Mara.
text_pt: E partiram de Pi-Hairote, e passaram pelo meio do mar ao deserto, e andaram caminho de três dias no deserto de Etã, e acamparam-se em Mara.
text_el: καὶ ἀπῆραν ἀπέναντι Εϊρωθ καὶ διέβησαν μέσον τῆς θαλάσσης εἰς τὴν ἔρημον καὶ ἐπορεύθησαν ὁδὸν τριῶν ἡμερῶν διὰ τῆς ἐρήμου αὐτοὶ καὶ παρενέβαλον ἐν Πικρίαις

text_en: And departing from Mara, they came into Elim, where there were twelve fountains of waters, and seventy palm trees: and there they camped.
text_la: Profectique de Mara, venerunt in Elim, ubi erant duodecim fontes aquarum, et palmæ septuaginta : ibique castrametati sunt.
text_pt: E partiram de Mara, e vieram a Elim, e em Elim havia doze fontes de águas e setenta palmeiras, e acamparam-se ali.
text_el: καὶ ἀπῆραν ἐκ Πικριῶν καὶ ἦλθον εἰς Αιλιμ καὶ ἐν Αιλιμ δώδεκα πηγαὶ ὑδάτων καὶ ἑβδομήκοντα στελέχη φοινίκων καὶ παρενέβαλον ἐκεῖ παρὰ τὸ ὕδωρ

text_en: But departing from thence also, they pitched their tents by the Red Sea . And departing from the Red Sea ,
text_la: Sed et inde egressi, fixerunt tentoria super mare Rubrum. Profectique de mari Rubro,
text_pt: E partiram de Elim, e acamparam-se junto ao Mar Vermelho.
text_el: καὶ ἀπῆραν ἐξ Αιλιμ καὶ παρενέβαλον ἐπὶ θάλασσαν ἐρυθράν

text_en: they camped in the desert of Sin.
text_la: castrametati sunt in deserto Sin.
text_pt: E partiram do Mar Vermelho, e acamparam-se no deserto de Sim.
text_el: καὶ ἀπῆραν ἀπὸ θαλάσσης ἐρυθρᾶς καὶ παρενέβαλον εἰς τὴν ἔρημον Σιν

text_en: And they removed from thence, and came to Daphca.
text_la: Unde egressi, venerunt in Daphca.
text_pt: E partiram do deserto de Sim, e acamparam-se em Dofca.
text_el: καὶ ἀπῆραν ἐκ τῆς ἐρήμου Σιν καὶ παρενέβαλον εἰς Ραφακα

text_en: And departing from Daphca, they camped in Alus.
text_la: Profectique de Daphca, castrametati sunt in Alus.
text_pt: E partiram de Dofca, e acamparam-se em Alus.
text_el: καὶ ἀπῆραν ἐκ Ραφακα καὶ παρενέβαλον ἐν Αιλους

text_en: And departing from Alus, they pitched their tents in Raphidim, where the people wanted water to drink.
text_la: Egressique de Alus, in Raphidim fixere tentoria, ubi populo defuit aqua ad bibendum.
text_pt: E partiram de Alus, e acamparam-se em Refidim; porém não havia ali água, para que o povo bebesse.
text_el: καὶ ἀπῆραν ἐξ Αιλους καὶ παρενέβαλον ἐν Ραφιδιν καὶ οὐκ ἦν ὕδωρ τῷ λαῷ πιεῖν ἐκεῖ

text_en: And departing from Raphidim, they camped in the desert of Sinai .
text_la: Profectique de Raphidim, castrametati sunt in deserto Sinai.
text_pt: Partiram, pois, de Refidim, e acamparam-se no deserto de Sinai.
text_el: καὶ ἀπῆραν ἐκ Ραφιδιν καὶ παρενέβαλον ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ Σινα

text_en: But departing also from the desert of Sinai , they came to the graves of lust .
text_la: Sed et de solitudine Sinai egressi, venerunt ad sepulchra concupiscentiæ.
text_pt: E partiram do deserto de Sinai, e acamparam-se em Quibrote-Taavá.
text_el: καὶ ἀπῆραν ἐκ τῆς ἐρήμου Σινα καὶ παρενέβαλον ἐν Μνήμασιν τῆς ἐπιθυμίας

text_en: And departing from the graves of lust , they camped in Haseroth.
text_la: Profectique de sepulchris concupiscentiæ, castrametati sunt in Haseroth.
text_pt: E partiram de Quibrote-Taavá, e acamparam-se em Hazerote.
text_el: καὶ ἀπῆραν ἐκ Μνημάτων ἐπιθυμίας καὶ παρενέβαλον ἐν Ασηρωθ

text_en: And from Haseroth they came to Rethma.
text_la: Et de Haseroth venerunt in Rethma.
text_pt: E partiram de Hazerote, e acamparam-se em Ritmá.
text_el: καὶ ἀπῆραν ἐξ Ασηρωθ καὶ παρενέβαλον ἐν Ραθαμα

text_en: And departing from Rethma, they camped in Remmomphares.
text_la: Profectique de Rethma, castrametati sunt in Remmomphares.
text_pt: E partiram de Ritmá, e acamparam-se em Rimom-Perez.
text_el: καὶ ἀπῆραν ἐκ Ραθαμα καὶ παρενέβαλον ἐν Ρεμμων Φαρες

text_en: And they departed from thence and came to Lebna.
text_la: Unde egressi venerunt in Lebna.
text_pt: E partiram de Rimom-Perez, e acamparam-se em Libna.
text_el: καὶ ἀπῆραν ἐκ Ρεμμων Φαρες καὶ παρενέβαλον ἐν Λεμωνα

text_en: Removing from Lebna they camped in Ressa.
text_la: De Lebna castrametati sunt in Ressa.
text_pt: E partiram de Libna, e acamparam-se em Rissa.
text_el: καὶ ἀπῆραν ἐκ Λεμωνα καὶ παρενέβαλον εἰς Δεσσα

text_en: And departing from Ressa, they came to Ceelatha.
text_la: Egressique de Ressa, venerunt in Ceelatha.
text_pt: E partiram de Rissa, e acamparam-se em Queelata.
text_el: καὶ ἀπῆραν ἐκ Δεσσα καὶ παρενέβαλον εἰς Μακελλαθ

text_en: And they removed from thence and camped in the mountain Sepher.
text_la: Unde profecti, castrametati sunt in monte Sepher.
text_pt: E partiram de Queelata, e acamparam-se no monte de Séfer.
text_el: καὶ ἀπῆραν ἐκ Μακελλαθ καὶ παρενέβαλον εἰς Σαφαρ

text_en: Departing from the mountain Sepher, they came to Arada,
text_la: Egressi de monte Sepher, venerunt in Arada.
text_pt: E partiram do monte de Séfer, e acamparam-se em Harada.
text_el: καὶ ἀπῆραν ἐκ Σαφαρ καὶ παρενέβαλον εἰς Χαραδαθ

text_en: from thence they went and camped in Maceloth.
text_la: Inde proficiscentes, castrametati sunt in Maceloth.
text_pt: E partiram de Harada, e acamparam-se em Maquelote.
text_el: καὶ ἀπῆραν ἐκ Χαραδαθ καὶ παρενέβαλον εἰς Μακηλωθ

text_en: And departing from Maceloth, they came to Thahath.
text_la: Profectique de Maceloth, venerunt in Thahath.
text_pt: E partiram de Maquelote, e acamparam-se em Taate.
text_el: καὶ ἀπῆραν ἐκ Μακηλωθ καὶ παρενέβαλον εἰς Κατααθ

text_en: Removing from Thahath they camped in Thare.
text_la: De Thahath, castrametati sunt in Thare.
text_pt: E partiram de Taate, e acamparam-se em Tara.
text_el: καὶ ἀπῆραν ἐκ Κατααθ καὶ παρενέβαλον εἰς Ταραθ

text_en: And they departed from thence, and pitched their tents in Methca.
text_la: Unde egressi, fixere tentoria in Methca.
text_pt: E partiram de Tara, e acamparam-se em Mitca.
text_el: καὶ ἀπῆραν ἐκ Ταραθ καὶ παρενέβαλον εἰς Ματεκκα

text_en: And removing from Methca, they camped in Hesmona.
text_la: Et de Methca, castrametati sunt in Hesmona.
text_pt: E partiram de Mitca, e acamparam-se em Hasmona.
text_el: καὶ ἀπῆραν ἐκ Ματεκκα καὶ παρενέβαλον εἰς Σελμωνα

text_en: And departing from Hesmona, they came to Moseroth.
text_la: Profectique de Hesmona, venerunt in Moseroth.
text_pt: E partiram de Hasmona, e acamparam-se em Moserote.
text_el: καὶ ἀπῆραν ἐκ Σελμωνα καὶ παρενέβαλον εἰς Μασσουρουθ

text_en: And removing from Moseroth, they camped in Benejaacan.
text_la: Et de Moseroth, castrametati sunt in Benejaacan.
text_pt: E partiram de Moserote, e acamparam-se em Bene-Jaacã.
text_el: καὶ ἀπῆραν ἐκ Μασσουρουθ καὶ παρενέβαλον εἰς Βαναια

text_en: And departing from Benejaacan, they came to mount Gadgad.
text_la: Profectique de Benejaacan, venerunt in montem Gadgad.
text_pt: E partiram de Bene-Jaacã, e acamparam-se em Hor-Hagidgade.
text_el: καὶ ἀπῆραν ἐκ Βαναια καὶ παρενέβαλον εἰς τὸ ὄρος Γαδγαδ

text_en: From thence they went and camped in Jetebatha.
text_la: Unde profecti, castrametati sunt in Jetebatha.
text_pt: E partiram de Hor-Hagidgade, e acamparam-se em Jotbatá.
text_el: καὶ ἀπῆραν ἐκ τοῦ ὄρους Γαδγαδ καὶ παρενέβαλον εἰς Ετεβαθα

text_en: And from Jetebatha they came to Hebrona.
text_la: Et de Jetebatha venerunt in Hebrona.
text_pt: E partiram de Jotbatá, e acamparam-se em Abrona.
text_el: καὶ ἀπῆραν ἐξ Ετεβαθα καὶ παρενέβαλον εἰς Εβρωνα

text_en: And departing from Hebrona, they camped in Asiongaber .
text_la: Egressique de Hebrona, castrametati sunt in Asiongaber.
text_pt: E partiram de Abrona, e acamparam-se em Ezion-Geber.
text_el: καὶ ἀπῆραν ἐξ Εβρωνα καὶ παρενέβαλον εἰς Γεσιωνγαβερ

text_en: They removed from thence and came into the desert of Sin, which is Cades .
text_la: Inde profecti, venerunt in desertum Sin, hæc est Cades.
text_pt: E partiram de Ezion-Geber, e acamparam-se no deserto de Zim, que é Cades.
text_el: καὶ ἀπῆραν ἐκ Γεσιωνγαβερ καὶ παρενέβαλον ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ Σιν καὶ ἀπῆραν ἐκ τῆς ἐρήμου Σιν καὶ παρενέβαλον εἰς τὴν ἔρημον Φαραν αὕτη ἐστὶν Καδης

text_en: And departing from Cades , they camped in mount Hor, in the uttermost borders of the land of Edom .
text_la: Egressique de Cades, castrametati sunt in monte Hor, in extremis finibus terræ Edom.
text_pt: E partiram de Cades, e acamparam-se no monte Hor, no fim da terra de Edom.
text_el: καὶ ἀπῆραν ἐκ Καδης καὶ παρενέβαλον εἰς Ωρ τὸ ὄρος πλησίον γῆς Εδωμ

text_en: And Aaron the priest went up into mount Hor at the commandment of the Lord : and there he died in the fortieth year of the coming forth of the children of Israel out of Egypt , the fifth month, the first day of the month,
text_la: Ascenditque Aaron sacerdos in montem Hor jubente Domino : et ibi mortuus est anno quadragesimo egressionis filiorum Israël ex Ægypto, mense quinto, prima die mensis,
text_pt: Então Arão, o sacerdote, subiu ao monte Hor, conforme ao mandado do Senhor; e morreu ali no quinto mês do ano quadragésimo da saída dos filhos de Israel da terra do Egito, no primeiro dia do mês.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέβη Ααρων ὁ ἱερεὺς διὰ προστάγματος κυρίου καὶ ἀπέθανεν ἐκεῖ ἐν τῷ τεσσαρακοστῷ ἔτει τῆς ἐξόδου τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου τῷ μηνὶ τῷ πέμπτῳ μιᾷ τοῦ μηνός

text_en: when he was a hundred and twenty-three years old.
text_la: cum esset annorum centum viginti trium.
text_pt: E era Arão da idade de cento e vinte e três anos, quando morreu no monte Hor.
text_el: καὶ Ααρων ἦν τριῶν καὶ εἴκοσι καὶ ἑκατὸν ἐτῶν ὅτε ἀπέθνῃσκεν ἐν Ωρ τῷ ὄρει

text_en: And King Arad the Chanaanite , who dwelt towards the south, heard that the children of Israel had come to the land of Chanaan .
text_la: Audivitque Chananæus rex Arad, qui habitabat ad meridiem, in terram Chanaan venisse filios Israël.
text_pt: E ouviu o cananeu, rei de Harade, que habitava o sul na terra de Canaã, que chegavam os filhos de Israel.
text_el: καὶ ἀκούσας ὁ Χανανις βασιλεὺς Αραδ καὶ οὗτος κατῴκει ἐν γῇ Χανααν ὅτε εἰσεπορεύοντο οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ

text_en: And they departed from mount Hor, and camped in Salmona.
text_la: Et profecti de monte Hor, castrametati sunt in Salmona.
text_pt: E partiram do monte Hor, e acamparam-se em Zalmona.
text_el: καὶ ἀπῆραν ἐξ Ωρ τοῦ ὄρους καὶ παρενέβαλον εἰς Σελμωνα

text_en: From whence they removed and came to Phunon.
text_la: Unde egressi, venerunt in Phunon.
text_pt: E partiram de Zalmona, e acamparam-se em Punom.
text_el: καὶ ἀπῆραν ἐκ Σελμωνα καὶ παρενέβαλον εἰς Φινω

text_en: And departing from Phunon, they camped in Oboth.
text_la: Profectique de Phunon, castrametati sunt in Oboth.
text_pt: E partiram de Punom, e acamparam-se em Obote.
text_el: καὶ ἀπῆραν ἐκ Φινω καὶ παρενέβαλον εἰς Ωβωθ

text_en: And from Oboth they came to Ijeabarim, which is in the borders of the Moabites .
text_la: Et de Oboth venerunt in Ijeabarim, quæ est in finibus Moabitarum.
text_pt: E partiram de Obote, e acamparam-se em Ije-Abarim, no termo de Moabe.
text_el: καὶ ἀπῆραν ἐξ Ωβωθ καὶ παρενέβαλον ἐν Γαι ἐν τῷ πέραν ἐπὶ τῶν ὁρίων Μωαβ

text_en: And departing from Ijeabarim they pitched their tents in Dibongab.
text_la: Profectique de Ijeabarim, fixere tentoria in Dibongad.
text_pt: E partiram de Ije-Abarim, e acamparam-se em Dibom-Gade.
text_el: καὶ ἀπῆραν ἐκ Γαι καὶ παρενέβαλον εἰς Δαιβων Γαδ

text_en: From thence they went and camped in Helmondeblathaim.
text_la: Unde egressi, castrametati sunt in Helmondeblathaim.
text_pt: E partiram de Dibom-Gade, e acamparam-se em Almom-Diblataim.
text_el: καὶ ἀπῆραν ἐκ Δαιβων Γαδ καὶ παρενέβαλον ἐν Γελμων Δεβλαθαιμ

text_en: And departing from Helmondeblathaim, they came to the mountains of Abarim over against Nabo .
text_la: Egressique de Helmondeblathaim, venerunt ad montes Abarim contra Nabo.
text_pt: E partiram de Almom-Diblataim, e acamparam-se nos montes de Abarim, defronte de Nebo.
text_el: καὶ ἀπῆραν ἐκ Γελμων Δεβλαθαιμ καὶ παρενέβαλον ἐπὶ τὰ ὄρη τὰ Αβαριμ ἀπέναντι Ναβαυ

text_en: And departing from the mountains of Abarim , they passed to the plains of Moab , by the Jordan , over against Jericho .
text_la: Profectique de montibus Abarim, transierunt ad campestria Moab, supra Jordanem, contra Jericho.
text_pt: E partiram dos montes de Abarim, e acamparam-se nas campinas de Moabe, junto ao Jordão, na direção de Jericó.
text_el: καὶ ἀπῆραν ἀπὸ ὀρέων Αβαριμ καὶ παρενέβαλον ἐπὶ δυσμῶν Μωαβ ἐπὶ τοῦ Ιορδάνου κατὰ Ιεριχω

text_en: And there they camped from Bethsimoth even to Ablesatim in the plains of the Moabites ,
text_la: Ibique castrametati sunt de Bethsimoth usque ad Abelsatim in planioribus locis Moabitarum.
text_pt: E acamparam-se junto ao Jordão, desde Bete-Jesimote até Abel-Sitim, nas campinas de Moabe.
text_el: καὶ παρενέβαλον παρὰ τὸν Ιορδάνην ἀνὰ μέσον Αισιμωθ ἕως Βελσαττιμ κατὰ δυσμὰς Μωαβ

text_en: where the Lord said to Moses :
text_la: Ubi locutus est Dominus ad Moysen:
text_pt: E falou o Senhor a Moisés, nas campinas de Moabe junto ao Jordão na direção de Jericó, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν ἐπὶ δυσμῶν Μωαβ παρὰ τὸν Ιορδάνην κατὰ Ιεριχω λέγων

text_en: Command the children of Israel , and say to them: When you shall have passed over the Jordan , entering into the land of Chanaan ,
text_la: Præcipe filiis Israël, et dic ad eos : Quando transieritis Jordanem, intrantes terram Chanaan,
text_pt: Fala aos filhos de Israel, e dize-lhes: Quando houverdes passado o Jordão para a terra de Canaã,
text_el: λάλησον τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ καὶ ἐρεῖς πρὸς αὐτούς ὑμεῖς διαβαίνετε τὸν Ιορδάνην εἰς γῆν Χανααν

text_en: destroy all the inhabitants of that land: Beat down their pillars, and break in pieces their statues , and waste all their high places,
text_la: disperdite cunctos habitatores terræ illius : confringite titulos, et statuas comminuite, atque omnia excelsa vastate,
text_pt: Lançareis fora todos os moradores da terra de diante de vós, e destruireis todas as suas pinturas; também destruireis todas as suas imagens de fundição, e desfareis todos os seus altos;
text_el: καὶ ἀπολεῖτε πάντας τοὺς κατοικοῦντας ἐν τῇ γῇ πρὸ προσώπου ὑμῶν καὶ ἐξαρεῖτε τὰς σκοπιὰς αὐτῶν καὶ πάντα τὰ εἴδωλα τὰ χωνευτὰ αὐτῶν ἀπολεῖτε αὐτὰ καὶ πάσας τὰς στήλας αὐτῶν ἐξαρεῖτε

text_en: cleansing the land, and dwelling in it. For I have given it you for a possession.
text_la: mundantes terram, et habitantes in ea. Ego enim dedi vobis illam in possessionem,
text_pt: E tomareis a terra em possessão, e nela habitareis; porquanto vos tenho dado esta terra, para possuí-la.
text_el: καὶ ἀπολεῖτε πάντας τοὺς κατοικοῦντας τὴν γῆν καὶ κατοικήσετε ἐν αὐτῇ ὑμῖν γὰρ δέδωκα τὴν γῆν αὐτῶν ἐν κλήρῳ

text_en: And you shall divide it among you by lot. To the more you shall give a larger part, and to the fewer a lesser. To every one as the lot shall fall, so shall the inheritance be given. The possession shall be divided by the tribes and the families .
text_la: quam dividetis vobis sorte. Pluribus dabitis latiorem, et paucis angustiorem. Singulis ut sors ceciderit, ita tribuetur hæreditas. Per tribus et familias possessio dividetur.
text_pt: E por sortes herdareis a terra, segundo as vossas famílias; aos muitos multiplicareis a herança, e aos poucos diminuireis a herança; conforme a sorte sair a alguém, ali a possuirá; segundo as tribos de vossos pais recebereis as heranças.
text_el: καὶ κατακληρονομήσετε τὴν γῆν αὐτῶν ἐν κλήρῳ κατὰ φυλὰς ὑμῶν τοῖς πλείοσιν πληθυνεῖτε τὴν κατάσχεσιν αὐτῶν καὶ τοῖς ἐλάττοσιν ἐλαττώσετε τὴν κατάσχεσιν αὐτῶν εἰς ὃ ἐὰν ἐξέλθῃ τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ ἐκεῖ αὐτοῦ ἔσται κατὰ φυλὰς πατριῶν ὑμῶν κληρονομήσετε

text_en: But if you will not kill the inhabitants of the land: they that remain, shall be unto you as nails in your eyes, and spears in your sides, and they shall be your adversaries in the land of your habitation.
text_la: Sin autem nolueritis interficere habitatores terræ : qui remanserint, erunt vobis quasi clavi in oculis, et lanceæ in lateribus, et adversabuntur vobis in terra habitationis vestræ:
text_pt: Mas se não lançardes fora os moradores da terra de diante de vós, então os que deixardes ficar vos serão por espinhos nos vossos olhos, e por aguilhões nas vossas virilhas, e apertar-vos-ão na terra em que habitardes,
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ μὴ ἀπολέσητε τοὺς κατοικοῦντας ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ἀπὸ προσώπου ὑμῶν καὶ ἔσται οὓς ἐὰν καταλίπητε ἐξ αὐτῶν σκόλοπες ἐν τοῖς ὀφθαλμοῖς ὑμῶν καὶ βολίδες ἐν ταῖς πλευραῖς ὑμῶν καὶ ἐχθρεύσουσιν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ἐφ' ἣν ὑμεῖς κατοικήσετε

text_en: And whatsoever I had thought to do to them, I will do to you.
text_la: et quidquid illis cogitaveram facere, vobis faciam.
text_pt: E será que farei a vós como pensei fazer-lhes a eles.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται καθότι διεγνώκειν ποιῆσαι αὐτούς ποιήσω ὑμῖν

text_en: And the Lord spoke to Moses , saying:
text_la: Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen, dicens:
text_pt: Falou mais o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν λέγων

text_en: Command the children of Israel , and you shall say to them: When you are entered into the land of Chanaan , and it shall be fallen into your possession by lot, it shall be bounded by these limits:
text_la: Præcipe filiis Israël, et dices ad eos : Cum ingressi fueritis terram Chanaan, et in possessionem vobis sorte ceciderit, his finibus terminabitur.
text_pt: Dá ordem aos filhos de Israel, e dize-lhes: Quando entrardes na terra de Canaã, esta há de ser a terra que vos cairá em herança; a terra de Canaã, segundo os seus termos.
text_el: ἔντειλαι τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ καὶ ἐρεῖς πρὸς αὐτούς ὑμεῖς εἰσπορεύεσθε εἰς τὴν γῆν Χανααν αὕτη ἔσται ὑμῖν εἰς κληρονομίαν γῆ Χανααν σὺν τοῖς ὁρίοις αὐτῆς

text_en: The south side shall begin from the wilderness of Sin, which is by Edom : and shall have the most salt sea for its furthest limits eastward:
text_la: Pars meridiana incipiet a solitudine Sin, quæ est juxta Edom : et habebit terminos contra orientem mare salsissimum.
text_pt: O lado do sul vos será desde o deserto de Zim até aos termos de Edom; e o termo do sul vos será desde a extremidade do Mar Salgado para o lado do oriente.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ὑμῖν τὸ κλίτος τὸ πρὸς λίβα ἀπὸ ἐρήμου Σιν ἕως ἐχόμενον Εδωμ καὶ ἔσται ὑμῖν τὰ ὅρια πρὸς λίβα ἀπὸ μέρους τῆς θαλάσσης τῆς ἁλυκῆς ἀπὸ ἀνατολῶν

text_en: Which limits shall go round on the south side by the ascent of the Scorpion and so into Senna, and reach toward the south as far as Cadesbarne , from whence the frontiers shall go out to the town called Adar , and shall reach as far as Asemona.
text_la: Qui circuibunt australem plagam per ascensum Scorpionis, ita ut transeant in Senna, et perveniant a meridie usque ad Cadesbarne, unde egredientur confinia ad villam nomine Adar, et tendent usque ad Asemona.
text_pt: E este limite vos irá rodeando do sul para a subida de Acrabim, e passará até Zim; e as suas saídas serão do sul a Cades-Barnéia; e sairá a Hazar-Adar, e passará a Azmom;
text_el: καὶ κυκλώσει ὑμᾶς τὰ ὅρια ἀπὸ λιβὸς πρὸς ἀνάβασιν Ακραβιν καὶ παρελεύσεται Σεννα καὶ ἔσται ἡ διέξοδος αὐτοῦ πρὸς λίβα Καδης τοῦ Βαρνη καὶ ἐξελεύσεται εἰς ἔπαυλιν Αραδ καὶ παρελεύσεται Ασεμωνα

text_en: And the limits shall fetch a compass from Asemona to the torrent of Egypt , and shall end in the shore of the great sea.
text_la: Ibitque per gyrum terminus ab Asemona usque ad torrentem Ægypti, et maris magni littore finietur.
text_pt: Rodeará mais este limite de Azmom até ao rio do Egito; e as suas saídas serão para o lado do mar.
text_el: καὶ κυκλώσει τὰ ὅρια ἀπὸ Ασεμωνα χειμάρρουν Αἰγύπτου καὶ ἔσται ἡ διέξοδος ἡ θάλασσα

text_en: And the west side shall begin from the great sea, and the same shall be the end thereof.
text_la: Plaga autem occidentalis a mari magno incipiet, et ipso fine claudetur.
text_pt: Quanto ao limite do ocidente, o Mar Grande vos será por limite; este vos será o limite do ocidente.
text_el: καὶ τὰ ὅρια τῆς θαλάσσης ἔσται ὑμῖν ἡ θάλασσα ἡ μεγάλη ὁριεῖ τοῦτο ἔσται ὑμῖν τὰ ὅρια τῆς θαλάσσης

text_en: But toward the north side the borders shall begin from the great sea, reaching to the most high mountain,
text_la: Porro ad septentrionalem plagam a mari magno termini incipient, pervenientes usque ad montem altissimum,
text_pt: E este vos será o termo do norte: desde o Mar Grande marcareis até ao monte Hor.
text_el: καὶ τοῦτο ἔσται τὰ ὅρια ὑμῖν πρὸς βορρᾶν ἀπὸ τῆς θαλάσσης τῆς μεγάλης καταμετρήσετε ὑμῖν αὐτοῖς παρὰ τὸ ὄρος τὸ ὄρος

text_en: from which they shall come to Emath, as far as the borders of Sedada:
text_la: a quo venient in Emath usque ad terminos Sedada:
text_pt: Desde o monte Hor marcareis até à entrada de Hamate; e as saídas deste termo serão até Zedade.
text_el: καὶ ἀπὸ τοῦ ὄρους τὸ ὄρος καταμετρήσετε αὐτοῖς εἰσπορευομένων εἰς Εμαθ καὶ ἔσται ἡ διέξοδος αὐτοῦ τὰ ὅρια Σαραδα

text_en: And the limits shall go as far as Zephrona, and the village of Enan. These shall be the borders on the north side.
text_la: ibuntque confinia usque ad Zephrona, et villam Enan. Hi erunt termini in parte aquilonis.
text_pt: E este limite seguirá até Zifrom, e as suas saídas serão em Hazar-Enã; este vos será o termo do norte.
text_el: καὶ ἐξελεύσεται τὰ ὅρια Δεφρωνα καὶ ἔσται ἡ διέξοδος αὐτοῦ Ασερναιν τοῦτο ἔσται ὑμῖν ὅρια ἀπὸ βορρᾶ

text_en: From thence they shall mark out the grounds towards the east side from the village of Enan unto Sephama.
text_la: Inde metabuntur fines contra orientalem plagam de villa Enan usque Sephama,
text_pt: E por limite do lado do oriente marcareis de Hazar-Enã até Sefã.
text_el: καὶ καταμετρήσετε ὑμῖν αὐτοῖς τὰ ὅρια ἀνατολῶν ἀπὸ Ασερναιν Σεπφαμα

text_en: And from Sephama the bounds shall go down to Rebla over against the fountain of Daphnis: from thence they shall come eastward to the sea of Cenereth ,
text_la: et de Sephama descendent termini in Rebla contra fontem Daphnim : inde pervenient contra orientem ad mare Cenereth,
text_pt: E este limite descerá desde Sefã até Ribla, para o lado do oriente de Aim; depois descerá este termo, e irá ao longo da borda do mar de Quinerete para o lado do oriente.
text_el: καὶ καταβήσεται τὰ ὅρια ἀπὸ Σεπφαμ Αρβηλα ἀπὸ ἀνατολῶν ἐπὶ πηγάς καὶ καταβήσεται τὰ ὅρια Βηλα ἐπὶ νώτου θαλάσσης Χεναρα ἀπὸ ἀνατολῶν

text_en: and shall reach as far as the Jordan , and at the last shall be closed in by the most salt sea . This shall be your land with its borders round about.
text_la: et tendent usque ad Jordanem, et ad ultimum salsissimo claudentur mari. Hanc habebitis terram per fines suos in circuitu.
text_pt: Descerá também este limite ao longo do Jordão, e as suas saídas serão no Mar Salgado; esta vos será a terra, segundo os seus limites ao redor.
text_el: καὶ καταβήσεται τὰ ὅρια ἐπὶ τὸν Ιορδάνην καὶ ἔσται ἡ διέξοδος θάλασσα ἡ ἁλυκή αὕτη ἔσται ὑμῖν ἡ γῆ καὶ τὰ ὅρια αὐτῆς κύκλῳ

text_en: And Moses commanded the children of Israel , saying: This shall be the land which you shall possess by lot, and which the Lord has commanded to be given to the nine tribes , and to the half tribe .
text_la: Præcepitque Moyses filiis Israël, dicens : Hæc erit terra, quam possidebitis sorte, et quam jussit Dominus dari novem tribubus, et dimidiæ tribui.
text_pt: E Moisés deu ordem aos filhos de Israel, dizendo: Esta é a terra que herdareis por sorte, a qual o Senhor mandou dar às nove tribos e à meia tribo.
text_el: καὶ ἐνετείλατο Μωυσῆς τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ λέγων αὕτη ἡ γῆ ἣν κατακληρονομήσετε αὐτὴν μετὰ κλήρου ὃν τρόπον συνέταξεν κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ δοῦναι αὐτὴν ταῖς ἐννέα φυλαῖς καὶ τῷ ἡμίσει φυλῆς Μανασση

text_en: For the tribe of the children of Ruben by their families , and the tribe of the children of Gad according to the number of their kindreds, and half of the tribe of Manasses ,
text_la: Tribus enim filiorum Ruben per familias suas, et tribus filiorum Gad juxta cognationum numerum, media quoque tribus Manasse,
text_pt: Porque a tribo dos filhos dos rubenitas, segundo a casa de seus pais, e a tribo dos filhos dos gaditas, segundo a casa de seus pais, já receberam; também a meia tribo de Manassés recebeu a sua herança.
text_el: ὅτι ἔλαβεν φυλὴ υἱῶν Ρουβην καὶ φυλὴ υἱῶν Γαδ κατ' οἴκους πατριῶν αὐτῶν καὶ τὸ ἥμισυ φυλῆς Μανασση ἀπέλαβον τοὺς κλήρους αὐτῶν

text_en: that is, two tribes and a half, have received their portion beyond the Jordan over against Jericho at the east side.
text_la: id est, duæ semis tribus, acceperunt partem suam trans Jordanem contra Jericho ad orientalem plagam.
text_pt: Já duas tribos e meia tribo receberam a sua herança aquém do Jordão, na direção de Jericó, do lado do oriente, ao nascente.
text_el: δύο φυλαὶ καὶ ἥμισυ φυλῆς ἔλαβον τοὺς κλήρους αὐτῶν πέραν τοῦ Ιορδάνου κατὰ Ιεριχω ἀπὸ νότου κατ' ἀνατολάς

text_en: And the Lord said to Moses :
text_la: Et ait Dominus ad Moysen:
text_pt: Falou mais o Senhor a Moisés, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν λέγων

text_en: These are the names of the men , that shall divide the land unto you: Eleazar the priest , and Joshua the son of Nun ,
text_la: Hæc sunt nomina virorum qui terram vobis divident, Eleazar sacerdos, et Josue filius Nun,
text_pt: Estes são os nomes dos homens que vos repartirão a terra por herança: Eleazar, o sacerdote, e Josué, filho de Num.
text_el: ταῦτα τὰ ὀνόματα τῶν ἀνδρῶν οἳ κληρονομήσουσιν ὑμῖν τὴν γῆν Ελεαζαρ ὁ ἱερεὺς καὶ Ἰησοῦς ὁ τοῦ Ναυη

text_en: and one prince of every tribe ,
text_la: et singuli principes de tribubus singulis,
text_pt: Tomareis mais de cada tribo um príncipe, para repartir a terra em herança.
text_el: καὶ ἄρχοντα ἕνα ἐκ φυλῆς λήμψεσθε κατακληρονομῆσαι ὑμῖν τὴν γῆν

text_en: whose names are these: Of the tribe of Juda , Caleb the son of Jephone .
text_la: quorum ista sunt vocabula. De tribu Juda, Caleb filius Jephone.
text_pt: E estes são os nomes dos homens: Da tribo de Judá, Calebe, filho de Jefoné;
text_el: καὶ ταῦτα τὰ ὀνόματα τῶν ἀνδρῶν τῆς φυλῆς Ιουδα Χαλεβ υἱὸς Ιεφοννη

text_en: Of the tribe of Simeon , Samuel the son of Ammiud.
text_la: De tribu Simeon, Samuel filius Ammiud.
text_pt: E, da tribo dos filhos de Simeão, Samuel, filho de Amiúde;
text_el: τῆς φυλῆς Συμεων Σαλαμιηλ υἱὸς Εμιουδ

text_en: Of the tribe of Benjamin , Elidad the son of Chaselon.
text_la: De tribu Benjamin, Elidad filius Chaselon.
text_pt: Da tribo de Benjamim, Elidade, filho de Quislom;
text_el: τῆς φυλῆς Βενιαμιν Ελδαδ υἱὸς Χασλων

text_en: Of the tribe of the children of Dan , Bocci the son of Jogli.
text_la: De tribu filiorum Dan, Bocci filius Jogli.
text_pt: E, da tribo dos filhos de Dã, o príncipe Buqui, filho de Jogli;
text_el: τῆς φυλῆς Δαν ἄρχων Βακχιρ υἱὸς Εγλι

text_en: Of the children of Joseph of the tribe of Manasses , Hanniel the son of Ephod.
text_la: Filiorum Joseph de tribu Manasse, Hanniel filius Ephod.
text_pt: Dos filhos de José, da tribo dos filhos de Manassés, o príncipe Haniel, filho de Éfode;
text_el: τῶν υἱῶν Ιωσηφ φυλῆς υἱῶν Μανασση ἄρχων Ανιηλ υἱὸς Ουφι

text_en: Of the tribe of Ephraim, Camuel the son of Sephtan.
text_la: De tribu Ephraim, Camuel filius Sephthan.
text_pt: E, da tribo dos filhos de Efraim, o príncipe Quemuel, filho de Siftã;
text_el: τῆς φυλῆς υἱῶν Εφραιμ ἄρχων Καμουηλ υἱὸς Σαβαθα

text_en: Of the tribe of Zabulon , Elisaphan the son of Pharnach.
text_la: De tribu Zabulon, Elisaphan filius Pharnach.
text_pt: E, da tribo dos filhos de Zebulom, o príncipe Elizafã, filho de Parnaque;
text_el: τῆς φυλῆς Ζαβουλων ἄρχων Ελισαφαν υἱὸς Φαρναχ

text_en: Of the tribe of Issachar , Phaltiel the prince, the son of Ozan.
text_la: De tribu Issachar, dux Phaltiel filius Ozan.
text_pt: E, da tribo dos filhos de Issacar, o príncipe Paltiel, filho de Azã;
text_el: τῆς φυλῆς υἱῶν Ισσαχαρ ἄρχων Φαλτιηλ υἱὸς Οζα

text_en: Of the tribe of Aser , Ahiud the son of Salomi.
text_la: De tribu Aser, Ahiud filius Salomi.
text_pt: E, da tribo dos filhos de Aser, o príncipe Aiúde, filho de Selomi;
text_el: τῆς φυλῆς υἱῶν Ασηρ ἄρχων Αχιωρ υἱὸς Σελεμι

text_en: Of the tribe of Nephtali : Phedael the son of Ammiud.
text_la: De tribu Nephthali, Phedaël filius Ammiud.
text_pt: E, da tribo dos filhos de Naftali, o príncipe Pedael, filho de Amiúde.
text_el: τῆς φυλῆς Νεφθαλι ἄρχων Φαδαηλ υἱὸς Βεναμιουδ

text_en: These are they whom the Lord has commanded to divide the land of Chanaan to the children of Israel .
text_la: Hi sunt, quibus præcepit Dominus ut dividerent filiis Israël terram Chanaan.
text_pt: Estes são aqueles a quem o Senhor ordenou, que repartissem as heranças aos filhos de Israel na terra de Canaã.
text_el: οὗτοι οἷς ἐνετείλατο κύριος καταμερίσαι τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ ἐν γῇ Χανααν

text_en: And the Lord spoke these things also to Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan , over against Jericho :
text_la: Hæc quoque locutus est Dominus ad Moysen in campes tribus Moab supra Jordanem, contra Jericho:
text_pt: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés nas campinas de Moabe, junto ao Jordão na direção de Jericó, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν ἐπὶ δυσμῶν Μωαβ παρὰ τὸν Ιορδάνην κατὰ Ιεριχω λέγων

text_en: Command the children of Israel that they give to the Levites out of their possessions ,
text_la: Præcipe filiis Israël ut dent Levitis de possessionibus suis
text_pt: Dá ordem aos filhos de Israel que, da herança da sua possessão, dêem cidades aos levitas, em que habitem; e também aos levitas dareis arrabaldes ao redor delas.
text_el: σύνταξον τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ καὶ δώσουσιν τοῖς Λευίταις ἀπὸ τῶν κλήρων κατασχέσεως αὐτῶν πόλεις κατοικεῖν καὶ τὰ προάστεια τῶν πόλεων κύκλῳ αὐτῶν δώσουσιν τοῖς Λευίταις

text_en: cities to dwell in, and their suburbs round about: that they may abide in the towns, and the suburbs may be for them cattle and beasts:
text_la: urbes ad habitandum, et suburbana earum per circuitum : ut ipsi in oppidis maneant, et suburbana sint pecoribus ac jumentis:
text_pt: E terão estas cidades para habitá-las; porém os seus arrabaldes serão o seu gado, e para os seus bens, e para todos os seus animais.
text_el: καὶ ἔσονται αὐτοῖς αἱ πόλεις κατοικεῖν καὶ τὰ ἀφορίσματα αὐτῶν ἔσται τοῖς κτήνεσιν αὐτῶν καὶ πᾶσι τοῖς τετράποσιν αὐτῶν

text_en: Which suburbs shall reach from the walls of the cities outward, a thousand paces on every side:
text_la: quæ a muris civitatum forinsecus, per circuitum, mille passuum spatio tendentur.
text_pt: E os arrabaldes das cidades, que dareis aos levitas, desde o muro da cidade para fora, serão de mil côvados em redor.
text_el: καὶ τὰ συγκυροῦντα τῶν πόλεων ἃς δώσετε τοῖς Λευίταις ἀπὸ τείχους τῆς πόλεως καὶ ἔξω δισχιλίους πήχεις κύκλῳ

text_en: Toward the east shall be two thousand cubits: and toward the south in like manner shall be two thousand cubits: toward the sea also, which looks to the west, shall be the same extent: and the north side shall be bounded with the like limits. And the cities shall be in the midst, and the suburbs without.
text_la: Contra orientem duo millia erunt cubiti, et contra meridiem similiter erunt duo millia : ad mare quoque, quod respicit ad occidentem, eadem mensura erit, et septentrionalis plaga æquali termino finietur, eruntque urbes in medio, et foris suburbana.
text_pt: E de fora da cidade, do lado do oriente, medireis dois mil côvados, e do lado do sul, dois mil côvados, e do lado do ocidente dois mil côvados, e do lado do norte dois mil côvados, e a cidade no meio; isto terão por arrabaldes das cidades.
text_el: καὶ μετρήσεις ἔξω τῆς πόλεως τὸ κλίτος τὸ πρὸς ἀνατολὰς δισχιλίους πήχεις καὶ τὸ κλίτος τὸ πρὸς λίβα δισχιλίους πήχεις καὶ τὸ κλίτος τὸ πρὸς θάλασσαν δισχιλίους πήχεις καὶ τὸ κλίτος τὸ πρὸς βορρᾶν δισχιλίους πήχεις καὶ ἡ πόλις μέσον τούτου ἔσται ὑμῖν καὶ τὰ ὅμορα τῶν πόλεων

text_en: And among the cities, which you shall give to the Levites , six shall be separated for refuge to fugitives , that he who has shed blood may flee to them: and besides these there shall be other forty-two cities,
text_la: De ipsis autem oppidis, quæ Levitis dabitis, sex erunt in fugitivorum auxilia separata, ut fugiat ad ea qui fuderit sanguinem : et exceptis his, alia quadraginta duo oppida,
text_pt: Das cidades, pois, que dareis aos levitas, haverá seis cidades de refúgio, as quais dareis para que o homicida ali se acolha; e, além destas, lhes dareis quarenta e duas cidades.
text_el: καὶ τὰς πόλεις δώσετε τοῖς Λευίταις τὰς ἓξ πόλεις τῶν φυγαδευτηρίων ἃς δώσετε φεύγειν ἐκεῖ τῷ φονεύσαντι καὶ πρὸς ταύταις τεσσαράκοντα καὶ δύο πόλεις

text_en: that is, in all forty-eight with their suburbs.
text_la: id est, simul quadraginta octo cum suburbanis suis.
text_pt: Todas as cidades que dareis aos levitas serão quarenta e oito cidades, juntamente com os seus arrabaldes.
text_el: πάσας τὰς πόλεις δώσετε τοῖς Λευίταις τεσσαράκοντα καὶ ὀκτὼ πόλεις ταύτας καὶ τὰ προάστεια αὐτῶν

text_en: And of these cities which shall be given out of the possessions of the children of Israel , from them that have more, more shall be taken: and from them that have less, fewer. Each shall give towns to the Levites according to the extent of their inheritance.
text_la: Ipsæque urbes, quæ dabuntur de possessionibus filiorum Israël, ab his qui plus habent, plures auferentur : et qui minus, pauciores : singuli juxta mensuram hæreditatis suæ dabunt oppida Levitis.
text_pt: E quanto às cidades que derdes da herança dos filhos de Israel, do que tiver muito tomareis muito, e do que tiver pouco tomareis pouco; cada um dará das suas cidades aos levitas, segundo a herança que herdar.
text_el: καὶ τὰς πόλεις ἃς δώσετε ἀπὸ τῆς κατασχέσεως υἱῶν Ισραηλ ἀπὸ τῶν τὰ πολλὰ πολλὰ καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν ἐλαττόνων ἐλάττω ἕκαστος κατὰ τὴν κληρονομίαν αὐτοῦ ἣν κληρονομήσουσιν δώσουσιν ἀπὸ τῶν πόλεων τοῖς Λευίταις

text_en: The Lord said to Moses :
text_la: Ait Dominus ad Moysen:
text_pt: Falou mais o Senhor a Moisés, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν λέγων

text_en: Speak to the children of Israel , and you shall say to them: When you shall have passed over the Jordan into the land of Chanaan ,
text_la: Loquere filiis Israël, et dices ad eos : Quando transgressi fueritis Jordanem in terram Chanaan,
text_pt: Fala aos filhos de Israel, e dize-lhes: Quando passardes o Jordão à terra de Canaã,
text_el: λάλησον τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ καὶ ἐρεῖς πρὸς αὐτούς ὑμεῖς διαβαίνετε τὸν Ιορδάνην εἰς γῆν Χανααν

text_en: determine what cities shall be for the refuge of fugitives , who have shed blood against their will .
text_la: decernite quæ urbes esse debeant in præsidia fugitivorum, qui nolentes sanguinem fuderint:
text_pt: Fazei com que vos estejam à mão cidades que vos sirvam de cidades de refúgio, para que ali se acolha o homicida que ferir a alguma alma por engano.
text_el: καὶ διαστελεῖτε ὑμῖν αὐτοῖς πόλεις φυγαδευτήρια ἔσται ὑμῖν φυγεῖν ἐκεῖ τὸν φονευτήν πᾶς ὁ πατάξας ψυχὴν ἀκουσίως

text_en: And when the fugitive shall be in them, the kinsman of him that is slain may not have power to kill him, until he stand before the multitude, and his cause be judged.
text_la: in quibus cum fuerit profugus, cognatus occisi non poterit eum occidere, donec stet in conspectu multitudinis, et causa illius judicetur.
text_pt: E estas cidades vos serão por refúgio do vingador do sangue; para que o homicida não morra, até que seja apresentado à congregação para julgamento.
text_el: καὶ ἔσονται αἱ πόλεις ὑμῖν φυγαδευτήρια ἀπὸ ἀγχιστεύοντος τὸ αἷμα καὶ οὐ μὴ ἀποθάνῃ ὁ φονεύων ἕως ἂν στῇ ἔναντι τῆς συναγωγῆς εἰς κρίσιν

text_en: And of those cities , that are separated for the refuge of fugitives,
text_la: De ipsis autem urbibus, quæ ad fugitivorum subsidia separantur,
text_pt: E das cidades que derdes haverá seis cidades de refúgio para vós.
text_el: καὶ αἱ πόλεις ἃς δώσετε τὰς ἓξ πόλεις φυγαδευτήρια ἔσονται ὑμῖν

text_en: three shall be beyond the Jordan , and three in the land of Chanaan ,
text_la: tres erunt trans Jordanem, et tres in terra Chanaan,
text_pt: Três destas cidades dareis além do Jordão, e três destas cidades dareis na terra de Canaã; cidades de refúgio serão.
text_el: τὰς τρεῖς πόλεις δώσετε ἐν τῷ πέραν τοῦ Ιορδάνου καὶ τὰς τρεῖς πόλεις δώσετε ἐν γῇ Χανααν

text_en: as well for the children of Israel as for strangers and sojourners, that he may flee to them, who has shed blood against his will .
text_la: tam filiis Israël quam advenis atque peregrinis, ut confugiat ad eas qui nolens sanguinem fuderit.
text_pt: Serão por refúgio estas seis cidades para os filhos de Israel, e para o estrangeiro, e para o que se hospedar no meio deles, para que ali se acolha aquele que matar a alguém por engano.
text_el: φυγάδιον ἔσται τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ καὶ τῷ προσηλύτῳ καὶ τῷ παροίκῳ τῷ ἐν ὑμῖν ἔσονται αἱ πόλεις αὗται εἰς φυγαδευτήριον φυγεῖν ἐκεῖ παντὶ πατάξαντι ψυχὴν ἀκουσίως

text_en: If any man strike with iron, and he die that was struck: he shall be guilty of murder , and he himself shall die.
text_la: Si quis ferro percusserit, et mortuus fuerit qui percussus est, reus erit homicidii, et ipse morietur.
text_pt: Porém, se o ferir com instrumento de ferro e morrer, homicida é; certamente o homicida morrerá.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ ἐν σκεύει σιδήρου πατάξῃ αὐτόν καὶ τελευτήσῃ φονευτής ἐστιν θανάτῳ θανατούσθω ὁ φονευτής

text_en: If he throw a stone, and he that is struck die: he shall be punished in the same manner .
text_la: Si lapidem jecerit, et ictus occubuerit, similiter punietur.
text_pt: Ou, se lhe ferir com uma pedrada, de que possa morrer, e morrer, homicida é; certamente o homicida morrerá.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ ἐν λίθῳ ἐκ χειρός ἐν ᾧ ἀποθανεῖται ἐν αὐτῷ πατάξῃ αὐτόν καὶ ἀποθάνῃ φονευτής ἐστιν θανάτῳ θανατούσθω ὁ φονευτής

text_en: If he that is struck with wood die: he shall be revenged by the blood of him that struck him.
text_la: Si ligno percussus interierit, percussoris sanguine vindicabitur.
text_pt: Ou, se o ferir com instrumento de pau que tiver na mão, de que possa morrer, e ele morrer, homicida é; certamente morrerá o homicida.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ ἐν σκεύει ξυλίνῳ ἐκ χειρός ἐξ οὗ ἀποθανεῖται ἐν αὐτῷ πατάξῃ αὐτόν καὶ ἀποθάνῃ φονευτής ἐστιν θανάτῳ θανατούσθω ὁ φονευτής

text_en: The kinsman of him that was slain , shall kill the murderer: as soon as he apprehends him, he shall kill him.
text_la: Propinquus occisi, homicidam interficiet : statim ut apprehenderit eum, interficiet.
text_pt: O vingador do sangue matará o homicida; encontrando-o, matá-lo-á.
text_el: ὁ ἀγχιστεύων τὸ αἷμα οὗτος ἀποκτενεῖ τὸν φονεύσαντα ὅταν συναντήσῃ αὐτῷ οὗτος ἀποκτενεῖ αὐτόν

text_en: If through hatred any one push a man , or fling anything at him with ill design:
text_la: Si per odium quis hominem impulerit, vel jecerit quippiam in eum per insidias:
text_pt: Se também o empurrar com ódio, ou com mau intento lançar contra ele alguma coisa, e morrer;
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ δι' ἔχθραν ὤσῃ αὐτὸν καὶ ἐπιρρίψῃ ἐπ' αὐτὸν πᾶν σκεῦος ἐξ ἐνέδρου καὶ ἀποθάνῃ

text_en: Or being his enemy, strike him with his hand, and he die: the striker shall be guilty of murder : the kinsman of him that was slain as soon as he finds him, shall kill him.
text_la: aut cum esset inimicus, manu percusserit, et ille mortuus fuerit : percussor homicidii reus erit : cognatus occisi statim ut invenerit eum, jugulabit.
text_pt: Ou por inimizade o ferir com a sua mão, e morrer, certamente morrerá aquele que o ferir; homicida é; o vingador do sangue, encontrando o homicida, o matará.
text_el: ἢ διὰ μῆνιν ἐπάταξεν αὐτὸν τῇ χειρί καὶ ἀποθάνῃ θανάτῳ θανατούσθω ὁ πατάξας φονευτής ἐστιν θανάτῳ θανατούσθω ὁ φονεύων ὁ ἀγχιστεύων τὸ αἷμα ἀποκτενεῖ τὸν φονεύσαντα ἐν τῷ συναντῆσαι αὐτῷ

text_en: But if by chance medley, and without hatred ,
text_la: Quod si fortuitu, et absque odio
text_pt: Porém, se o empurrar subitamente, sem inimizade, ou contra ele lançar algum instrumento sem intenção;
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ ἐξάπινα οὐ δι' ἔχθραν ὤσῃ αὐτὸν ἢ ἐπιρρίψῃ ἐπ' αὐτὸν πᾶν σκεῦος οὐκ ἐξ ἐνέδρου

text_en: and enmity , he do any of these things,
text_la: et inimicitiis quidquam horum fecerit,
text_pt: Ou, sobre ele deixar cair alguma pedra sem o ver, de que possa morrer, e ele morrer, sem que fosse seu inimigo nem procurasse o seu mal;
text_el: ἢ παντὶ λίθῳ ἐν ᾧ ἀποθανεῖται ἐν αὐτῷ οὐκ εἰδώς καὶ ἐπιπέσῃ ἐπ' αὐτόν καὶ ἀποθάνῃ αὐτὸς δὲ οὐκ ἐχθρὸς αὐτοῦ ἦν οὐδὲ ζητῶν κακοποιῆσαι αὐτόν

text_en: and this be proved in the hearing of the people, and the cause be debated between him that struck, and the next of kin :
text_la: et hoc audiente populo fuerit comprobatum, atque inter percussorem et propinquum sanguinis quæstio ventilata:
text_pt: Então a congregação julgará entre aquele que feriu e o vingador do sangue, segundo estas leis.
text_el: καὶ κρινεῖ ἡ συναγωγὴ ἀνὰ μέσον τοῦ πατάξαντος καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον τοῦ ἀγχιστεύοντος τὸ αἷμα κατὰ τὰ κρίματα ταῦτα

text_en: The innocent shall be delivered from the hand of the revenger, and shall be brought back by sentence into the city, to which he had fled, and he shall abide there until the death of the high priest , that is anointed with the holy oil .
text_la: liberabitur innocens de ultoris manu, et reducetur per sententiam in urbem, ad quam confugerat, manebitque ibi, donec sacerdos magnus, qui oleo sancto unctus est, moriatur.
text_pt: E a congregação livrará o homicida da mão do vingador do sangue, e a congregação o fará voltar à cidade do seu refúgio, onde se tinha acolhido; e ali ficará até à morte do sumo sacerdote, a quem ungiram com o santo óleo.
text_el: καὶ ἐξελεῖται ἡ συναγωγὴ τὸν φονεύσαντα ἀπὸ τοῦ ἀγχιστεύοντος τὸ αἷμα καὶ ἀποκαταστήσουσιν αὐτὸν ἡ συναγωγὴ εἰς τὴν πόλιν τοῦ φυγαδευτηρίου αὐτοῦ οὗ κατέφυγεν καὶ κατοικήσει ἐκεῖ ἕως ἂν ἀποθάνῃ ὁ ἱερεὺς ὁ μέγας ὃν ἔχρισαν αὐτὸν τῷ ἐλαίῳ τῷ ἁγίῳ

text_en: If the murderer be found without the limits of the cities that are appointed for the banished,
text_la: Si interfector extra fines urbium, quæ exulibus deputatæ sunt,
text_pt: Porém, se de alguma maneira o homicida sair dos limites da cidade de refúgio, onde se tinha acolhido,
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ ἐξόδῳ ἐξέλθῃ ὁ φονεύσας τὰ ὅρια τῆς πόλεως εἰς ἣν κατέφυγεν ἐκεῖ

text_en: and be struck by him that is the avenger of blood: he shall not be guilty that killed him.
text_la: fuerit inventus, et percussus ab eo qui ultor est sanguinis : absque noxa erit qui eum occiderit.
text_pt: E o vingador do sangue o achar fora dos limites da cidade de seu refúgio, e o matar, não será culpado do sangue.
text_el: καὶ εὕρῃ αὐτὸν ὁ ἀγχιστεύων τὸ αἷμα ἔξω τῶν ὁρίων τῆς πόλεως καταφυγῆς αὐτοῦ καὶ φονεύσῃ ὁ ἀγχιστεύων τὸ αἷμα τὸν φονεύσαντα οὐκ ἔνοχός ἐστιν

text_en: For the fugitive ought to have stayed in the city until the death of the high priest : and after he is dead, then shall the manslayer return to his own country.
text_la: Debuerat enim profugus usque ad mortem pontificis in urbe residere. Postquam autem ille obierit, homicida revertetur in terram suam.
text_pt: Pois o homicida deverá ficar na cidade do seu refúgio, até à morte do sumo sacerdote; mas, depois da morte do sumo sacerdote, o homicida voltará à terra da sua possessão.
text_el: ἐν γὰρ τῇ πόλει τῆς καταφυγῆς κατοικείτω ἕως ἂν ἀποθάνῃ ὁ ἱερεὺς ὁ μέγας καὶ μετὰ τὸ ἀποθανεῖν τὸν ἱερέα τὸν μέγαν ἐπαναστραφήσεται ὁ φονεύσας εἰς τὴν γῆν τῆς κατασχέσεως αὐτοῦ

text_en: These things shall be perpetual, and for an ordinance in all your dwellings.
text_la: Hæc sempiterna erunt, et legitima in cunctis habitationibus vestris.
text_pt: E estas coisas vos serão por estatuto de direito às vossas gerações, em todas as vossas habitações.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ταῦτα ὑμῖν εἰς δικαίωμα κρίματος εἰς τὰς γενεὰς ὑμῶν ἐν πάσαις ταῖς κατοικίαις ὑμῶν

text_en: The murderer shall be punished by witnesses: none shall be condemned upon the evidence of one man .
text_la: Homicida sub testibus punietur : ad unius testimonium nullus condemnabitur.
text_pt: Todo aquele que matar alguma pessoa, conforme depoimento de testemunhas, será morto; mas uma só testemunha não testemunhará contra alguém, para que morra.
text_el: πᾶς πατάξας ψυχήν διὰ μαρτύρων φονεύσεις τὸν φονεύσαντα καὶ μάρτυς εἷς οὐ μαρτυρήσει ἐπὶ ψυχὴν ἀποθανεῖν

text_en: You shall not take money of him that is guilty of blood, but he shall die forthwith.
text_la: Non accipietis pretium ab eo qui reus est sanguinis, statim et ipse morietur.
text_pt: E não recebereis resgate pela vida do homicida que é culpado de morte; pois certamente morrerá.
text_el: καὶ οὐ λήμψεσθε λύτρα περὶ ψυχῆς παρὰ τοῦ φονεύσαντος τοῦ ἐνόχου ὄντος ἀναιρεθῆναι θανάτῳ γὰρ θανατωθήσεται

text_en: The banished and fugitives before the death of the high priest may by no means return into their own cities.
text_la: Exules et profugi ante mortem pontificis nullo modo in urbes suas reverti poterunt,
text_pt: Também não tomareis resgate por aquele que se acolher à sua cidade de refúgio, para tornar a habitar na terra, até à morte do sumo sacerdote.
text_el: οὐ λήμψεσθε λύτρα τοῦ φυγεῖν εἰς πόλιν τῶν φυγαδευτηρίων τοῦ πάλιν κατοικεῖν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ἕως ἂν ἀποθάνῃ ὁ ἱερεὺς ὁ μέγας

text_en: Defile not the land of your habitation, which is stained with the blood of the innocent: neither can it otherwise be expiated, but by his blood that has shed the blood of another.
text_la: ne polluatis terram habitationis vestræ, quæ insontium cruore maculatur : nec aliter expiari potest, nisi per ejus sanguinem, qui alterius sanguinem fuderit.
text_pt: Assim não profanareis a terra em que estais; porque o sangue faz profanar a terra; e nenhuma expiação se fará pela terra por causa do sangue que nela se derramar, senão com o sangue daquele que o derramou.
text_el: καὶ οὐ μὴ φονοκτονήσητε τὴν γῆν εἰς ἣν ὑμεῖς κατοικεῖτε τὸ γὰρ αἷμα τοῦτο φονοκτονεῖ τὴν γῆν καὶ οὐκ ἐξιλασθήσεται ἡ γῆ ἀπὸ τοῦ αἵματος τοῦ ἐκχυθέντος ἐπ' αὐτῆς ἀλλ' ἐπὶ τοῦ αἵματος τοῦ ἐκχέοντος

text_en: And thus shall your possession be cleansed, myself abiding with you. For I am the Lord that dwell among the children of Israel .
text_la: Atque ita emundabitur vestra possessio me commorante vobiscum. Ego enim sum Dominus qui habito inter filios Israël.
text_pt: Não contaminareis pois a terra na qual vós habitais, no meio da qual eu habito; pois eu, o Senhor, habito no meio dos filhos de Israel.
text_el: καὶ οὐ μιανεῖτε τὴν γῆν ἐφ' ἧς κατοικεῖτε ἐπ' αὐτῆς ἐφ' ἧς ἐγὼ κατασκηνώσω ἐν ὑμῖν ἐγὼ γάρ εἰμι κύριος κατασκηνῶν ἐν μέσῳ τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ

text_en: And the princes of the families of Galaad, the son of Machir, the son of Manasses , of the stock of the children of Joseph , came and spoke to Moses before the princes of Israel , and said:
text_la: Accesserunt autem et principes familiarum Galaad filii Machir filii Manasse, de stirpe filiorum Joseph : locutique sunt Moysi coram principibus Israël, atque dixerunt:
text_pt: E chegaram os chefes dos pais da família de Gileade, filho de Maquir, filho de Manassés, das famílias dos filhos de José, e falaram diante de Moisés, e diante dos príncipes, chefes dos pais dos filhos de Israel,
text_el: καὶ προσῆλθον οἱ ἄρχοντες φυλῆς υἱῶν Γαλααδ υἱοῦ Μαχιρ υἱοῦ Μανασση ἐκ τῆς φυλῆς υἱῶν Ιωσηφ καὶ ἐλάλησαν ἔναντι Μωυσῆ καὶ ἔναντι Ελεαζαρ τοῦ ἱερέως καὶ ἔναντι τῶν ἀρχόντων οἴκων πατριῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ

text_en: The Lord has commanded you, my lord, that you should divide the land by lot to the children of Israel , and that you should give to the daughters of Salphaad our brother the possession due to their father:
text_la: Tibi domino nostro præcepit Dominus ut terram sorte divideres filiis Israël, et ut filiabus Salphaad fratris nostri dares possessionem debitam patri:
text_pt: E disseram: O SENHOR mandou a meu senhor que, por sorte, desse esta terra em herança aos filhos de Israel; e a meu senhor foi ordenado pelo SENHOR, que a herança do nosso irmão Zelofeade se desse às suas filhas.
text_el: καὶ εἶπαν τῷ κυρίῳ ἡμῶν ἐνετείλατο κύριος ἀποδοῦναι τὴν γῆν τῆς κληρονομίας ἐν κλήρῳ τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ καὶ τῷ κυρίῳ συνέταξεν κύριος δοῦναι τὴν κληρονομίαν Σαλπααδ τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ ἡμῶν ταῖς θυγατράσιν αὐτοῦ

text_en: Now if men of another tribe take them to wives , their possession will follow them, and being transferred to another tribe , will be a diminishing of our inheritance.
text_la: quas si alterius tribus homines uxores acceperint, sequetur possessio sua, et translata ad aliam tribum, de nostra hæreditate minuetur.
text_pt: E, casando-se elas com alguns dos filhos das outras tribos dos filhos de Israel, então a sua herança será diminuída da herança de nossos pais, e acrescentada à herança da tribo a que vierem a pertencer; assim se tirará da sorte da nossa herança.
text_el: καὶ ἔσονται ἑνὶ τῶν φυλῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ γυναῖκες καὶ ἀφαιρεθήσεται ὁ κλῆρος αὐτῶν ἐκ τῆς κατασχέσεως τῶν πατέρων ἡμῶν καὶ προστεθήσεται εἰς κληρονομίαν τῆς φυλῆς οἷς ἂν γένωνται γυναῖκες καὶ ἐκ τοῦ κλήρου τῆς κληρονομίας ἡμῶν ἀφαιρεθήσεται

text_en: And so it shall cone to pass, that when the jubilee , the is, the fiftieth year of remission, has come, the distribution made by the lots shall be confounded, and the possession of the one shall pass to the others.
text_la: Atque ita fiet, ut cum jubilæus, id est, quinquagesimus annus remissionis advenerit, confundatur sortium distributio, et aliorum possessio ad alios transeat.
text_pt: Vindo também o ano do jubileu dos filhos de Israel, a sua herança será acrescentada à herança da tribo daqueles com que se casarem; assim a sua herança será tirada da herança da tribo de nossos pais.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ γένηται ἡ ἄφεσις τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ καὶ προστεθήσεται ἡ κληρονομία αὐτῶν ἐπὶ τὴν κληρονομίαν τῆς φυλῆς οἷς ἂν γένωνται γυναῖκες καὶ ἀπὸ τῆς κληρονομίας φυλῆς πατριᾶς ἡμῶν ἀφαιρεθήσεται ἡ κληρονομία αὐτῶν

text_en: Moses answered the children of Israel , and said by the command of the Lord : The tribe of the children of Joseph has spoken rightly.
text_la: Respondit Moyses filiis Israël, et Domino præcipiente ait : Recte tribus filiorum Joseph locuta est.
text_pt: Então Moisés deu ordem aos filhos de Israel, segundo o mandado do Senhor, dizendo: A tribo dos filhos de José fala o que é justo.
text_el: καὶ ἐνετείλατο Μωυσῆς τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ διὰ προστάγματος κυρίου λέγων οὕτως φυλὴ υἱῶν Ιωσηφ λέγουσιν

text_en: And this is the law promulgated by the Lord touching the daughters of Salphaad: Let them marry to whom they will, only so that it be to men of their own tribe .
text_la: Et hæc lex super filiabus Salphaad a Domino promulgata est : nubant quibus volunt, tantum ut suæ tribus hominibus:
text_pt: Isto é o que o Senhor mandou acerca das filhas de Zelofeade, dizendo: Sejam por mulheres a quem bem parecer aos seus olhos, contanto que se casem na família da tribo de seu pai.
text_el: τοῦτο τὸ ῥῆμα ὃ συνέταξεν κύριος ταῖς θυγατράσιν Σαλπααδ λέγων οὗ ἀρέσκει ἐναντίον αὐτῶν ἔστωσαν γυναῖκες πλὴν ἐκ τοῦ δήμου τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτῶν ἔστωσαν γυναῖκες

text_en: Lest the possession of the children of Israel be mingled from tribe to tribe . For all men shall marry wives of their own tribe and kindred:
text_la: ne commisceatur possessio filiorum Israël de tribu in tribum. Omnes enim viri ducent uxores de tribu et cognatione sua:
text_pt: Assim a herança dos filhos de Israel não passará de tribo em tribo; pois os filhos de Israel se chegarão cada um à herança da tribo de seus pais.
text_el: καὶ οὐχὶ περιστραφήσεται κληρονομία τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ ἀπὸ φυλῆς ἐπὶ φυλήν ὅτι ἕκαστος ἐν τῇ κληρονομίᾳ τῆς φυλῆς τῆς πατριᾶς αὐτοῦ προσκολληθήσονται οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ

text_en: And all women shall take husbands of the same tribe : that the inheritance may remain in the families .
text_la: et cunctæ feminæ de eadem tribu maritos accipient : ut hæreditas permaneat in familiis,
text_pt: E qualquer filha que herdar alguma herança das tribos dos filhos de Israel se casará com alguém da família da tribo de seu pai; para que os filhos de Israel possuam cada um a herança de seus pais.
text_el: καὶ πᾶσα θυγάτηρ ἀγχιστεύουσα κληρονομίαν ἐκ τῶν φυλῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ ἑνὶ τῶν ἐκ τοῦ δήμου τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτῆς ἔσονται γυναῖκες ἵνα ἀγχιστεύσωσιν οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ ἕκαστος τὴν κληρονομίαν τὴν πατρικὴν αὐτοῦ

text_en: And that the tribes be not mingled one with another, but remain so
text_la: nec sibi misceantur tribus, sed ita maneant
text_pt: Assim a herança não passará de uma tribo a outra; pois as tribos dos filhos de Israel se chegarão cada uma à sua herança.
text_el: καὶ οὐ περιστραφήσεται κλῆρος ἐκ φυλῆς ἐπὶ φυλὴν ἑτέραν ἀλλὰ ἕκαστος ἐν τῇ κληρονομίᾳ αὐτοῦ προσκολληθήσονται οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ

text_en: as they were separated by the Lord . And the daughters of Salphaad did as was commanded:
text_la: ut a Domino separatæ sunt. Feceruntque filiæ Salphaad ut fuerat imperatum:
text_pt: Como o Senhor ordenara a Moisés, assim fizeram as filhas de Zelofeade.
text_el: ὃν τρόπον συνέταξεν κύριος Μωυσῇ οὕτως ἐποίησαν θυγατέρες Σαλπααδ

text_en: And Maala, and Thersa, and Hegla, and Melcha, and Noa were married to the sons of their uncle by their father
text_la: et nupserunt Maala, et Thersa, et Hegla, et Melcha, et Noa, filiis patrui sui
text_pt: Pois Maalá, Tirza, Hogla, Milca e Noa, filhas de Zelofeade, se casaram com os filhos de seus tios.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένοντο Θερσα καὶ Εγλα καὶ Μελχα καὶ Νουα καὶ Μααλα θυγατέρες Σαλπααδ τοῖς ἀνεψιοῖς αὐτῶν

text_en: of the family of Manasses , who was the son of Joseph : and the possession that had been allotted to them, remained in the tribe and family of their father.
text_la: de familia Manasse, qui fuit filius Joseph : et possessio, quæ illis fuerat attributa, mansit in tribu et familia patris earum.
text_pt: E elas casaram-se nas famílias dos filhos de Manassés, filho de José; assim a sua herança ficou na tribo da família de seu pai.
text_el: ἐκ τοῦ δήμου τοῦ Μανασση υἱῶν Ιωσηφ ἐγενήθησαν γυναῖκες καὶ ἐγένετο ἡ κληρονομία αὐτῶν ἐπὶ τὴν φυλὴν δήμου τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτῶν

text_en: These are the commandments and judgment, which the Lord commanded by the hand of Moses to the children of Israel , in the plains of Moab upon the Jordan over against Jericho .
text_la: Hæc sunt mandata atque judicia, quæ mandavit Dominus per manum Moysi ad filios Israël, in campestribus Moab supra Jordanem contra Jericho.
text_pt: Estes são os mandamentos e os juízos que mandou o Senhor através de Moisés aos filhos de Israel nas campinas de Moabe, junto ao Jordão, na direção de Jericó.
text_el: αὗται αἱ ἐντολαὶ καὶ τὰ δικαιώματα καὶ τὰ κρίματα ἃ ἐνετείλατο κύριος ἐν χειρὶ Μωυσῆ ἐπὶ δυσμῶν Μωαβ ἐπὶ τοῦ Ιορδάνου κατὰ Ιεριχω
